tei:div.tei:p: sna tshogs/ 9) (219)3590 byebye rngonab/ /khye —steb/05 nga/zang dre)tshod nga// 3sa/ngas rgyas kyi mtshan dang sku dang che ba nyid kyi rnam grangs/ kyi ming / 3de bzhin gshegs/ pa/ so so'i ma'abyen kyi ming / 5sa/ngas/ rgyas/ kyi sa dang / mi mnyam nga dang / mnyam nga 'i phung ngo lnga dang /ye shes bzhi dang / sgu gsum sogs/ kyi ming / 5de ba'in gshegs pa/'i stobs bcu'i ming / 6nge ba'in gshegs pa 'i mi 'jigs pa/ bzhi'i ming / 7sa ngas rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi ming / 7de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ming / 8ma/ 'dres pa/'i dran pa nye bar gzhag nga gsu ma gyi ming / 10bsru/nga ba med pa bzhi'i ming / 10so so yang dag par rig nga/ bzhi'i ming / 111

mngon par shes pa lnga'i ming / 11mngon par shes pa drug gi skabs nas 'byung ba'i ming 12cho 'phrul gsum gyi ming / 13skyes bu chen ngo/'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ming / 14dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ming / 15—de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba mdo sde las byung ba'i ming 17dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cu'i ming / 20shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nang nas 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin kyi ming / 21byang chub sems dpa' spyi'i mtshan la sogs pa'i ming 27byang chub sems dpa/'a so so'i mtshan la sogs pa'i ming 28byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ming / 30byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs bcu gnyis kyi ming / 30byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcu'i ming / 31byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bcu'i ming / 31byang chub sems dpa'i mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i ming / 32byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi ming / 32mdo sde las byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan thog thog smos /pa/sde /miḥng rtenatsamabyang chub sems dpa'i sa'i ming 37mos pas spyod pa'i sa'i ming 37mos nga/sa spyod pa'i sa la chos spyod bcu'i ming / 38pha rol tu phyin pa/ bcu'i ming / 38bsdu ba'i dngos ngo/ bzhi'i ming / 38bslab pa gsum gyi ming / 382

stong nga/ nyid bco brgyad kyi ming / 39dran nga/ nye bar gzhag nga/ bzhi'i ming / 39yang dag nga/ra spong ba bzhi'i ming / 39rdzu 'phrul gyi zang nga bzhi'i ming / 40dbang ngo/ lnga6) :sgong / 41stobs lnga6) :)nga / 41byang chub kyi yan la ga bdun kyi ming / 41'phags pa/'i la ma yan lag brgyad kyi ming / 41rang sangs/ rgyas kyi rim nga/'i ming / ༷ 42nyan thos kyi gang zag ṅga rim nga 'i ming / 42nyan thos so so 'i ming / 43nyan thos/ kyi yo/na tan kyi ming / 44sbya ngas nga 'i yo/na tan bcu gnyis kyi ming / 45nyan thos kyi sa/'i ming / 46rjes su dran nga drug be+e ming / 46dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba bgrang ba'i rim nga 'i ming / 46'phags nga 'i bden nga ba'i rnam nga bcu drug tu phye ba'i ming / gonges/ nga/ra 'byed nga 'i cha dang ma/thun nga 'i rim nga/'i ming / gosems kyi ska da cig ma bcu drug gi ming / 50shegs/ nga bsres:re :)nga / 50(bzug pa/stug:re :)pang / 51jeg pa'i rnam nga 'i ming / 51dbang ngo/'i rim nga 'i ming / ༷ 511sdebakabasgyu /snga:re :)nga / 513

dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ming / 52chos kyi 'khor lo'i ming 53dam pa'i chos kyi ming / 54zhal nas gsungs pa dang tshig le'ur byas pa la sogs pa'i ming 57bsam gtan bzhi la sogs pa'i ming — 58snyoms par 'jug pa'i ming 59tshad med bzhi'i rgyud kyi ming / 60rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi ming / 60zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad kyi ming / 62zad par gyi skye mched bcu'i ming / 65rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi ming / 65snostezug nga pa/stuno:re :sgopa 65shes rab rnam pa gsum gyi ming / 66rig pa'i gnas lnga'i ming / 66chos yang dag par len pa bzhi'i ming / 66cesazab nga duzug 4) :sgopa 67bla na med pa drug gi ming / 67byin kyis brlabs pa bzhi'i ming / 67mchog tu dga' ba sngon du 'gro ba'i chos dgu'i ming / 68'byung bar 'os pa'i khams drug gi ming / 68lha dang mi rnams kyi 'khor lo bzhi'i ming / 69dka' thub la gnas pa dang sdom pa 'dzin cing spyod pa la sogs pa'i ming 69rnal 'byor spyod pa dang rnal 'byor gyi yan lag gi ming / 70lung bstan pa bzhi'i ming / 70

mtshan nyid gsum gyi ming / 71dgongs pa bstuno'i ming / 71ldem por dgongs pa bzhi'i ming / 71zhi gnas lhag mthong la sogs pa/'i ming / 71mi dge ba bcu'i ming / 72dge ba bcu'i las kyi ming / 72bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po bzhi'i ming / ༷ ༷ 72don dam pa/'i ming / 73mya ngan las 'das pa/ la sogs pa'i ming / 73(1bas rnams kyi ming / 74ri mor bya ba'i rnam pa'i ming / 74spro zhing brtson pa/ la sogs pa/'i ming / 75mi 'acesam pa/'i ming / 76phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa 'i ming / 76gzugs kyi phung po so sor phye ba'i ming / 76tshor ba'i phung ngo/ so sor phye ba'i ming / 78'du shes kyi phung po so sor phye ba'i ming / 78sems dang mtshungs pa/ra ldan nga/'i 'du byed dang / sems dang ldan pa/ ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi ming / 78rnam nga ra shes pa'i ming 80skye mched bcu gnyis kyi ming / 80khams bco brgyad kyi ming / ༷ 81dbang po nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi ming / 81phung po khams dang skye mched dang dbang po bshad pa/'i nang nas 'byung 3

/ba/sde /miḥng za rtenachags pa dang zhen pa'i rnam pa'i ming 84sdug bsngal gsum kyi ming / 85sdug bsngal brgyad kyi ming / 85rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis kyi ming / 86/spyo drug than :go :sgopa 86khye)na bstuno:re :sgong 86'bras bu lnga'i ming / 87skye gnas bzhi'i ming / 87zas ba:de:re :sgong 87sems can gyi gnas dgu'i ming / 87mi khom pa brgyad kyi ming / 88las kyi rnam par byun pa la sogs pa'i ming 88mtshams med lnga'i ming / 89mtshams med pa dang nye ba lnga'i ming / 89snyigs ma lnga'i ming / 89'jig rten chos brgyad kyi ming / 9༷yon tan sna tshogs kyi ming / 90skyon du brtsi ba'i ming 92bla na med pa dang mchog tu brtsi ba'i rnam grangs kyi ming / 94dag pa/ dang grol ba la sogs pa'i ming / 94spangs pa dang dor ba la sogs pa'i ming 95bstod pa dang smad pa dang grags pa'i rnam grangs kyi ming / 96mthun pa dang mi mthun pa la sogs pa'i ming / 97

che chung dang mtho dman la sogs pa/'i ming / 98bshes pa'i rim pa dang phas kyi sgol ba 'a sogs pa/'i ming / 98dge ba dang shis pa'i ming / 99chos smra ba dang nyan pa/ dang sgra skad kyi ming / 99sgyu ma la sogs pa'i dpe'i ming 101gtong ba dang mchod sbyin byed pa la sogs pa'i ming 101phan pa dang phan nga/'i rnam nga/'i ming / 102blo dang bye brag phyed nga 'i rnam nga 'i ming / 102mkhas nga/'i rnam grangs kyi ming / 103zab nga/'i rnam grangs kyi ming / 103dga' ba'i rnam grangs kyi ming / 104khro zhing gtum pa/'i rnam nga dang gnod nga 'i ming / 104bkang zabaka bstusno:re :sgong / 105tshe 'di dang phyi ma dang 'chi 'pho ba'i rnam nga/'i ming / 105dbe+en nga 'i rnam pa/'i ming / 106thakacadathag thab:de/nge :bapa / 106sa g.yos pa 'i rnam nga/'i ming / 106/rocad /bye /ste/pang / 107stong che chung la sogs nga/'i ming / 107/cepa tshab:sna:re :sgopang / 107khams gsum pa 'i rim pa'i ming / 108'dod nga 'i khams kyi lha'i ming / ༷ 108bsam gtan dang ngo/'i sa'i ming / 109bsam gtan gnyis pa/'i sa'i ming / 1097

bsam gtan gsum pa'i sa'i ming 109bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sa'i ming 109gnas gtsang ma'i sa'i ming 1༷9gzugs med pa'i sa'i ming 11༷'jig rten pa'i lha'i ming / 110gza' dgu'i ming / 111rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ming / 111lha dang klu la sogs pa'i ming 112klu'i rgyal po'i ming 112klu la la ba6) :sgong 114gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i ming 115dri za'i dbang po'i ming 116lha ma yin kyi dbang po'i ming 116nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i ming 117mi'am ci'i dbang po'i ming 117lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'i ming 118grul bum gyi dbang po'i ming 118drang srong chen po'i ming 118sngon gyi mkhan po'i ming 119ya mtshan can gyi ming / 12༷mu stegs can gyi ston pa drug gi ming / 120'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rgyud kyi ming / 121'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i yon tan dang rin po che sna bdun la sogs ngas:re :sgopa 122

bu stong du tshang bar 'gyur ba'i ming / 122dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi'i ming / 123rgyal po phal pa6) ming 123skya seng gi bu la sogs pa'i ming 123:ba:re 1sdezug ngas/re :sgong 124mi'i rigs sna tshogs kyi ming / 127pha ma la sogs pa/ gnyen bshes kyi ming / ༷ 127lus dang lus kyi yan la/ga la sogs pa'i ming / 128lus su 'gyur ba'i rim pa'i ming 13༷na tshod kyi rim pa'i ming 130rgas pa dang na ba'i rnam pa/'i ming / 131(thu(pa/) shā)pang 1311re/re sbyosapang / 132rgya mad+ku ming gi rnam grangs dang chu dang gling la sogs pa/'i ming / 132/depa (go (petshong 133sngags kyi rgyud du 'byung ba'i ming 134ltas dang mtshan mar gzung ba'i ming / 137tshad ma dang rtog ge pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i ming / 138mu stegs rigs pa can gyi gzhung las 'byung ba'i ming 141grangs can gyi gzhung las 'byung ba'i ming / 141dpyod pa can gyi gzhung las 'byung ba'i ming / 142bye brag pa'i tshig gi don drug la sogs pa 'i ming / 142lta ba sna tshogs kyi ming / ༷ ༷ 142lung du ma bstan pa'i chos bcu bzhi'i ming / 1449

mu stegs can gyi bdag tu brjod pa'i ming 144'jig tshogs la lta ba nyi shu'i ming / 145byā ka ra ṇa'i skad kyi ming / 145rnam par dbye ba'i tshig bdun gyi ming / 146pa zug mu 11:re :sgopa 1'ju6yi dwags su gtogs pa'i ming 147dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa'i ming ༷ 1gyetsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba'i ming 1gograng ba'i sems can dmyal ba'i ming 150rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad kyi ming / 150bzo'i gnas dang sgyu rtsal la sogs pa'i ming 151rol mo'i cha byad kyi ming / 151(spyi pa/byu1pa thab () :sgong / 152gar thabs kyi rnam grangs kyi ming / 152bram ze'i gtsug lag dang las kyi ming / 152bram ze'i las rnam pa drug gi ming / 153skad go mthun kyi ming / 153mtho ris dang 'dod pa la sogs pa'i ming ༷ ༷ 159skabs skabs nas tshig gi phrad du 'byung ba'i ming 160mkhar dang gnas la sogs pa'i ming 161shing rta la sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad du ma'i ming 164'bru sna tshogs kyi ming / ༷ 165sdogathab /stezug (1 :sgopa 165zho mar dang zas skom gyi ming / 16510

'tsho chas kyi sma na gyi ming / 16714thag /) :)pa / 168'tshog chas dang yo byad kyi ming / 169cesacad /) /)pang / ༷ 169rin ngo/ che dang nor bu dang gser dngul 'a sogs pa 'i ming / 170dung la sogs pa/'i ming / 171rgyan gyi rnam pa 'i ming / 171go ma13na /) :)nga / 173mchod pa 'i yo byad kyi ming / 173me tog sna tshogs kyi ming / 174me tog gi rtsa ba la sogs pa'i ming / 175me tog gi yon tan gyi ming / 176spo sa/ kyi rnam nga/'i ming / 176skad go bdun gyi ming / 177ska da ko bdun gyi ming / ༷ 192phal chen gyi grangs kyi le'u 'a sa 'byung ba'i grangs kyi ming / 210sdong po bkod nga las byung ba'i grangs kyi ming / 212rgya cher rol pa/ las byung ba'i grangs dang rtsis kyi ming / 214chos mngon pa/ las byung ba'i grangs kyi ming / 216'jig rten pa/'i grangs kyi ming / 217rdul phra mo las bsgyur te dpa ga tshad la so/gas nga bsgre ba'i ming / 219stobs bcur bsgyur te bsgre ba'i ming / 220dus /) :sgong / 220phyogs dang mtshams kyi ming / 2221

'a/zug mkhyezug bas 6) :sgong 223thong byed sde lnga dang ma nges pa'i ming 223phas pham pa baḥ/lnga/ ming 223dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum dang ma nges pa gnyis kyi ming / 224spang ba'i thong byed sum cu'i ming / 224ltung byed dgu bcu'i ming / 225so sor bshags pa'i chos bzhi'i ming / 228bslab pa'i chos mang po'i ming 228rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'i chos bdun gyi ming / ༷ 233chad pas bcad cing gso ba la sogs pa'i ming 2 gsol ba dang las la sogs pa'i ming 234skyabs gsum du 'gro ba'i ming 234bslab pa'i gzhi brgyad la sogs pa'i ming 235dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi'i ming / 235rab tu byung ba la sogs pa'i ming 236rab tu byung ba'i gzhi'i ming / 237yo byad bcu gsum gyi ming / 240dge slong gi yo byad kyi ming / 240gang zag bcu gnyis kyi ming / 243sde bzhi rnam pa bco brgyad du gyes pa'i ming 243gzhi bcu bdun gyi ming / 244chu rung ba rnam pa lnga'i ming / 244dge sbyong gi skyon du brtsi ba'i ming 245gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i ming 24612

gos kyi gzhi'i ming / 246'dul ba las btus pa'i skad thor bu ba'i ming 247skad go bdun gyi ming / 250drug sde'i ming / 252ma ma bzhi'i ming / 253nad kyi ming / ༷ 253bsdur mchan/(211) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(288)3591 sgra spyor bam po gnyis pa/ 312bsdur mchan/(385) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(396)3592 lung du ston pa'i rtsa ba sum cu pa/ 397slo ba dngo na a nus ma/dzad/bsdur mchan/(401) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(401)3593 lung du ston pa rtags kyi 'jug pa/ 402slo ba dngo na a nus mdzad/bsdur mchan/(406) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(406)3594 gnas brgyad chen po'i rtsa ba/ 407lce khyi 'brug gis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(413) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(415)3595 sgra'i bstan bcos/ 41613

bsdur mchan/(439) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(442)3596 sgra'i rnam par dbye ba bstan pa/ 443gnas dang po gang yang rung ba'i sa bstan pa/ 443gnas gnyis pa las spu) sa bstan pa/ 446gnas gsum pa byed pa'i sa bstan pa/ 450gnas bzhi pa ched kyi sa bstan pa/ 454gnas lnga pa 'byung khungs kyi sa bstan pa/ 456gnas drug pa 'brel pa'i sa bstan pa/ 458gnas bdun pa gnas gzhi'i sa bstan pa/ 459gnas brgyad pa bod pa'i sgra bstan pa/ 461bsdur mchan/(464) basbur 'bras re'u mig(465)3597 bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma las mdo btus pa/ 466dang po/ ltos pa'i rigs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 466gnyis pa/ bya ba byed pa'i rigs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ gye8gsum pa/ gtan tshigs sgrub pa yan lag gi le'u/ 479bzhi pa/ mngon sum yongs su dag pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ rga9lnga pa/ rjes su dpag pa yongs su dag pa'i le'u/ go8drug pa/ rang gi rigs kyi dpe'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 501bdun pa/ yongs su gregs pa'i le'u/ 5༷3brgyad pa/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i lung gi mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 505dgu pa/ tshad ma'i grangs dang mtshan nyid kyi bka' thang gi le'u/ 513bcu pa/ bka' thang gi mngon sum tshad mar bya ba'i le'u/ 51414

bcu gcig pa/ bka' thang gi rjes su dang/ga pa'i tshad mar bya ba'i le'u/ 519bcu gnyis pa/ yid ches nga/'i tshad ma'i lung gi le'u/ 523bcu gsum pa// yongs su ma dag pa'i le'u/ 525bcu bzhi pa/ chos nyid kyi rigs nga/'i le'u/ 537bco lnga pa// tshad ma'i yon tan bkod nga/'i le'u/ 542bsnyur mchan/(545) brdu ra 'bras re'u mig(552)3598 sher snying 'grel pa sngags su 'grel pa/ 553shrī dzi has ma/dzad/bsnyur mchan/(563) bci ra 'bras re'u mig(564)3599 lnga/na nges byebye ——nga) nga/6) 9/mthozab mtho 565dang po/ rtsod nga/'i bca' thabs bstan nga/'i le'u/ 565gnyis pa// 'khrung nga 'i 'dra gabe+e bstan nga/'i le'u/ 569gsum nga// 'khrul/ nga/'i 'a/ma bstan nga 'i le'u/ 571bzhi nga// 'khru'/ nga/'i 'bras/ bu bstan nga/'i le'u/ 573lnga pa/ 'khrul gzhi gcigs/ su/ che ba bstan nga/'i le'u/ 574drug pa/ theg nga/ 'og ma'i brga' brtag bstan nga/'i le'u/ 577bdun nga// rdzogs chen kha 'byam la brgal brtag bstan nga/'i le'u/ 578brgyad nga// gsang sngags 'bras bu'i jeg nga/'i le'u/ 579dgu nga// lhun grub kyi mtshan nyid bstan nga/'i le'u/ 581bcu nga// chos nyid don gyi me long bstan nga/'i le'u/ 586bcu gcig pa/ chos sku rang gsal kyi me long bstan nga/'i le'u/ 588bcu gnyis pa/ kun gzhi sems/ kyi me long bstan pa'i le'u/ 591bcu gsum pa/ kun tu bzang po phra rags phye ba'i le'u/ 5955

bcu bzhi pa/ 'byung ba'i 'byung lugs bstan pa'i le'u/ 598bco lnga pa/ byung ba'i byung lugs bstan pa'i le'u/ 599bcu drug pa/ gnas pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u/ 602bcu bdun pa/ gtad rgya bstan pa'i le'u/ 604bsdur mchan/(6༷6) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(610)3600 gces pa bsdus pa'i 'phrin yig bod rje 'bangs la brdzangs pa/ ( 11btsun pa dpal dbyangs kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(639) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(642)3601 2lta /ba:re 1sde65 ngas tshob44tshod ngas/ 643ka ba dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(6na) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(6go)3602 gsung rab rin po che'i gtam rgyud dang shākya'i rabs rgyud/ 650mkhan po dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(976) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1006)sna tshogs/ 1sgo (22༷)3603 'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i mdo'i rnam par 16

byed /bye zag tu rtogs par byed pa/①byed/ /na mo bha ga ba ④te shākya mu na ye ta thā ga tā yār+ha te samyak+shi bud+dhā ya/༄— / / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo snesangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang sku dang che ba nyid kyi rnam grangs kyi ming la/budhaḥ bha ga bānupya/ ta thā ga taḥ artanarjo/ samyakle sangs rgyas/ bcom ldan 'das/de bzhin gshegs pa/dgra bcom pa/yang dag par rdzogs burnyaḥ bit+yā tsa ra ṇa sadzan+daḥ rjo su ga taḥ lo ka bitu⑦/pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig ⑧pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mabyed pa/a nut+ta ra pu ru ṣa da mya sā ra thi⑨ཿ shāstu/ dzi naḥspyo/ lo ka byeṣ+ṭhaḥ/skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur ⑪ba bla na med pa/ ston pa/ rgyal ba/ 'jig rten gyi gtso bo/sarba dzhaḥ⑫/ tā yi/ de bā ti de baḥ/ ma hāk+ṣiḥ⑫/ dhabyu swā rmā/thams cad ④mabyed nam spyokun mabyed/ skyob pa/ lha yi yang lha/ drang srong chen po/ chos kyi rje/115—3

ṛ ṣa bhaḥ/ nā ya kaḥ/ pa ri rja ya kaḥ/ bi nā ya kaḥ/ a dwa ya khyu mchog /'dren pa/ yongs su 'dren pa/ rnam par 'dren pa/ gnyis su bā dī/ sau dhi da niḥ/ da sha pa laḥ①/ mā ra dzit+pa/ shākya puṅga baḥ/med par gsung ba/ zas gtsang gi sras/ stobs bcu/ bdud thul/ shākya skyes mchog /gobhā —/ ma hān+d+ra/ bi dza yī/ bi bhuḥ/ bi shwan+ta raḥ/srung ④mdzad/ bdag nyid chen po/ rnam par rgyal ba mnga'/ khyab bdag /thams cad sgrol/sarba dharme shwa ①raḥ/tsho bi rātra④/ dhī raḥ/ gu ṇa sā ga raḥ/ sha ra t+taḥ/chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug /rnam par mdzes/ brtan pa/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ skyabs 'os/sha ra ṇamra/ bā di sau haḥ/ na rot+ta maḥ/ mā rā r+bha khyuḥ/ a pra ti puṅga laḥ/ bān+ta dhido skyabs—/ smra ba'i seng ge/ mi mchog /bdud zil gyis gnon/ gang zag zla med pa/ skyon bsal ṣaḥ—/ ha ta bi ṣaḥ/ a naṅga dzitu/ ṣa ḍa rnyi p+taḥ/ bha bān+ta kṛtra/ba—/ dug bcom pa/ lus med thul/ mngon par shes pa drug dang ldan pa/ srid mthar byed0/a gha han+taḥ/ sid+dhārbaḥspyo/ shākya sau haḥ/ ba rārtaḥ⑧/ ba ra daḥ/ bī raḥ/ sha mi sdig 'joms/ don grub/ shākya seng ge/ mchog don 'os/ mchog sbyin/ dpa' ba/ zhi bar tāske/ shān+ta pā paḥ⑨/ shī tī byu ⑩taḥ/ shi baṃ ka raḥ⑪/ nirwan+d+raḥ/ nirma maḥ/mdzad pa/ sdig pa zhi ba/ bsil bar gyur pa/ shis mdzad/ rtsod med/ bdag gi ba med pa/ne+e tā/ ni ra ba r+yaḥ/ nir+bha yaḥ/ bī ta z-i:⑫/ ni rā mtshon pa/ kha na ma tho ba mi mnga' ba/ bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba/ sred pa dang bral ba/ len pa mi dā naḥ/ bi khru taḥ/ shu bha dharmā ka raḥ/ shu tsiḥ/ a nu pa maḥ/mnga' ba/ rnam par grags pa// dge ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas/ gtsang ba/ dpe med pa/115—4

tri kā ladzhaḥ/ bā dī/ tri do sngo pa hā/ tri pā ti hār+ya sadzan+daḥ/ nirma laḥ/dus gsum mkhyen pa/ gsung ldan/ nyes gsum 'joms/ cho 'phrul gsum dang ldan pa/ dri ma med pa/tri skan+ta ba tha de shi kaḥ/ nirja ①raḥ/ srur+ya baṃ shaḥ/ 2ji ra saḥ go ta maḥgaphung po gsum gyi lam ston pa/ nad mi mnga' ba/ nyi ma'i rigs/ nyi ma'i rgyud/ go ta ma/i kyu ku la nan+da naḥ/ pra bhuḥ//bu ram shing pa'i rigs dga' ba/ mnga' bdagade bzhin gshegs pa so so'i mtshan la/bai ro tsa naḥ / a k+ko bh+yaḥ / a mi tā bhaḥ / rat+na sam+bha ba ཿ /rnam par snang mdzad/ mi 'khrugs pa/ 'od dpag med/ rin chen 'byung ldan/a mo gha sidhiḥ/ be+e pa bye/ si khā+e/ bi shwa bhukra/don yod grub pa/ rnam par gzigs/ gtsug tor can/ thams cad skyob 7/kra ④kuts+tshan+daḥ/ kra ⑤kurlun+daḥ/ ka na ka mu niḥ/ kā byu paḥ/ shākya mu niḥ/ dī paṃ ka raḥ/log dad sel/ 'khor ba 'jig /gser thub/ 'od srungs/ shākya thub pa/ mar me mdzad/pad+ma ne+e traḥ/ pra ha si ta ne+e traḥ/ rat+na shi khā+e⑥/ me gha swa raḥ④/ sa lī la ga dza pad+ma'i spyan/ spyan gsal rgyas/ rin chen gtsug tor can/ 'brug sgra/ glang po che ltar 'gying gā m+bi / lo ⑧kā bhi khā ṣ+pe rngu//zhing bzhud pa/ 'jig rten mos pa/sangs rgyas kyi sa dang / mi mnyam pa dang / mnyam pa'i phung po lnga dang / ye shes bzhi dang / sku gsum la/sa man+ta pra bhā ljo 7budhe bhū miḥ/ shrī laskan+tahuskyuḥ/ sa mā dhi skan+dhaḥ/sangs rgyas kyi sa kun du 'od/ tshul khrims kyi phung po/ ting nge 'dzin 'dzin gyi phung po/115—5

ga oṃ dz+nyā nā nu pa ri bat+t+waṃ/ sarba ma naskarmā ①dz+nyā na pūbaṃ ga oṃ dz+nyā nā nu pa sngon du 'go zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ yid kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi ri baṭī/ a tī te rgya nā saṃ ⑧ga ma pra ti ha lta dz+nyā na dar+sha rna pra brta te/ a tsā ga te rjes su 'brang ba/ 'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i dh+wa ④n+ya saṃ ga ma pra ti ha tram̐ rjodz+nyā na dar+sha dz+wa ⑤pra brta te/ pra kyut+pan+da rjodh+wa n+ya saṃ ga dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa/ da ltar gyi dus la ma chags ma thogs ma pra ti ha tai dz+nyā na dar+sha rna pra bak+ṣiṃ te//pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ming la/ni rās+thā na be+erba dharmāḥs tā sh+tsa ne+e rāhūṃ ⑦nā dhi mutsudhe a tasta thā chos thams cad ni bdag med pa yin na sems can rnams bdag med par ma mos pas skede'i phyir ga ta mya sa twe 6 ma hā ka ru rtot+pa r+ya te/ niḥs tāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni sems can med pa/ni jo ⑨bāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ nin+d+raṅga khāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a bhā bāḥsarba chos thams cad ni srog med pa/ chos thams cad ni gang zag med pa/ chos thams cad ni rang bzhin dhas+thāḥ—/ a ni ke tāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a nā la yāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a ma māḥsarba med pa/ chos thams cad ni gnas med pa/ chos thams cad ni gzhi med pa/ chos thams cad ni nga yi bar dhas+thāḥ —/ a shā mi kāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a bstu kāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/byar med pa/ chos thams cad di bdag po med pa/ chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa/a dzā tāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a sgo tā a nut+pan+d+raḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a saṃ khriṣ+ṭaḥchos thams cad ni ma skyes pa/ chos thams cad ni shi 'pho med cing ma skyes pa/ chos thams cad ni kun nas 115—8

sarba dhas+thāḥ/ bi ga ta rā gāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ bi ga ta dz+wa ṣāḥ① sarba nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa/ chos thams cad ni 'dod chags dang bral ba/ chos thams cad ni zhe sdang dhas+thāḥ—/ bi ga ta mo hāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a nā ga ti kāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a ga ti ②dang bral ba/ chos thams cad ni gti mug dang bral ba/ chos thams cad ni 'ong ba med pa/ chos thams kāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a na rnyi snesaṃ sku ra0ཿsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a pra pa.ā+oṃ⑤ཿsarba dhas+thāḥ/cad ni 'gro ba med pa/ chos thams cad ni mngon par 'du byed pa med pa/ chos thams cad ni spros pa med pa/shusgyuḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a ni mit+taḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/ a pra ṇi hi tāḥsarba dhas+thāḥ/chos thams cad ni stong pa/ chos thams cad ni mtshan ma med pa/ chos thams cad ni sgon pa med pa/a byophon+ya rjobi bā da saṃ kṛ hi ⑦to ba tā yi lo ka saṅgi be sho byā pā da khi la dz+wa ṣa pra ti kye ma 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni phan tshun rtsod pas yongs su zin cing gnod sems kyi tha ba dang zhe sdang la pan+da i ti saṃ pa byutu⑧/ bi parlu sa saṃ pra yuk+to ba tā yi lo ka san+ni be sho bi ṣa ma zhugs par gzigs/ kye ma 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni phyin ci log dang ldan zhing lam nyam nga bar mārga pra yā taḥ.ut+pa tha mārga s+thā yī/ lusto lā sā bhi bhū ⑨to ba tā yi lo ka zhugs pa lam gol ba la gnas pa/ kye ma 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni brkam zhing 'dod pas zil gyis san+ni be shaḥ/ a trip+taḥpa ra tsi du ⑪pa hā rī⑪/ dha na dh+wa ⑫n+ya kṛ ha pu tra bhārlu non pa ste chog mi shes shing gzhan gyi nor la 'phrog pa/ kye ma sems can 'di dag ni ⑫nor dang 'bru dang z-i: (stedā sā ba te me sa tā a (snyesā re sā ra saṃ rnyi naḥ/ bi ṣa mā dz+re ()bā ba khyim dang bu dang chung ma la sred pas 'khol ba ste snying po med pa la snying por 'du shes pa/⑩ kye ma sems te ⑫me sa tā a byophon+ya ⑪pa ri bañtsa no pasbi tāḥ/ a z-ibhā ba te me can 'di dag ni mi rigs pas 'tsho ba ste gcig la gcig 'drid pas gnas pa/ kye ma sems can 'di sa tā ()lā bha saṭ+wā ra sh+lau ko pa tsa ri tāḥ/ dṛ(sprebhāsma i ti dag ni chog mi shes pa ste rnyed pa dang bkur ste dang tshigs su bcad pa la spyod kyang / bdag ni chog shes pa'o 175byed9

pra ti dzā na te/ na ①t+yā rnyi ra tā ba te me sa tā ②e kādhā kṛṣ+ṭa duḥkha bhā dza ne+e kṛ hā ④snyam du 'dzin/ kye ma sems can 'di dag ni khyim gyi gnas sdug bsngal gyi snod ④kun nas nyon mongs bā se kā ra rte pa ga⑤ཿpu narjoḥsarba dhas+thā ⑦bi ṭha pa na pra kyu pa s+thā na lak+ṣa ṇ+ḍaḥ/pa can la rtag tu dga' ba chos thams cad ni rgyus nye bar 'go ba ste sgrub pas nye bar gnas pa'i mtshan nyid/i rda pu na ra gra ma saṃ ga dz+nyā na muṣ+ṭṛ dzu bi shiṣ+ṭa pa ri nithā ṇa/ haṃ sa tā ⑧sems can rnams ni chags pa med pa'i ye shes dam pa khyad par du 'phags pa yongs su/ mya ngan las tī na yā dz+wa pārba yadhe ⑨ya di rda shā ba ka pra bye ka busnya yā ṭ+wāṃ ⑩te bh+ya u dā re ma ti ro 'das pa 'di btang zhing gang 'di nyan thos kyi theg pa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dman pa tshol ba yin tsa yi byā m+bi ti ya di rda ⑩bud+dhi ⑫dz+nyā nā dh+yā ⑫lo ba na tā yi i tri ④ta thā ga ta su sa twe gyi de dag la gang 'di sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la dmigs par bya ba'i phyir rgya chen po la blo mos par bya'o zhes 6 ma hā ka ru khot+pa r+ya te//sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po skye'o//ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum gyi ming la/shu shā ṣa mā ṇi ⑫6 sa ma tsit+ta tā/ a shu byu ṣa mā ṇi ⑩6 sa ma tsit+ta tā⑫/gus par nyan pa rnams la sems snyoms pa/ gus par mi nyan pa rnams la sems snyoms pa/shu shā ṣa mā ṇa ⑫shu byu ṣa mā ṇi ⑩6 sa ma tsit+ta ⑥tā//gus par nyan pa dang gus par mi nyan pa rnams la sems snyoms pa/bsrung ba med pa bzhi'i ming la/pa ri shudha kā ya sa mu dā tsā rasta thā ga taḥstso/ nāste ta thā ga ta sgyu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i phrin las kyi spyod pa yongs su dag pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa 115—10

pa ri shurtse kā ya sa mu dā tsā ra tā/ pa ri shurnya bākla mu dā tsā rasta thā la sku'i phrin las yongs su ma dag pa med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa la gsung gi phrin las kyi spyod pa ga taḥ/ nāste ①ta thā ga ta sgyu pa ri shurnya bākla mu dā tsā ra tā/yongs su dag pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la gsung gi phrin las kyi spyod pa ②yongs su ma dag pa med pa/pa ri shurnya ma naḥs mu dā tsā rasta thā ga taḥ/ nāste ta thā ④ga ta sgyu de bzhin gshegs pa la thugs kyi phrin las kyi spyod pa yongs su dag pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la pa ri shurnya ma naḥ sa mu dā tsā ra tā / pa ri shurnya jo ba sta thā thugs kyi phrin las kyi ④spyod pa yongs su ma dag pa med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la 'tsho ba yongs su ga taḥ/ nāste ⑤ta thā ga ta myu pa ri shudha dzī ba tā//dag pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'tsho ba yongs su ma dag pa med do//so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i ming la/dharma pra ti sam+bit+padu/ arba pra ti sam+bit+pa/ ni rut+ta pra ti chos so so yang dag par rig pa/ don so so yang dag par rig pa/ nges pa'i tshig so so yang sam+bit+pa / pra ti bhā na pra ti sam+bitu//dag par rig pa/ spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa/mngon par shes pa lnga'i ming la/di bye tsak+ṣuḥ/ di bye tho tramra/ pa ra ⑦tsit+ta dz+nyā rna/ tse taḥparlu ya tshwa rgo/lha'i spyan/ lha'i snyan/ pha rol gyi sems shes pa/ sems kyi rnam grangs shes pa/pūrba ni bā sā nu smṛ ti khrudz+nyā namra⑨/ ṛdhi ⑩bi dhi dz+nyā rna/ ā sra ba k+ṣa ya dz+nyā ne+e⑪//sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa shes pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bya ba shes pa/ zag pa zad pa shes pa/115—11

mngon par shes pa drug gi skabs nas 'byung ba'i ming la/ya thā sa mā hi te tsiste swa ye ā sa ne+elhan+tarnyi stitaḥ/ bi hā ji ltar sems mnyam par gzhag sdepa bzhin du bdag gi stan gyi steng du mi snang bar 'gyur/ nam ya su ④byuṅga mya tsa tube+e dha m+birlu rjopa dze+e kalpa ya ti/ u pa ri maḥkā yarjoḥpra dz+wa la ti/mkha' la mngon par 'phags te spyod lam rnam pa rjobazhi byed/ lus kyi stod nas me 'bar/a dhaḥkā yāt+pa ⑦shrī ta lā bā ri dhā rāḥsun+dadhe⑧/ a ne+e ka bi dha mṛrnyi bi ṣa yo pra t+ya nu lus kyi smad nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bab/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yul rnam pa mang po myong bar bha ba ti/ e ⑨ko bhū tā ba hu dhā bha ba ti/ ba hu dh+wa bhū tā e ko bha ba ti/ byu byed pa yin/ gcig tu gyur nas mang por 'gyur/ mang por gyur nas gcig tu 'gyur⑩/ snang tidzha ba ti ti ro dhā na ⑪ma pi pra t+ya nu bha ba ti/ ti raḥku bye⑫/ ti raḥpā kā ⑫reḥ/bar 'gyur zhing mi snang bar yang ⑫'gyur/ rtsig pa la yang thad kar 'gro/ ra ba la yang thad kar 'gro/parba ta ma pya saṅga ma (smeno gats+tsha ti/ ā kā she pi kra ma te tar+ya thā paspyi sha ri la yang mi thogs par 'gro/ nam mkha' la yang 'gro ste dper na 'dab chags bya ku niḥ⑪/ thra be+e byā mud+madz+dza ni rgo ⑩ka ro ti tar+ya thā pi nā mo da ke/ u da ke bzhin no / /spyos la yang steng du 'byung ba dang byi'u zul byed de dper na chu la bya ba bzhin no/ /⑪chu la pya rnyi r+ya mā no gats+tsha ti tar+ya thā pi nā ma ma hā dṛ thi ṭ+wāṃ⑫/ dhū mā ⑫ya t+ya pi pra dz+wa ⑫la yang mi nub par 'gro ste dper na sa chen po la bya ba bzhin no/ /du ba 'thul bar yang byed 'bar t+ya pi nā ma ma hāghi skadzha⑫ཿ/ swa kā yā ④da pi ma hā bā ri dhā rā udṛ dza ⑫ti bar yang byed de dper na me'i phung po bzhin no/ /bdag gi lus las kyang chu'i rgyun chen po 'byin te tar+ya thā pi nā ma ma hā me ghaḥ⑪/ yā bhir+pā ri jo rā bhi ra yi tro sā ha sra ma hā sā ha dper na sprin chen po bzhin no/ /chu'i rgyun de dag gis stong gsum rmi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 115—12

sro lo ka dhā tu rā dīp+taḥpra dīp+taḥ/ saspra dz+wa li tophoghi hunā e ka dz+wa lali bhū to nir+pā snye 'di sreg cing getshig ste/ mes rab tu 'bar zhing 'bar ba gcig tu gyur pa zhi bar pya mete/ i mā ba pi tsan+d+ra srur+ya e baṃ ma hādhi spyoka e baṃ ))ma hā nu bhā bo e baṃ ma ho rngubyed do/ /zla ba dang nyi ma 'di gnyis 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba 'di ltar mthu che ba 'di ltar gzi brjid dzad pā ṇi nā pa rā mṛ 1sha ti pa ri mardza tshuya ti/ yā ban+d+ra lharjeh+ma lo kā da pi sa t+t+waṃ kā che ba la'ang lag pas 'dzin cing kun du nyug par byed do/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du sems can ye na ba she bat+t+waṃ ya ti/ sā kā re/ sodre 7shaṃ/ sa ni rnams la lus kyis 8dbang bsgyur ro/ /rnam pa dang bcas/ yul phyogs dang bcas/ gzhi ci las gyur pa dā rna/ pūn+d+ra ni bā sa ma nu sma ra tisma/ dzā 8ti sma raḥ/ a mu tā ⑩ha mā sa mi ma dang bcas/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa/ tshe rabs dran pa/ che ge mo zhig na bdag ming ban+d+ra ma/ e baṃ hūṃ dzā tiḥ/ e baṃ go traḥ/ e baṃ mā hā raḥ/'di zhes bya bar gyur/ rigs 'di zhes bya/ rus 'di zhes bya/ zas 'di lta bu zhig za/e baṃ su kha khye5duḥkha pra ti saṃ be+e dī/ e baṃ tsi rasbi ti kaḥ/ e ba mā yuḥpazla ཿ/bde ba dang sdug bsngal 1('di lta bu zhig myong / yun 'di srid cig gnas/ tshe ni 'di tsam zhig thub/ta tabyu taḥ.a mu tro pa pan+daḥ/ ta tabyuta i hā pyu pa pan+daḥ//de nas shi 'phos nas che ge mo zhig tu skyes/ de nas tshe 'phos nas yang 'dir skyes/cho 'phrul gsum gyi ming la/ṛdhi pā ti hāzlo/ ā de sha na pā ti hāzlo/ a nu sā sa rī pā ti hāzlo du //rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul/ kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul/ rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul/115—13

skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ming la/uṭī ṣa shi raska tā/ pra dak+shi ḍā brta ke shaḥ①/ sa ma la lā ṭaḥ/ spru1 ko shā②/dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ dbu skra g.yas su 'khyil ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes mnyam pa/ mdzod spu/a rnyi nī la ne+e tra go pasmra①/ tsa tā ri shadrwan+taḥ/ sa ma darnyaḥ/ a bi ra la dan+taḥ/spyan mthon mthing la ba'i ji ma lta bu/ tshems bzhi bcu mnga' ba/ tshems mnyam pa/ tshems thags bzang ba/su shukla dan+taḥ/ ra sa ra sā gra tārjo/ mo ha ha nuḥ/ pra khyu ta ta nu tshems shin tu dkar ba/ ro bro ba'i mchog dang ldan pa/ 'gram pa seng ge'i ⑤'dra ba/ ljags shin tu ring dzi hwaḥrjo/ bra ṣ+ṭha swa raḥ⑦/ su saṃ dṛt+ta skarnyaḥ/ sastot+ma daḥ/ tsi tān+ta ⑧zhing srab pa⑨/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ dpung 'go ⑩shin tu rlum pa/ bdun mtho ba/ thal gong dzā saḥ/ sru gh+ra su paṇ+ḍits+tsha biḥ⑪/ sbri tā na ba na ta pra ⑫lasbra bā rgyas pa/ pags pa srab cing mdog gser mdog ⑫'dra ba/ bzhengs bzhin du ma btud par phyag pus hu tā/ dzi ha pūr+pādzha ⑫kā yaḥ/ n+ya go dha pa ri maṇ+ḍa laḥ/ e kai ka ro ma pra mor sleb ⑫pa/ ro stod seng ge'i 'dra ba/ shing rgya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab pa/ spu re re nas skyes shing dak+ṣ-i ṇa brtaḥ⑩/ sprusgroṅga ro māḥ/ ko sho ⑩ga ta bste gu h+yaḥ/ su bat+t+waṃ to g.yas su 'khyil ba/ sku'i spu gyen du phyogs pa/ mdoms kyi sba ba spubs su nub pa/ brla legs par ruḥ—/ ⑫ustso ⑩kha pā daḥ/ mṛ du ta ru ṇa hasta pā da ta laḥ/rlum pa/ ⑫zhabs kyi long mo'i tshigs mi mngon pa/ phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa/dzā khā ban dha ⑪hasta pā daḥ/ dīspyo gu liḥ/ tsaṭ+wāṃ ki ta hasta pā da ta phyag dang zhabs gnyis dra bas 'byel ba/ sor mo ring ba/ phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil 'khor lo'i mtshan la⑫—/ su pra tiṣ+ṭṛ ta pū daḥ/ ā ya ta pā da pārnyiḥ/ e ṇi ya rdza dughaḥ//dang ldan pa/ zhabs shin tu gnas pa/ zhabs kyi rteng pa yangs pa/ byin pa ri dwags e na ④ya'i lta bu/115—14

pra dak+ṣi ṇa bsto nā bhiḥ/ sa man+ta pā ①sā di kaḥ/ shu tsi sa mā tsā raḥ/ bya pa ga ta lte ba g.yas phyogs su 'khyel ba/ kun nas mdzes pa/ kun spyod gtsang ba/ sku la sme ba dang ti la ⑤ka kā la gā traḥ tu la ①sa dṛ sha su ku mā ra pā ṇiḥ/ sdisnya ④pā ṇi lekhaḥ/gnag bag med pa/ phyag shing bal ltar shin tu 'jam pa/ phyag gi ri mo mdangs yod pa/shaṃ bhā ra pā ṇi le khaḥ/ ā ya ta pā ṇi le khaḥ/ nā t+yā ya ta ba da naḥ/ bisbra pra ti phyag gi ri mo zab pa/ phyag gi ri mo ring ba/ zhal ha cang yang mi ring ba/ zhal la gzugs kyi bidza dar+sha na ba da naḥ/ mṛ du ⑤dzi hwaḥ/ ta nu dzi hwaḥ/ rak+tadzi hwaḥ/ ga dza gzugs brnyan snang ba/ ljags mnyen pa/ ljags srab pa/ ljags dmar ba/ glang po che'i nga gardzi ta jo rū ta sgo ṣaḥ/ ma byu ra tsā rjoru mañdzu swa raḥ/ dṛt+ta rda ṣ+ṭa/ tīkyā rda ṭ+wā⑦/ro dang 'brug gi sgra dang ldan pa/ gsung snyan cing mnyen la 'jam pa/ mche ba klum pa/ mche ba rdo ba/shukla rda ṣ+ṭha⑧/ sa ma rda ṣ+ṭha⑨/ u ⑩nu pūrba rda ṣ+ṭha⑪/ hūṃ ga nā saḥ/ shu tsi nā saḥ/mche ba dkar ba/ mche ba mnyam pa/ mche ba byin gyis phra ba/ shangs mtho ba/ shangs gtsang ba/bi shudha ne traḥ/ bi shā la ne+e traḥ/ tsi ta pasmra⑫/ se tā se ta ka ma la da la sa spyan rnam par dag pa/ spyan yangs pa/ rdzi ma stug pa/ spyan dkar nag 'byes shing pad+ma'i ka la na ya naḥ/ ā ya ta khyuḥ/ bla kyā zla⑫ཿ/ sa ma ro ma khyuḥ/'dab ma rangs thostepa lta bu/ byun tshugs ring ba/ smin ma 'jam pa/ smin ma'i ()spu mnyam pa/sdisnyakhyuḥ—/ dzī nā ya ta kaṇ+ḍiḥ/ sa ma kaṇ+ḍiḥ/ a nu pa ha ta kazlodh+ri yaḥ/byun ma snum pa/ snyan shal stug cing ring ba/ snyan mnyam pa/ snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams pa/su pa ri ṇa ta la khā ṭaḥ/ thra ⑩thu la lā ṭaḥ/ su pa ri pūṇ+ḍit+ta rmā gaḥ/ bh+ra ma ra sa dṛ ⑩dpral ba legs par 'byes ⑫pa/ dpral ba dbyes che ba/ dbu shin tu rgyas pa/ dbu skra bung ba sha ke shaḥ/ tsi ta ke shaḥ/ bla kyā ke shaḥ/ a saṃ lu li ta ⑪ke shaḥ a pa ru ltar gnag pa/ dbu skra stug pa/ dbu skra 'jam pa/ dbu skra ma 'dzings pa/ dbu skra mi 115—16

ṣa ke shaḥ/ su ra rnyi ke shaḥ/ shrī bat+ma swaste ka nad+dhā ①brta la li ta ②pā ṇi gshor ba/ dbu skra dri zhim pa/ phyag dang zhabs dpal gyi be+e'u dang bkra shis dang g.yung drung pā daḥ/ bsnya mā naḥ①//'khyil pas brgyan pa/ sdong ris/de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba mdo sde las byung ba'i ming la/su bi shudha burnyiḥ/ a dwa ya sa mu dā ⑦tsā raḥ/ a lak+ṣa ṇa dhan+d+ra rjopa rā ya ṇaduḥ/blo shin tu rnam par dag pa/ gnyis su spyod pa med pa/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos la gzhol ba/budha bi hā re ṇa be+e ha re/ sat+tha ⑦budha sa ma tā pāp+taḥ/ a nā ba sangs rgyas kyi gnas pas gnas pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid brnyes pa/ sgrib pa mi mnga' ra ṇa ga to ga taḥ/ ske.a pra kyu dā baju dhan+d+raḥ/ a saṃ har+ya stigo tsa raḥ/bas rtogs par thugs su chud pa/ ⑨phyir mi ldog pa'i chos dang ldan pa/ spyod yul gyis mi 'phrog pa/a tsirnyu bya ba s+thā na/ spya dh+wa sa ma tā nir+yā ta⑪ཿ/ sarba lo ka dh+wa rnam par gzhag ⑫pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid tshar phyin pa/ sku 'jig rten gyi tu pra bhū ta kā yaḥ/ sarba dha1 ⑫niḥsaṃ sha ya dz+nyā naḥ④/ sarba tsarlu ⑫khams thams cad du khyab pa/ chos thams cad la the tshom med pa'i ye shes mnga' ba/ blo spyod pa sa man+d+ra ⑩ga ta burnyiḥ/ nis+t+waṃ k+ṣe dhan+d+ra ⑩dz+nyā ne+e⑫/ a bi kalpi ta sha rī reḥ/thams cad dang ldan pa/ chos mkhyen pa la ne+em nur med pa/ rnam par ma brtag pa'i sku mnga' ba/sarba bo dhi sa twa saṃ pra tīts+tsha dz+nyā naḥ/ dwa ya budha bi hā ra pa ra ye shes byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ⑪yang dag par mnos pa/ sangs rgyas kyi gnas pa gnyis su ma pā ra mi ta pāp+taḥ/ a saṃ bhin+d+ra ta thā ga ta bi mo k+ṣa dz+nyā na med pa dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa brnyes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa ma 'dres pa'i rnam par ⑩mdzad pa'i 115—17

nijo ①ga taḥ/ a nan+ta ma d+ma bu’ bhū ②mi sa ma tā dhi ga taḥ/ye shes kyi mthar phyin pa/ mtha' dang dbus med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa mnyam pa nyid thugs su chud pa/dhan+d+ra dhā tu par+yan+tasneḥ/ ā kā sha dhā tu par+ya rjob sā naḥ/ a pa rārnya ko ṭi niṣ+ṭhaḥ/chos kyi dbyings kyi ⑤gtugs pa/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ni gyin+daḥs ta thā ga taḥpu sgyu ṭ+wāṃ/ a bi pra zla shaḥku sha la spru rjolā ṭ+wāṃ/ a lo de bzhin gshegs pa de bsod nams dag gi rgyu mthun pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams chud mi za ba/ bzod pas lo kṛ taḥk+ṣubyu⑦/ ā la ya⑧ཿpu rgya ni dh+wa nā māṃ⑨/ tsi tri tolhanu ()byañdza ne+eḥ/brgyan pa/ bsod nams kyi gter rnams kyi gzhi/ dpe byad bzang po rnams kyis spras pa/ku su mi to lak+ṣa ṇi⑪ཿ/ pra tī rū ⑫po go tsa re ṇa/ sa ⑫pra ti kyu ⑫lo dar+sha ni ⑫na/mtshan gyi me tog rgyas pa/ spyod yul ran par mthun pa/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/a rnyi ra tiḥshād+dhā dhi mulnga ṭ+wāṃ/ a na bhi khyu taḥpra rnye yā/ a na ba marda nī yo dad pas mos pa rnams mngon par dga' ba/ shes rab zil gyis mi non pa/ stobs rnams la rdzi ⑩ba ba le'i/ shāstu sarba sa tā ṭ+wāṃ⑩/ pi tā bo dhi sa tā māṃ/ rā dzā ār+ya med pa/ sems can thams cad kyi ston pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yab/ 'phags pa'i puṅga khā ṭ+wāṃ/ sāṭ+wā spyobā ha ā di karmi kā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra me yo dz+nyā ne+e na/ a gang zag rnams kyi rgyal po/ las dang po pa rnams kyi ded dpon/ ye shes dpag tu med pa/ spongs nan+taḥpra ti bhā ni ⑪na/ bi shudha sru ⑥re ṇa/ sā ⑪swā da nī yo gho ṣe ṇa/ a se pa mtha' yas pa/ gsung rnam par dag pa/ dbyangs snyan pa/ sku byad lta ⑫tsa na ko rū pe ṇa/ a pra ti sa maḥkā ⑫ye na/ a ④libe+eḥkā ⑫miḥ/ a nu bas chog mi shes pa/ sku mtshungs pa med pa/ 'dod pa dag gis ma gos pa/ gzugs dag pa listo rū baiḥ/ a saṃ mṛṣ+ṭa ā rū bye⑪ཿ/ bi pra muk+taḥskadhe ⑦bh+yaḥ/gis nye bar ma gos pa/ gzugs med pa dag dang ma 'dres pa/ phung po dag las rab tu rnam par grol ba/175—18

bi saṃ yuk+to dhā tu bhiḥ/ saṃ dṛt+ta ①ā ya ta ne+eḥ/ prakhyurjogradzhai ཿ/khams rnams dang mi ldan pa/ skye mched rnams bsdams pa/ mdud pa rnams shin tu bcad pa/bi muk+ta④ཿpa ri dā ghiḥ/ pa ri muk+ta z-i ṇ+ḍa yā/ au ghā dut+t+waṃṇ+ḍiḥ①yongs su gdung ba dag las rnam par grol ba/ sred pa las yongs su grol ba/ chu bo las brgal ba/pa ri phuzlo rjodz+nyā ne+e na/ pra tiṣ+ṭṛ topho ⑤tī tā nā ga ta pra kyut+padz+nyā bud+dhā dzā bha ga ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ba t+t+waṃ dz+nyā ne+e/ a pra tikhyu to nir+pā ṇi/ sbi to byu ta ko ṭ+wāṃ/kyi ye shes la gnas pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' la gnas pa/spri taḥsarba sa two khro ka bhā rjoyā yī byu mo/ a nan+ta shi gyi ga ṇa su sems can thams cad la gzigs pa'i sa la bzhugs pa/ slob ma shin tu dul ba mtha' yas pa'i bi nī taḥ/ sarba sa tā sha ya su bi dhi dz+nyāḥ/ a nā sgo ga burnya tshogs mnga' ba/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa legs par bsgrub pa shes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi kār+ya ⑦pra ti pra srabha⑧ཿ/ muk+to muk+ta pa ri bā raḥ/ pā ra ga taḥ/mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/ grol ba grol ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa/sba la ga taḥ/ tīṇ+ḍiḥ/ tā ra kaḥ/ ā shwa staḥ/ sho tri yaḥ/ rnyin+da skam la phyin pa/ brgal ba/ sgrol ba po/ dbugs 'byin pa/ bram ze gtsang sbra can/ nyon kle shaḥ/ bā hi ta pā pa dhas+thā⑨/ be+e da kaḥ/ bi nī ba ra ṇaḥ/ bi pra mongs pa bcom pa/ sdig pa bsal ba'i chos can/ rig pa po/ sgrib pa dang rnam par bral ba/ yid san+da ma naḥ/ ṣa ḍi ga sa ma nā ga taḥ/ a na nu rodha bi rodha bi pra muk+taḥ/ pra ṇan+ta rnam par dang ba/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ bsnyen bsring dang bral ba/ so so'i bden pa pra t+ya ⑩ka sa h+yeḥ/ sa mudṛṣ+ṭi ⑪ṣa ṇaḥ/ e ka rak+ṣaḥ/ smṛ ti do bā ri ka saspan+d+raḥ/bstsal ba/ btsal ba spangs pa/ bsrung ba gcig pa/ dran pa'i sgo bsrungs phun sum tshogs pa/115—19

tsa tu rā mā ①shra ya ṇaḥ/ par+ya ba ṅga tārbaḥ/ bhā bi tās+thā/rten pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ don gyi mthar gtugs pa/ bsgoms pa'i bdag nyid can nam bdag nyid sgom pa/a pa ga ta shā khā pa tra pa khā sha pra pā ṭi kā twah+phalguḥ/ a nā bi la saṃ yal ga dang lo ma dang 'dab ma dang 'khri shing dang shun pags kyi skyon dang bral ba/ kun du rtog pa'i rnyog pa kalpaḥske/ pra srabha snekā ya saṃ s+thā raḥ/ a pra mā ṇa ga ta budha mā hāt+thaḥ/med pa/ lus kyi 'du byed shin tu sbyangs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi che ba nyid tshad med pa brnyes pa/a pra tiṣ+ṭha dh+yā na brta nī/ ka la ①māsto burnyot+pā daḥ/ mārga ④pa ri bsam gtan gyi 'jug pa la gnas pa mi mnga' ba/ dus la bab par sangs rgyas 'byung ba/ lam yongs ṇa ya kaḥ/ mārga ⑤snyoḥ/mdu mārga bit+pa/ mārga spyode shi ka ཿ/ mārga ⑧khyu yī//su 'dren pa/ lam thugs su chud pa/ rjo lam mkhyen pa/ lam ston pa/ lam gsung ba/dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cu'i ming la/ tsistorjel+ya ka rī/ snaghā⑨/ mṛ du kā/ ma no dz+nyāspre)/ ma no ra mā /sems tshim par byed pa/ mnyen pa/ 'jam pa/ yid du 'ong ba/ yid du 'thad pa/shud+dhā(ste—/ bi ma lā/ pra bhā swa rā/ balguḥ/ shra bā ()rtswa yā/ a ne+e lā/dag pa/ dri ma med pa/ gsal dbyangs/ snyan cing ⑫'jebs pa/ mnyan par 'os pa/ mi tshugs pa/ka lā/ be+e bhā tā/ a karka shā/ a pa ru ṣā/ su bi nī ④tā/ kaṇ+ḍi ⑫su khā /snyan pa/ dul ba/ mi rtsub pa/ mi brlang ba/ rab tu dul ba/ rna bar snyan pa/kā ⑩ya pra h+la dā na ka rī/ cisarnyi ⑩l+ya ka rī⑫/ z-i da ya san+tuṣ+ṭi ka rī/ t+pā ti lus sim par byed pa/ sems tshim ()par byed pa/ snying dga' bar byed pa/ dga' ba su kha dzā na ⑫nī/ nit+pa ri dā hā/ ā zlo ⑥yā/ bi zlo ⑫yā/dang bde ba bskyed pa/ yongs su gdung ba med pa/ kun du shes par bya ba/ rnam par rig par bya ba/115—20

bit+paṣ+ṭa①rka/ pre ma tsā yā/ a bhi nan+da snyenī yā/ ā dz+nyā pa rnam par gsal ba/ dga' bar byed pa/ mngon par dga' bar byed pa/ kun shes par nī yā/ bi dz+nyā pa rī ya/ yut+ta snes hi tā/ pu na ④ruk+ta do ṣa dza hā/ mo ha swa byed pa/ rnam par rig par byed pa/ rigs ⑤pa 'byel ba/ zlos pa'i skyon med pa/ seng ge'i ra be gā/ nā ga rjoswa ra shabhā/ me gha swa ra gho ṣā/ nā gen+d+ra ru tā/ garnyar+bha ⑦saṃ gī sgra shugs/ glang po che'i sgra skad/ 'brug gi sgra skad/ klu yi dbang po'i sgra/ dri za'i ti sgo ṣā⑧/ ka la bo ⑨ka swa ra ru tā/ bra h+pha swa ra ru ta ra bi tā/ dzī baṃ ṭī ba glu dbyangs/ ka la ping ka'i dbyangs/ tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa/ shang shang te'u'i ka swa ra ru ta ra bi tā/ de ben+d+ra madhū ⑩ra nisgo ṣā⑪/ dun+d+ra bhi swa rā⑫/ a nun+da sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa/ lha'i dbang po'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa/ rnga'i sgra/ ma khengs tā—/ a na ba na tā/ sarba shabhā nu pra biṣ+ṭa/ a ba shap+ta bi ga tā/ a bi ka lā/pa| mi dma' ⑫ba/ sgra thams cad kyi rjes su zhugs pa/ tshig zur chag med pa/ ma tshang ba med pa/a lī nā/ a dī nā/ pra mu di tā/ pra sre ④tā/ sa khi khā/ sa ri tā/ la li tā/ma zhum pa/ mi zhan pa/ rab tu dga' ba⑫/ khyab pa/ chub pa/ rgyun chags pa/ 'bel ba/sarba swa ra pū ra ḍā/ sarbe— ⑩ya sarnyo ṣa bhā/ a nin+di ⑩tā/ a tsañtsa lā/sgra thams cad rdzogs par byed pa/ dbang po thams cad tshim par byed pa/ ma smad pa/ mi 'gyur ba/a tsa pa khā/ sarba par+ṣa da nu ra bi tā/ saṭ+wā kā ra ba ro pe spyotā/ma rtabs ⑪pa/ 'khor kun du grags pa/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nang nas 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ming la/shu re ga mo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ rjo / rat+na mu dā nā ma sa mā byeḥ/dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rin chen phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/115—21

su tsadz+nyā nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ dzi ①ha bi khri ④ḍi to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ seng ge rnam par rtse ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/tsan+d+ra dh+wa dza ke turwa snem sa mā dhiḥ/ sarba dhasgroṅga ④to nā ma zla ba'i rgyal mtshan tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos thams cad las shin tu 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i sa mā dhiḥ/ sarba dhasmra ⑤mu drwa nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ bi lo ki ta rūting nge 'dzin/ chos thams cad kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ spyi gtsug rnam par lta rjob zhes rnyo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ dhasmra ⑦dz+nyā tu ni ya to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ni ya to dh+wa dza bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos kyi dbyings su nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ nges pa'i rgyal mtshan ke tu tsā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ badzo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ sarba dhan+d+ra ⑧pra be sha tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i phyag mu dā nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ sa mā dhi rā dza su pra ⑨tikhyu to nā ma sa mā rnyiḥ/rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po ltar rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/rasmi ⑩pra musto nā ma sa mā rnyiḥ/ ba la byu ho nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ dpung bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/sa muṅga to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ni ruk+to ni ya ta ⑪pra be sho nā ma yang dag par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ nges pa'i tshig la gdon mi za bar 'jug pa zhes bya sa mā dhiḥ/ a rnyi ba tsa na pra be sho nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ disngo ⑫lo ki to ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ tshig bla dwags la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ phyogs la rnam par blta ba nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ā dhā ra mu dru nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a saṃ pra mo sngo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ brjed pa med pa nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ sarba dhan+d+ra ⑫sa ma ba sha ra ṇa sā ga ra mu dru nā ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos thams cad yang dag par 'du ba rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i 115—22

sa mā dhiḥ/ ā ①kā sha spa ra rto nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa lo nā ma ting nge 'dzin/ nam mkha' khyab par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhes sa mā dhiḥ/ dh+wa dz+dza gra ke yu ro nā ma sa mā rnyiḥ/ in+d+ra ke tu bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ dbang po'i tog ces nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ sro tolhanu ga ③tā nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ dzi ha skebi dz+re bhi 0to bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rgyun gyi jes su song ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ seng ge rnam par bgyings nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ bya t+yasto nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ra ṇa dza ho nā ma pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ snrel zhi zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ nyon mongs pa spong ba zhes bya ba'i sa mā dhiḥ/ bai ro tsa no ⑤nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a ni mi ṣe ④nā ma sa mā rnyiḥ/ting nge 'dzin/ rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ tshol ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/a ni ke ta sbi to tsā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ni—sto nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ bi ma gnas la brten med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ sems med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ dri ma la pra dri po nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a narnya pra sgo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ pra dhā ⑦med pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'od mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'od byed ka ro nā ma sa mā dhi⑧ཿ/ shudha sā ro nā ma sa mā dhi⑨ཿ/ bi ma la pra sgo nā ma pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ dag pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'od dri ma med pa zhes bya sa mā dhitho)ཿ/ ra ti ka ro nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ bi byu ta pra dī po nā ma sa ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ glog gi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge mā dhiḥ/ a k+ṣa yo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a dze yo ⑪nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ te dzo 'dzin/ zad mi shes pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ mi pham pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ gzi ba tī nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ k+ṣa yā pa ga to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ tsan+d+ra bi ma brjid yod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ zad pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ zla ba dri ma 115—23

lo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ srur+ya ①pra dī po ④nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a bai bsto ⑧nā ma med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ nyi ma'i sgon ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'gyur ba med pa zhes bya sa mā dhiḥ/ a no dubyo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ pra dz+nyā pra dī po nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/shusnya pra ti bhā so nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ā ⑤lo ka ka ro nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ kā 0ra kā ⑦ro snang ba gsal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ snang ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ bya ba byed pa nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ dz+nyā na ke tudrwa ma sa mā dhiḥ/ badzo pa mo nā ma sa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ ye shes tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge mā dhiḥ/ tsit+ta byu to nā ma sa mā byeḥ/ sa man+ta lo ko nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/'dzin/ sems gnas pa zhes bya bya ⑧ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/su pra tiṣ+ṭṛ to ⑨nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ rat+na ko ṭirtswa ⑩ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ba ra rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rin chen mtha' zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos dam dhabyu ⑪mu dru nā ma sa mā byeḥ/ sarba dhadz+re sa ma tā nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ra ti dza ho nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ dhaspoṅga to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ bi ki dga' ba spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos kyi 'phags pa zhes pa'i ⑫ting nge 'dzin/ rnam par ra ḍo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/⑫ sarba dhan+d+ra pa da pra ste do nā ma sa mā 'thor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/⑫ chos thams cad kyi tshig rab tu 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge dhiḥske/ sa mā k+ṣa rā ba kā ro nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a k+ṣa rā pa ga to nā ma sa mā 'dzin—/ yi ge mnyam par 'god pa zhes bya ba'i bhang nge 'dzin/ yi ge dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge dhiḥ—/ ā rasba ṇa ts+tshad ⑫no nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a bi kā ro nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/'dzin—/ dmigs pa gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rnam pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/115—24

a pra kā ro nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ nā ma ni ya ta pra be+e sho nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/'gyur ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ ming nges par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/a ni ke ta tsā ①rī nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ti mi rā pa ga to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/gnas med par spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rab rib med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/tsā ri tra ba tī nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a tsa lo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ bi ṣa yaspyod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ g.yo ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ yul las brgal tīsto nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ sarba gu ṇa sañtsa ya ga to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ yon tan thams cad kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/sbri ta ni—sto nā ma sa mā dhiḥ / shu bha puṣ+ṭṛ ⑤ ta shudhirtswa ma sa sems med par gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ dge ba'i me tog rgyas shing dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting mā rnyiḥ/ a nan+ta pra ti bhā ①no nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ bo bye dhig ba tī nā ma nge 'dzin/ sgobs pa mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ byang chub kyi yan lag yod pa zhes bya sa mā dhiḥ / a sa ma sa mā nā ma sa mā dhiḥ / sarba dha s+thā ti ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos thams cad las kra ma ṇi ⑤nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ pa rits+tsha da ka ro nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ bi rjom ti 'da' ba ⑦zhes bya ba'i ting nge ⑧'dzin/ yongs su gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ ne+em nur rnam bi ki ra rto nā ma sa mā dhiḥ⑨/ ni ra ba ⑩dhiṣ+ṭha no nā ma sa mā byeḥ/ e ka par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ gnas su bya ba med pa ⑪zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ bkod pa byu ho tsā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ā kā rā ⑫bhi ni hā ⑫ro nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/gcig pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rnam par mngon par bsgrub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/e kā kā ro nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ā kā rā na ba kā ro nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/rnam pa gcig tu gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rnam pa dor ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/115—25

ne+erbe ①dhi ka sarba bha ba ⑤ta mo pa ga to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ saṃ ④ke ta ru ta pra be sho rtogs pas srid pa'i gzhi thams cad khong du chud pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ brda dang sgra la 'jug pa nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ nisgo ṣā k+ṣa ra rjobi muk+to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ dz+wa la nolka ⑤zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ sgra dbyangs kyi yi ge dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ sgron ma 'bar nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ lak+ṣa ṇa pa ri sho dha no nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a na rnyi ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ mtshan nyid yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ mngon par ma lak+ṣi to nā ma sa mā rnyiḥ/ sar+pā rjokā ra pa ro pe to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/a k+ṣa ya ka raṇ+ḍi nā ma sa mā rnyiḥ/ dhā ⑦ra bhā ma tirtswa ⑧ma sa mā rnyiḥ/mi zad pa'i za ma tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ gzungs kyi blo gros zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/samyak+ta mi ⑨byā twa sarba saṃ tsu)gra sa thospreno nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ sarba ro yang dag pa dang log pa thams cad yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'gal ba dang dha bi ⑫ro dha saṃ pra sha ⑫ma no nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ sarba su kha duḥkha 'gog pa thams cad yang dag par zhi ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge spyo'adzin/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ni ra bhi nan+di nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a nu ro dha ⑫pra ti ro ho thams cad la mngon par dga' ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ mthun pa dang 'gal ba med pa ⑩nā ma sa mā rnyiḥ/ bi ma la pra sgo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ sā ra ba tī ⑫nā ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'od dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ snying po dang ldan pa zhes bya sa mā dhiḥ/ pa ri pūṇ+ḍi ⑫tsan+d+ra bi ma la pra sgo nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ bi byun+d+ra ⑪bho nā ma ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ zla ba nya ba'i 'od dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ glog gi 'od ces bya sa mā dhiḥ/ ma hā byu ⑫ho nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ sar+pā kā ⑥ra pra bhā kā duro ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ bkod pa chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rnam pa thams cad du 'od byed pa 115—26

nā ma sa mā rnyiḥ/ sa mā dhi sa ma ①tā nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a ra dzo bi zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ ting nge 'dzin mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rdul med cing ra dzo na ya yuk+to nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a ra ṇa sa ma ba sa ②ra ḍo rdul dang bral ba'i tshul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ nyon mongs pa med par yang dag par nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a ra ṇa sa ra ṇa saza ①sa ma ba sa ④'du ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ nyon mongs pa med pa dang nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa thams cad ⑤ra rto nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ a ni lo bha ni ke ༷ta ni ka to nā ma yang dag par 'du ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ gnas la brten ④pa med pa la brtson pa zhes bya ba'i sa mā dhiḥ/ ta tha ⑧tā byu ta stini—sto nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ kā ya ka li saṃ ting nge 'dzin/ de bzhin nyid la gnas shing sems med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ lus kyi skyon pra marba no ⑩nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ bāk+ka lo ⑪be+e t+t+waṃ sa na ga ga na kaspo yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ ngag gi skyon rnam par 'jig ⑫pas nam mkha' ltar gyur pa zhes bya ba'i nā ma sa mā dhiḥ/ ā kā shā saṃ ga bi muk+to ni ru pa le po nā ma ⑫sa mā dhiḥ//ting nge 'dzin/ nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pas rnam par grol zhing gos pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin/byang chub sems dpa' spyi'i mtshan la sogs pa'i ming la/ byang chub sems dpa' spyi'i mtshan la/bo dhi sa twaḥ/ ma hā sa twaḥ/ dhī mān⑫/ ut+ta ma byu tiḥ⑫/ dzi na pu traḥ/byang chub sems dpa'/ sems dpa' chen po/ blo ldan/ gsal mchog /rgyal ba'i sras/dzi nā dh+wa raḥ/ bi dze tā⑩/ dzi ṭ+wāṃ ku raḥ/ bi krān+taḥ⑩/ pa ra mār+ya⑫ཿ/rgyal ba'i gzhi/ rnam par rgyal byed/ rgyal ba'i myu gu/ rtsal ldan/ 'phags mchog /sārja bā haḥ/ ma hā ya shāḥ /kṛ pā luḥ/ ma hā pu 5ཿ/ sī ⑪shwa raḥ/ded dpon/ grags chen/ snying rje can/ bsod nams che/ dbang phyug /115—27

dham+bi kaḥ/ dze ①no ra saḥ/ dhan+d+ra ②to nirga taḥ/ nirdzi ④taḥ/ mu kha to dzā taḥ//chos dang ldan pa/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi sras/ chos las byung ba/ nges par rgyal ba/rjo zhal nas skyes pa/byang chub sems dpa' so so'i mtshan la/a ba lo ki te shwa raḥ/ be+e tre yaḥ/ ā kā sha gasgoḥ/ sa marnya bha draḥ/spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /byams pa/ nam mkha'i snying po/ kun du bzang po/badz+ra pā ṇi⑤ཿ/ mañdzu shrī ku mā ra khyu rjotaḥ/ sarba ni ⑦ba ra ṇa bi skasnyiḥ/ k+ṣi ti gar+bhaḥ/lag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba/ sa'i snying po/ma hā s+thā ma pāp+taḥ/ rat+na ke ④tuḥ/ rat+na pā ṇiḥ/ rat+na mu dru ⑨hastaḥ/ rat+na mthu chen thob/ rin po che'i tog lag na rin chen/ lag na phyag rgya rin po che/ cod pan mu ku ṭaḥ/ rat+na tsū ḍaḥ/ rat+na ⑩ku ⑪ṭaḥ/ rat+na ka raḥ/ rat+na shi kha raḥ/rin po che/ gtsug na rin po che/ rin chen brtseg pa/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ rin po che'i rtse mo/rat+na dh+wa dzatho)ཿ/ badz+ra gar+bhaḥ/ su baṇ+ḍi gar+bhaḥ/ rat+na gar+bhaḥ/ shrī gar+bhaḥ/rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje'i snying po/ gser gyi snying po/ rin po che'i snying po/ dpal gyi snying po/shu bha gasgoḥ/ shu bha bi ma la gasgoḥ/ ta thā ga ta gar+bhaḥ/ dz+nyā na gar+bhaḥ/dge ba'i snying po/ dge ba dri ma med pa'i snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/ ye shes kyi ⑫snying po/srur+ya ⑫gasnyaḥ/ sa mā dhi gar+bhaḥ/ pad+ma gasnyaḥ/ bi muk+to tsan+d+raḥ/ sa madha byane+e traḥ/nyi ma'i snying po/ ting nge 'dzin gyi snying po/ pad+ma'i snying po/ rnam par gol ba'i zla ba/ kun du mig /pad+ma ne+e traḥ/ bi ma la ne+e traḥ/ bi shā la ne+e traḥ/ sa marnyer+yā ⑫pa thaḥ/ sa man+ta pā pad+ma'i mig /dri ma med pa'i mig /yangs pa'i mig /kun du spyod lam/ kun nas sā di ⑩kaḥ/ dz+nyā na ba tre+eḥ/ sa man+ta tsā ri tra ma tiḥ/ dza ya ma tiḥ/mdzes—/ ye shes ldan pa/ kun du spyod pa'i blo gros/ rgyal ba'i blo gros/115—28

sau ha ①bi shrī ḍi taḥ/ ma hā gho ṣa swa ra rā dzā / dzi ha ④nā da nā diḥ/ gi ṭī ①ra gho seng ge rnam par rol ba/ sgra chen po'i dbyangs kyi rgyal po/ seng ge'i sgra sgogs④/ zab mo'i ṣa swa ⑤nā di taḥ/ a nu pa lip+taḥ/ sarba ma bukhā pa ga taḥ/ tsan+d+ra pra bhaḥ/ srur+ya ⑦dbyangs kyi nga ro sgrogs pa/ gos pa med pa/ dri ma kun dang bral ba/ zla 'od/ nyi ma'i pra bhaḥ/ dz+nyā na pra bhaḥ/ bha dra pā laḥ/ me ru shi kha ra dhā ra 9ku mā ra bhū taḥ/ ba ru 'od/ ye shes 'od/ bzang skyong / lhun po rtse 'dzin gzhon nur gyur pa/ chu lha'i ṇa ma ti ⑨ku mā ra bhū ⑩taḥ/ su ma ti ku mā ra bhū ⑪taḥ/ ni rkyo byuk+ta⑫ཿ/ su sārba blo gros gzhon nur gyur pa/ bzang po'i blo gros gzhon nur gyur pa/ rtag tu brtson/ ded dpon bā ⑫haḥ/ byo tiṣ+ṭha ti ④ku mā ra byu taḥ/ dudzhaste ⑫ku mā ra bhū /7taḥ/ ga ga na gañdza⑩ཿ/bzang po/ 'od can gzhon nur gyur pa/ thub dka' gzhon nur gyur pa/ nam mkha' mdzod/ shu re ga maḥ/⑫ a k+ṣa ya ma tiḥ/ pra ti bhā na ku ⑪ṭaḥ/ gan+ta ha steḥ/ dzā le dpa' bar 'gro ba/() blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ spos kyi glang bo/ dra ba nī pra bhaḥ/ bsgo 0mā na ma tiḥ/ sa man+ta pra bhaḥ/ ā ( )di t+ya can gyi ⑫'od/ 'phel ba'i blo gos/ kun du 'od / srurlu 0 dang ma 'dom na nyi ma'i snying po gar+bhaḥ⑫—/ sarba bi ṣa yā ba bhā sā 0lo kā ra pra ti bhā na dar+sha na ⑦gar+bhaḥ/ a ma 'dom na nyi gdugs ⑫snying po/ yul thams cad snang ba'i rgyan sgobs pas ston pa'i snying po/ dri ma med la gar+bhaḥ/ bi ma la gar+bhaḥ/ byo ti dz+wa la nāzlo ⑩shrī garjaḥ/ badz+ra sā raḥ/pa'i snying po/ dri ma dang bral ba'i snying po/ 'od 'bar zhing 'phro ba'i dpal gyi snying po/ rdo rje snying po⑩/ni t+ya pra bhaḥ/ ā shugarnya⑪ཿ/ gu ha gup+taḥ/ a mo gha dazlo/ su saṃ pro spri ⑫taḥ/rtag tu 'od/ dri mgyogs/ phug sbas/ mthong ba don yod/ legs par yang dag bzhugs/a ni k+ṣibe+e dhu ⑫raḥ/ a nu pa ha ta ma tiḥ/ ni trospyop+ta (3hastaḥ/ na dī dat+taspyo/brtson pa mi gtong / blo gros ma nyams pa/ rtag tu lag brkyang / chu bo byin⑫/115—29

bi dza ya bi krā m+bi①/ dza ya dat+taḥ/ bi ga ta sho kaḥ/ bha dra kalpi ②ka bo rnam par rgyal bar gnon pa/ rgyal bas byin/ mya ngan bral/ bskal ba bzang po'i byang chub dhi sa twaḥ/ a ①bye tsa ma ho dzaska rjobo dhi sa twaḥ/ dza ga tirnya raḥ/ byo tiḥ⑤sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid che ba gzhan dag kyang / 'gro ba 'dzin/ skar ma'i 'od pra bhaḥ/ e ka kān+ta rā dzā/ khyu rjomi ba la ⑦bai shā ra r+ya dhā ri⑧—/ su tsan+d+raḥ/dam me'i 'od/ gcig tu mdzes pa'i rgyal po⑨/ sa dang stobs dang mi 'jigs pa 'chang ba/ zla mdzes/a pa rā dzi ta te dzaḥ/ a tsis ()ka ma rgya burnyi bi khri ḍi tsuspetaḥ/ tshwa na gzi brjid gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dkyil la blos rnam par rol pa/ ye shes bi khyu ti ⑫gasnyaḥ/ burtse badz+ra san+d+ra ra ṇa ⑫sarnyiḥ//'byor pa'i snying po/ sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mtshams spyor ba⑫//byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ming la/rat+na sa muṅga taḥ/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhaḥ/ a kaspya⑫ཿ/ a bi ni bsto rī yaḥ/rin chen kun du 'phags/ shin tu gnas pa/ mi bsgul ba/ phyir mi ldog pa/ rat+na ka raḥ/ srur+ya ()pra bha te dzaḥ/ sar+pārba sirtseḥ/ dz+nyā nolka⑩ཿ/dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi gzi brjid/ don thams cad grub pa/ ye shes sgron ma/pra kyut+pan+da ⑫burnyaḥsaṃ mu khā babyu taḥ//da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum ⑫bzhugs pa/byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs bcu gnyis kyi ming la/a bhi ṣe tsa ba tī⑥ཿ/ ⑫bi shurtse swa ra ni snyo ṣā⑫/ a k+ṣa ya ka raṇ+ḍa/ a nan+d+ra dbang bskur ldan/⑫ sgra dbyangs rnam par dag pa/ mi zad pa'i za ma tog /'khyil pa 115byed30

ba1① / sā ga ra mu dru②/ pad+ma byu hā④/ a saṃ dug mu kha pra be shā⑤/ pra ti saṃ mtha' yas pa/ rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya/ pad+ma bkod pa/ chags pa med pa'i sgor 'jug pa/ so so ⑦bi—sh+tsa yā ba tā rā⑦/ bud+dhā lo kā rā dhiṣ+ṭṛ tākhru/ a nan+ta ba—⑨/yang dag par rig pa nges pa la 'jug pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyan byin gyis brlabs pa/ kha dog mtha' yas pa/burtse kā ya baṇ+ḍi pa ri niṣ+ka t+yā rnyi nir+sā rā⑩//sangs rgyas kyi sku'i kha dog yongs su rdzogs pa mngon par bsgrub pa/byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcu'i ming la/lhag sha ya ba lo/ a sgyu sha ya ba lo/ pra yo ga ba lo⑩/ dz+nyā na ba lo⑫/bsam pa'i stobs/ lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs⑫/ sbyor ba'i stobs/ ye shes kyi stobs/pra ṇi d+mā ⑫na ba lo⑫/ yā na ba lo/ tsar+ya ⑩ba lo/ bi kuzaṇa ⑩ba lo/smon lam gyi stobs/ theg pa'i stobs/ spyod pa'i stobs/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i stobs/bo rnyi ba lo/ dharma tsakra pra brta na ba lo//byang chub kyi stobs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i stobs/byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bcu'i ming la/ā yurba shi 8tā/ tsit+ta ba shi tā/ pa ri sku ra ba shi tā/ kan+d+ra ⑪ba shi tā/tshe la dbang ba/ sems la dbang ba/ yo byad la dbang ba/ las la dbang ba/u pa pati ba shi tā/ a dhi mut+ta ba shi tā/ dhan+d+ra ⑥ba shi tā/ pra ṇi sgyu na ba shi tā/skye ba la dbang ba/ mos pa la dbang ba/ chos la dbang ba/ smon lam la dbang ba/ṛrnyi ⑥ba shi ⑫tā/ dz+nyā na ba shi tā//rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba/ ye shes la dbang ba/115—31

byang chub sems dpa'i mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i ming la/dhā ra rji shu tosgra ha ṇ+ḍarba ①nirde sha bai shā ra bye/ ne+e raju ②dhi ga māt+pa ra be+e gzungs kyi thos pa 'dzin cing don bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa/ bdag med pa khong du chud he ṭha nā ni mit+ta sa mu dā tsā ①ra sa ha ④dzā na dhi gi ⑤terlu pa tha tri pas gzhan gyis gtse rjoba'i mtshan ma mi 'byung zhing rang bzhin gyis ⑦spyod lam smad du med pa'i ④kan+d+ra⑨—/ pa ri shudha ma hā rak+ṣa saṃ pan+da bai shā ra bye/ sa do ta kṛ hi ta ⑩las gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsrung ba chen po phun sum tshogs pa'i mi 'jigs pa/ chos gzung ba yun du dharmā bi sma ra ṇa pra zlo pā ya nijo ga ta sa twa nistu ra ṇa ⑪pra sā da san+dar+sha na shu mi brjed pa dang thabs dang shes rab mthar phyin pas sems can sgrol zhing dad pa ston pa dang dge ba'i bar chad bhā nan+ta rā yi ka bai shā ra bye/ sarba dz+nyā tā tsiṭ+wā saṃ ⑫pra mo ṣā n+ya yā nā nir+yā ṇa saṃ du mi 'gyur ba'i mi 'jigs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems ma nyams shing theg pa gzhan gyis mi 'byung pūr+ṇa ⑫ba si tā sarba bra ⑫kā ra sa tārba saṃ pā pa ṇa ⑫bai shā ra bye//bar dbang yongs su rdzogs pa dang sems can gyi don rnam pa thams cad du yang dag par thob par bya ba la mi 'jigs pa/byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi ming la/a nu pa diṣ+ṭa dā nā⑩ཿ/ a nu pa diṣ+ṭa shī lā⑩ཿ/ a nu pa diṣ+ṭa k+ṣun+ta ma bstan pa'i sbyin pa can rnams/ ma bstan pa'i tshul khrims can rnams/ ma bstan pa'i bzod pa ya⑫ཿ—/ a nu pa diṣ+ṭa bīrlu⑪ཿ/ a nu pa diṣ+ṭa ⑫sgyu nāḥ/can rnams/ ma bstan pa'i brtson 'grus can rnams/ ma bstan pa'i bsam gtan can rnams/a nu pa diṣ+ṭa pra dz+nyāḥ/ saṃ gra ha ba stu sarba sa twa saṃ gā ha kā⑪ཿ/ma bstan pa'i shes rab can rnams/ bsdu ba'i dngos pos sems can thams cad ⑫sdud pa can ⑫rnams/115—32

pa ri ṇa ma na ①bi dhi dz+nyāḥ/ u pā ya kau sha l+ya sarba sa twa tsa ri yongs su bsngo ba'i cho ga shes pa rnams/ thabs mkhas pas sems can thams cad kyi spyod tā ba shi ta pa ra ma yā na ni rlu ṇa san+dar+sha kāḥ / ma hā yā nā sgo pa'i dbang gis theg pa'i mchog gis 'byung ba ④rnams/ theg pa chen po las ma nyams pa tāḥ—/ saṃ sā ra nir+pā ṇa mu kha san+dar+sha kāḥ/ ya ma ka bya t+yastu hā ra ku sha rnams/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo ston pa rnams/ zung dang snrel zhi'i rgyud la mkhas pa khāḥ—/ dz+nyā na pūbaṃ ga ma nā ①bhi saṃ s+thā ra nir ba bye 4/sarba dzad+mā bhi mu kha rnams—/ ye shes sngon du 'gro bas mngon par 'du mi byed cing kha na ma tho ba med par tshe rabs thams cad pra dṛt+tha ཿ/ da sha ku sha lo pe ta kā ya bāgla na skarmān+d+raḥ/du mngon du zhugs pa rnams/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' dge ba bcu dang ldan pa rnams/sarba duḥ kha ska rnya sa hā nāsmro pā dā na sarba sa twa dh+wa twa pa ri t+yā sdug bsngal gyi phung po thams cad bzod pa'i lus len pas rjosems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su gi naḥ/ sarba dza gad bhi ru tsi ta saṃ dar+sha kārngo raḥ/ ki yaskṛts+tsha mi gtong ba rnams/ 'gro ba thams cad mngon par dga' bar ston pa rnams/ byes pa dang bā la shā ba ka ma rgya shu bha byu ⑦ha rat+na kalpa dṛk+ṣa dṛ bhā sarba dz+nya ⑧tā nyan thos mi bzad pa ji snyed cig gi nang na yang dge ba mang po'i rin po che'i shing dpag bsam ltar brtan pa'i thams tsit+ta saṃ pra mu ṣi tāḥ/ sarba dharma pa ṭ+wā ba d+dhā ⑨bhi ṣe ka pābhi cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ⑩sems yongs su ma nyams pa rnams/ chos thams cad thabs sbyin pas dbang bskur ba burnya ⑪dhan+d+ra parleji ⑫san+dar+sha nā ni thraṣ+ṭha⑫ཿ//thob par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos btsal ba bstan pa la phyir mi ldog pa rnams/115—33

mdo sde las byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan thog thog smos pa'i ming la/e ka dzā ti pra ti badhaḥ/ sarba dz+nyā tā bhi mu khaḥ/ sarba dz+nyā tā skye ba gcig gis thogs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon du phyogs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nisnaḥ①—/ sarba dz+nyā tā pra ba ṇaḥ/ sarba tshwa tā pāsgo raḥ/ a saṃ nyid la gzhol ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'bab pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la bab pa/ chags pa ga dhā ra bhā sa mā dhi pra ti la ba dhaḥ/ shu re ga ma ②sa mā dhi ①sa ma nā ga taḥ/med pa'i gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin thob pa/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa/ma hā rnyi dz+nyā bi 1 ḍi taḥ/ sar+pā ba ra ṇa parlubye rjon bi ga taḥ/mngon par shes pa chen pos rnam par rol pa/ sgrib pa dang chod pa dang kun nas ldang ba thams cad dang bral ba/a pra ti pra srabha mārgaḥ/ ma hā mi ṭī ⑤ma hā ka ru ṇa da sha diglo ka dujo tu spa ra ṇaḥ/lam gyi rgyun ma chad pa/ byams pa ⑦dang snying rje chen pos phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su khyab pa/a nan+ta burnya k+ṣe tā kra ma ṇa ku sha laḥ/ shu n+ya tā go tsa raḥ/ a ni mit+ta bi sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas par 'gro ba la mkhas pa/ stong pa nyid kyi spyod yul ba/ mtshan ma med pa hā riḥ/ sarba pra sgeṇi d+mā na ni ⑨shra ya bi ga taḥ/ sarba sa twa hi tā byu ⑩r+ya taḥ/la gnas pa/ smon lam la gnas pa thams cad dang bral ba/ sems can thams cad la phan par brtson pa/sarba budha bi ṣa ya ku sha laḥ⑪/ a nan+ta dz+nyā naḥ⑫/ ā kā sha sa ma tsit+taḥ⑫/sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad la mkhas pa/ ye shes mtha' yas pa/ sems nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/sā ga ra baṅgaspyi ra tsit+taḥ/ su me ru barba ta rā dza ⑫ba da kamyu tsit+taḥ/ pad+ma ba da nu sems rgya mtsho ltar zab pa/ sems ri'i rgyal po ri rab ltar mi sgul spyob/ sems pad+ma ltar ma pa lip+ta tsit+taḥ/ rat+na bsi pa ri shudha ⑫tsit+taḥ/ su baṇ+ḍi bakhru par+ya ⑩ba dā gos pa/ sems rin po che ltar shin tu yongs su dag pa/ sems gser ltar shin tu yongs su 115—34

ta tsit+taḥ/ a pa ri mi ta dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ra parle ṣa ṇa ①ku sha laḥ/ pa ra pra bā r+ya na byang ba/ ye shes kyi tshogs tshad med pa ⑦yongs su tshol ba la mkhas pa/ pha rol gyi rgol bas zil bhi dhū ①taḥ/ sarba dharmā nā ba ra ṇa dz+nyā nī/ sarba sa twa sa ma tsit+taḥ//gyis mi non pa/ chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes can/ sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa/sarba mā ra bi ṣa ya sa ma ti krān+tarjoḥ/ sarba ta thā ga ta be+e ⑤ṣa yā ba tā ra dz+nyā na bdud kyi yul thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ku sha laḥ/ ma hā mi ṭī ma hā ka ru ṇ+ḍa sa man+d+ra rjog taḥ/ u pā ya dz+nyā na ku sha laḥ/shes pa la mkhas pa/ byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po dang ldan pa/ thabs shes pa la ⑦mkhas pa/dhā ⑧ra tī pra ti labhaḥ/ pra ṇi dhā nā ⑨kalpi taḥ/ k+ṣurnyi sa ma tā pra ti labhaḥ/ a sgo tā gzungs thob pa/ smon lam ma brtags pa/ bzod pas ( )mnyam pa nyid thob pa/ mngon par rnyi dzhatsuspreḥ/ ni tho)rā mi ṣa dharma de sha kaḥ/ shaṃ dhī tho)ra dharma k+ṣurnyi pā ra mo ga taḥ/shes pa ma nyams pa/ zang zing med par chos ston pa/ chos zab mo la bzod pa'i pha rol tu son pa/mā ra kan+d+ra sa ma ti krān+taḥ/ karmā ba ra ṇa pra ti pra srasnyaḥ/ dhabyu pra bi tsa ya bdud kyi las las yang dag par 'das pa⑫/ las kyi sgrib pa'i rgyun bcad pa/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed bi bhat+ta nirde sha ku sha laḥ/ a saṃ ⑫khye ya kalpa pra ṇi dhā na su sa mā ram+bha⑩ཿ/pas rnam par dbye ba bstan pa la mkhas pa/ bskal pa grangs med par smon lam shin tu brtsams pa/smi ta mu kha pūr+pā ⑩nyi khā piḥ/ gā thā bhi gī tā bhi lā pa naḥ/ a pa ga ta lī na tsit+taḥ/bzhin 'dzum zhing gsong por smra ba/ tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis ⑫smra ba/ sems zhum pa med pa/a nāts+tsha r+ya pra ti bhā naḥ/ a nan+ta pa ri ṣa da rnyi bha ba naḥ/ a nan+ta kalpa spobs pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/ 'khor mtha' yas pa zil gyis gnon pa/ bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas pa ko ṭī niḥ/ sa ra ṇa ku sha laḥ/ mā yā ma rī tsi ko da ka tsan+d+ra las 'byung ba la mkhas pa/ sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang / chu zla dang / rmi lam dang / brag 115—35

swasna pra ti byuṭ+wā ①pra ti bhā sa pra ti bisbra nis+thā ④ḍo pa ma dhas+thā rnyi muk+taḥ①/ a pra ti ha ca ④dang / mig yor dang / gzugs brnyan dang / sprul pa lta bu'i chos la mos pa/ sems thogs ta tsit+taḥ/ sa twa tsit+ta tsa ri ta sru gh+ra dz+nyā nā bye mukhya ba tā ⑤ra ku sha laḥ/ a dhi mā tra rjopa med pa/ sems can gyi sems dang spyod pa shes pa phra mo la mos shing 'jug mkhas pa/ bzod pa chen k+ṣurnyi sa ma nā ga taḥ/ ya thābyu ba tā ⑦ra ku sha laḥ/ budha k+ṣe tra byu hā nadha pra ṇi ⑧po dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin du 'jug mkhas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa mtha' dhā na pra s+thā ⑨na pa ri kṛ tī taḥ/ a saṃ khye ya lo ka dz+dza tu bud+dhā nu smṛ yas par smon pa la 'jug pas yongs su gzung ⑩ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa'i sangs rgyas ti sa mā ⑪bye sa ta ta sa mi ta a bhi mu khā+e khyu taḥ/ a pa ri mi ta bud+dhā rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin rtag par rgyun du mngon du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la bye ṣa ṇa ⑫ku sha laḥ/ nā nā dṛsgyu spyonu sha ya par+ya bas+thā na kle ④sha pra sha ma na gsol ba ⑫'debs mkhas pa/ lta ba tha dad pa dang bag la nyal dang kun nas dkris pa'i nyon mongs pa ku sha laḥ/ sa mā bye bi shrī ḍi ta sha ta sa ha sra nirtu ra ku sha laḥ/rab tu zhi bar byed pa la mkhas pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par rol ba brgya stong bsgrub ⑩pa la mkhas pa/sarba rnye ⑫tā nirlu taḥ/ tre+e dh+wa tu kā sak+taspyoḥ/ ga ti ga taḥ/thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la nges par 'byung ba/ khams gsum la ma chags pa/ rtogs par khong du chud pa/sar+pā shā pa ri pū ra kaḥ/ a pra mā ṇa sa mā dhi ⑪sa mā pasbyi⑥ཿ sa ma nā ga re ba thams cad yongs su skong ba/ ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa tshad med pa dang taḥ⑩ske/ a mo gha kā ya bād+mā na skas+thār+sā bhi 3yuk+taḥ/ a pra mā ṇa sa mā rnyi ldan pa/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' don yod pa la brtson pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod pa tsar+yā dhiṣ+ṭṛ ⑪taḥ/ na pu nasbo dhi sa twa ma hā sa twaḥkā ④ma gu be+erlip+taḥ/tshad med pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dod pa'i yon tan gyis ma gos pa/115—36

sarba sa mā rnyi ①ba shi tā pā ④ra mo ga taḥ/ a nu ba listolo ka dhamaiḥg/ting nge 'dzin thams cad la dbang gi pha rol tu son pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos rnams kyis ma gos pa/yuk+ta pra ti bhā naḥ/ muk+ta pra ti bhā naḥ/ mi byut+ma kaḥ/ ka ru ṇat+ma rjorig par spobs pa/ sgobs pa grol ba/ byams pa'i bdag nyid can/ snying rje'i bdag nyid kaḥ—/ mu di tā bi hā rī⑤/ u pe k+ṣu rjobi hā rī⑦/ a sgo ta shī laḥ/ a tsu ta sa can| dga' ba la gnas pa/ btang snyoms la gnas pa/ tshul khrims nyams pa med pa/ ting nge 'dzin mā rnyiḥ/ a rnyi dz+nyā bi bī ḍi taḥ/ te tsa bo dhi sa twa ⑧ma hā sa twa byu nyams pa med pa/ mngon par shes pas rnam par rol pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de yaste ⑨na sarba ku mā ra bhū ⑩tāḥ/ bha dra kalpi ⑪ka bo bye sa twaḥ//dag thams cad kyang phal cher gzhon nur gyur pa/ bskal ba bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa'⑫/byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i ming la/pra mu di tā⑫/ bi ma lāspyo/ pra bhā kā rīspyo/ artsiṣ+ṭha tī⑩/ su dudz+dza yā/rab tu dga' ba/ dri ma med pa/ 'od byed pa/ 'od 'phro can/ shin tu sbyang dka' ba/a t+ta ⑩mu khā+e/ dru re ga mā/ a tsa lā/ sā dhu ma tī/ dhadz+re ⑫me ghā//mngon du gyur pa/ ring du song ba/ mi g.yo ba/ legs pa'i blo gros/ chos kyi sprin/mos pas spyod pa'i sa'i ming la/a dhi ⑪muk+to tsarlu bhū miḥ/ ā ⑫lo ka la bhaḥ/ ā spyolo ka thra 3dhiḥ/ ta tābe+e ka mos pa spyod pa'i sa/ snang ba thob ()pa/ snang ba mched pa/ de kho na'i don gyi phyogs de shā nu pra ba shaḥ④/ a nan+tar+ya sa mā dhiḥ//gcig la rjes su zhugs pa⑫/ bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/115—37

mos pas spyod pa'i sa la chos spyod bcu'i ming la/le kha nā/ pū dza nā/ dā dz+wa①/ shra ba rde/ bā tsa tsā②/ usgra ha r+ṇa/yi ger bri ①ba/ mchod pa/ sbyin pa/ nyan pa/ klog pa/ 'dzin pa/pra kā sha nā/ swā sgyu yaḥ cis nā/ bhā ba nā④//rab tu ston pa/ kha ton ⑤byed pa/ sems pa/ sgom pa/pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i ming la/dā na pā ra mi tā/ shī rjol pā ra mi tā/ k+ṣurnyi pā ra mi tā/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/bīr+ya pā ra mi tā/ dh+yā ⑦na pā ra mi tā/ pra 1 pā ra mi tā/ u pā brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ thabs kyi pha ya pā ra mi tā/ pra ṇi dh+wa na pā ra ⑧mi tā/ ba la pā ra mi tā/ dz+nyā na pā ra mi tā//pha rol tu phyin pa/ smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i ming la/dā rgo/ pri ya bā di tā⑨/ arba tsarlu/ sa mā nārba//sbyin pa/ snyan par smra ba/ don spyod pa/ don mthun pa/bslab pa gsum gyi ming la/a dhi shī lo/ a dhi tsit+t+waṃ⑩/ a dhi pra oṃ⑪//lhag pa'i tshul khrims/ lhag pa'i sems/ lhag pa'i shes rab/115—38

stong pa nyid bco brgyad kyi ming la/a sgyut+ma shu ①n+ya tā/ ba hijo shu n+ya tā/ a sgyut+ma ②ba hisgro shu n+ya tā/ shu n+ya tā nang stong pa nyid/ phyi stong pa nyid/ phyi nang stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid shu n+ya tā/ ma hā shu n+ya tā/ pa ra mārja shu n+ya tā/ saṃ ④skṛ ta shu n+ya tā/ a saṃ skṛ ta stong pa nyid/ chen po stong pa nyid/ don dam pa stong pa nyid/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid/ 'dus ma byas shu n+ya tā/ a t+yan+ta shu n+ya tā/ a na ba rā gra shu n+ya tā/ a na ba kā ra shu n+ya tā/stong pa nyid/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid/pra kṛ ti shu n+ya tā/ sarba dhasmra ④shu n+ya tā/ swa lak+ṣa ṇa shu n+ya tā/ a nu ba lo ba ⑤rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid/ mi dmigs pa shu n+ya tā/ a bhā ba shu n+ya tā/ swa bhā ba shu n+ya tā/ a bhā ba swa bhā ba shu n+ya tā//stong pa nyid/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'i ming la/kā yasmṛ khyu pas+thā dz+wa/ be da nasmṛ rjokyu pas+thā rna/ tsit+tasmṛ kyu pas+thā rgo/lus dran pa nye bar bzhag ⑦pa/ tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa/ sems dran pa nye bar gzhag skepa/dhasmasmṛ khyu pas+thā rna//chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa/yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i ming la/a nut+pan+d+ra ṭ+wāṃ ⑨pā pa kā nā ma ku sha lnga nārnyas+thā ṇ+ḍa ma nut+pā dā yats+tshan+de dzā ⑫na ya ti⑪/sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa'i phyir 'dun pa skyed ⑫do/ /115—39

ut+pan+d+ra nāspra pa kā nā ma ku sha khā māṃ dhas+thā ①ṇ+ḍaṃ pra hā ṇa yats+tshasdo dzā ②na ya ti/ a sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spang ba'i phyir 'dun pa skyed ④do/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa nut+pan+d+ra māṃ buku sha lā nān+tas+thā rjoṇ+ḍa mut+pā dā yats+tshasdo dzā ④na ya ti/ ut+pan+d+ra nāmyusha rnams bskyed pa'i phyir 'dun pa skyed do/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams gnas pa dang phyir zhing lnga nārnyas+thā shā spri tā dze+eya byu yo bhā ba tā ma ⑧a saṃ pra mo ṣā ya pa ri ⑨sgo ra yets+tshasdo dzā ⑩'byung ba dang nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir 'dun pa skyed na ya ti/ byā yats+tsha te⑪/ bīr+ya mā ra bha te/ tsit+t+waṃ pra kṛsgru ⑫ti/ saṃ ⑫myakru da dhā ti//do / /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'dzin to/ /yang dag par rab tu 'jog go//rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i ming la/ts+tshan+da sa mā bye pra hā ṇa saṃ sku ra sa ma nā ga to ṛrnyi pā daḥ/ tsit+ta sa mā dhi pra 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong pa'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ sems kyi ting nge hā ṇa saṃ skya ra sa ma nā ⑫ga to ṛrnyi pā ⑫daḥ/ bīr+ya sa mā dhi pra hā ṇa saṃ sku 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du ra sa ma ⑫nā ga to ṛdhi pā daḥ/ m+bi māṃ sa sa mā ⑫bye pra hā ṇa spyosaṃ s+thā ra sa ma ⑪byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ dpyod ⑫pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu nā ga to ṛdhi pā daḥ/ a nu pa lo bha yo ge na bhā 0ba ti/ bi be+e ka ni shri tai/ bi rā ga 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom ⑫mo/ /dbe+en pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ni shri lta/ ni ro dha ni shri haṃ/ bya ba sarga pa ri ṇa lta//ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su bsgyur ba/115—40

dbang po lnga'i ming la/shradhebyu ①yi/ bībyu— yo/ smṛ tīdh+ri yi/ sa mā dhī— yi/ prazlobyu ④yi//dad pa'i dbang po/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po/ dran pa'i dbang po/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po/ shes rab kyi dbang po/stobs lnga'i ming la/shrad+dhā ba lo/ bīr+ya ba lo/ smṛ ti ba lo/ sa mā bye ba lo/ pra dz+nyā ba lo//dad pa'i dbang po④/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs/ dran pa'i stobs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs/ shes rab kyi stobs/byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi ming la/smṛ ti saṃ bo bye garjo/ dhan+d+ra ⑤pra bi tsa ya saṃ bo bye ga du/dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /bīr+ya saṃ bo bye shaṃ/ dz+rī ti ⑦ saṃ bo bye gi/ pra srabhi brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang saṃ bo r+ghaṃ go/ sa ⑧mā dhi saṃ bo ⑨bye gi/ u pe k+ṣa saṃ ⑩bo bye shaṃ//chub kyi yan lag /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyi ming la/samya1jiḥ⑪/ samyak+shi kabe+eḥ/ samyagākra⑫/ samyak+kas+thādhaḥ⑫/yang dag pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa/ yang dag pa'i ngag /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'/ samyakra jo baḥ④/ samyakra ⑫byā yā maḥ/ samyakra ⑫smṛ tiḥ/ samyakra ⑩sa mā dhiḥ⑫//yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba/ yang dag pa'i dran pa/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin/115—41

rang sangs rgyas kyi rim pa'i ming la/khaṅga bi ṣā ṇa kalpaḥ brga ①tsā rī②//bse ru lta bu/ tshogs dang spyod pa/nyan thos kyi gang zag gi rim pa'i ming la/tho tā ①ban+daḥrjo/ sabe+e kṛsgo ba pa ra maḥ/ ku lo ⑤ku laḥ/rgyun du zhugs pa/ re ltar thogs na rjosrid pa lan bdun pa/ rigs nas rigs su skye ba/sa kṛ dā sa/ m+bi⑦/ e ka bī tsi ka⑧ཿ/ a nā sa/ m+bi⑨/ an+ta ra pa lan cig ⑩phyir 'ong ba/ bar chad gcig pa/ phyir mi 'ong ba/ bar ma dor yongs su mya ngan las ri nir+pā yī⑪/ u pa pa r+ya ⑫pa ri nithā yī/ sā bhi saṃ sku ra pa ri 'da' ba⑫/ skyes nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed dang bcas pas yongs su nir+pā yī/ a na rnyi saṃ ska ra pa ri nir+pā tsusreyī/ sprudz+nya ()sho tā/mya ngan las 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed med par yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba/ gong du 'pho ba/kā ya sā spyi/ shrad+dhā nu sā rī⑩/ dhas+thā ⑩nu sā rī/ shrad+dhā rnyi lus kyis ⑫mngon sum du byed pa/ dad pas rjes su 'brang ba/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ dad pas muk+taḥ⑪—/ dṛṣ+ṭi pābe+eḥ/ sa ma ya bi muk+taḥ⑥/ a sa ma ya ⑥bi muk+taḥ⑫/mos pa/ mthong bas thob pa/ dus kyis rnam par grol ba/ dus dang mi sbyor bar rnam par grol ba/pra dz+nyā bi muk+taḥ/ ya/ bha ya to bhā ga bi muk+taḥ//⑪shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba/ gnyi ga'i cha las rnam par grol ba/115—42
