nyan thos so so'i ming la/ā dz+nyā ta ①kauṇ+ḍi n+yaḥ②/ kā sh+ya paḥ①/ shā ri pu traḥ/ moṅga spyo naḥdu/ ma hā kā t+yā kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+yabu/ 'od srungasabu/ shā ri'i bu/ mod ⑦gal gyi bu/ ka t+ya'i bu ya naḥ/ su bhū tiḥ/ pūsto ⑧mi tre ya bhā pu traḥ/ a shwa ⑨dzitu/ a ni rudhaḥ/ rā hu chen po/ rab 'byor/ byams ma'i bu gang po/ rta thul/ ma 'gags pa/ sgra gcan laḥ—/ ā nan+da⑩ཿ/ nan+daḥ/ nan+da kaḥ/ nan+di kaḥ/ ma hā nā maḥ/ tsun+daḥ/'dzin / kun dga' bo/ dga' bo/ dga' byed/ dga' yod/ ming chen/ skul byed/ti6ཿ/ u pa ti6ཿ/ ko li taḥ/ u ru bi wā kā sh+ya paḥ/'od ldan pugyi tsutredang ma 'dom na skar rgyal/ nye rgyal/ pang nas skyes/ lteng rgyas 'od srungs/na dī kā sh+ya paḥ/ ga yā kā sh+ya paḥ/ ga bādza tiḥ/ bā byuḥlho5 / u pa se naḥ/ tsū ta chu klung 'od srungs/ ga ya 'od srungs/ ba lang bdag /rlangs r+sha)pa/ nye sde/ lam pan+d+ra kaḥ/ ma hā pan+d+ra kaḥ/ sho ṇa ko ṭī bī ④shaḥ/ u snyedā yī/ sun+da ⑩ra nan+daḥ/phran stan/ lam chen stan⑫/ gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa/ 'char ka /mdzes dga'/sho ṇa ko ṭī kaṇ+ḍiḥ/ su bā huḥ/ u dā ya ṇaḥ/ la ba na spyo bha dri kaḥ/ u pā liḥ/gro bzhin skyes rna ba bye ba ri⑪/ lag bzang / lhag spyod kyi bu 0 / mdzes bzang / nye ba 'khor/ma hā koṣ+ṭṛ laḥ/ bklu laḥ/ kha di ra ba ṇi kaḥ/ swā ga taḥ/ ma hā pra dzā ba ti gsus po che/ ba ku la'am ngos su gzhag ⑩/ seng ldeng nags pa/ legs 'ongs 3/ skye dgu'i 0bdag mo go ta m+bi④/ mā yā de bī④/ ya sho dha rā/ go pā/ ut+pal bkyā⑩/ dharma din+d+ra⑦//chen mo go ta misnye/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul/ grags 'dzin/ sa 'tsho ma/ ut+pa la'i mdog /chos kyis byen/115—43

nyan thos kyi yon tan gyi ming la/spyo 5 ①shra baḥ/ niḥkle shaḥ/ ba shrī bhū ②taḥ/ su bi muk+ta tsit+taḥ/①zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par bugyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/rjosu bi muk+ta pra dz+nyā / ā rjodz+nyā ne+e yaḥ/ ma hā nā gaḥ/ kṛ ta kṛ t+yaḥ/ kṛ ta ka ra bhā yaḥ/shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byede pa byas pa/a pa z-i ⑦ta bhā raḥ/ ba ri k+ṣi ṇa bha ba saṃ yo dza naḥ⑧/ a nu pābe+e swa kār+ṣaḥ/ samya khur bor ba/ srid par kun du sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ yang dag gā dz+nyā su bi muk+ta tsit+taḥ/ sarba tse to ba shi pa ra ma pā ra mi ta māp+taḥ/pa'i shes pas ⑨sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa thob pa/dharma dh+wa ⑩tu ku sha laḥ/ dharma rā dza ⑪pu traḥ/ a pa ga ta sarba khā bha saṭ+wā ra tsit+taḥ/chos kyi dbyings la mkhas pa/ chos kyi rgyal po'i sras/ sems rnyed pa dang bkur ste thams cad dang bral ba/su pra bra dzi taḥ/ sru pa sadzan+d+raḥ/ pa ri pūr+ṇa ()saṃ kalpaḥ/legs par rab tu byung ba/ legs par bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ brnag pa yongs su rdzogs pa/nir+pā ṇa māṭ+wā ⑫basbi taḥ/ ba hu shu taḥ/ shu ta dhā ④raḥ/ khru ta san+ni tsa yaḥ/mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam la gnas pa/ mang du thos pa/ thos pa 'dzin pa/ thos pa bsags pa/su dzizhi ta tsit+ta⑫/ su bhā ṣi ta bha ṣ+pe⑩/ su kṛ ta kabyu kā rī/ ā shu pra dz+nyā⑩/legs par bsam pa sems pa/ legs par smra ba brjod pa/ legs par bya ba'i las byed pa/ shes rab myur ba/dza ba na pra dz+nyā⑫/ tīkyā pra dz+nyā⑪/ niḥs ra ṇa pra dz+nyā⑦/ ne+e be dhi ka pra ⑥dz+nyā/shes rab mgyogs pa/ shes rab rno ba/ 'byung ba'i shes rab can/ nges par 'byed pa'i shes rab can/ma hā pra dz+nyā/ thra thu pra dz+nyā⑫/ gartswa ra pra dz+nyā⑫/ a sa ma pra dz+nyā⑫/shes rab che ba/ shes rab yangs pa/ shes rab zab pa/ shes rab mnyam pa med pa/115—44

pra dz+nyā rat+na sa ma nā ga taḥ/ pa ra ma dṛṣ+ṭa dhan+d+ra su kha bi hā ra pāp+taḥ/shes rab rin po che dang ldan pa/ mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i mchog thob pa/ma hā dak+ṣ-i ṇa ①pa ri sho dha kaḥ/ pra shārnyerlu ④pa tha sadzan+daḥ/ ma hā k+ṣurnyi sau ra yon yongs su sbyong ba chen po/ spyod lam rab tu zhi ba phun sum tshogs pa/ bzod pa dang t+ya ①sa ma nā ga taḥ/ ta thā ga tā dz+nyā su pra ti pan+daḥ/ pa ri pūṇ+ḍi shukla dhan+d+raḥ/des pa chen po dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' la shin tu zhugs pa/ chos dkar po yongs su rdzogs pa/dṛṣ+ṭa dhadz+reḥ/ su pra ti parngo ④bha ga ba taḥ/ shā ⑤ba ka saṃ ghaḥ/ t+yā ya pra ti pan+daḥ/chos mthong ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun legs par zhugs pa/ rigs par zhugs pa/ṛ dzu pra ti pan+daḥ/ sa rjormā tsi pra ti pan+daḥ/ a nu dhan+d+ra tsā rī/ dhas+thā nu ⑦dha1 ④drang por zhugs ⑨pa/ mthun par zhugs pa/ chos dang rjes su mthun par spyod pa/ chos dang rjes su pra ti pan+daḥ/ a ra ṇa sa mā dhiḥ/ pra ṇi dhi dz+nyā rna//mthun pa'i chos la zhugs pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ smon gnas shes pa/sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyi ming la/dzā suklu li kaḥ/ tre+e ṭī ba ri kaḥ/ nā ma tsi ⑪ kaḥ/ be+eṇ+ḍa pā ti kaḥ/ e kā phyag dar khrod pa/ chos gos gsum pa/ 'phying pa kṛtrepa/ bsod snyoms pa/ stan sa ni ka⑫ཿ/ kha lu pasbyor+bhak+to kaḥ/ ā ⑫ra 5 kaspyoḥ/ bṛk+ṣa spru li kaḥ/ a bh+ya ba kā ⑫gcig pa/ zas phyis mi len pa/ dgon pa pa/ shing drung pa/ bla gab med se kaḥ/ shāsā ni kaḥ/ ne+e ṣadri ⑩kaḥ/ yā ⑩thā saṃ sta ri kaḥ//pa/ dur khrod pa/ cog pu pa/ gzhi ji bzhin pa/115—45

nyan thos kyi sa'i ming la/shukla bi dar+sha na ①khyu miḥ/ go tra khyu miḥ/ aṣ+ṭa ma ka khyu miḥ/ dar+sha dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa/ rigs kyi sa/ brgyad pa'i sa/ mthong na khyu miḥ/ ta nu khyu miḥ/ bi ga ta rā ga byu ②miḥ/ kṛ tā bi khyu miḥ//ba'i sa/ bsrabs pa'i sa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa/rjes su dran pa drug gi ming la/bud+dhā nu smṛ tiḥ/ dhas+thā nu smṛ tiḥ/ saṃ ghā nu smṛ tiḥ/ shī lā sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa/ chos rjes su dran pa/ dge 'dun rjes su dran pa/ tshul khrims nu smṛ tiḥ/ t+yā gā nu smṛ tiḥ/ de ba tā nu smṛ tiḥ/ bi rtswa la ka saṃ dz+nyā⑦/ bi rjes su dran pa/ gtong ba rjes su dran pa/ lha rjes su dran pa/ rnam par sdos ④pa'i 'du shes/ rnam pū ti ka saṃ dz+nyā⑤/ bi pa du ma ka saṃ dz+nyā / byāsgyu dhita ka saṃ dz+nyā⑦/par gnag sgepa'i 'du shes/ rnam par 'bus gzhigs stipa'i 'du shes/ rnam par bam ⑩pa'i 'du shes/bi lo hi ta ⑪saṃ tshwa⑫/ bi khā di ta ka saṃ dz+nyā⑫/ bi k+ṣibe+e ka saṃ dz+nyā⑫/ bi rnam par dmar ba'i 'du shes/ rnam par zos pa'i 'du shes/ rnam par 'thor ba'i 'du shes/ rnam dasnya ka saṃ dz+nyā/⑫ a byu saṃ dz+nyā⑫//par tshig pa'i 'du shes/⑩ rus gong gi 'du shes/dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba bgrang ba'i rim pa'i ming la/ā nā pā na smṛ tiḥ/ ga ṇa nā⑫/ a nu ga maḥ/ s+thā rgo⑪/ u pa lak+ṣa ḍādu/dbugs rngub pa ⑥dang 'byung ba dran pa/ bgrang ba/ nang du zhugs pa/ gnas pa/ nye bar mtshon pa/115—46

bi brta nā①/ pa ri shurnyiḥ/ hra swa mā swa saṃ khruhra swa mā shwa sā ①m+bi ti ya thā khyu lta dusgyur ba/ yongs su dag pa/ dbugs thung ngu zub pa ⑤na yang thung ngu rngubs so rjosnyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du pra dzā ⑦nā ti/ hra swe ⑧pra shwa saṃ hra swa pra shwa sā sbo ti ya thā byu tai pra dzā ⑨nā ti/rab tu shes/ dbugs thung ngu byung na yang ⑩dbugs thung ngu phyung ngo snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/dīr+gha ⑪mā shwa ⑫saṃ drirga mā shwa ⑫sā 'i ti ya spyothā bhū haṃ pra dzā ⑫nā ti/dbugs ring du zubs na dbugs ⑩ring du zubs ⑩so snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so//dīr+ghaṃ pra swa saṃ ⑫drir+ghaṃ pra shwa sā m+bi ⑪ti ya thā bhū tai pra dzā ⑫nā ti/ sarba dbugs ring du phyung na dbugs ring du phyung ngo snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/ lus kā ya pra ti saṃ be t+yā shwa sa na sa rba kā ya pra ti saṃ kyi ⑪las las zhes pa'i skad dod ma byung thams cad yang dag par myong zhing dbugs rngubs ⑫na lus kyi las ⑫be byā ④shwa sā rmā ti ya thā byu tai pra dzā ⑪nā ti/thams cad yang dag par myong zhing dbugs rngubs ⑪so snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du ⑫rab tu shes/sarba kā ya pra ti sam+bi dī pra shwa sa na sarba kā ya pra ti saṃ be ⑫dī lus kyi las ⑥thams cad yang dag par myong zhing dbugs phyung ⑩na lus kyi las ⑪thams cad yang dag pra shwa swa rmā ti ya thā byu lta pra dzā ⑫nā ti/ pra par ⑫myong zhing dbugs phyung ngo snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /lus kyi 'du byed srasbya ④kā ya saṃ sku ra nā ⑪shwa saspra srabh+ya ⑪kā ya saṃ sku ra nā shwa sā rī ti ya thā byu shin tu sbyangs nas dbugs zubs ⑥na lus kyi 'du byed shin tu sbyangs nas dbugs rngubs ⑫so snyam du yang haṃ pra dzā ⑥nā ti/ pra srabh+ya ④kā ya saṃ sku rānu sh+yipra shwa san pra dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/ lus kyi 'du byed shin tu sbyangs nas dbugs phyung na lus kyi 'du srabh+ya 9kā ya saṃ sku rānu pra 9shwa sā m+bi ti ya thā bhū lta pra dzā ④nā ti/ t+pā ti byed shin tu sbyangs nas dbugs phyung ngo snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/ dga' ba yang 115—47

pra ti saṃ be byā shwa sanu t+pā ①ti pra ti saṃ be+e byā shwa ④sā m+bi ti ya thā bhū haṃ pra dzā ①dag par myong zhing dbugs rngubs ④na dga' ba yang dag par myong zhing dbugs rngubs ⑤so snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba nā ti/ t+pā ti pra ti saṃ be rjodī pra shwa san dz+rī ⑦ti pra ti saṃ be+e ⑧ bzhin du rab tu shes/ dga' ba yang dag par myong zhing dbugs phyung na dga' ba yang dag par myong zhing dī pra shwa sā rī ti ya thā byu haṃ ⑨pra dzā ⑩nā ti/ tsit+ta saṃ dbugs phyung ngo snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/ sems kyi 'du byed sku ra pra ti saṃ be+e ⑪byā shwa san tsit+ta ⑫saṃ sku ra pra ti saṃ be ⑫byā shwa sā rmā ti ya thā byu yang dag par myong nas dbugs rngubs ④na sems kyi 'du byed yang dag par myong nas dbugs rngubs ⑫so tai pra dzā ⑩nā ti/ tsit+ta saṃ sku ra pra nyi saṃ snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/ sems kyi 'du byed yang dag par myong nas dbugs be dī pra shā san tsit+ta ⑩saṃ skya ra pra ti saṃ be spyodri pra shwa sā m+bi ti ya thā bhū tai pra dzā ⑪ phyung na sems kyi 'du byed yang dag par myong nas dbugs phyung ngo snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab nā ti/ ⑫ pra sabh+ya ⑥tsit+ta saṃ sku rā ⑫nā shwa san pra srabh+ya ⑪tsit+ta saṃ ska rā nā shwa sā tu shes/ sems kyi 'du byed shin tu sbyangs nas dbugs rngubs ④na sems kyi 'du byed shin tu sbyangs nas sī ti ya thā bhū haṃ pra dzā ⑫nā ti/ pra srabh+ya ⑪ tsit+ta dbugs rngubs ⑫so snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/ sems kyi 'du byed shin tu sbyangs saṃ sku rān ⑫pra shwa saṃ pra srabye ⑫tsit+ta saṃ sku rān ⑫pra shwa sā m+bi ti ya thā khyu tai pra dzā nas dbugs phyung na sems kyi 'du byed shin tu sbyangs nas dbugs phyung ngo ⑪snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba nā ti⑫/ tsit+ta pra ti saṃ be ⑫t+yā shwa sanu tsit+ta ④pra ti saṃ be ⑫byā shwa sā bzhin du rab tu shes/ sems yang dag par myong nas dbugs rngubs ⑪na sems yang dag par stsong nas ⑩m+bi ti ya thā bhū haṃ pra dzā ⑫nā ti/ tsit+ta pra ti saṃ be+e dī ⑥pra swa dbugs rngubs so ⑩snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/ sems yang dag par myong nas 115—48

sabyut+ta ①pra ti saṃ be+e budī pra shwa sā m+bi ti ya thā bhū tai pra dzā ne+enā ti//dbugs phyung na sems yang dag par spyong nas dbugs phyung ngo snyam du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rnam pa bcu drug tu phye ba'i ming la/tsa tār+yār+ya ④sat+yā ni/ duḥkhaṃ/ a ni bye/ shu bye/ a nāt+ma shaṃ/'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi/ sdug bsngal ba/ mi rtag pa/ stong pa/ bdag med pa/sa mu dayaḥ/ pra bha baḥ⑤/ he tuḥ tsu/ pra t+ya yaḥrngu/ ni ro dhaḥ / shān+taḥ ḍa/ pra dhī taḥ1 /kun 'byung ba/ rab tu skye ba/ rgyu/ rkyen/ 'gog pa/ zhi ba/ gya nom pa/niḥs ra r+ṇa/ mārgaḥlho7/ t+yā yaḥlho5/ pra ti bat+t+waṃḥ1rte/ ne+er+yā ṇi kaḥ/ ā nan+tar+ya mārgaḥ/nges par 'byung ba/ lam/ rigs pa/ sgrub pa/ nges par 'byin pa/ bar chad med pa'i lam/bi muk+to mārgaḥ/ a bhi sa ma yārnyi shaṃ ku sha la spru los/ k+ṣa ya dz+nyā rgo lā bhi 7rnam par grol ba'i lam/ mngon par rtogs pa'i mjug la 'byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ zad pa shes pas meke ṭa/ lhan 'ab (1 tsho'i//thob pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i rim pa'i ming la/nirbe dha bhā gī ⑫yaḥ/ u ga taḥ⑪/ mūn+d+ra naḥ3(/ k+ṣudhiḥtsho 7/ lo ki —1nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa/ dro bar gyur pa/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ 'jig rten kā gra dhadz+reḥ//pa'i chos mchog /115byed49

sems kyi skad cig ma bcu drug gi ming la/duḥ khe dhabyu ①dz+nyā na k+ṣurnyiḥkhru/ duḥ khe dhan+d+ra dz+nyā rgo/① duḥkhe3n ④ya sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa/ sdug bsngal la rjes su rtog ⑤dz+nyā na k+ṣurnyiḥ/ duḥkhelhanā 0ya dz+nyā rna/ sa mu da ye dhan+d+ra ⑦dz+nyā na k+ṣurnyiḥ/par shes pa'i bzod pa/ sdug bsngal la rjes su rtog ⑧pa'i shes pa/ kun 'byung la chos shes pa'i bzod pa/sa mu da ya dhan+d+ra ⑨tshwa rna/ sa mu da yephon spyoya dz+nyā na ⑪k+ṣurnyiḥ/ sa mu da yelhan kun 'byung la chos shes pa/ kun 'byung la rjes su rtog par shes pa'i bzod pa/ kun 'byung la rjes su ya dz+nyā rgo⑩/ ni ro dhe dhabyu ⑫dz+nyā na k+ṣurnyiḥ/ ni ro dhe dhan+d+ra ④dz+nyā rna/ ni ro rtog pa'i shes pa/ 'gog pa la chos shes pa'i bzod pa/ 'gog pa la chos shes pa/ 'gog pa la rjes dhephon ⑫ya dz+nyā na k+ṣurnyiḥ/ ni ro dhelharwa ⑩ya dz+nyā rna/ mārge dhan+d+ra ⑩dz+nyā na k+ṣurnyiḥ/su rtog ⑫par shes pa'i bzod pa/ 'gog pa la rjes su rtog pa'i shes pa/ lam la chos shes pa'i bzod pa/ mārge dha1 spyodz+nyā dz+wa/ mārgephon ⑫ya dz+nyā na k+ṣurnyiḥ/ mārgelhan ⑫ya dz+nyā dz+wa//lam la chos shes pa/ lam la rjes su rtog ⑫par shes pa'i bzod pa/ lam la rjes su rtog pa'i shes pa/shes pa bcu'i ming la/dhan+d+ra ⑫dz+nyā rgo/ pa ra tsit+ta dz+nyā dz+wa/ a na ya dz+nyā dz+wa/ saṃ dṛ ti dz+nyā dz+wa/ duḥkha dz+nyā dz+wa/chos shes pa/ pha rol gyi sems shes pa/rjes su rtog par shes pa/ kun rdzob shes pa/ sdug bsngal shes pa/sa mu da ya dz+nyā rgo/ ni ro dha dz+nyā rgo/ mārga dz+nyā rna/ k+ṣa ya dz+nyā dz+wa/ a nut+pā ④da dz+nyā rgo//kun 'byung shes pa/ 'gog pa shes pa/ lam shes pa/ zad pa shes pa/ mi skye ba shes pa/115—50

lam bzhi'i ming la/duḥkhā ①pra ti pa dwa nā ⑧bhi dz+nyā/ duḥkhā pra ti pak+ṣi ①pā rnyi dz+nyā/ su khā pra ti mngon par shes pa bul la dka' ba'i lam/ mngon par shes pa myur la dka' ba'i lam/ mngon par pa dwa nā ④bhi dz+nyā/ su khā pra ti pak+ṣi pā rnyi dz+nyā//shes pa bul la sla ba'i lam/ mngon par shes pa myur la sla ba'i lam/theg pa'i rnam pa'i ming la/ma hā yā naphra/ pra bye ka burtse yā namra⑤/ shā ba ka yā napo/ ṭī na yā napo/theg pa chen po/ rang sangs rgyas kyi zeg pa/ nyan thos kyi theg pa/ theg pa dman pa/pra de shi ka yā namra/ e ka yā namra//nyi tshe ba'i theg pa/ theg pa gcig pa/ dbang po'i rim pa'i ming la/i— ya bai mā tra tā/ mṛ dwobyu yaḥrjo/ ma byedh+ri ya ཿ/ tī laspri ⑦yaḥ⑧//dbang po'i rim pa/ dbang po rtul ⑨po/ dbang po 'bring po/ dbang po rnon po/rigs lnga'i ming la/shā ba ka yā ⑩nā rnyi sa ma ya go traḥ/ pra h+ye ka budha yā nā rnyi ⑪sa ma ya go nyan thos kyi theg pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rigs/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa mngon par rtogs ⑫pa'i tra⑫ཿske/ ta thā ga ta yā nā bhi sa ma ya go traḥ/ a ni ya ta go traḥ④/ a go tra kaḥ//rigs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rigs/ ma nges pa'i rigs/ rigs med pa/115—51

dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ming la/sru tram̐/ ge yapo/ byā ka ra rde/ gā thā/mdo'i sde/ dbyangs kyis bsnyad ①pa'i sde/ lung du bstan ②pa'i sde/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sde/u dā rna/ ni rā napo/ a ba dā napo/ i ti z-it+ta blukapo/ dzā ④ta kaphra/ched du brjod pa'i sde/ gleng gzhi'i sde/ rtogs pa brngod pa'i sde/ de lta bu byung ba'i sde/ skyes pa rabs kyi sde/bai rjopu sum̐/ abyu ta dhabyuḥrjo/ u pa de shaḥ⑦/ bra h+ma tsazlo/ ā do ka s+thā ṇiske/shin tu rgyas pa'i sde/ rmad du byung ba'i sde/ gtan la dbab pa'i sde/ tshangs par spyod pa/ thog mar dge ba/ma bye ⑨ka s+thā rde/ par+ya ba sā ne+e ka s+thā r+ṇa/ swadze+e/ su byañdza rgo⑩/bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ke ba lo⑪/ pa ri pūṇ+ḍaṃ⑫/ pa ri shur+ghaṃ⑫/ma 'dres pa skabs gzhan du 'ba' zhig tu'ang ④gdags/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/par+ya ba dā tai/ a bhi ba da ⑫mā nā a ⑩rnyi ba darnyi/ swā khyu to ⑩bha ga ba to yongs su byang ba/ mngon par brjod pas mngon par brjod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi chos ni legs dhan+d+raḥ saṃ dṛji kaḥ/ nirja raḥ/ ā kā li kaḥ/ u pa nā yi kaḥ/par gsungs pa/ yang dag par mthong ba/ nad med pa/ dus chad pa med pa/ nye bar gtod pa/e hi pa bye kaḥ/ pra t+yāt+ma ⑫be da nī yo bi dzhaiḥ⑪/ swā khyu to bha ga 'di mthong ba la don ⑫yod pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis rang gis ⑪rig par bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑫ba to dha1 ⑫bi na yaḥsu pra be+e di taḥ/ be+er+yā ṇi kaḥsaṃ bo dhi ⑪legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba ni legs par bstan pa/ nges par 'byung ba rdzogs pa'i byang 115—52

gā m+bi①/ a bhin+daḥs s+t+ra ④paḥ/ sa pra ti sha ra ṇaḥ①/chub tu 'gro bar byed pa/ mi mthun pa med cing 'dus pa dang ldan pa④/ brten pa yod pa⑤/shāstu tsā su rjota thā ga tolhar+hanu samyak+shi (ge/budheḥ/ swā khya to 'di ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ dge slong dag nga'i me rnyi k+ṣa bo dhan+d+ra⑧ཿ/ uṣ+ṭhanaḥ/ bi bṛ taḥ/ stson+da bloti kaḥ/ yā batre+e ba ma chos ni ⑨legs par gsungs pa⑩/ gsal ba/ phye ⑪ba/ rgyu ba bcad pa/ lha dang mi'i bar dag la nu bye ⑫bh+yaḥsamyaklu pra kā shi ta⑫ཿ//yang dag par shin tu bstan pa/chos kyi 'khor lo'i ming la/tri pa ri bat+t+waṃ dā da shā kā ra dhan+d+ra tsakra brta rna/ ār+ya spyosat+yā ṭ+wāṃ spyopra tha ma lan gsum du bzlas te chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor ba/ 'phags pa'i bden pa pa ri bsto dar+sha na ⑩mārgaḥ/ i ⑩damra ⑫duḥkhamra/ a yi sa mu da yaḥ/ a yarji rnams bzlas pa dang po ste ⑪mthong ba'i lam/ 'di ni ⑥sdug bsngal/ 'di ni kun 'byung ba/ 'di ni ro dhaḥ/ i yo duḥkha ni ro dha gā mi nī pra ti patu/ ār+ya sat+yā māṃ ⑪dī tī ya pa ri 'gog pa/ 'di di sdug bsngal 'gog pa'i lam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams bzlas pa gnyis pa ste bsto bhā ba na mārga⑫ཿ/ duḥkha mār+ya sa t+t+waṃ pa ri zlo ⑫yo/ duḥkha sa mu da yaḥpra hā ta bsgom ④pa'i lam/ sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa yongs su shes par bya/ sdug bsngal kun 'byung bye—/ duḥkha ⑫ni ro dhaḥsā k+ṣuṅkat+t+waṃ ⑪bye/ duḥkha ni ro dha gā mi nī pra ⑫ti pat+pa bhā ⑫yi ba spang bar bya/ sdug bsngal 'gog pa mngon du bya/ sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam bsgom par ta bye/ ār+ya sa t+yā māṃ tri tī ya ⑥pa ri bstolhashik+ṣa 0mārgaḥ⑥/ duḥkhaṃ pa ri dz+nyā bya| 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams bzlas pa gsum pa ste mi slob pa'i lam/ sdug bsngal yongs su 115—53

tai①| sa mu da yaḥpra dri ṇaḥ⑦/ ni ro dhaḥsā k+ṣu t+pa kṛ taḥsne/ duḥkha ni ro shes/ kun 'byung ba spangs/ 'gog pa mngon du byas/ sdug bsngal 'gog par dha gā mi rtswa rjopra ti badhā bi tā⑤//'gyur ba'i lam bsgoms/dam pa'i chos kyi ming la/sha rjota snga ha sri kā pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā⑦/ pañtsa dzi ⑧sha ti sā ha sri kā/ aṣ+ṭa sā shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ nyi khri lnga stong pa⑨/ brgyad ha sri kā/ bud+dhā ba tai sa rka⑩/ bo rnyi sa twa pi ṭa rka/ la li ta bi sta ra ཿ/stong pa/ sangs rgyas phal po che/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod/ rgya cher rol pa/sa ⑪mā rnyi rā dzā⑫/ pi tā pu tra sa mā ga maḥ lo kot+ta ra pa ri brtaḥ/ sadu ⑫dhasma ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po/ yab sras mjal byab/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u/ dam pa'i chos puṇ+ḍa rī kaposke/ ga ga na gañdza⑫ཿ/ rat+na me ghaḥ/ lo ⑩kā ba tā raspo⑫/ su baṇ+ḍi pra bhā pad+ma dkar po/ nam mkha' mdzod/ dkon mchog sprin/ lang kar gshegs pa/ gser 'od sot+ta rma/ bi ma la tīt+t+waṃ rgorde shaḥ/ gaṇ+ḍa byu ⑪haḥ/ gha na byu duhaḥ/ ā kā sha gar+bhaḥ/dam pa/ dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa/ sdong po bkod pa/ stug po bkod pa/ nam mkha'i snying po/a k+ṣa ya ma ti nirde shaḥ/ u pā ya kau sha sum̐⑪/ dhabyu saṃ gī tiḥ/ su bi lngan+ta blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa/ thabs la mkhas pa/ chos yang dag par sdud pa/ rab kyi rtsal gyis bi krā m+bi⑫/ ma hā ka ru ṇ+ḍa puṇ+ḍa rī kaphra⑫/ rat+na ke tuḥ/ da sha byu mi kaḥ/ ta thā rnam par gnon pa/ snying rje chen po pad+ma dkar po/ rin po che'i tog /sa bcu pa/ de bzhin ga ta cim hā ka ru ṇ+ḍa nirde shaḥ/ dru ma kin+da ra ⑫rā dza pa ri thrats+tshaḥ/ a dzā ⑪ta gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po bstan pa/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa/ ma skyes 115—54

sha tru kau kṛ ①t+ya bi no da naḥ/ sarnyi nid+mo ②tsa —/ bu— saṃ gī tiḥ/ rāṣ+ṭa pā la dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa/ saras rgyas yang dag par sdud pa/ yul 'khor pa ri thratsā⑧/ sarba dhasmra ④pra dṛsti nide shaḥ/ rat+na tsu ⑤ḍa pa ri thratshwarjo/ rat+na skyong gis zhus pa/ chos thams cad 'byung ⑦ba med par bstan pa/ gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa/ dkon kyu ⑧ṭaḥ/ ma hā yā na pra sā da bhā ba namra/ srur+ya ⑨gar+bhaḥ⑩/ burnya byu miḥ/mchog brtsegs pa/ theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu sgom ⑩pa/ nyi ma'i snying po/ sangs rgyas kyi sa/ta thā ga tā tsistsa ⑫gu h+ya nirde shaḥ/ sru re ga ma sa mā dhi nirde ⑫shaḥ/de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin bstan pa/sā ga ra nā ga rā dza ⑫pa ri dṛtshwaske/ shā listasbra kaphra/ ma hā yā no pa de shaḥ⑩/ brad+ma klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa/ snga lu ljang pa/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag /tshangs pa bi she ṣa cis pa ri thratshwa⑩/ pa ra māze saṃ thra spyoti sa t+ya nidre ⑪shaḥ/ mdzi shrī bi khyad par sems kyis zhus pa/ don dam pa dang kun rdzob kyi bden pa bstan pa/ 'jam dpal hā duraḥ/ ma hā pa ri niṭ+wā r+ṇa/ a bai brta tsakramra/ kan+d+ra ⑪bi ste gaḥ⑫/gnas pa/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po/ phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo/ las rnam par 'byed pa/pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā pañtsa sha nyi kā⑫/ tri sha ti kā pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā/ rasgos+thā /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga brgya pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sum brgya pa/ dkon mchog ta la la/go chatsa ra ba ri shur+ghaṃ⑫/ pra shāsnya bi nish+tsa ya mā ti hār+ya ⑪nirde shaḥ/ ta thā ga spyod yul yongs su dag pa/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par gdon mi za ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pa/ de bzhin tot+panyi saṃ ⑥bha ba nirde shaḥ/ bha ba saṃ krārnyi⑫ཿ/ pa ra māza dhan+d+ra ⑪bi dza yaḥ/gshegs pa skye ba 'byung ba bstan pa/ srid pa 'pho ba/ don dam pa'i chos kyis rnam par rgyal ba/mdzi shrī ⑩burtse k+ṣe tra gu ṇa byu ⑪haḥ/ bo dhi pakhyu nirde shaḥ/ kas+thā ⑫ba 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs nges par bstan pa/ las kyi 115—55

ra ṇa pra ti pra sradhiḥ/ tri skarnya kaphra/ sarba be+e da l+ya saṃ gra haḥ①/ saṃ ghā ṭa sru tram̐/sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa/ phung po gsum pa/ rnam par 'thag ④pa thams cad bsdus pa/ zung gi mdo/ta thā ga ta tshwa na mu dru sa mā dhiḥ/ badz+ra me ru shi kha ra kyu ṭā ①gā re jo ra de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin/ rdo rje ri rab kyi rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i bhā—/ a na ba tap+ta tsā ga rā dza bupa ri thratshwa⑤/ sarba budha bi ṣa yā ba tā ra dz+nyā tsā lo gzungs/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ye shes kā lo rjokā raḥ/ sap+ta sha ti ka pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā/ byā sa pa ri thratsā⑦/ su bā hu ⑧snang ba'i rgyan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa/ drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa/ lag pa ri thratshwa⑨/ dzi ha pa ri thratshwa⑩/ ma hā sā ha sra pra marda naphra/ u gra pa ri bzang gis zhus pa/ seng ges zhus pa/ stong chen mos ⑪rab tu 'joms pa/ drag shul can gyis thratshwa—/ shrad+dhā ⑫pa lā dhā napo/ e ⑫gu li mā lī yo⑫/ haste kakhyu/ a k+ṣa ya ma ti zhus pa/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa/ sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa/ glang po'i rtsal/ blo gos mi zad pa ri dṛtshwa⑫/ bhe ṣa dz+nyā gu ru bai byur+ya ⑩pra bhaḥ⑩/ arja bi nish+tsa yaḥ/ ma tā spyob pas zhus pa/ sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od/ don rnam par nges pa/ stobs po la sru traḥ/ bī spyor dat+ta kṛ ⑩ha pa ti pa ri thratshwa⑪/ rat+na ka raṇ+ḍa kamra/ bi kurba ṇa che'i mdo/ khyim bdag dpas byin gyis zhus pa/ dkon mchog za ma tog /rnam par rā ⑫dza pa ri thratshwa⑫/ dh+wa dzā gra ke yu ④rā/ tro pi ṭa kaḥ/ sru tram̐⑫/ a rnyi dhan+d+ra⑪ཿ/'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ sde snod gsum/ mdo sde/ chos mngon pa/bi na yaḥ⑫/ pra dz+nyāt+ta shās+t+ra⑫phra/ saṃ bī ti parlu ⑥yaḥ/ dhan+d+ra ska—ཿ/'dul ba/ gdags pa'i gtsug lag gam ⑥bstan bcos/ bgro ba'i rnam grangs/ chos kyi phung po/dh+wa tu kā yaḥ/ dz+nyā na pra s+thā naphra/ pra ka ra ṇa pā daḥ/ e kot+ta ri kā ga maḥ/khams kyi tshogs/ ye shes la ⑪'jug pa/ rab tu byed pa'i rkang pa/ gcig las 'phros pa'i lung /115—56

bar sdom/ sdom skabs kha cig tu mdor yang gdags//bsam gtan bzhi la sogs pa'i ming la/bi bit+t+waṃ kā be+em+bi 1 bik+to pā ba kai ra ku sha le dhathreḥs bi tarko sa bi tsā ⑪'dod pa dag las dben pa sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams las dben pa rtog pa dang bcas pa ram̐ bi be ka dze+e rjodz+rī ti su khaṃ pra ⑤tha rma dh+yā na mu pa saṃ pa r+ya bi ha dpyod ⑥pa dang bcas pa dbe+en pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po rdzogs par ra ti/ sa bi tarka bi tsā rā rde byu pa sha ⑦mā da dh+yād+me saṃ skepra sā dā — ⑨ ta byas te gnas so/ /de rtog pa dang dpyod pa dang bral zhing nang yongs su dang ste sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur sa e ko tī ⑩bhā bā da bi tarka ma bi tsā ⑪ram̐ sa mā dhi dze+e dz+rī ti su khaṃ dri tī yadz+nyā na mu pas rtog pa med pa dpyod pa med pa ⑫ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan pa saṃ pa r+ya bi ha ra ti/ sa dz+rī terbi ⑫rā gā du pe k+ṣa ko bi ha gnyis pa rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang bral bas btang snyoms la gnas ra ti smṛ tisme pra dzā rna su khaṃ ⑫tsa kā ye na pra ti saṃ be da ya ti yat+ta dārlu ske.ā bak+ṣa shing dran pa dang shes bzhin can yin te bde ba lus kyis stsong la 'phags pa rnams kyis ⑩gang de dran pa te u pa k+ṣa kaḥsmṛ ti māṃ ⑩su kha bi hā rī ⑩ti nispri ti rka tri tī ya dh+yā ⑪na mu pa saṃ dang ldan pa bde ba la gnas pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste dga' ba med pa bsam gtan gsum pa pa r+ya bi ha ra ti/ sa su kha gya tsa pra hā ṇad+dhaḥ me kha su tsa pra hā nān+d+rarba ⑩me rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs te snga nas sdug bsngal yang spangs shing yid ⑫bde ba ba tsa sau ma na su dormā na gya yo ra ⑫s+t+waṃ ga mā ta a duḥkhā ④su kha mu pe k+ṣu smṛ ti pa ri dang yid mi bde ba yang nub pas bde ba yang ma yin sdug bsngal yang ma yin pa btang snyoms dang dran pa 115—58

shudhe tsa turba m+me ①na mu pa saṃ pa r+ya bi ha ra ti/ /mān+ta ko ṭi ka m+me napo/yongs su dag pa bsam gtan bzhi pa rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /rab kyi mthar phyin pa'i bsam gtan/a nā ga rmya/ sgyu nān+ta raphra/ sā skeman+ta shaṃ/ mo lo/ ā spa ra ṇa ka sa mi spyogs pa med pa/ bsam gtan gyi khyad par can/ nyer bsdogs/ dngos gzhi/ mkha' khyab ting mā dhiḥ①/ pra ti saṃ la ya naḥ/ sa mā hi taḥ④/ sa ta ta sa mi ta sa mā hi ta tsit+taḥ//nge 'dzin/ nang du yang dag 'jog /mnyam par gzhag⑤/ rtag par rgyun mi 'chad par sems rjomanyam par gzhag ⑦pa/snyoms par 'jug pa'i ming la/sa sarba so rū pa saṃ dz+nyā ṭ+wāṃ ⑧sa ma ti kra māt+tha ⑨ti gha saṃ dz+nyā de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes rnams las yang dag par 'das te thogs nā ma ⑩ste ga mātu ⑪nā nā twa saṃ dz+nyā nā ma ma na si kā rā da nan+ta mā kā sha mi t+yā kā shā pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing sna tshogs kyi 'du shes rnams yid la mi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' nasgyu ya ta na mu pa saṃ par+ya bi ha ra ti/ sa sarba sha yas so snyam nas nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du ā kā shā nasgyu ya ta naphra sa ma ti kra myu ⑫narnya bi dz+nyā nā mi ti bi dz+nyā nā ⑫ nasgyu ya nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so snyam nas rnamata na mu pa saṃ pa r+ya bi ha ra ti/ sa sarba sho bi ④dz+nyā nā nadh+yā shes mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye ya ta rgo sa ma ti kra mya nāste ki— di t+yā ki— t+yā spyoya ta na mu pa saṃ pa r+ya bi ⑫ mched las yang dag par 'das te ci yang med do ⑫snyam nas ci yang med pa'i skye mched rdzogs par byas te ha ra ti/ sa sarba sha ā ki tsit+yā spyoya ta na sa ma ti kra mya ne+e ba saṃ dz+nyā gnas so/ /de rnam pa ⑪thams cad du ci yang med pa'i skye mched las 'das nas 'du shes med 'du 115—59

nā saṃ dz+nyā ya ta na mu pa saṃ pa r+ya bi ha ra ti/ byu tra krān+ta sa mā pat+t+waṃḥ/ byā ①skan+da shes med min skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /thod rgal du snyoms ②par 'jug pa/ thod rgal ka sa mā pat+t+waṃḥ/ na bā nu sgorba bi snehā ra sa mā patiḥ/ ni ro dha sa du snyoms ④par 'jug pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms rjopar 'jug pa dgu/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 0mā pat+t+waṃḥ/ ma hā byu ta sa ma ⑦sā dha rgo/ a saṃ dz+nyā sa mā patiḥ⑧// —par 'jug pa/ 'byung ba chen po mthun par sgrub ⑨pa/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms ⑩par 'jug pa/tshad med bzhi'i rgyud kyi ming la/mi ⑪ṭī/ ka ru ṇa/ mu di tā/ u pe k+ṣu/ sa mi ṭī sa ha ga te na tsit+ta nā be+e ⑫byams pa/ snying rje/ dga' ba/ btang snyoms/ de byams pa dang ldan pa'i re ⑫ḍā saṃ pan+de ⑫ saṃ bat+ta rtsod par 'jug pa de yin nam slar brtag ⑫nā byā bā dhe na be+e pu le na ma haṅga sems 'khon med pa 'gran zla med pa gnod pa med pa ⑩yangs pa chen por gyur pa tshad med pa ⑩mi te nā pra mā ṇi nā dwa ye na su bhā bi te ne+e rka di spyosha ma ⑪dhi mu tsuspa ri twa ⑥pa saṃ pa r+ya gnyis pa shin tu bsgoms pas phyogs gcig tu mos te khyab par byas nas rdzogs par byas te bi ha ra ti/ ta thā dī tī ⑥ya ta thā tro tī ⑫yan+ta thā tsa turba mi rtu— ma ⑫dha ster+yakra gnas so/ /de bzhin du gnyis pa dang de bzhin du gsum pa dang de bzhin du bzhi pa dang bla dang 'og sarba saḥ④sathru brnya mi mi lo shaṃ//dang thad kar rnam pa thams cad du thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten 'di/rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi ming la/rū spru rū pā ṇi pa sh+yi ⑫t+ya yo pra tha mo bi mo k+ṣaḥ/ a dh+yāt+ma ma ⑫rū pa gzugs can gzugs rnams la lta ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa dang po'o/ /nang gzugs med par 115—60

saṃ tshwa ba hin+d+ra rū pā ṇi ①pa sh+yi ④t+ya yo dī tī yo bi mo k+ṣaḥ/ shu bhi bi mo k+ṣ-i 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams la lta ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa gnyis pa'o/ /sdug pa'i rnam par kā ye na sā 7skṛ ①two pa saṃ pa ④r+ya bi ha ra ⑤t+ya yi tri tī buyo bi dze+emo k+ṣaḥ/thar pa lus kyis ④mngon sum du byas te rdzogs par byas nas gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa gsum pa'o//sa sat+tha ⑨sho rū pa saṃ dz+nyā dzā ()sa ma ti kra māt+tha thokyeti gha saṃ dz+nyā nā mas+t+waṃ ga māt+pa () de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te thogs ⑫pa'i 'du shes rnams nub nā nā twa sprestesaṃ dz+nyā nā ma ma na ()si kā rā da nan+ta mā kā sha mi t+yā kā ()shā nadh+yā par gyur cing sna tshogs kyi 'du shes rnams yid la mi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam nas nam ya ta na mu pa saṃ pa r+ya bi ha ra t+ya yañtsa tu rasgo ⑩bi mo k+ṣaḥ/ sa sarba mkha' mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa bzhi pa'o/ /de rnam pa sha ā kā shā nasgyu ya ta rna sa ma ti kra myu nat+t+waṃ ⑫bi dz+nyā nā mi ti bi ⑪dz+nyā nā nadh+yā ya thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so ta ⑫na sa mu pa saṃ pa r+ya bi ha ra t+ya yi pañtsa mo ⑪bi mo k+ṣaḥ/snyam nas rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa lnga pa'o/ /sa sarba sho bi dz+nyā nā nasgyu ya ta rgo sa ma ti kra mya nā ste ki tsi di t+yā ki tsi de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te ci yang med do snyam nas t+yā ⑫ya ta na mu pa saṃ pa r+ya bi ha ra t+ya yi ṣakhye bi mo k+ṣaḥ/ sa sarba ci yang med pa'i skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa drug pa'o/ /de rnam pa sha ā ki tsi t+yā ⑫ya ta dz+wa sa ma ti kra mya ne+e ba saṃ dz+nyā nā saṃ dz+nyā ya ta na mu pa saṃ ba thams cad du ci yang med pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das nas 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye r+ya ④bi ha ra t+ya yi ⑫sap+ta mo bi mo k+ṣaḥ/ sa sarba sho nai ba saṃ ⑪ mched rdzogs par byas te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa bdun pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du 'du 115—61

tshwa nā saṃ dz+nyā ya ta dz+wa sa ma ti kra ①mya saṃ dze+edz+nyā be ①di ta ni ro dhe kā ye na sā shes med 'du shes med min skye mched las yang dag par 'das te 'du shes dang tshor ba ④'gog pa lus 7tu kṛ two pa saṃ pa r+ya bi ha ra t+ya ya maṣ+ṭha ⑤mo bi mo k+ṣaḥ//kyis dumangon sum du byas nas rdzogs par byas te gnas pa 'di — rnam par thar pa brgyad pa'o/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad kyi ming la/a dh+yāt+t+waṃ ⑦rū pa skesaṃ rnyi ba nyi— byu pā ṇi pa sh+yarnyi ⑨pa rit+ta ni su baṇ+ḍi durbasgyu nang gzugs su 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs chung ngu kha dog bzang po dang kha dog ngan pa rnams ni tā ni kha lu rū pā 5 ⑩rnyi khyu ya dzā nārnyu rnyi byu ya pa sh+yadhe ⑪baṃ saṃ rnyi tsa bha ba tī la lta zhing gzugs de dag zil gyis mnan nas shes rtezil gyis mnan nas mthong ste de lta bur ⑫'du shes rda pra tha ma ④ma rnyi 1 ya ta dz+wa/ a dh+yāt+ma ma rū pa saṃ 1 ba par 'gyur ba 'di ni zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched dang po'o/ /nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas nyisgro rū spyopā ṇi pa sh+yarnyi ma haṅga ⑩tā ni su baṇ+ḍi ⑩durba1 ni tā ni kha lu rū pā rgya ⑫phyi rol gyi gzugs chen por gyur pa kha dog bzang po dang kha dog ngan pa rnams la lta zhing gzugs de dag rnyi byu ⑪ya dzā nā6 rnyi byu ⑪ya pa sh+yakhye ⑪baṃ saṃ rnyi tsa ⑫bha ba tī rda dri tī ya ma bhi zil gyis mnan nas shes duzil gyis mnan nas mthong ste de lta bur 'du shes par gyur pa 'di ni zil gyis bhā ya ta dz+wa/ a m+met+ma ma rū pa saṃ dz+nyā ba hin+d+ra rū pā ṇi pa blash+yarnyi smi gnon pa'i skye mched gnyis pa'o/ /nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs sngon po kha khā ni smi la bsgro ni nī la ni dar+sha nā ni nī la nidhā sā ⑫ni tar+ya thā u ma kā ⑪puṣ+pe dog sngon po sngon po lta bur ston pa 'od sngon po 'byung ba rnams la lta ⑥ste dper na zar ma'i me tog gam sadza.oṃ ⑫bā ⑥bā rā ṇa se yi bste smi lo ⑫nī la baṇ+ḍaṃ ⑥rī la ni dar+sha rgo ⑫nī la nidhā sa ⑫yul bā rā ciṇa sī'i ras phun sum tshogs pa kha dog sngon po sngon po lta bur ston pa 'od sngon po 'byung ba de 115—62

me ba ①me bā sgyut+mam ①rū pa ⑦saṃ rnyi ba hi— dhirū pā ṇi ba sh+yarnyi rī lā ni rtswa la ba1 ni bzhin du nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs sngon po kha dog sngon po sngon po lta bur ston nī la ni dar+sha nā ni nī la ⑤niṭ+wā sā nī rda tri tī ya ma rnyi bhā ya ta namra/ a dh+yāt+ma ma pa 'od sngon po 'byung ba rnams la lta ba 'di ni zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched gsum pa'o/ /nang gzugs rū pa saṃ jo ba hid+dhā rū pā ṇi rjopa sh+yarnyi spru tā ni spru ta btsā ni t+pā ta ni dar+sha nā ni smi med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs ser po kha dog ser po ser po lta bur ston pa 'od ser po 'byung ta nidhā bā ⑦ni tar+ya thā kaṇ+ḍi kā ra puṣ+pe sasbrar+ghaṃ ⑧bā bā rā ṇa ⑨se yo bs+t+waṃ spru haṃ ba rnams la lta ste dper na dong ka'i mdog gam yul bā rā ⑩ṇa sī'i ras phun sum tshogs pa ser po kha dog spru ta baṇ+ḍaṃ r+pā ⑪ta ni dar+sha dz+wa r+pā ta nidhā sa me ba me ()bā dh+yāt+ma ma rū pa saṃ rnyi ba ser po ser po lta bur ston pa 'od ser po 'byung ba de bzhin du nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi hin+d+ra rū pā ṇi ba sh+yarnyi t+pā tā ⑫ni bī ta ba7 ni spru ta ni dar+sha nā ni sni ta nidhā sā rī ④rol gyi gzugs ser po kha dog ser po ser po lta bur ston pa 'od ser ⑫po 'byung ba rnams la lta ba 'di ni rda tsa turba ma rnyi bhā ya ta rna/ /a m+met+ma ma ⑩rū pa saṃ rnyi ba hin+d+ra ⑩pā ṇi pa sh+yarnyi ⑫lo zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched bzhi pa'o/ /nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs dmar hi tā ni lo hi ⑪ta bsgro ni ⑫lo hi ta ni dar+sha nā ni ⑪lo hi ta niṭ+wā sā ni tar+ya thā po kha dog dmar po dmar po lta bur ston pa 'od dmar po 'byung ba rnams la lta ste dper na ban du 'dzi ba ban+d+ra jo ⑫ba ka pube+e saphra param̐ ⑫bā bā rā ṇa se yo bs+t+waṃ ④lo hi tai lo hi ⑫ta baṇ+ḍaṃ ⑪lo ka'i me tog gam yul bā rā ṇa sī'i ⑥ras phun sum tshogs pa dmar po kha dog dmar po dmar po lta bur hi ta ni dar+sha rna lo hi ta nidhā sa me ⑫ba me bā dh+yāt+ma rū ba saṃ ⑥rnyi ba histso rū pā ṇi pa ⑩ston pa 'od dmar po 'byung ba de bzhin du nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs dmar sh+yarnyi lo hi tā ni lo hi ta bsgyu ni lo hi ta ni dar+sha nā ⑥ni lo hi ta nidhā ⑫sā rī ⑫rda po kha dog dmar po dmar po lta bur ston pa 'od dmar po 'byung ba rnams la lta ba 'di ni zil gyis gnon 115—63

pañtsa ma ma bhi bhā ya ta rgo/ a dh+yāt+ma ma rū pa saṃ rnyi ba histso byu pā ṇi ba sh+yan+tu ba dā tā ni pa'i skye mched lnga pa'o/ /nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs dkar po kha dog a ba dā ta bash+lau ni a ba dā ta ni dar+sha nā n+ya a ①ba dā ta nidhā sā ni tar+ya thā u sha na dkar po dkar po lta bur ston pa 'od dkar po 'byung ba rnams la lta ste dper na skar ma pa ba sangs kyi stu ra kā yā baṇ+ḍi ②a ba dā tophob dā ta bzlophob ④dā ta ni dar+sha nolhab budā ta nidhā mdog dkar po kha dog dkar po ⑤dkar po lta bur ston pa 'od dkar po 'byung ba de bzhin du nang sa rjo.e ba me bā dh+yāt+ma rū ④pa saṃ rnyi ba nyidz+nyā rū pā ṇi ba byun+d+ra ⑧ba dā tā n+ya ba dā ta brje gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs dkar po kha dog dkar po dkar po ⑨lta bur ston pa n+ya ⑩ba dā ta ni ⑪dar+sha nā ni a ba dā ta nisgo ⑫sā nī rda ⑫ṣaṣ+ṭha ma ma ④bhi bhā ya ta rgo⑫/'od dkar po 'byung ba rnams la ⑩lta ba 'di ni zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched drug pa'o/ /sa sarba sho rū pa saṃ dz+nyā ṭ+wāṃ ⑩sa ma ti kra māt+tha ti gha saṃ dz+nyā nā maste ga saṃ spyonā nā twa saṃ de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes rnams las yang dag par 'das te thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams dz+nyā nā ma ma na si kā rā da nan+ta lho)mā kā sha mi t+yā kā shā nadh+yā ya ta na mu pa nub par gyur cing sna tshogs kyi 'du shes rnams yid la mi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam nas nam saṃ pa r+ya bi ha ra tī rda sap+ta ma ma bhi bhā ya ta rgo/mkha' mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te ⑥gnas pa 'di ni zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched bdun pa'o//sa sarba sa ⑪kā shā nasgyu ya ta rgo ⑫sa ma ti kra myu nan+ta ⑫bi dz+nyā nā mi ti bi dz+nyā nā nasgyu de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par ④'das te rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so ya ta na snyemu pa saṃ ba r+ya bi ha ⑪ra tī da maṣ+ṭha ⑥ma ma bhi bhā ya ta rgo//snyam nas rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas pa 'di ni zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad pa'o//115—64

zad par gyi skye mched bcu'i ming la/nī la kṛspyo ya ta rna/ spru ta kṛsgyu ya ta dz+wa/ lo hi ta kṛsgyu ya ta rgo/zad par sngon po'i skye mched/ zad par ser po'i skye mched/ zad par dmar po'i skye mched/a ba dā ta kṛsgyu ya ta dz+wa/ thra thi bī kṛsgyu ①ya ta rna/ ā ba ⑦kṛsgyu ya ta rgo/zad par dkar po'i skye mched/ zad par sa'i skye mched/ zad par chu'i skye mched/te dzaḥ1kṛsgyu ya ta rna/ bā rjoyu kṛsgyu ya ta rna/ ā kā sha kṛsgyu ya ta rna/ bi dz+nyā zad par me'i skye mched/ zad par rlung gi skye mched/ zad par nam mkha'i skye mched/ zad par rnam na kṛspyo ya ta rgo/ dṛ thi bī kṛsgyu mi bye ke saṃ dzā ⑤na te i rtudz+nya ma dha ster+ya ga 6)dwa par shes pa'i skye mched/ la lar zad par sa'o ⑦zhes steng dang 'og dang thad kar gnyis su med cing tshad ya ma pra mā r+ṇa/ apra te dzo ⑧bā yu nī la bī ta lo hi tā ba dā ⑨ta kṛspyo mi med par 'du shes su byed⑩/ la lar zad par chu dang me dang rlung dang sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po bye ke saṃ dzā ⑩na te i rtusgo ma dha ster+ya ga ⑫dwa ya ma pra mā rde⑫//dang dkar po'o zhes steng dang 'og dang thad kar gnyis su med cing tshad med par 'du shes su byed/rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi ming la/shu n+ya tā/ a ni mit+t+waṃ/ a pra ṇi hi tai//stong pa nyid/ mtshan ma med pa/ smon pa med pa/rton pa bzhi'i ming la/arba pra ti sa ra rte na bha bi ta bye na byaspru na pra ⑫ti sa ra ṇi na/ dharma pra don la rton par bya'i tshig 'bru la rton par mi bya/ chos la rton par bya'i 115—65

ti sa ra be+e na bha bi ta bye na ①puṅga la pra ti ①sa ra ṇi na/ tshwa na pra ti sa ra ṇi na bha gang zag la rton par mi bya/ ye shes la rton par bya'i bi ta ①bye na bi dz+nyā na pra ti sa ra ṇi na/ bhā tārba sru tram̐ ④pra ti sa ra be+e na bha bi ta rnam shes la rton par mi bya/ nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde la rton par bya'i drang ba'i byun+da ⑤ne+e yārja sru tra rjopra ti sa ra ṇi na//don gyi mdo sde la rton par mi bya/shes rab rnam pa gsum gyi ming la/shu tā ma yī pra dz+nyā/ ci ma yī pra 1/ bhā ba nā ma yī pra dz+nyā//thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab/ bsam pa las byung ba'i shes rab/ bsgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab/rig pa'i gnas lnga'i ming la/shalda bibyā/ he dze+etu bibyā/ ā dh+yā ṇa skebit+yā/ tsi kit+ma ⑨bit+yā/sgra'i rig pa/ gtan tshigs kyi rig pa/ nang gi rig pa/ gso ba'i rig pa/shi lpa kasmra s+thā ⑩bit+yā//bzo'i gnas kyi rig pa/chos yang dag par len pa bzhi'i ming la/tsa tā ri dhan+d+ra sa mā dā nā ni/ pra kyut+pan+da su kha mā ya t+t+waṃ duḥkha bi pā rka/chos yang dag par len pa bzhi/ da ltar byung ba la bde la phyi ma la rnam par smin pa sdug bsngal ba/pra sgot+pan+da duḥkha mā ya ṭ+wāṃ ⑪su kha bi pā rka/ pra kyut+pan+da su kha mā ya t+t+waṃ da ltar byung ba la sdug bsngal la ⑫phyi ma la rnam par min pa bde ba/ da ltar byung ba la'ang ⑫bde la phyi ma 115—66

su kha bi pā rka/ pra khyut+pan+da duḥkha mā ya t+t+waṃ duḥkha bi pā ka①//la'ang ⑦rnam par —na pa bde ba/ da sneltar byung ba la'ang sdug bsngal la phyi ma la'ang rjornam par byun pa sdug bsngal ba/nor bdun gyi ming la/ shra dh+wa ⑤dha rna/ shī la dha rna/ s+thā dha rnadu/ a pa tā bya ⑦dha rgo/ shu ta dha rna/dad pa'i nor/ tshul khrims kyi nor/ ngo tsha shes pa'i nor/ khrel yod pa'i nor/ thos pa'i nor/t+yā ga dha rna/ pra dz+nyā dha dz+wa//gtong ba'i nor/ shes rab kyi nor/bla na med pa drug gi ming la/dar+sha nā nut+tazlo/ shra ba ṇ+ḍa skenut+tazlo/ lā bhā nut+tazlo/ shi kyu ⑨nut+tazlo/mthong ba bla na med pa/ thos pa bla na med pa/ rnyed pa bla na med pa/ bslab ⑩pa bla na med pa/ba ri tsarlu nut+tazlo/ a nu smṛ t+ya nut+tazlo//rim gro bya ba bla na med pa/ rjes su dran pa bla na med pa/byin gyis brlabs pa bzhi'i ming la/sa t+yā dhijo rna/ t+yā gā dhijo ⑪rgo/ u pa sha mā ⑫bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs⑫/ gtong ba'i byin gyis brlabs⑫/ nye bar zhi ba'i byin gyis dhiṣ+ṭha rna/ pra dz+nyā dhijo rgo//brlabs⑫/ shes rab kyi byin gyis brlabs⑩/115—67

mchog tu dga' ba sngon du 'gro ba'i chos dgu'i ming la/na ba pra mo r+ya pūrba kā dhas+thāḥ①/ pra mu di ta su dz+rī ti dzā ya te/ t+pā ti ②ma mchog tu dga' ba sngon du 'gro ba'i chos dgu/ rab tu dga' ba la dga' ba skye'o/ /yid dga' na saḥkā yaḥpra srabh+ya ①te/ pra srabha kā yaḥsu kha be+e da ya ti/ su khi ta ba'i lus shin tu sbyangs par gyur to/ /lus shin tu sbyangs pa rjobade ba myong bar byed do/ /bde bar gyur tsit+t+waṃ sa mā dhī ⑤ya te/ sa mā hi ta tsisto ya thā byu te pra dzā rjopa'i sems mnyam par 'jog go/ /sems mnyam par gzhag ⑦na yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu nā ti ⑧ya thā bhū tai ⑨pa sh+ya ti/ ya thā bhū ta da: nibe+er+ya shes so yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ngo / / yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ba skyo bar 'gyur te—/ ni birnyo ( )bi ra dz+ra te/ bi rak+to bi mu tsu ro/ /skyo na ⑪'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags dang bral nas rnam par grol bar te—/ bi muk+ta su ⑩bi mustopho ⑫ti dz+nyā na ④dar+sha dz+wa bha ba ti//'gyur ro/ /rnam par grol na bdag rnam pa grol lo snyam pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'byung ngo / /'byung bar 'os pa'i khams drug gi ming la/ṣaṭa nim ra bhā ya dhā ta paḥ/ ⑫ byā pā da sgyu byā pā do niḥs ra rde ⑩be+e ṭī/'byung bar 'os pa'i khams drug /gnod sems las 'byin pa ni gnod sems med pa ste byams pa/bi ho sā nisma ra r+ṇa ⑩ka ru ṇ+ḍa/ a ra ti nim ra ṇi mu di tā/ kā ma niḥs rnam par 'tshe ba las 'byin pa ni snying rje/ mi dga' ba las 'byin pa ni dga' ba/ 'dod pa las ra ṇa mu pe k+ṣu/ bi tsi kiṣ+ṭha ⑫nim ra ṇa mabyu ⑪mā na sa musgyu ⑥taḥ/'byin pa ni btang snyoms/ the tshom las 'byen pa ni nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal yang dag par 'joms pa/115—68

ni mit+ta 8ཿ①sa ra ṇa ④ma ni mit+t+waṃ//mtshan ma las 'byin pa di mtshan ma med pa④/lha dang mi rnams kyi 'khor lo bzhi'i ming la/pra ti rū pa de sha ④bā saḥ/ sadru ru ṣā shra yi/ āt+ma namamyakru mthun pa'i yul du gnas pa/ skyes bu dam pa la brten ⑤pa/ bdag nyid buyang dag pa'i ṇi dhā dz+wa/ pūbye tsa ⑦kṛ ta pu t+ta tā⑧//smon lam/ sngon yang bsod nams byas pa/dka' thub la gnas pa dang sdom pa 'dzin cing spyod pa la sogs pa'i ming la/e ⑨ka de sha kā rī/ pra de sha kā rī/ yasgru yasku rī/ a pa ri pūṇ+ḍi ⑫kā rī/sna gcig spyod pa/ nyi tshe spyod pa/ de bas mang du spyod pa/ ma chub par spyod pa/ba ri puṇ+ḍi ⑪kā rī/ saṃ ya maḥ/ da maḥ/ su bi nī taḥ/ ta bsī⑫/ bra ⑫chub par spyod pa/ legs par sdom pa/ dul ba/ shin tu dul ba/ dka' thub can/ brtul tī—/ ya ti⑫/ ahrī dro⑫/ a khaṇ+ḍaṃ/ a sa ba lam̐/ a ⑩kas+thā ṣe/zhugs can/ sdom brtson/ skyon med pa/ ma nyams pa/ 'dres par ma gyur pa/ thun tshags ma yin pa/bhū dzi ṣ+yospyo/ a pa rā mṛṭaṃ/ su sa mābye/ su sa rang dbang can/ nog nog por ma gyur pa/ legs par 'dzin pa'am legs par chub pa/ legs par mā ⑫radzhai/ ār+ya ⑪kādhe⑩/ u pa bā sa mu pa ba sarnyi/ tsā ri brtsams pa/ 'phags pa bzhed pa'am 'phags pa dgyes pa/ bsnyen gnas la nye bar gnas pa/ cho ga tra saspan+daḥstso/ bā ri tā saṃ pan+daḥ⑫/ ā ya t+t+waṃ saṃ ba ra mā pa r+ya te/ sa mā phun sum tshogs pa/ bzlog pa phun sum tshogs pa/ phyis sdom pa 'dzin pa/ yang dag par bzung ⑫115—69

dā ya bat+t+waṃ te①/ sā dhu da maḥ/ sā byu sha maḥ/ sā dhu saṃ yā maḥ//nas gnas pa/ dul ba legs/ zhi ba legs/ yang dag par sdom pa legs/rnal 'byor spyod pa dang rnal 'byor gyi yan lag gi ming la/yo gā tsā raḥ②/ yo bī/ yo gaḥdze+e/ yo ni sho ma na si kā raḥ/ pra ti rnal 'byor spyod pa/ rnal 'byor pa/ rnal 'byor/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa/ nang du yang saṃ la ya rna/ dṛṣ+ṭa dhasmra ④su kha bi hā ra⑤ཿ/ ā swā da na saṃ pra yuk+ta m+me rjorna/ bhā ba nā dag 'jog /mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas/ myong ba dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan/ sgom pa la rā ma tā/ a bhi byun+da ya ti/ ba ⑦ri gyin+da ⑧ya ti/ pa ri t+pā ṇa ⑨ya ti/ pa ri dga' ba/ mnyen par byed/ yongs su mnyen par byed/ yongs su tshim par byed/ kun du rgyas spa ra ti/ e kā ⑩ki no ra ho ga ⑪tā/ sna la nyiti ⑫ka tā/ o dā ri ka tā/ duḥpar byed/ gcig pu dben pa'am ⑫skog tu song ste/ rtsig ⑫pa stug po lta bur⑫/ rags pa/ tha ba kha li tā/ yi cos ghā⑩/ a ba:⑩/ sa pha lo⑫/ ces ko tī bhā baḥ⑪//ngan pa ltar/ don yod pa/ 'bras bu yod pa/ 'bras bu dang bcas dupa/ rgyud gcig tu gyur pa/lung bstan pa bzhi'i ming la/e ṭ+wāṃ sha byā ka ra ṇapo/ bi bha bye byā ka ra rde/ pa ri thrats+tsha byā ka ra rde/ s+thā pa mgo gcig tu lung bstan pa/ rnam par phye ste lung bstan pa/ dris nas lung bstan pa/ gzhag ⑥nī ya byā ka ra ṇi//par lung bstan pa/115—70

mtshan nyid gsum gyi ming la/pa ri kabra ta lak+ṣa r+ṇa/ pa ra tan+t+ra lak+ṣa rte/ ba ①ri nijun+da ②lak+ṣa ṇi//kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid/ yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid/dgongs pa bzhi'i ming la/sa ma tā bi ①pā yaḥ/ kā lāsto rā bhi pā yaḥdu/ an+d+ra ⑤n+ta rā rnyi pā yaḥmanyam pa nyid la dgongs pa/ dus gzhan la dgongs pa/ don gzhan la dgongs pa/puṅga khārnya ⑦rā rnyi pā yaḥ⑦//gang zag gzhan la dgongs pa/ ldem por dgongs pa bzhi'i ming la/a ba tā ra ṇ+ḍa bhi sarnyiḥske/ la k+ṣa ḍā rnyi sarnyiḥsti/ pra ti pak+ṣu gzhug pa la ⑩sdem por dgongs pa/ mtshan nyid la ldem por dgongs pa/ gnyen po la ldem por rnyi sarnyiḥ⑪/ ba ri ṇ+ḍa ma nā rnyi sarnyiḥ⑫//dgongs pa/ bsgyur ba la ldem por dgongs pa/zhi gnas lhag mthong la sogs pa'i ming la/sha ma thaḥ⑫/ bi pa byu nā/ yo ga /yo ni sho ma nasku ⑫raḥ//zhi gnas/ lhag mthong / rnal 'byor/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa/115—71

mi dge ba bcu'i ming la/ ṭī ṇi kā ①ya dush+tsa ri tā ni/ tsa tā ②ri bāgrush+tsa ri tā ni/ ṭī ṇi ma no dush+tsa ri tā ni//lus kyi snenyes par spyod pa gsum/ ngag gi nyes par spyod pa bzhi/ yid kyi nyes par spyod pa gsum/dge ba bcu'i las kyi ming la/kā ya su tsa ri taphra/ pā ḍā ti ghā tā dī rjor tiḥ/ a ⑤dāt+ta dā nā dī ༷ra tiḥ/lus kyis legs par spyod pa/ srog gcod pa spong ba/ ma byin par len pa spong ba/kā ma mi byā tsā ⑦rā dī ⑧ra tiḥ/ bāklu tsa ri haṃ⑨/ mṛ ṣa bā dāt+tha ti bi ra tiḥ/ pā 'dod pa la ⑩log par g.yem pa sgong ba/ ngag gi legs par spyod pa/ brdzun ⑪du smra ba spong ba/ tshig ru ṣān+d+ra ti bi ra tiḥ/ ba ⑫shu t+yāt+tha ti bi ra tiḥ/ saṃ bhen+d+ra pra lā pāt+tha ti bi ra tiḥ/tsub por smra ba spong ba/ phra mar smra ba spong ba/ tshig bkyal ⑫spong ba/ma na su tsa ri tai/ a bhi sgyu yāḥpra ti bi ra tiḥ/ byā pā dāt+pa ④pra ti bi ra tiḥyid kyis legs par spyod pa/ brnab sems spong ba/ gnod sems spong ba/mi byā dṛṣ+ṭi⑫ཿpra ti bi ra tiḥ⑩//log par lta ba spong ba/bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po bzhi'i ming la/pu khyu kṛ yā bstuḥ⑩/ dā na ma yo purgya kṛ yā bstuḥske/ shī la bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ tshul khrims ma yo ⑪pu5 kṛ yā bstuḥstso/ bhā ⑪ba nā ma yi pu5 kṛ yā bstuḥ⑫/las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ bsgoms ⑫pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/715—72

lo ①pa rnyi rka pu5 kṛ yā bstuḥ④/ gu ṇaḥ//ros las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ yon tan/don dam pa'i ming la/ba ra marba④ཿ/ ta tworjo/ bhū ta ko ṭiḥ/ ta tha tā/ a bi ⑤ta tha tā/don dam pa/ de kho na/ yang dag pa'i mtha'/ de bzhin nyid/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid/a na n+ya ta tha tā/ shu n+ya tā/ dharma dz+nyā tuḥdhi/ dharma ni yā ma tā/ a tsiṣ+ṭha gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid/ stong pa nyid/ chos kyi dbyings/ chos mi 'gyur ba nyid/ bsam gyis mi dhā tuḥ⑦/ a bi parlu sa ta tha tā/ a dwa yi/ a dwo ⑧dhī kā re⑨/ dhabyu ⑩sbi khyab pa'i dbyengs/ phyin ci ma log pa de bzhin nyid/ gnyis su med/ gnyis su byar med/ chos ti tā⑪/ spri tai ba dhan+d+ra ⑫dhā tu spri ti tā/ e kai bai ⑫ṣā ta thā tā/gnas pa nyid/ chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul ni gnas pa nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid 'di ni gcig pa nyid do/ /dhasma spyojo twa saste daḥ/ a dwa ya me ta da dwo dhā ⑩kā ra ma chos kyi dbyings 'dres pa med pa'am ⑩dbyer med pa/ 'di ni gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med cing tha rnyin+da ma stso.oṃ⑩//mi dad de bcad du med/mya ngan las 'das pa la sogs pa'i ming la/nir+pā rde/ sau pa dhi she ṣa nis+thā rde⑫/ ni ru pa dhi she ṣa mya ngan las 'das pa/ phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa/ phung po lhag ma med nir+pā ṇaphra⑪/ a pra tiṣ+ṭṛ ta niza ṇamra⑥/ ni shri ya saḥ/ a pa brgaḥ/pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa/ nges par legs pa/ byang grol/115—73

a rnyi sa ma yaḥ/ shi k+ṣaḥ/① a shi k+ṣaḥ②/ ne+e ba shi skek+ṣa na shi ④k+ṣaḥ/ samyadh+wa mngon par rtogs pa/ slob pa/ mi slob pa/ slob pa yang ma yin mi slob pa yang ma yin/ yang dag ni ya ta rā shiḥ/ mi byā twa ni ya ta rā shiḥ/ a ni ya ta rā shiḥ//pa nyid du nges pa'i phung po/ log pa nyid du nges pa'i phung po/ ma nges pa'i phung po/skyabs rnams kyi ming la/sha ra ṇi⑤/ nā thaḥrjo/ pa rā ⑦ya r+ṇa/ tā r+ṇa/ pa ri tā rgo⑧/ tā yī/skyabs/ mgon/ dpung gnyen/ skyob pa/ yongs su skyob pa/ skyob ston/la ya rna/ ga ti/ dī baḥ⑨/ tā ra kaḥ/ ut+ta ⑩ra r+ṇa/ pa ri tā tā⑪//gnas/ rten/ skyabs dang gling skabs dang sbyar/ sgrol byed/ bsgral ba po⑫/ skyob par byed pa/ri mor bya ba'i rnam pa'i ming la/ban+da rna⑫/ pū dza nā④/ mā na nā/ artsa nā/ a pa tsā ya nā/ cisti ⑫kā raḥ⑩/phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa/ ri mor bya ba/ brjed pa/ gsol ba/ gces par byed pa/ sad+ku raḥ⑩/ gu ru kā raḥ/ u pas+thā naḥ/ parlu pū sa rna⑫/ ā da raḥ/bkur ster bya ba/ bla mar bya ba'am ⑪btsun par bya ba/ rim gro/ bsnyen bkur/ gus par bya ba/go ⑪ra baṃ/ e dza ⑪li karmā/ pra t+yābye ⑫dz+wa/ sā m+bi ṭī/ pra ṇa rmya⑫/ a zhe sa/ thal mo sbyar ba/ mngon du ldang ba/ 'dun pa'am mthun pa/ rab tu 'dud pa/ mngon par rnyi na ma dz+wa/ sā mi ⑫ṭī ka ra bhā yaḥ/ ā ⑫ha ba rī yaḥ/ pā ha ba nī ⑩yaḥ /'dud pa/ phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ kun du sbyin pa'i 'os su gyur pa/ rab tu sbyin pa'i 'os su gyur pa/115—74

bhak+to gu ruḥ/ gu ru shu ①shu ṣāsne/ sa pra tī shaḥ/ sa go ④ra baḥ/bla ma la gus pa'am dusnying nye ba/ bla ma la srid zhu che ba/ zhe sa dang bcas pa/ gus pa dang bcas pa/se ba ⑤rna/ bha dza rna/ brlu pā dus rgo/ u pā sa dz+wa/ saṃ se ba rna/bsten pa/ bsnyen pa/ bsnyen bkur byed pa/ bsnyen bkur byed pa/ yang dag par bsten pa/u pa se ba rna/ ba hu ⑦mā naḥni/ pra ṇi pa ju⑨/ a bhi bā da rgo/ pūza ⑩bhi khā spru//nye bar bsten pa/ ri mor bya ba'i rin po cher ⑪bya ba/ phyag 'tshal lam ⑫btud nas/ gus par smra ba/ gsong por smra ba/spro zhing brtson pa la sogs pa'i ming la/uskṛ tsi taḥ/ un+d+ra ⑫haḥ/ ā ④ram+bhaḥ/ a tadh+ri taḥ⑫/ sa1 t+ya kā rī/spro ba'am/ brtson ⑩pa/ rtsom pa/⑩ mi g.yel ba'am snyoms ⑫las med pa/ gus par byed pa/sā tan+t+ra ⑪kā rī/ ni ya kaḥ⑩/ pra ti dz+nyot+ta ⑪ra kaḥ/ āsbi ti kṛ yā⑫/rgyun du byed pa/ rtag 'grus che⑫/ kha 'og tu lus 'khrus pa/ nyams su len pa'am ④zhen par byed pa/a rnyi yo gaḥ⑫/ sngo/ byo ga⑪ཿ/ yo ⑫ga mā pan+ta bye⑫/mngon par brtson pa/ brtson pa/ brtson par bya rnal 'byor du bya sbyor bar bya skabs dang sbyar zhing gdags⑫/dharmā nu dhan+d+ra ⑩pra ti patiḥ/ ā ṭ+wāp+ta ⑥shi rabye lo pa maḥ/ orlu k+to⑫/chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos kyi nan tan/ mgo dang gos la me 'bar ba lta bu/ spro ba'am brtson pa skabs dang sbyar/ba ⑫rā kra maḥ/ ā tā yī⑫/ ā tap+ta kā rī⑫/ u r+ya taḥ/brtul ba'am pha rol gnon pa'am dpa' ba/ rtun pa/ brtun cing byed pa/ brtson pa'am zhugs pa/ni ra taḥ/ asbyi kṛ t+yaḥ/ pra ti pat+t+waṃ sā ⑪raḥ/'bad pa'am brtson pa/ ru ⑥shing ltar 'dzin pa'am ⑫ched cher 'dzin pa/ nan tan snying por byed pa/na byu hā ra ru ta ⑥bāthi ra maḥ/ bya ba sā yaḥ/ a byun+d+ra ha⑩ཿ/ san+d+ra ha san+darnya⑪ཿ/brjod pa'i sgra dang smra ba lhur byed pa ma yin/ 'bad pa'am rtsol ba/ mngon par spro ba/ go cha bgos/115—75

u pā dā ya rū paṃ/ ① dza na rgo/ ni she yaḥ/ s+thā rnaḥdze+e/ u pa stam+bhaḥ/ u pa rgyur byas pa'i gzugs/ skyed ⑦pa/ rten/ gnas/ rton pa/ 'phel bṛ ha rde④/ tsakyu ridh+ri yam̐/ sho ⑤tespri yi/ ghā durtebyu yi/ dzi twedh+ri yo/ kā bar byed pa/ mig gi dbang po/ rna ba'i dbang po/ sna'i dbang po/ lce'i dbang po/ lus yedh+ri yi/ rū pa pra sā ⑦daḥ⑧/ rū paṃ/ shajaḥ⑨/ garnyaḥ⑩/ ra sa⑪ཿ/kyi dbang po/ gzugs dang ba/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/spraṣ+ṭa ⑫bye/ baṇ+ḍi ⑫rū paṃ/ dri lo/ spru tai/ lo hi haṃ/ a ba dā tai/ a ṭ+wāṃ ④/reg bya/ kha dog gi gzugs/ sngon po/ ser po/ dmar po/ dkar po/ sprin/dhū maḥ⑫/ ra dzaḥ⑩/ ma hi kā/ ts+tsha ⑩yā/ ā (sretā paḥ⑪/ ā lo ka 0ཿ/du ba/ rdul/ khug rna/ grib ma/ nyi ma/ snang ba/arnya kā raḥ⑪/ saṃ s+thā ⑫na rū paṃ/ dīr+ghaṃ/ hra swe/ dṛt+t+waṃ/ pa ri maṇ+ḍa lo/mun pa/ dbyibs kyi gzugs/ ring po/ thung ngu/ lham pa/ rlum po/shā tai/ bi shā tai/ bho ti ka rū baṃ⑫/phya ④le ba'am ⑫mnyam pa/ phya ⑩le ba ⑫ma yin pa'am ⑫mi mnyam pa/ 'byung ba las gyur pa'i gzugs/un+da tai/ a ba na ⑥lta/ tsa tu ra sre/ bi dz+nyā pra ⑥tī/ sa ni dar+sha rgo/ a ni darga rgo/⑥mthon po/ dma' ba/ gru bzhi/ rnam par rig byed/ bstan du yod pa/ bstan du med pa/⑫sa pra ti ghaḥ⑫/ a pra ti ghaḥ/ a nu pāt+ta ma hā bhū ta he tu kaḥ④/ sa tā thogs pa dang bcas pa/ thogs pa med pa/ ma zin pa'i 'byung ba chen po'i rgyu las byung ba/ sems khyolha ⑫sa tā khyaḥ/ ma no dz+nyā ma no dz+nyāsh+tsa⑪/ u pāt+ta can ⑩ston pa dang sems can du mi ston pa/ yid du 'ong ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba/ zin pa'i 'byung ba ma hā bhū ta te tu kaḥste/ sa tā khyo sa tā khyaḥ/ ma no tshwa ma chen po'i rgyu las byung ba/ sems can du ston pa dang sems can du mi ston pa/ yid du 'ong ba dang yid du mi 115—77

no dz+nyāsh+tsaḥ/ su garnyaḥ/ durgarnyaḥ/ sa ma garnyaḥ①/ bi ṣa ma garnyaḥ/ ma dhu raḥ②/ abe+eḥ/'ong ba dang ①/ dri zhim pa/ dri nga ba/ dri mnyam pa/ dri mi mnyam pa/ mngar ba/ myur ba/la ba ṇaḥrjo/ ka ṭu kaḥ/ tik+taḥ/ ka ṣā yaḥ/ blakyā two/ karka sha two/ gu ru ⑤ṭ+wāṃ/lan tshwa/ tsha ba/ kha ba/ bska ba/ 'jam pa/ tsub pa/ lci ba/la ghu tworjo/ shī lta/ bu bhuk+ṣu⑦/ dzi ghan+d+ra/ pi pā sā/ a bi dz+nyāsteḥ⑧//yang ba/ grang ba/ bkres pa/ bkres pa'am ltogs ⑨pa/ skom pa/ rnam par rig byed ma yin⑩/tshor ba'i phung po so sor phye ba'i ming la/su khā/ duḥkhā/ a duḥkhā su khā//bde ba/ sdug bsngal/ bde ba yang ma yin sdug bsngal yang ma yin/'du shes kyi phung po so sor phye ba'i ming la/pa rīṣ+ṭha⑪/ ma hāsgro tā/ a pra mā ṇa⑫//chung ngu / chen por gyur pa/ tshad med pa/sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i 'du byed dang / sems dang ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi ming la/tsi ta si kā dharmā⑫ཿ/ spar+shaḥspyo/ saṃ dz+nyā⑫/ be da nā/ ma nasku raḥ/sems las byung ba'i chos rnams/ reg pa/ 'du shes/ tshor ba/ yid la byed pa/tse ta nā/ ts+tshan+daḥ/ a dhi mo k+ṣaḥ/ smṛ tiḥ pra dz+nyā/ sa mā dhiḥ/ shradhā/ ṭīḥ/sems pa⑩/ 'dun pa/ mos pa/ dran pa/ shes rab/ ting 'dzin/ dad pa/ ngo tsha shes pa/a pa tā bye⑩/ a lo bhaḥku sha la rū lo/ sa ⑫dwo ṣaḥku sha la spru lo/ a mo haḥkhrel yod pa/ ma chags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa spyob/ zhe sdang med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ gti mug med 115—78

ku sha la tho lo/ ṭ+wāṃzlo①/ bra saḥrnyi④/ sa ①pra mā daduḥ/ u be+e 7/ a hosā/pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ brtson 'grus/ shin tu sbyangs pa/ bag yod pa/ btang snyoms/ mi 'tshe ba/rā ga⑤ཿ/ bra ⑦ti ghaḥ/ mā naḥ/ a dhi mā ⑦naḥ/ mā nā ti mā naḥ/ asmi mā naḥ/'dod chags/ khong khro ba/ nga rgyal/ lhag pa'i nga rgyal/ nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal/ nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal/a rnyi mā naḥ/ sprun ⑧mā naḥ/ mi byā mā naḥ/ a bibyā⑨/ dṛsbyiḥ/mngon pa'i nga rgyal/ cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ log pa'i nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ lta ba/sad+ku ya dṛjiḥ/ arnya gā ⑩ha dṛjiḥ/ mi byā dṛjiḥ/ dṛji pa rā mar+shaḥ/ shī la 'jig tshogs la lta ba/ mthar 'dzin par lta ba/ log par lta ba/ lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa/ tshul khrims bra ta pa rā mar+shaḥ/ bi tsi kit+pā/ kro dhaḥ/ u pa nā haḥ/ mrak+ṣaḥ/ pra ⑪dā sa⑫ཿ/dang brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa/ the tshom/ khro ba/ khon du 'dzin pa/ 'chab pa/ 'tshig pa/ir+ṣaspyoske/ mat+mazlo⑨/ mā yā/ shā :/ ma daḥ/ bi ho sā/ a byā kyi/phrag dog ser sna/ sgyu/ g.yo / rgyags pa / rnam par 'tshe ba/ ngo tsha med pa/a na pa tā byespyo/ a shrahūṃ/ kau shrī bye/ pra mā daḥ/ mu ⑩ṣi ta smṛ ti tā/ bi k+ṣe paḥ/khrel med pa/ ma dad pa/ le lo/ bag med pa/ brjed (rtengs pa/ g.yeng ba/a saspra dza sbyaspyo/ lodha h+ye⑪/ kau kṛ tram̐/ sgyu dz+wa ① / mit+t+waṃ/ bi tarkaḥ/ bi tsā ⑩raḥ/shes bzhin ma yin pa/ rgod pa/ 'gyod pa/ rmugs pa/ gnyid/ rtog pa/ dpyod pa/pāsteḥ⑤—/ a pābhiḥ⑫/ a saṃ rnyi ④sa mā pat+t+waṃḥ/ ni ro dha sa mā patispyo/'thob pa/ 'thob pa med pa/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa/a saṃ rnyi ka/ dz+re ⑪be+e tebyu yo/ ni kā ya sa bhā gaḥ/ dzā tiḥ⑫/ dza rā/ t+tha ti 3/'du shes med pa/ srog gi dbang po/ rigs mthun pa/ skye ba/ rga ba/ gnas pa/115—79

a ni t+ya tā①/ nā ma kā yaḥ/ pa da ka ⑤yaḥ/ byañdza na kā yaḥ/ e baṃ bhā gī yā/mi rtag pa/ ming gi tshogs/ tshig gi tshogs/ yi ge'i tshogs/ de lta bu'i cha dang mthun ①pa/pra bṛt+t+waṃḥ/ pra ti ni buya maḥ/ yo gaḥ/ dzā baḥ/ a nu kra maḥ/ kā laḥ/ de ⑤shaḥ/'jug pa/ so sor nges pa/ 'byor 'brel/ mkhyegs pa/ go rims/ dus/ yul/saṃ khyu/ bhe daḥ/ sā ma shrī⑥/ pra ban+taḥ/ a n+ya thā two/grangs—/ tha dad pa'am ⑦bye brag 'du 'phrod dam tshogs pa/ rgyun/ gzhan du 'gyur ba/pra brjo pa ra maḥ/ byañdza rgoske/ a k+ṣa ram̐/ bar+ṇaḥ//⑨rgyun chad pa/ gsal byed/ yi ge/ bajod pa/rnam par shes pa'i ming la/ā la ya bi dz+nyā māṃ/ ā dā na bi dz+nyā rgo/ kliṣ+ṭa ma naḥtu) / tsakyube+e dz+nyā dz+wa/kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa/ len pa'i rnam par shes pa/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid/ mig gi rnam par shes pa/sho tra bi dz+nyā rna/ ghā ṇa bi dz+nyā rgo/ dzi hwa bi dz+nyā ā+oṃ/ kā ya bi dz+nyā rgo/rna ba'i rnam par shes pa/ sna'i rnam par shes pa/ lce'i rnam par shes pa/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa/ma no bi dz+nyā rgo//yid kyi rnam par shes pa/skye mched bcu gnyis kyi ming la/tsak+ṣu rā ya ta rgo/ rū pā ya ta rgo/ sho ⑪tā ya ta rgo/ shas+thā ⑫ya ta rgo/mig gi skye mched/ gzugs kyi skye mched/ rna ba'i skye mched/ sgra'i skye mched/115—80

7 ḍā ya ta rna/ gan+d+ra ya ta rgo/ dzi hā ya ta rna/ ra sā ya ta rna/ kā yā ya ta rgo /sna'i skye mched/ dri'i skye mched/ lce'i skye mched/ ro'i skye mched/ lus kyi skye mched/sbraṣ+ṭa byā ya ta rna/ ma na ā ya ta rna/ dharmā ya ta rgo//reg bya'i skye mched/ yid kyi skye mched/ chos kyi skye mched/khams bco brgyad kyi ming la/tsagrudhā tuḥ/ rū pa khyu tuḥ/ tsak+ṣubi dz+nyā na dhā tuḥ/ tho tra dhu ①tuḥ/ shaja dhu ④tuḥ/mig gi khams/ gzugs kyi khams/ mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams/ rna ba'i khams/ sgra'i khams/sgo ④tra bi dz+nyā na jo tuḥ/ s+thā ṇa rjojo tuḥ/ gad+dha dh+wa tuḥ'/ s+thā ṇa bi dz+nyā na dhā tuḥ/rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i khams/ sna'i khams/ dri'i khams/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i khams/dzi hwa khyu tuḥdhi/ ra sa dze+edz+nyā tuḥ/ dzi hwa bi dz+nyā na dh+wa tuḥ/ kā ya dhā tuḥ/ spraṣ+ṭa bya dhā tuḥ/lce'i khams/ ro'i khams/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i khams/ lus kyi khams/ reg bya'i khams/kā ya bi dz+nyā na dhā tuḥ/ ma no sgyu tuḥ/ dharma ④dhā tuḥ/ ma no bi dz+nyā na dh+wa tuḥ//lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams/ yid kyi khams/ chos kyi khams/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams/dbang po nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi ming la/tsakyu ri— yi/ tho tre— yi/ gyu ṇidh+ri yi/ dzi twedh+ri yi/ kā yespri yo/ ma ne+e dh+ri yo/mig gi dbang po/ rna ba'i dbang po/ sna'i dbang po/ lce'i dbang po/ lus kyi dbang po/ yid kyi dbang po/pu ru ṣedh+ri yo/ ྈdh+ri yam̐/ duḥkhedh+ri ⑨yi/ su khejo ⑩yi/ sau ma na gyedh+ri ⑪yo/pho'i dbang po/ mo'i dbang po/ sdug bsngal gyi dbang po/ bde ba'i dbang po/ yid bde ba'i dbang po/dorma na sum+bi ⑫yi/ u pe k+ṣedh+ri ⑫yo/ shrad+dhidh+ri ⑫yo/ bīrledh+ri yi/yid mi bde ba'i dbang po/ btang ⑫snyoms kyi dbang po/ dad pa'i dbang po/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po/115—81

smṛ tīrje yo/ sa ①mā dhīdh+ri ②yo/ pra zlos ①yo/ a nā dz+nyā ta mā dz+nyā myu m+bidz+re dhiyi/dran pa'i dbang po/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po/ shes rab kyi dbang po/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po/ā zlospri yam̐/ ā rjodz+nyā tā bīdz+re yi/ dz+re bi terje yam̐rjo//kun shes pa'i dbang po/ kun shes pa dang ldan pa'i dbang po/ srog gi dbang po/phung po khams dang skye mched dang dbang po bshad pa'i nang nas 'byung ba'i ming sna tshogs la/a ba d+mā ra r+ṇa/ ā shra ya bhū ta byu pa rjat+pasti/nges par 'dzin pa'am dbye ba/ rten du gyur pa ④gzugs su yod pa'i phyir ram gzhag tu rung ba'i phyir/su baṇ+ḍaṃ/ durba r+ṇa⑨/ paṇ+ḍa re/ stso saṃ/kha dog bzang po'am tsu )mdog bzang po/ kha dog ngan pa'am 'dog mi sdug pa/ skya'o/ sngo bsangs/sha ba lo/ dzi ga lo/ tsa tuḥ pat+t+waṃ/ ā bho gaḥ/sre bo'am khra bo ⑪'am stag ri'am 'dres pa/ ser skya/ ngas gzhi/ sgrin pa'am 'jug pa'am gzo ⑫ba/a bye khā ṣaḥ/ saṃ stu tai/ a saṃ pra mo ṣaḥ/ bi nyi tai/ a bhi saspra t+ya yo/ laspyo /'dod pa/ 'dris pa/ mi brjed pa/ byas pa'am bskyed pa/ mngon par yid ches pa/ 'dzem pa'am ngo tsha ba/saspra ti pat+t+waṃḥ/ sa haḥ/ pra sha ṭha tā/ do byu lhi/ karma rgyu tā/ ā ghā taḥ④/yang dag par rtogs pa/ spyo ba/rnal du bab pa'am spyo'adug pa/ gnas ngan len/ lus su rung ba/ kun nas mnar sems/she yaḥ⑩/ ba hun+ta ra bi shaṣ+ṭa⑩ཿ/ a pa kā raḥ/ be+e rā nu brnyaḥ/legs pa'am dge ba'am che ba/ khyad ches 'phags pa/ gnod par byed pa/ mdud par 'dzin pa/tsaṇ+ḍa ba tso dā shi tā/ byā ro ṣaḥ/ ā gra haḥ⑫/ bañtsa ⑪nā/ brludā rgo/tshig brlang pos zher 'debs pa/ khong nas 'khrug pa/ kun du 'dzin pa/ slu ba/ yongs su gtugs pa'am ⑦'phyos pa/115—82

bi he ṭha nā/ bi pra ti sā raḥ/ ma no dzabe+eḥ/ ma hā bhū ①mi kaḥ/ sa ha dzaḥ/the 'tshams ⑧pa/ yid la bcags pa/ yid la brjod pa'am rtog pa/ sa chen po pa/ lhan cig skyes pa/pa ri kalpi lta/ āt+ma mo haḥ/ āt+ma dṛṣ+ṭi①ཿ/ āt+ma mā naḥ/ āt+ma sne haḥ/kun du brtag ④pa/ bdag tu rmongs pa/ bdag tu lta ba/ bdag tu nga rgyal/ bdag la chags pa/san+d+ra nā nu z-itiḥ⑤/ e ka dzā tī rjoya bi dz+nyā dz+wa/ sa bhā gaḥ/ tat+ma bhā rgyun chags par 'jug pa/ rnam par shes pa rigs gcig pa/ bsten pa dang bcas pa/ de'i bsten pa dang gaḥ / nirbit+pa⑦/ tsā k+ṣaḥ/ bi ma tiḥ⑧/ a nu na yaḥ/ kā ma rā gaḥ⑨/bcas pa/ yid 'byung ba/ som nyi'am dem nur/ yid gnyis/ rjes su chags pa/ 'dod pa la 'dod chags/bha ba rā gaḥ/ saṃ yo dza dz+wa/ brnya dz+wa/ a nu sha yaḥ/ parlubye rna/srid pa'i 'dod chags/ kun du sbyor ba/ 'ching ba / bag la nyal dang phra rgyas skabs dang sbyar/ kun nas ldang ba/u pa kle shaḥ/ par+ya bas+thā rna/ par+ya ba nar+ghaṃ⑩/ ā shra baḥ/ o ghaḥ/ yo gaḥ/ u pā dā rgo/nye ba'i nyon mongs pa/ kun nas dkris pa/ yongs su dkris pa/ zag pa/ chu bo/ sbyor ba/ nye bar len pa/gran+d+raḥ| ni ⑪ba ra rde⑫/ kā ma pra ti saṃ yuk+to/ rū pa pra ti saṃ yuk+to/ ā rū pya pra ti saṃ yus+t+waṃ/mdud pa/ sgrib pa/ 'dod pa dang ldan pa/ gzugs dang ldan pa/ gzugs med pa dang ldan pa/dar+sha na bra ⑫hā ta bye/ bhā pa na pra hā ta bye/ kā māp+taḥ/ kā ma ⑫dhā tu (9parlu parjaḥ/mthong bas spang bar bya ba/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba(9/ 'dod par bsdus pa/ 'dod pa'i khams su gtogs pa/kā mā ba tsa raḥ/ udz+nya ⑩bhā gī yaḥ/ a pa ⑫ra bhā gī yaḥ/ aṅga rde/ 'dod pa na spyod pa/ gong ma'i cha dang mthun pa/ tha ma'i cha dang mthun pa/ nyon mongs pa'i ming ste 'dom na skor ba/sa ra ṇi/ a haṃ kā raḥ/ ma ma kā raḥ/ dīspyo nu pa ri baṭī/ston mongs pa dang bcas pa/ ngar 'dzin pa'am nga rgyal/ bdag gir 'dzin pa/ ring du rjes su 'brang ba/115—83

sa dā nu brnyo bha ba ①ti/ pra ti sarnyi②ཿ/ saṃ sā raḥ/ sarnyiswāsdo ti①/rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur/ nying mtshams sbyor ba/ 'khor ba/ 'brel par byed pa/sa ma nu brnyaḥ/ tsit+ta nu pa ri baṭī/ a nu sa hi taiḥ0/ sa ma gra sā ma ⑤shrī/rjorjes su 'brang ba⑦/ sems kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ rjes su 'brel pa/ 'du ba tshogs pa/pra ti ⑧sasba dhā ⑨ti/ a pra ti sarnyiḥ()/ a nu pat+t+waṃ rna/ san+d+ra na baṭī/nying mtshams sbyor ba'am 'brel bar byed pa/ mtshams sbyor ba med pa/ rjes su 'jug pa/ rgyu la ⑩'bras bu yod pa/snye rgyud la yod pa skad dod dang 'di 'grig kyang don thob kyis dmyus bzhin 'gyur bcos pa'ang mtshar/ā nuts+tsha bi kaḥ/ a nu sarnyiḥ/ sā nu tsā ⑩raḥ/ pra bā ha⑫ཿ/ a nu brnyaḥ/'phrod pa'am 'byor pa/ mtshams sbyor ba/ 'khor dang bcas pa/ rgyun/ rgyun chags pa/a dza srapothoste/ a nu ga taḥ/ a byu tā spyobhā baḥ/rgyun mi 'chad pa'am ⑩khor mor⑩/ rjes su song ba'am rjes su ⑫zhugs pa'am rjes su mthun pa/ ma byung ba las byung ba/ya thā yo gi/ a saṃ skṛ haṃ/ pra ti saṃ khyu ni ro dhaḥ/ a pra ti saṃ khyu ni ro ()dhaḥ/ci rigs ⑫par/ 'dus ma byas/ so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa/ so sor brtags pa ma yin pa'i 'gog pa/sum̐ ⑪skṛ taḥ/ sā sa ⑫baḥ/ a nā sra baḥ//'dus byas/ zag pa dang bcas pa/ zag pa med pa/chags pa dang zhen pa'i rnam pa'i ming la/rak+taḥ/ sak+taḥ/ kṛ ⑫snyaḥ/ gro thi lta/ rūṭī ⑫te/ a rgya ⑫ba si taḥ/chags pa/ zhen pa/ chums pa'am ⑪mkhron pa/ mdud pa bor ba/ brgyal ba/ lhag par chags pa/a dh+ya ba sā na mā pan+da⑩ཿ/ a bya ⑫ba sā rgo/ bi ni brnyi/ pa ri gre ⑥dhaḥ/ saṃ rā gaḥ/lhag par chags par gyur pa/ lhag par zhen pa/ rnam par bcings pa/ yongs su zhen pa/ kun du 'dod chags/115—84

lo lu paḥ①/ ghasma ②raḥ/ laspa ṭaḥ①/ lubharjoḥ/ saṃ rak+taḥ/ rañdza rtswa ⑤yaḥ/bskam dupa/ sto che ba'am za phod pa/ dad che ba'am sto che ba/ brkam chags/ kun du chags/ chags pa 'gyur ba⑦/bhū ya sku ma tā⑧/ yā dṛstso ⑨kaḥ/ its+tsharnyi kaḥ/yang 'dod pa'am phyir zhing 'dod pa'am mang du 'dod pa'am 'dod pa⑪ / 'dod rgyal/ 'dod chen/bhū yats+tshan+di kaḥthospe/ bhū yo ru tsi tā/ bhū yophobhi ()s+thā yaḥ/phyir zhing sred pa'am phyir zhing 'dun pa/ phyir zhing dad che ba/ phyir zhing sems pa'am mang du sems pa/swā du kā ma tā/ bi tsi tā hā ⑫ra tā/ ne+e ta re ta re ṇa san+tuṣ+ṭiḥspyo/ natwe rā gaḥ/myang bar 'dod pa'am ⑫zhim por 'dod pa/ zas 'dam pa/ ngan ngon gyis chog mi shes pa/ dga' ba'i 'dod chags/kā ma ts+tshan+daḥ⑫/ a bhi ni be+e shaḥ/ ā s+thā/ z-i hā/'dod pa la 'dun pa/ mngon par zhen pa/ chags pa'am zhen pa/ 'dod pa'am re ba'am dga' ba⑩/ro tsa naḥ⑫/ i ts+tsharnyi kaḥ/ yā dṛstso kaḥ/⑪ tī bre ṇats+tshan+de na ༷ / ā hā re kṛrnyirja ba ⑪'dod pa'am sred pa/ 'dod chen pa/ 'dod rgyal ba/ 'dun pa drag pos()/ kha zas la brkam par tiḥske/ gā ⑫5mra//'gyur/ zhen pa/sdug bsngal gsum gyi ming la/duḥkha ④duḥkha tā/ saṃ sku ra duḥkha tā/ bi ba ⑫ri shā ma duḥkha tā//sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/sdug bsngal brgyad kyi ming la/dzā ti duḥkhaṃ/ dza rā duḥkhaṃ/ byā dhi duḥkhaṃ/ ma ra ṇa duḥkhaṃ/ pri ya bi ⑪pra skye ba'i sdug bsngal/ rga ba'i sdug bsngal/ na ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal/ sdug pa dang 115—85

yo go ①duḥkhaṃ/ a pri ya saṃ pra yo go duḥkhaṃ/ ya da spruts+tsha ②pabyu ṣa mā kho na la bha te ta bral ba'i sdug bsngal/ mi sdug pa dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal/ gang 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed par ④de da pi duḥkhaṃ/ saṃ k+ṣe pe ṇa pastso pā dā na skan+dha duḥkhaṃ//yang sdug bsngal/ mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga ⑦sdug bsngal⑤/rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis kyi ming la/a bibyā/ saṃ s+thā raḥ/ bi dz+nyā rgorjo/ nā stim rū paṃ/ ṣa ḍā ⑧ya ta rgo/ spar+shaḥ⑨/ma rig pa/ 'du byed/ rnam par shes pa/ ming dang gzugs/ skye mched drug /reg pa/be da nā/ tri:⑪ / u pā dā rgo/ bha baḥ/ dzā ⑪tiḥ/ dza rā ma ra r+ṇa/ sho kaḥ/ pa ri de baḥ/tshor ba/ sred pa/ len pa/ srid pa/ skye ba/ rga shi/ mya ngan / smre sngags 'don pa/duḥkhaṃ—/ dorma na sum̐⑫/ u pā yā saḥ⑫//sdug bsngal ba/ yid mi bde ba/ 'khrug pa/rgyu drug gi ming la/kā ra ṇa te tuḥ/ sa hā bhū he tuḥ/ bi pā ka te tuḥ/ saspra yuk+ta ka he tuḥ/byed pa'i rgyu/ lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu/ rnam par smin pa'i rgyu/ mtshungs par ldan pa'i rgyu/sarba tra ga he tuḥ/ sa ma bhā ga he tuḥ//kun du 'gro ba'i rgyu/ skal ba mnyam pa'i rgyu/rkyen bzhi'i ming la/te tu pra t+ya yaḥ/ sa ma nan+ta ra pra t+ya yaḥ/ ā lo ba na pra t+ya yaḥ/ a rnyi pa ti pra t+ya yaḥ//rgyu'i rkyen/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen/ dmigs pa'i rkyen/ bdag po'i rkyen/115—86

'bras bu lnga'i ming la/ni 6n+da pha ①lo/ a dhi pa ti pha ①lo/ pu ru ṣa kā ①ra rgyun mthun pa'i 'bras bu/ bdag po'i 'bras bu/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu skabs gzhan du skyes bu'i pha tsho'i/ bi // ka pha 76/ bi // myos ga pha ④7///mthur yang gdags/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu⑤/ bral ba'i 'bras bu/skye gnas bzhi'i ming la/dzā rā yu dzā/ aṇ+ḍa dzā/ saṃ swe da dzā/ u pa pā du kā//mngal nas skye ba/ sgo nga las skye ba/ drod gsher las skye ba/ rdzus rjote skye ba/zas bzhi'i ming la/ka ba ti kā hā raḥ⑦/ spar+ṣa hā raḥ/ ma na saṃ tse ta khrunā hā raḥ⑨/ bi 1 na mā hā raḥ⑩//kham gyi zas/ reg pa'i zas/ yid la sems pa'i zas/ rnam par shes pa'i zas/sems can gyi gnas dgu'i ming la/na ba sa tā bā sāḥ⑪/ nā nā twa kā yāḥ/ nā nā twa saṃ rnyi naḥ/ tar+ya thā ma nu byā sems can gyi gnas dgu/ lus tha dad cing / 'du shes tha dad pa dag /dper na mi rnams dang lha e ka kyubyu de bāḥ/ nā nā twa ka ⑫yāḥ/ e ka twa saṃ rnyi ⑫naḥ/ tar+ya thā de ba brah+ma kā kha cig go/ /lus tha dad la/ 'du shes gcig pa dag /dper na tshangs ris tsu)kyi lha dag 115—87

yi kāḥpra tha mā rnyi nidṛt+tha/ e ka twa kā yāḥ①/ nā nā twa saṃ rnyi ⑤naḥ/ tar+ya thā ā bhā dang por 'byung ba'o/ /lus gcig la/ 'du shes tha dad pa dag /dper na 'od gsal ba rnams swa rāḥ④/ e ka butwa kā yāḥ/ e ka ⑤twa saṃ rnyi naḥ/ tar+ya thā de bā shu bha kṛsgyuḥ/ ā so—/ /lus gcig la/ 'du shes gcig pa dag /dper na dge rgyas kyi lha rnams so/ /nam mkha' kā shā nadh+yā ya ta ⑥rna/ bi dz+nyā nā nasgyu ya ④rgo/ ā kiñtsa t+yā ya ta rgo/ nai ba saṃ ⑧dz+nyā nā mtha' yas skye mched/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched/ 'du shes med 'du shes saṃ ⑨dz+nyā ya ta rgo/ a saṃ rnyi ⑩sa tā//med min gyi ⑩skye mched/ 'du shes med pa'i sems can/mi khom pa brgyad kyi ming la/aṣ+ṭa bak+ṣa ṇaḥ()/ na ra kā/ tir+yañtsaḥtsu)/ pre tā/ dīspyo yu kho de bā/mi khom phostebargyad/ sems can dmyal ba/ dud 'gro/ yi dwags/ lha tshe ring po/pra t+yan+ta dza na pa rda/ idz+re skeya bai ka lhi/ me ⑩byā dar+sha rgo/ ta thā ga tā nā ma nut+pā rda/ /mtha' 'khob kyi mi/ dbang po ma tshang ba/ log par lta ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa ma byung ba/las kyi rnam par smin pa la sogs pa'i ming la/dṛṣ+ṭi ⑩dharma be+e da nī yi/ u pa pa r+ya be+e da nī yo/ a pa ra brlu ⑫ya mthong ba'i chos la stsong bar 'gyur ba/ skyes nas myong bar 'gyur ba/ lan grangs gzhan la myong be+e da nī yo/ ni ya ta be+e da nī yo/ a ni ya ta be+e da nī yi/ karma swa kaḥ/bar 'gyur ba/ spyong bar 'gyur bar nges pa/ myong bar 'gyur bar ma nges pa/ las bdag gir bya ba/115—88

karma dā ya daḥ/ kan+d+ra ①yo niḥ/ karma pra (kyeti sa ra ṇamra①/ pra yo gaḥ/ mo bulo/las kyi bgo skal duspyod pa/ las kyi skye gnas pa/ las brten par bya ba/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhirjo/thraṭaṃ⑦—/ ā ⑧se bi tai/ bhā bi haṃ/ ba hu lī ⑨kṛ tai//'jug /bsten ⑩pa'am bsnyen pa/ bsgom pa'am goms par byas pa/ lan mang du byas pa/mtshalas med lnga'i ming la/mā tre ⑪ghā taḥ⑫/ artabi dhaḥ/ pi ⑫/ dṛ ghā taḥ/ sat+ta bhe daḥ/ma bsad pa/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa/ pha bsad pa/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa/ta thā ga ta myurnyi ke duṣ+ṭa tsit+ta ru dhi rot+pā da māṃ//de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba/mtshalas med pa dang nye ba lnga'i ming la/mā tu ra haṃ dh+yā du ⑫ṣa r+ṇa/ ni ya ta byu ⑫mi sbi ta gya bo dhi sa twa su mā ra r+ṇa/ma dgra bcom ma sun phyung ba/ byang chub sems dpa' nges pa'i sa la gnas pa bsad pa/shi ⑩k+ṣa su mā ra r+ṇa/ saṃ ghā ya dār+ya ha ra rde/ s+t+ra pa bhe da rgo//slob pa bsad pa/ dge 'dun gyi 'du ba'i sgo phrog ⑩pa/ mchod rten 'jig pa/snyigs ma lnga'i ming la/ā yuska ṣā ⑫yaḥ/ dṛji ka ṣā yaḥ/ klesha ka ṣā yaḥ/ sa twa ka tu)ṣā yaḥ/tshe'i snyigs ma/ lta ba'i snyigs ma/ nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma/ sems can gyi snyigs ma/kalpa ka ṣā yaḥ//dus kyi snyigs ma/115—89

lnga bhaḥ/ a lā bhaḥ/ ya shaḥ/ a ya shaḥ/ nin+d+ra①/ pra shaṃ sa①ཿ/ su khaṃ/ duḥkhaṃ//rnyed pa/ ma rnyed pa/ snyan pa/ mi snyan pa/ smad pa/ bstod pa/ bde ba/ sdug bsngal/yon tan sna tshogs kyi ming la/dharmādz+re kaḥ/ bo dhi tsiṭ+wā ① saspra mo ṣaḥ/ a ni shri taḥ/chos don du gnyer ba'am chos 'dod pa/ byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa/ mi gnas pa'am mi brten pa/ā dā rā bye mut+ta kaḥ/ ā tsā ④ra shī laḥ/ ā tsā ⑤ra sbaḥ/ kṛ ta be+e dī⑥ / kṛ ta dzha⑦ཿ/rgya chen po la mos pa/ cho ga'i ngang tshul can/ cho ga la gnas pa/ byas pa tshor ba/ byas pa gzo ba/ā dz+nyā ka raḥ/ su kha saṃ bā saḥ/ sru sker taḥ/ bai sa laḥ/ ṛ dzu tsit+taḥ/bka' bzhin byed pa/ 'grogs na bde ba⑨/ nges pa/ nges pa'am gya nom pa/ sems drang po/ārdza baḥ/ mārda ⑩baḥ/ pra dak+ṣi ṇa gā tī⑪/ su ba tsā⑩/ pra ti ts+tshan+da ka lnga ṇaḥ/ alpaka ra hā yaḥ/gnam po/ mnyen pa/ mthun par 'dzin pa/ bka' blo bde ba/ dge ba mi choms pa/ byed pa nyung ba/alpa kṛt+pa⑫ཿ/ astets+tshaḥ/ ār+ya baṃ sha san+tuṣ+ṭaḥ④/ dharma spyolā bha san+tuṣ+ṭaḥ/bya ba nyung ba/ 'dod pa chung ba/ 'phags pa'i rigs kyis chog shes pa/ chos kyi rnyed pas chog par 'dzin pa/ṭī ba ra san+tuṣ+ṭaḥ/ piṇ+ḍa pā tra san+tuṣ+ṭaḥ/ sha ya nā sa na san+tuṣ+ṭaḥ/ su po ṣa tā ⑩/gos kyis chog par 'dzin panyu 7/ bsod snyoms kyis chog shes pa/ mal stan ⑫gyis chog shes pa/ gso sla ba/su bha ra tā/ nan+da ⑪bhā ṣ+yo ④bha ba ti/ na tsa pa re ṣ+pe do ṣān+ta raslu li ta ga be+e ṣ+pe/dgang sla ba/ nyung ngu smra ba yin/ gzhan dag nyes pa'i skabs dang 'khrul pa mi tshol(spe/ka s+thā ṇa 3mi tre 3ṇa ba ri kṛ tī taḥ/ ba hu shu taḥ/ e ④gi ta snyoḥ⑫/ su pra dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa/ mang du thos pa/ zur tsam gyis go ba/ legs par sad pa'am 115—90

burtseḥ① —/ ut+ta spyi ta dzha⑤ ཿ/ bi paspyo ta dzha①ཿ/ su shu taḥ/legs par khong du chud pa/ mgo smos pas go ba/ rnam par spros pas go ba'am zhib tu bshad na go ba/ legs par mnyan pa/de sha dzharjoḥ/ lo ka dzha⑤ཿ/ āt+ma dzhaXḥ/ kā la dzha⑦ཿ/ be la dzha⑧ཿ/ sa ma ya snyo⑨ཿ/yul shes pa/ 'jig rten shes pa/ bdag shes pa/ dus shes pa/ tshod shes pa/ dus min shes pa/mā tra dzha⑩ཿ/ ā rā ga ya ti⑪/ na bi rā ga ya nyi⑫/ a pa ra pra t+ya yaḥ/drod rig pa'am tshod shes pa/ mnyes par byed/ thugs dbyung bar mi byed/ gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa/a pa rā dhī naḥ/ a pa ra pra ṇi yaḥ/ a na n+ya ne+e yaḥ/gzhan la rag ma las pa/ gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa/ gzhan gyis mi dkri ba'am gzhan gyis kha drang du mi rung ba/bi kra rmā/ bī raḥ/ shu ⑫raḥ/ bi hā ya sa gā m+bi/ pā sā di kaḥ/rtsal chen po⑫/ dpa' ba'am rtul ⑫phod pa/ dpa' bo/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ tshul du shis pa'am mdzes pa/a ba ga ta z-i ku ṭi kaḥ/ asbyi dro pa tsā ⑩raḥ/ a ⑩mā ya spyobī/ ya spyothā bā dri ta thā kā rī/khro gnyer med pa/ nye bar spyod pa la skyon med pa/ sgyu med pa/ ji skad smras pa bzhin du byed pa/ dṛ bhā ⑫sa mā dā naḥ⑪/ bha ya da:⑫/ ba tsa snga pa ri dzi taḥ/ pa ri dzi taḥ/ su sa māp+ta⑫ཿ/yi dam la brtan pa/ 'jigs par lta ba/ kha ton byang ba/ legs par byang ba/ shin tu rdzogs par byas pa/su sa mā rabhaḥ/ ma na sāphortswa k+ṣi taḥ/ dṛsgyu su pra ti birtseḥ/ bī ta thoṇ+ḍam+bha ⑫legs par brtsams pa/ yid kyis brtag pa/ mthong bas ⑫shin tu rtogs pa/ 'byung ba dang 'jig pa la bā bha be / yā nī kṛ ta ཿ / ba stu kṛ ta ཿ /sred pa dang bral ba/ lam du byas pa'am bgrod par byas pa/ dngos por byas pa'am rten ⑪du byas pa/a nuṣ+ṭṛ taḥ/ sa ma ba harnyi⑩/ ā dhu nā ti/ sarba ka ṣaṭaṃ shā ḍa ⑫ya ti/nan tan du byas pa/ yang dag par 'dzom pa'am ⑥sel ba/ sprug pa/ snyigs ma ⑫thams cad sel ba⑥/115—91

shu byu ṣa mā ṇaḥ/ a nu bi dhī ya mā naḥ/ a nu sru yā/nyan 'dod pa'am gus pa/ bsgo ba bzhin nyan pa'am rjes su 'jug pa/ ma rangs pa med pa'am mi bzod pa med pa①/a nu pā lo bha pre k+ṣi ṇa②ཿ/ a ba hi ta sro ⑦traḥ/ ā ba dzi ④ta mā na saḥ/ dhargo ⑤klan ka mi tshol ba/ rna blags pa/ sems btud pa'am sems bsdus pa/ chos dang ldan zhing dharma labhaḥ / ni kā ma lnga dī/ a kṛts+tsha khā bhā/ a ki sa ra chos kyis ⑥thob pa/ ci 'dod pa bzhin thob pa/ dka' ba med par thob pa/ tshegs med par thob pa'am khā dī4bhe/ ku la byekhye pa tsā ya kaḥ/ shāstuḥshā sa na ka raḥ/ngan ngon ma yin par thob pa/ rigs kyi nang nas rgan rabs la ri mor byed pa/ ston pa'i bstan pa spyod pa/a ni rā kṛ ༄8 to dh+yā yī/ phroṃ ha yi tā shu t+yā bhā rā rde/ swa kārja yo ga ma nu yuk+taḥ/mi gtong bar bsgom pa/ khyim stong pa rgyas par byed pa/ rang gi don sbyor ba la rjes su brtson pa/a mo gha rāṣ+ṭa piṇ+ḍaṃ pa ri byuk+to/ u pa ro dha shī laḥ//yul 'khor gyi bsod snyoms 'bras bu yod par za ba/ ngo mi chod pa'am ngo mi zlog pa/skyon du brtsi ba'i ming la/bi ṣa ma lo bhaḥ⑨/ mi byā dharma ba ⑩ rī taḥ/ ād+moṅkar+ṣa/ pa ra paṃ se kaḥ/mi rigs par chags pa/ chos log pas dkris ⑪pa/ bdag la bstod pa/ gzhan la smod pa/ā r+bha mā ni kaḥ/ ku ṭi la tsit+taḥ/ ṭī ()nā dhi musti kaḥ/ gra hi kaḥ/ kha ṭuṅka(steḥ/mngon pa'i nga rgyal can/ sems gya gyu can/ dman pa la mos pa/ dus po che/ dmu rgod/udha taḥ/ un+da taḥ/ karka shaḥ/ pa ru ṣaḥ/ nī tsa bṛt+t+waṃḥ/rgod pa/ pho che ba'am (stekhengs pa/ brlangs pa'am rtsub pa/ zhe gcod pa'am (nyertsub pa/ dman pa la 'jug pa/lā bhe na lā bha nish+yi ⑪krir+ṣa/ a bhā dza na bhu ta sa twa⑫ཿ/ alba shu taḥ/ a krā h+ma bye/rnyed pas spyornyed par byed 'dod pa/ sems can snod du ma gyur pa/ thos pa nyung ba/ bram zer mi 'dzin pa/115—92

a shra ma bye/ a pi z-i dz+nyā/ a mā tre dz+nyā7 / a dharma ka ( 7maḥ/ pā pa dharmaḥ/dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa/ phar mi 'dzin pa/ mar mi 'dzin pa/ chos ma yin pa 'dod pa/ sdig pa'i chos can/dz+nyā tra kā maḥ/ ba hu kṛh+ye / ba hu ka ra bhā pyayaḥ/ pra dz+nyā dorba lhi kye/ duḥshrī laḥ/ dut+tha dz+nyā ⑦/shes kyi khe 'dod pa/bya ba mang ba/byed pa mang ba/shes rab zhan pa/tshul khrims 'chal pa/shes rab 'chal pa/man+da pra dz+nyā/ dusgo ṣa tā/ dusnya ra tā/ saṃ krirto skyabi ha ra ti(8tre/ ā mi ṣa ki 7kyetsiṅka ⑩te toḥskye /shes rab zhan pa/ gso dka' ba/ dgang dka' ba/ 'dres hūṃ5par gnas pa/ zang zing cung zad kyi phyir/duḥkhru tai/ pa da pa ra maḥ/ a saṃ tshu5 prakra khyu / rgo/ a bhā bi ta kā yaḥ/mnyan nyes pa/ tshig tunyel 'chel pa/ mi gsal ba/ lus ma bsgoms temipa'am lus ma sbyangs pa/pra galhaḥ⑩dhāsnre⑫/ mu spyokha raḥ/ a k+ṣa dhūrtad bheḥ/ ghasma raḥ/ māt+ma raḥ/spyis brtsan ⑩pa'am spyi rtol che ba/ mu cor ⑦ smra ba'am kha drag pa/ rgyan po la dor ba/ lto che ba/ ser sna can/ka da yi/ kha la 0ཿ/ sha ṭhaḥ/ dhūrtaḥ ④bi ṭaḥ/ mā yā bī/ ku ra ku tsi'udam+bhaḥku 3ha rgo/'jungs pa/ mi srun ⑩pa/ g.yo sgyu ⑩can/ g.yo can/ sgyu byed pa/ ngan g.yo'am tshul 'chos pa ngan pa/la ba rgo/ ne+e mit+t+waṃ ( nyeka two/ nai bye shi ka two( bhe/ khā bhe na khā bha nit+pa (pād nā/kha gsag / gzhogs slongs/ ༄spe thob kyis ke )'jal ba/ rnyed pa las rnyed pa sgrub pa/sa twa bi kra yaḥ/ shas+t+ra ⑫bi kra yaḥ/ bi ṣa bi kra yaḥ/ saṃ thus bi kra yaḥ/ ma r+ya bi kra yaḥ/sems can 'tshong ba/ mtshon cha 'tshong ba/ dug 'tshong ba/ sha 'tshong ba chang 'tshong ba/durmad+kuḥ⑪—/ ṣasgo gā nā ma pā ya s+thā nā ni/ ma r+ya pā rgo/ byu pya tai/ bi kā la tsarlu/ gnong mi bskur ba/⑩ longs spyod bri ba'i gnas drug /chang 'thung kyeb/ rgyan po/ mtshan mo 'phyan pa/bā ⑥ba mi tra tā/ sa mā dzā dar+sha zhu rgo/ ā la sri⑪//sdig pa'i grogs po bsten ④pa/ 'dus pa la lta ba/ le lo/115—93

bla na med pa dang mchog tu brtsi ba'i rnam grangs dang dag pa dang grol ba la sogs pa'i ming las bla na med pa dang mchog tu brtsi ba'i rnam grangs kyi ming la/a nut+ta raḥ/ ni rut+ta raḥ/ a nut+ta maḥ/ ut+ta raḥ/ ut+ta maḥ/ dz+reṣ+ṭhaḥ/ sheṣ+ṭhaḥ/bla na med pa/ gong na med pa/ ltag na med pa/ bla ma/ dam pa / thu bo'am rgan rabs①/gtso bo/ba raḥ/ pra ba raḥ/ a graḥ/ bi shiṣ+ṭaḥ/ pra d+mā dz+wa/ pa ra maḥ②/ ut+pa kṛṣ+ṭa②ཿpra kṛṣ+ṭaḥ/rab/ rab mchog /mchog /khyad par du 'phags pa/ gtso bo'am gces pa/ dam pa'am dbyig /mchog tu byung ba/pra bhā taḥ/ a sa maḥ/ a sa ma sa maḥ/ a pra ti sa maḥ/ su byuḥ/ a t+yarnyi④/gya nom pa/ mnyam pa med pa/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa/ zla med pa/ rab tu/ mchog tu/sar+pā kā ra ba ro be ⑤lta/ praṣ+ṭhaḥ//rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/ mchog gam gtso bo/dag pa dang grol ba la sogs pa'i ming la/su ba ri shur+ghaṃ/ tro rjomaṇ+ḍa la pa ri shusgo⑦/ a nu pā dā ya ā shra be bh+yaḥtsija ni bi muthi ni/shin tu yongs su dag pa/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa/ len pa med par zag pa las sems rnam par grol ba/pa ri mo tsa yi ta bye/ pi mu tsu te⑧/ shī tī bha ba ti/ kṛ ta pa ri yongs su thar bar bya ba'am yongs su grol ba/ rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ bsil bar gyur pa/ yongs su sbyang ba byas karmā⑨/ nirlu rde/ nirlu taḥ/ nirlu ti//pa'am ⑩byi dor byas pa/ nges par 'byung ba/ nges par byung ba/ mthar phyin pa'am nges par byung ba/115—94
