spangs pa dang dor ba la sogs pa'i ming la/pra ti ni thra rdzu①/ bārnyi kṛ tai/ sarbo pa dhi pra ti ni sargaḥ/ byatre+e kṛ ④tapo/spangs te/ bsal ba'am sbyangs pa/ phung po kun spangs pa/ mtha' med par byas pa/bi ske ①bha rde④/ riñtsa ti/ stso ri tā/ bā hi tā pā paḥ⑤/rnam par gnon pa'am rnam par sel ba/ 'dor ba'am spong ba/ bor ba'am btang ba/ sdig pa spangs pa'am sbyangs pa/bya ti thrat+taḥ/ pra ti ni mṛ rjodza ti/ pra ti bi ni mṛ dza ti④/ ut+tha bye ti/shin tu 'das pa/ 'dor ba/ 'or cig ⑧gam thong zhig /gtong ba'am 'dor ba/pa ri t+yā gaḥ/ dzā hā ti/ pra ti k+ṣe paḥ/ a pra kar+ṣa rde/ pra ti krādhaḥ/yongs su gtong ba'am 'dor ba/ spong ba'am 'dor ba/ spong ba/ bsal ba/ phyir log pa'am spangs pa/a pa kar+ṣa/ spru na two/ a yo gaḥ/ bi yo gaḥ/ bi saṃ yo gaḥ/ 'bri ba'am ⑨'grib pa/ 'grib pa/ mi ldan pa/ bral ba/ mi ldan pa'am bral ba/bi ble ṣe⑩/ bi gaspyot+pa/ ⑪bi byu tai/bye ba'am bral ba'am gyed pa/ bral bar 'gyur ram med par 'gyur/ bral ba'am zhig pa/arnyasgo ()dz+wa/ a pa krān+ta⑫ཿ/ bi pa ri ṇa tai/ ā shra ya pa rā dṛt+t+waṃ/nub pa'am mi snang ba/ phyir byung ba'am med par gyur pa/ rnam par gyur pa/ gnas gyur pa/pa ri ṇa te/ pa ri 5 ④maḥ/ jo bi tābye pa ro pa yetu/ bar+yā dā skerna gats+tsha tiḥ/yongs su gyur pa/ gyur pa/ srog dang phral/ ma lus pa'am gtan nas sam ⑩rim gyis zad par 'gyur/bi tho)tī dz+wa()/ pa ri bhuk+to/ as+t+waṃ gats+tsha ti/ bi dha ma ti/nyams pa'am ma tshang ba/ yongs su spyad pa'am zos pa/ nub pa'am med pa'am zhig par gyur pa/ sel ba'am 'joms pa/a pa ri bi dwo⑪/ ga rā ⑥ni sru da rgo/ parlu (spred staḥ/ sbri te ra n+ya thā two/bor ba/ 'dod chags sel ba/ bstsal sgo)ba/ gnas pa las gzhan du gyur pa/115byed95

na rā shi bhā baḥ/ pra ①lha gu re/ thraṣ+ṭṛ ②bha ba ti/spungs pa'i dngos po med pa'am phung por gyur pa ma yin pa/ rab tu 'jig pa/ rgyab kyis ④phyogs par 'gyur/ko khā yi ta bye/ uts+tshaṣ+ṭha duti/ bi ti mi ra ka re/ a nu na yālhasamyu ⑤k+ṣa ṇa tā/bstsal rjoba'am bcos ⑦pa/ chad par 'gyur/ rab rib med par byed pa/ rjes su chags pa bdo bar ma byas pa⑧/nirli khi tai/ sa ma bā ⑨harnyi/ su pra k+ṣu li tai/shin tu phyis pa'am bsrabs pa'am bzhar ⑩ba/ yang dag par 'joms pa'am spong ba/ legs par bkrus pa'am bshal ba/su bye tai/ nistsodhe/ bārnyi bhā baḥthospe/ pa ri t+yak+to/ uskṛṭaṃ/sbyangs pa'am dul ba/ btso ma/ bstsal ⑫pa'am skyugs pa/ yongs su spangs pa/ btang ba'am spangs pa'am bor ba/pra t+yā khyu ⑫lta/ 47rdza dz+wa/ sho ka bi no da rna⑫/ bra bi dza ju⑫/ a rna ga ṇaḥ⑩/ ni ha taḥ⑩//phul ba/ gtang ba/ mya ngan bsal ba/ rab tu spangs pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ bcom pa/bstod pa dang smad pa dang grags pa'i rnam grangs kyi ming la/tīt+t+waṃḥ⑫/ pra shaṃ sā/ ya shaḥ/ stu ti/ sto ṣi tai/grags pa'am brngod pa/ rab tu bsngags pa/ snyan pa'am grags pa/ bstod pa/ bkur ba ma 'dom na bstod pa/pra shaṃ si taḥ/ baṇi ⑪taḥ/ shajaḥ/ sh+lau kaḥ⑩/ baṇ+ḍiḥ/rab tu bstod pa/ bsngags pa/ sgra/ tshigs su bcad pa/ bsngags pa'am snyan par brjod pa/pan+ni taḥ/ a bhi nan+di ta ya shaḥ/ bhū sgospeta baṇ+ḍi nirtswa ra ya ti/ pra sirnyaḥ/bsngags pa/ mngon par bstod pa'i grags pa/ yang dag pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa/ rab tu grub pa'am grags pa/pra thi taḥ⑫/ pra tī taḥ/ a ⑫nu shaṃ sā/ a brje⑫/gsal bar grags pa/ kun la grags pa/sra ⑫sirnya dang ma 'dom na grags par gdags/ phan yon/mi snyan par brjod pa/115—96

do ṣaḥ①/ bhaṇ+ḍa rgo/ paṃ sa rgo/ nin+d+ra/ dzu ① gus+thā/ bi garta/skyon nam nyes pa/ 'tshang 'bru ba/ bshung ba'am smad pa/ smad pa/ skyon du bgrang ba/ dgongs pa'am smad pa/kut+ma rna/ a ba sā daḥ/ a ba saṃ gya ti/ bi mā na ya ti/ pa rā 3bha baḥ/ kut+pa — yo/ngan par rtsi rjob/ smad pa'am spyo ba/ smod par byed/ khyad du gsod par byed/ brnyas pa/ smad khyepar bya ba/a ba dh+yā ⑥yarnyi/ k+ṣi parnyi/ bi bā tsa rteyi ti/ pa ri bhā ṣā//smod pa'am 'phya ba/ gzhog 'phyas sdezer/ kha zer/ spyo ba 'am brgyad 17pa/mthun pa dang mi mthun pa la sogs pa'i ming la/a nu kyu laḥ/ pra ti kyu lo/ pra ti lo maḥ/ a nu lo maḥ/mthun pa/ mi mthun pa/ rjes su mi mthun pa'am lugs su mi 'byung ba/rjes su mthun pa'am lugs su 'byung ba/a nu sro to gā m+bi/ pra te () sro to gā m+bi/ byaste/ sa maste/'bab phyogs su 'gro ba/ chu'i bzlog phyogs su 'gro ba/ so so'am re re/ bsdus pa'am mtha' dag/ā yaḥ/ durla bhaḥ/ su la bhaḥ/ a be+e mā tram̐/'byung ba'am 'du ba/ rnyed par dka' ba'am dkon pa/ chu'i rnyed be+e ba'am mod pa/ che ba'am rab/ mā bye⑪/ mṛ duḥ⑫/ su sā :/ duḥspyosā bye⑩/ ā ram̐/ pā ram̐6/ pra brta rna/'bring / chung ngu'am tha ma/ sgrub ⑪sla ba/ sgrub dka' ba/ tshu rol/ pha rol/ 'jug pa/ni brta rgo/ a badha muk+to⑩/ ni miñtsi tai/ utho dzi tai/ saspra khyu rgo/bzlog pa/ ma bcings ma grol/ btsums pa/ phye ba / shin tu gsal ba'am shin tu dran pa/a saspra khyu rgo/ a nu gu bye⑫/ a nu bā ta⑪ཿ/ pra ti bā taḥ/ sa ma nu pa byu ti/shin tu gsal ba'am shin tu dran pa/ rjes su mthun pa/ rdzi phyogs/ rdzi phyogs ma yin pa/ rjes su mthong /115—97

na sa na ①nu ba ①byu ti/ a nu lo mi kri//rjes su mi mthong / mthun pa/che chung dang mtho dman la sogs pa'i ming la/ā yā oṃ① / bi skaste ṇa / bi stu ram̐④ / der+ghaṃ / ā ro mchur/ zheng du'am sboms su'am ⑤zabs su/ zheng du'am rgyar/ srid du/ mchu dang zheng ha pa ri ṇa ha saṃ pan+daḥ/ ā ro haḥ/ pa ri rja haḥ/ ā ro ha pa ri ṇa ⑥haḥ/ saṃ par+ghaṃ⑦/du ldan pa/ 'khrun tam 'phang ⑧ngam srid/ zheng ngam sboms sam kho lag /chu zheng gab pa/ phun sum tshogs pa/bi s+t+riṇ+ḍaṃ⑨ / u dā raḥ/ bi shā lo/ bi bu lo/ o dā ri shaṃ/rgya che ba/ rlabs po che'am rgya che ba/ yangs pa/ rgyas pa'am yangs pa/ rigs hu )pa'am che long /thra thu/ adze+e(7/ alpa ta ram̐/ alpa ta rmalhaste/ ba hu ta ram̐/ byu yiṣ+pe/ ma yangs pa'am rgya che ba/ chung ba/ ches chung ba/ chung ches pa/ ches mang / mang po pa chen hat+ta (sprerma/ i twa ram̐/ lu haḥ/ a ba ba ra ka /bor+pā ⑫pazlo/ a pūrba ma tsa ra mo/ srukhye/po pa/ ngan pa'am tha ma/ ngan pa/ ngan ngon/ snga phyi/ snga phyi med/ phra mo'am zhib mo/sna lo/ daṭ+wāṃ/ a da rja/ 0zla la ni kyu lo//sbom ④pa'am rags pa/ nyung ba'am chung ba/ mi nyung ba'am mi chung ba/ shang shong ngam 'bar 'bur ram mtho dman/bshes pa'i rim pa dang phas kyi rgol ba la sogs pa'i ming la/ā lap+ta kaḥ/ sa ⑩lap+ta kaḥ/ sastu ta kaḥ/ sa bre ⑩ma kaḥ/ bre ⑪maḥ/gtam 'dres pa/ phebs par smra ba/ smod 'drin/ 'grogs bshes/ byams pa'am mdza' 'am sdug pa 115—98

āste①—/ bi shwasta mā na saṃ②/ saṃ ①hā yī bhā baṃ ga ts+tsha ti/ kārnya④/ pri yā/gcugs ⑤pa'am yid brtan rjopa/ yid brtan pa'am yi gcugs ⑦grogs su 'gyur/ sdug pa/ phongs pa'am sdug pa/pra ṇa yaḥ⑧/ pa ra ma ma no snyo⑨ཿ/ mi tram̐/ su dz+dzatu/ z-i bye/ e ⑩mi tram̐/mdza' gcugs ⑪pa/mchog tu yid 'thad pa/mdza' bo/mdza' bo'am ⑫snyir sdug/snying sdug⑫ /mi mdza' ba/pra t+ya mi traḥ/ ku mi traḥ/ pa ra pra bā dī/ pra t+yabe+e ⑫kaḥ/ pra t+ya nī spyokaḥ/ pa ra tsakre/dgra bo/ bshes gnyen ngan pa/ phas kyi rgol ba/ phyir rgol ba/ phas kyi dgra/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs/bai ⑩rī/ sha rgyu⑩/ ku sa hā yaḥ//sha khon nam mkhon yod pa/ dgra/ grogs ngan pa/dge ba dang shis pa'i ming la/ā shrīr+pā daḥ/ ā shi shaḥ/ baṇ+ḍi bā dī/ shrīḥ()/ lasmroḥ()/shis par brjod pa/ legs su smon pa/ bsngags pa smra ba/ dpal lam g.yang / dpal lam shis pa/oṃ ⑩ga lo/ ku tū ha lo⑪/ pra ⑫shastaḥ/ swa snya/ swasgyu ya rgo/bkra shis sam ltas/ dge mtshan nam ltad mo/ dge shis/ dge legs sam dge ba/ dge legs su 'gyur ba/sau ⑫ba ste kaḥ/ ka spyo rde⑫/ shārgyu⑫/ ku sha lo/ she yāmra/bde legs brjod pa/ dge legs sam dge ba/ legs pa/ dge mkhas bde ba skabs dang sbyar/ mchog tu bkrabs pa/dz+re yānu/ swa dhā/ ba ṣaṭu/ oṃ/ swā hā//mchog tu btu ba/ gzhi srung ⑪/ gzhi mi 'grib pa/ rab bsngags/ gzhi tshugs/chos smra ba dang nyan pa dang sgra skad kyi ming la/pra be+e tā/ a bi pa ri ta mārga de shi kaḥ/ saṃ gī ti kā raḥ/ dharma ka thi kaḥ/byed pa'am ston pa/ lam ma nor bar ston pa/ yang dag par sdud ⑫par byed pa/ chos sgrog ⑫pa/115—99

dharma bhā ṇa kaḥ/ dar+sha yi tā/ sho tā/ bhā ṣa te dzalpa ti/ la pa ti/chos smra ba/ ston par byed pa'am mthong bar byed pa/ nyan pa/ smra ba'am brjod pa/ smras pa'am brngod pa/de ①sha ya ti/ ut+tha bhā ka ri 6 ti/ srus+t+waṃ/ su bhā ṣi taphra/ su byā ston pa/ gsal bar byed pa / legs par bshad pa / gsungs pa'am legs par smra ba/ gsungs pa'am khyu tai/ bya ⑤ba hā raḥ/ saṃ ke taḥ/ uji sha ti/ u pa di sha ti/ u dī ra ya ti/legs par smras pa/ tha snyad/ brda/ lung nod pa'am 'bogs 1pa/ lung 'bogs pa/ smra ba'am brjod pa/saṃ pra kā sha ya ti/ pra ti man+d+ra yi ta bye/ ujiṭaṃ/ ā tsabhe④ / prak+ṣu ⑤bha r+ṇa/yang dag par rab tu ston pa/ be+er smra bar bya ba/ brjod pa'am ston pa'am smras pa/ smra bo/ byugs pa/swa re shā rnyi bi dz+nyā ba ya ti/ ki li ki 'gra yi tai/ ka la ka laḥ/ a shrī lo/ sgo ṭaṃ tsa/sgras mngon par go bar byed pa/ dar dir ku co ca co/ ca co/ tshig dor ba'am mi gshe ba/ sgra gsal ba/ko lā ha laḥ⑦/ ka la swa raḥ/ e ka ba tsa no dā hā 5re ṇa⑫ / a la ma ne+e na bi bā ⑩de na/ku co/ skad snyan/ tshig gcig brjod pas⑪/ brtsad pa 'dis ci zhig bya zhe'am brtsad pa 'di thong /bi ṣa molhaya ()mu pa t+yā saḥ/ a bhi la pa na tā/ pra kyu dī ra ya ti/bzhag pa'am/ smras pa 'di ni mi mthun pa'o/ /mngon par brjod pa/ slar smra ba'am slar zlos ⑫pa/pra kyudz+nyā raḥ/ uṭ+wā sha nā shaja45ཿ/ hā hā kā kṛster ki li ki khā pak+ṣe slar gsungs pa/ gsung bstsal ⑩ba'am skad bstsal ⑩ba/ a la la zhes ca co dang ga zha'i sgra pra k+ṣe ḍi steḍi ta shaja()ཿ/ ats+tsha ṭā shajaḥ/ ā biska ra r+ṇa/ pra t+yā khyu rgo/ bya kha cig tu 'ur ④ sgrar yang gdags/ se gol gyi sgra/ 'chags dupa'am smra ba/ 'bul ba'am spong ba/ brjod ba ⑫de shaḥ/ bā tso yut+taḥ ⑦/ tso da ya ti/ po ④rī/pa'am snyad 'dogs pa'am lce rten/ smra ba'i tshul/ bskul ba'am rtsod mepa/ pho brang 'khor gyi skad dam 'khor du grags pa/115—100

sāṅka bye/ ā de ya bā kyi①/ ma dhu raḥswa raḥ//'be+el ba'i gtam/ tshig gzung ba'am btsun pa/ sgra mnyen pa'am snyan pa/sgyu ma la sogs pa'i dpe'i ming la/mā yā/ nirmi taḥ/ u da ka tsan+d+raḥ/ a k+ṣi pu ru ṣaḥ/ ma rī tsi/ mṛ ga sgyu ma/ sprul pa/ chu zla/ mig gi skyes bu/ smig rgyu/ ma ri tsi dang ma 'dom z-iṣ+ṭi kā/ ma ru ma rī tsi kā②/ gan+dharba na ga ram̐/ pra ti bim+bi/ pra ti bhā saḥ/na smig 1rgyu 'dom na ri dwags skom/ mya ngam gyi smig rgyu/ dri za'i grong khyer/ gzugs brnyan/ mig yor/swasnaphra—/ pra ti shud+ku/ pra ④ti shabhāphya/ budru daḥ 'u/rmi lam/ brag ca/ brag ca'i ming ste pra ti shu tu tra kye ka dang 'dom na sgra brnyan du gdags/ chu'i chu bur/ka da lī skarnyaḥ⑤/ a ba shā ya bin+d+raḥ⑨/ in+d+ra rtse bhedzā lo/ ban+dha 17bu traḥ/ kha puṣ+pe/chu shing gi phung po/ zil ba'i thigs tugepa/ mig 'phrul/ mo gsham gyi bu/ nam mkha'i me togakṛge /rik+ta muṣ+ṭiḥ⑫/ a lā ta tsakre/ arta ṭa gha ṭi tsakre/ khe ṭa 6piṇ+ḍaḥ/ phan ⑩biṇ+ḍaḥ/chad pa stong pa/ mgal me'i 'khor lo/ zo chu na rgyud pa'i 'khor lo/ mchil ma'i thal ba/ be+e ba rdos pa 4 bhe/ ka shoṇ+ḍa spyoka/ na ṭa raṅgaḥ⑪/ tū la pi tsuḥ pya / u dā ha ra rte/skra shad 'dzings pa( tre/ gar gyi ltad mo pa/ shing bal gyi 'dab ma/ dper brjod pa( nya/pra kyu dā ha ④ra r+ṇa/ dṛṣ+ṭan+taḥ/ u pa mā//so so'i dper brjod pa/ dbe+e/ dpe'am nye bar 'jal ba/gtong ba dang mchod sbyin byed pa la sogs pa'i ming la/muk+ta t+yā gaḥ( ste/ pra ta ta pā ṇiḥX 5/ bya ba sarga ra taḥ/ yā ya ju ( nyalhug par gtong ba/ lag brkyang ba/ rnam par gtong ba la dga' ba/ mchod sbyin khor mor byed ⑩pa'am sbyin pa mi 115—101

kaḥ / dā ne+e sam+bi sā ①ga ra taḥ/ bi bhā dza te/ sam+bi bhā dza te/ yaṣ+ṭaḥ/'chad par byed pa/ sbyin pa la 'gyed par dga' ba/ 'gyed/ rnam par 'gyed pa/ mchod sbyin byas/su yaṣ+ṭaḥ/ hu tai/ su hu te/ yā ga ma yi/mchod sbyin legs par byas/ sbyin sreg byas/ legs par sbyin sreg byas/ mchod sbyin las byung ba/yā ba da n+ya ta rā ⑤n+ya ta ra pa ri snga re da dā ti①/ pā rna pā nābe+e ④bh+yaḥ/ an+da man+d+rabe+e ⑤bh+yaḥ/yo byad gang yang rung ba'i bar du sbyin par byed/ skom 'dod pa la skom/ zas 'dod pa la zas/pra rjoti saṃ sta re/ de yi/ dā ya kaḥ/ dā na pa tiḥ⑦/ dā tā/ pra ti gā ha kaḥ/so sor 'gyed pa/ sbyin par bya ba/ sbyin pa po/ sbyin bdag /sbyin par byed pa/ len pa/drwa dā ltaske/ krastuḥ⑨/ ni rarga ta ⑩ya dz+nyā/ shārtse ma nu pra dā surnyi/byin ⑪no/ /mchod sbyin/ gtan pa sri ba med pa'i mchod sbyin/ dad pa'i rjes su sbyin par byed pa/pra yats+tsha ti//sbyin par byed pa/phan pa dang phan pa'i rnam pa'i ming la/ti tapo/ āt+ma hi lta/ pa ri ⑫hi tapo/ u pa kā raḥ/ u pa yu bye te/phan pa/ bdag la phan pa/ gzhan la phan pa/ phan gdags pa/ phan 'dogs pa'am ⑫nye bar sbyor ba/pra kyu pa kā ra ṭ+wāṃ ⑫k+ṣu/ a pra kyu pa kā raḥ⑫//lan du phan 'dogs su re ba/ lan du phan 'dogs pa la mi re ba/blo dang bye brag phyed pa'i rnam pa'i ming la/burnyiḥ/ ma tespyoḥ/ ga tiḥ/ ma te/ dṛṭaṃ/ a bhi sa blo/ blo gros / rtogs pa / bye brag byed pa'am rtogs pa/ mthong ba/ mngon par rtogs 115—102

mi tā bī/ samyag ①ba bo dhaḥ/ su pra ti bidhaḥ/pa dang ldan pa/ yang dag par rtogs pa'am ⑤yang dag par khong du chud pa/ legs par rtogs pa/a bhi la k+ṣi taḥ/ ga ti ga taḥ/ a ba bo t+t+waṃ①/mngon par rigs pa'am rjomangon par snang ba'am ngo shes pa/ rtogs par khong du chud pa/ rtogs pa'am khong du chud pa/pra t+yā rjobhi dz+nyā/ me ni re//ngo shes pa/ shes par 'gyurarjo/mkhas pa'i rnam grangs kyi ming la/paṇ+ḍi taḥ/ bi tsak+ṣa ṇaḥ/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzā tre+e yi⑦ / pra bi duṇaḥ/mkhas pa'am mdzangs ⑨pa/ mkhas pa'am ⑩rtogs pa/ mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can/ mkhas pa/ni: ⑪taḥ/ byak+taḥ/ me dh+wa bī/ budhaḥ/ burnyi mān⑫/ pra dz+nyā/ bod+dhā⑫/byang ba/ gsal ba / yid gzhungs pa/ rtogs pa/ blo dang ldan/ shes rab can/ khong du chud pa/pra dz+nyā bān/ bid+mānu⑫/ ni pu ṇaḥ(spre/ bi dzhaḥ4nya/shes rab dang ldan pa/ mkhas pa'am rig ⑩pa/ brtags pa'am rtogs ⑫pa'am mkhas ⑩pa/ mdzangs pa'am dushes pa/ā kṛji mānu/ pa ṭuḥ/ tsa tu ra sraḥ/ dak+ṣaḥ//ldob rkyen pa/ g.yer po/ grims pa/ mkhas pa'am 0shes nyen can/zab pa'i rnam grangs kyi ming la/ga: ro gasbyi ⑫rā ba bhā saḥ/ dudṛ bu shaḥ/ du ra ba bo dhaḥ/ du ra nu bo dhaḥ/zab pa zab par snang ba/ mthong bar dka' ba/ khong du chud par dka' ba/ khong du chud par dka' ba/115—103

srusgra ①ni pu ṇa paṇ+ḍi ta bi snyo ②be+e da nī yaḥ①/ a tarkyaḥ/ a tarka ba tsa raḥ/zhib mor brtags pa'i mkhas pa dang mdzangs 0pas rig pa/ brtag par mi nus pa/ rtog ge'i spyod pa ma yin pa/a ni dar+sha naḥ/ a ba gā haḥ/ shi baḥ/ a pra pañtsaḥ/ niḥpra pañtsaḥ/bstan du med pa/ gting dpag dka' ba/ zhi ba/ spros pa med pa/ spros pa dang bral ba/a bi pra pañtsaḥ/ dube+e gā bye//rnam par spros pa med pa/ rtogs par dka' ba/dga' ba'i rnam grangs kyi ming la/tuṣ+ṭaḥ/ u da graḥ/ āt+ta ma nāḥ/ pra mu di ⑤taḥ/ shrī ti sau dhim na gya dzā taḥ/ tshim pa'am ⑦dga' ba/ mgu ba/ yi rangs pa⑧/ rab tu dga' ba/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes/har+ṣa dzā taḥ/ z-i ṣi ta tsit+taḥ/ pra ⑨mo r+yapo/ san+tuṣ+ṭaḥ/ pa ri to ṣaḥ/ aurnyi ⑩rangs pa skyes/ sems rangs par gyur/ mchog tu dga' ba/ chog shes pa/ yongs su mgu ba/ shin tu l+ya ka rī/ ba hu dza na pri yā⑪/ saṃ rañdza ⑫— yaḥ/dga' bar byed pa/ skye bo mang po dga' ba/ yang dag par sdug par 'gyur ba'am chags par 'gyur ba/sasmo da byā yaḥ/ ā rā dha naḥ/ a bhi rā dha nā/yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba/mgu bar bya ba'am mnyes par bya ba⑫/mngon par mgu ba'am mnyes pa/a bhi nan+da yi byu ti//mngon par dga' bar 'gyur/khro zhing gtum pa'i rnam pa dang gnod pa'i ming la/ro draḥ/ tsaṇ+ḍaḥ/ u graḥthoshe/ hrū raḥ/ duṣ+ṭa tsit+taḥ/zhe gnag pa'am drag pa/ gtum pa/ drag shul can/ ma rungs pa/ sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/115—104

ro dra tsit+taḥ/ pra ti ha ta tsit+ta ཿ/ kha raḥ/ nibyu raḥ/gnod pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ zhe 'gras pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ brlang po/ sri ba med pa/dā ru ṇaḥ / tī praḥ / tsaṇ+ḍa mṛ gaḥ / u pā dro tā raḥ /mi bzad pa/ drag po'am bdo ba/ gcan gzan khro bo/ gnod par byed pa'am brjed pa'am 'tshe ba/a ①nasgo pa sa hi haṃ/ bi he ṭha kāḥ/ ku pi taḥ/ pra ko paḥ/gnod pa dang bcas pa/ 'tshe ba'am co 'dri ba/ 'khrugs ①pa/ 'khrugs pa'am khong nas ldang khyab/ka ṭu kaḥ/ a bhi ṣak+taḥme/ ra bha saḥ skye/ sā ha si kā//spro thung ba/ nang pa/ brtun ngas pa'am gzu tsa lums can/ tsham tshom med pa/gang zag bzhi'i ming la/ta masta ma pa rā ya ṇaḥ⑦/ ta mo dresat+pa rā ya ṇashe/ bye tista ma pa rā ya ṇaḥ kye/mun khrod nas mun khrod du 'gro ba/ mun khrod nas snang bar 'gro ba/ snang ba nas mun khrod du 'gro ba/sbyo/ tirdzo ⑩tit+pa rā ⑪ya ṇaḥ/ /snang ba nas snang bar 'gro ba/tshe 'di dang phyi ma dang 'chi 'pho ba'i rnam pa'i ming la/dṛṣ+ṭi ⑫dharmaḥ/ i ha traḥ/ a mu traḥ/ i ha dzad+maḥ/ ā pa nyartet+t+waṃ/ pā ra dzam+bi ka④ ཿ/mthong ba'i chos/ 'di la/ phyi ma/ tshe 'di(sgo/ phyi ma/ tshe gzhan/dzā ti bya ti thrat+t+waṃ/ sāspa ⑩rā yi kaḥ/ saspa rā yaḥ⑫/ dzā ⑩ti pa ri brtaḥ/tshe 'phos pa'am tshe brjes tho)pa/ tshe phyi ma pa/ tshe phyi ma/ tshe rabs brje ( )ba'am 'pho ba/sgo nyi/ tsu ba rna/ sgro ti sa ⑩kra saṃ//ma 'dom na 'chi 'pho/ 'dom na tsu ba nam ⑤'chi ba/ 'chi ba dang 'pho ba/115—105

dben pa'i rnam pa'i ming la/mādhe sha pyu sa rgo/ mādha ①ba na pra s+thā/ mān+tadhiḥ/ a ra sbya/ kān+ta ram̐/bas mtha'i gnas mal/ nags khrod/ bas mtha'/ dgon pa/ 'brog dgon pa/ba rna/ u ba ba rna//nags sam tshal lam nags tshal/ skyed mos tshal lam nags 'dab/gnas bzhi'i ming la/gārtaspru①ཿ/ prah+ma tsarlu rjoshra maḥ/ bā dun pra sbaḥ/ hai rjokyu kaḥ//khyim na ⑦gnas/ tshangs par spyod pa la gnas/ nags khrod na gnas pa/ spong ba pa⑧/sa g.yos pa'i rnam pa'i ming la/kam+bi taḥ/ pra kam+bi taḥ/ saspra kam+bi taḥ/ tsa li taḥ/ pra tsa li taḥ/ saṃ pra ⑨tsa li taḥ⑩/'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun du rab tu 'gul/ g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos/be dhi taḥ/ pra be+e dhi taḥ/ saṃ pra be dhi taḥ/ kyu bhi taḥ/ pra kyu bhi taḥ/ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun du rab tu ldeg /'khrugs/ rab tu 'khrugs/saṃ pra ⑪gru bhi taḥ/ ra ṇi taḥ/ pra ra ṇi taḥ/ saṃ pra ra ṇi taḥ/ gardzi taḥ/kun du rab tu 'khrugs/ 'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du rab tu 'ur 'ur/ chem chem/pra gardzi taḥ/ saṃ pra gardzi taḥ/ pūr+pā di ga ba na ma ti pa— mā di gun+d+ra ma ti/rab tu chem chem/ kun du rab tu chem chem/ shar phyogs dma' na nub phyogs mtho()/pa— mā di ga ba ṇa ma ti pūr+pā di gun+da ⑫ma ti/ dak+ṣi ṇa di ga ba na ma ti ut+ta rā di gun+da ma ti/nub phyogs dma' na shar phyogs mtho/ lho phyogs dma' na byang phyogs mtho/115—106

ut+ta rā di ga ba na ma ti dak+shi ṇ+ḍa di gun+da ma ti/ an+d+ra da ba na ma ti ma dh+yā dun+da ma ti/byang phyogs dma' na lho phyogs mtho/ mtha' dma' na dbus mtho/ma sgyu da ba na ma ti adhā dun+da ma ①ti/ a pra kabye②//dbus dma' na mtha' mtho/ mi bskyod pa'am mi bsgul ba'am bskyod mi nus pa/'od kyi ming la/pra bhā/ rasmi/ ā ①lo kaḥrjo/ ma rī tsiḥ⑤/ saṃ shuḥ/ te dzaḥ/'od/ 'od zer/ snang ba/ mun sel lam 'od/ 'od dam gsal ba/ 'bar ba'am gzi brjid/dzā laḥ/ byu tiḥ//'bar ba/ gsal ba'am 'od dam zer/stong che chung dang gling bzhi dang khams gsum dang 'jig rten pa'i lha la sogs pa'i ming las/ stong che chung la sogs pa'i ming la/sā ha sra tsu ḍi rjoko lo ka dhā tuḥ/ dī sā ha sro ma dh+ya ⑦mo lo ka dhā tuḥ/ z-i sā stong spyo phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ stong ha sra ma hā sā ha sre ⑤lo ka dh+wa tuḥ//gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams/gling bzhi'i ming la/tsa tudī pa ko stilo ka dhā tuḥ/ pūrba bi de haḥ/ de haḥ/ bi de haḥ/gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ shar gyi lus 'phags/ lus/ lus 'phags/115—107

dzasru ①dī paḥ/ dzam+bu ②ṣaṇ+ḍaḥ/ tsā ma raḥ/ a pa sner tsā ma raḥ/ a pa ④ra go dā bhā yaḥ/'dzam bu gling / dzam bu'i tshal/ rnga yab/ rnga yab gzhan/ nub kyi ba lang spyod/shā dz+re/ ut+ta ra madh+ri ṇaḥ/ ut+ta ra ku ruḥ/ ku ra baḥ/ kau ra baḥ/g.yo ldan/ lam mchog 'gro/ byang gi sgra mi snyan/ sgra mi snyan/ sgra mi snyan gyi zla/lo ka dhā tuḥ/ lu bye ta i ti lo ka⑤ཿ/ lo kān+ta ri karjoḥ/ sarba 'jig rten gyi khams/ 'jig pas na 'jig rten/ 'jig rten gyi bar/ 'jig lo ka dhā tu pra sa raḥ/ burnya bi ṣa yaḥ/ burnya k+ṣe tram̐⑦/ sa hā lo rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad/ sangs rgyas kyi yul/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing / mi mjed kyi ka dhā tuḥ/ a ba mū5ཿ/ bya ba tastaḥ/ tir+yaglo ka jo tuḥ//'jig rten gyi khams/ spyi'u tshugs/ snrel gzhi④/ thad ka ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams/khams gsum pa'i rim pa'i ming la/kā ma dhā tuḥ/ rū pa dh+wa tuḥ/ a rū pa dhā tuḥ//'dod pa'i khams/ gzugs kyi khams/ gzugs med pa'i khams/'dod pa'i khams kyi lha'i ming la/r+bha māḥ/ an+ta ri k+ṣa bā si naḥ/ tsa turma hā rā dza kā yi kā⑨ཿ/ tra ya sto shāḥ⑪/sa bla/ bar snang la gnas pa/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa/yā māḥ/ tu ṣi tāḥ/ nirmā ṇa ra ta yaḥ/ pa ra nirmi ta ba sha brti ⑪naḥ//'thab bral/ dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed/115—108

bsam gtan dang po'i sa'i ming la/brad+ma kā yi kāḥ①/ brad+ma pā ri ṣa t+yāḥ/ brah+pha pu ro hi tāḥ/ ma hā brad+ma ②ṇaḥ//tshangs ris/ tshangs 'khor/ tshangs pa mdun na 'don/ tshangs pa chen po/bsam gtan gnyis pa'i sa'i ming la/pa rīt+tha bhāḥ/ a pra mā ṇa bhāḥ/ a bha ①swa rāḥ//'od chung / tshad med 'od/ 'od gsal/bsam gtan gsum pa'i sa'i ming la/pa rī ta rjoshu bhāḥ/ a pra mā ṇa shu bhāḥ/ shu bha ⑤krosgyuḥ//dge chung / tshad med dge/ dge rgyas/bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sa'i ming la/a na bh+ra kāduḥ/ pu 5 pra sa bāḥ/ bṛ hat+pa ④laḥ//sprin med/ bsod nams skyes/ 'bras bu che/gnas gtsang ma'i sa'i ming la/a dṛ ⑧hāḥ/ a ta pāḥ/ su dṛ shāḥ/ su dar+sha nāḥ/ a ka nijoḥ⑨/mi che/ mi gdung / gya nom snang / shin tu mthong / 'og min namatho )/agha nijoḥ⑪/ ma hā ma te shwa rā ya ta namra⑫//gzugs mtha'/ dbang phyug chen po che ba'i gnas/115—109

gzugs med pa'i sa'i ming la/ā ①kā shā nasgyu ya ta namra/ bi dz+nyā nā nasgyu ya ta naphra/ ā kiñtsa sdet+yā ya ta na ma①/nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched/nai ba saṃ dz+nyā nā saṃ dz+nyā ya ta naphra④//'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched/'jig rten pa'i lha'i ming la/brad+mā/ ha ⑤ra 5 gar+bhaḥ/ brad+mā sa hādza tiḥrjo/ a shī ni ku mā ro⑦/tshangs pa/ dbyig gi snying po/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa/ tha skar gzhon nu/ma he shwa raḥ/ ma hā de baḥ/ shasnaḥ⑧/ pa shu pa tiḥ⑨/ dṛ pu ra bi— ⑩sa kaḥ/dbang phyug chen po/ lha chen po/ bde 'byung / phyugs bdag /sum brtsegs ⑪'jig byed/shu la pā ṇiḥ⑫/ ju mu kaḥ/ shaṃ ka raḥ/ sma ⑫ra sha tru⑫ཿ/ sharbaḥ/lag na mdung thogs/ chung ma gsum ⑫yod pa/ bde byed/ 'dod dran ⑩dgra/ 'tsho byed/ru draḥ/ yī shwa raḥ/ bijuḥ/ kṛ ⑫ṇ+ḍaḥ/ bā su de baḥ()/drag po/ dbang phyug /khyab 'jug/khyab 'jug gi ming ste 'dom na nag po/nor lha'i bu ste khyab 'jug gi ming /kā ma de baḥ/ mā raḥ/ su nirma ṇa ra ti de ba pu traḥ/ su sī ma de ba pu traḥ/'dod pa'i tsu)lha/ bdud/ lha'i bu rab 'phrul dga'/ lha'i bu mtshams bzang /san+tu ṣi ta de ba pu traḥ/ su yā ma de ba pu traḥ/ sha kro de ben+d+ra⑫ཿ/lha'i bu yongs su dga' ldan/ lha'i bu rab 'thab bral/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin/da sha sha ta na ya naḥ/ sha kraḥ/ kau shi kaḥ/ sha ta kra tuḥ/ pu ran+da raḥ/brgya byen 'dom na mig stong pa/ brgya byen/ brgya byin/ mchod sbyin brgya ba/ brgya byin nam khyer 'jig /115—110

lo ka pā laḥ①/ bi ②shra ba ṇaḥ/ z-i ta rāṣ+ṭa①ཿ/ pi rū bhā ④kaḥ/ pi rū rjopā k+ṣaḥ/'jig rten skyong / rnam thos kyi bu/ yul 'khor srung spyo/ 'phags skyes po/ mig mi bzang /ka ro ṭa pā ṇa yo de bāḥdze+e/ mā lā d+mā rāḥ/ sa dā ma dā⑤ ཿ/ i shā naḥ⑨/ in+d+raḥ/lag na gzhong thogs/ phreng thogs/ rtag tu myos/ dbang bdag /dbang po/ya maḥ/ ni ṛ tiḥ⑩/ ba ru ṇaḥ/ bā yuḥ/ ku be+e raḥ⑪/ bai shā na raḥ/ kāt+t+waṃ ke yaḥ/gshin rje/ bden bral/ chu lha/ rlung / lus ngan po/ mi/ smin drug bu/ma hā kā laḥ/ nan+di ke shwa raḥ/ phroṃ ⑫gi ri tiḥ⑫/ bi nā ya kaḥ/ dha na daḥ/ de bī/nag po chen po/ dga' byed dbang phyug / z-ing gi tsuste ri ti/ log 'dren/ nor sbyin/ lha mo4lta/su ra ba dhū/ a sgyurā⑩/ de ba ka r+sā/ dunā de bī/ u mā/ gi ri 7su tā/lha'i bu mo/ lha'i bu mo/ lha'i bu mo/ rdzong gi lha mo/ dka' bzlogatho5 /ri'i sras mo/sha ṭī/ pisnaḥ//bde sogs/ bgegs⑪/gza' dgu'i ming la/ā du di t+yaḥ/ sau 0maḥ me/ e gā ra kaḥ/ bu dhaḥ/ bṛ hasba tiḥ/ shu kraḥ/nyi ma/ zla ba/ mig dmar/ gza' lhag /phur bu/ pa ba sangs/sha ne+esh+tsa raḥ④/ rā hu④ཿ/ ke tuḥ//spen pa/ sgra gcan/ mjug ⑫rings/rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ming la/sdekṛti ⑦kā/ ro hi bhā3/ mṛ ga si rā/ ād+dhā/ pu narba suḥ/ pu 6ཿ/ a bye ṣā/ ma ghā/smin drug /snar ma/ mgo/ lag /nab ( )so/ rgyal/ skag /mchu/ 115—111

pūrba palgu rī①/ ut+ta ra palgu ①nī/ hastu/ tsi tā/ swā ti/ be+e shā khā/ a nu rā ①dhā/gre/ dbo/ me bzhi/ nag pa/ sa ri/ sa ga /lha mtshams/byejo④rka/ spru lo/ pū bā ⑤ṣā ṭ+wā/ ut+ta ra ṣā 4/ shra ba ṇa/rjo a bhi dzitu/ sha ta bhi ṣā/stson | snub sa/ chu stod/ chu smad/ gro bzhin/ byi bzhin/ mon gre/dha nijo/ pūrba ⑦bha dra ba ⑧dā/ ut+ta ra bha dra pa dā/ re ba tī/ a shi nī/ bha ra bhā//mon gru/ khrums stod/ khrums smad/ nam gru/ tha skar/ bra nye/lha dang klu la sogs pa'i ming la/de baḥ/ nā gaḥ/ yak+ṣaḥ/ garnyarbaḥ⑨/ a su raḥ/ de lha/ klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ lha ma yin/ lha ma yin 'dom t+yaḥ—/ ga ru ḍaḥ/ kin+da raḥ/ ma ho ra gaḥ⑩/ kusgyuṇ+ḍa//na sbyin byed ma'i bu/ nam mkha' lding / mi'am ci/ lto 'phye chen po/ grul bum/klu'i rgyal po'i ming la/shaṃ kha bā lo nā ga rā ⑪dzā/ karka ⑫ṭa ko nā ga rā dz+dza⑫/ ku li ko nā ga rā dzā/ pad+mo klu'i rgyal po dung skyong / klu'i rgyal po stobs kyi rgyu/ klu'i rgyal po rigs ldan/ klu'i nā ga rā dzā/ ma hā pad+mo nā ga rā dzā/ bā ⑫su tī ⑫nā ga rā dzā/ a nadho nā ga rā dzā/rgyal po pad+ma/ klu'i rgyal po pad+ma chen po/ klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu⑫/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas/tak+ṣa ko nā ga rā dzā/ ba ru ṇa nā ga rā dzā/ ma ka ro nā ga rā dzā/ sā ga ro nā ga rā dzā/klu'i rgyal po 'jog po/ klu'i rgyal po chu lha/ klu'i rgyal po chu srin/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho/lam+bu ko nā ga rā dzā/ a na ba tap+ta nā ga rā dzā/ dzi ga lo nā ga rā dzā/ nasdo nā ga rā dzā/klu'i rgyal po 'phyang ba/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa/ klu'i rgyal po ser skya/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo/115—112

su ba hurtswa ga rā dzā/ narda no nā ga rā dzā/ tsi tā k+ko nā ga rā dzā/ rā ba kho nā ga rā dzā/klu'i rgyal po lag bzangs①/ klu'i rgyal po sgra 'byin/ klu'i rgyal po mig bkra/ klu'i rgyal po sgra sgrogs/pan+d+rartswa ga rā dzā/sde kṛ mirtswa ga rā dzā/ saṃ kho nā ga rā dzā/ paṇ+ḍa ①ra ko nā ga rā dzā/klu'i rgyal po skya bseng /dhi klu'i rgyal po srin bu/ klu'i rgyal po dung / klu'i rgyal po dkar gsal/kā lo nā ga rā dzā/ u pa kā lo nā ga rā dzā/ gi ri ko nā ga rā dzā/ a ba lo nā ga rā dzā/klu'i rgyal po nag po/ klu'i rgyal po nye nag /klu'i rgyal po ri bo/ klu'i rgyal po stobs med/shaṃ ka ro nā ga rā dzā/ bhāṇ+ḍi nā ga rā dzā/ pa.ā+oṃ ⑤lo nā ⑥ga rā dzā/ kā li ko nā ga rā dzā/ཿklu'i rgyal po bde byed/ klu'i rgyal po spyad spreladze+e/ klu'i rgyal po lnga len/ klu'i rgyal po dus can/kiñtsa na ko sdenā ga rā dzā/ ba li ko nā ga rā dzā/ ut+ta ro nā ga rā dzā/ mā lta 97go nā ga rā dzā/klu'i rgyal po chung zad/ klu'i rgyal po stobs can/ klu'i rgyal po ltag hu 3ma/ klu'i rgyal po glang po che/e ḍo nā ga rā dzā/ sā ga ro nā ga rā dzā/ u pejo nā ga rā dzā/ u pa na ro nā ⑪ga rā dzā/klu'i rgyal po lug /klu'i rgyal po dug can/ klu'i rgyal po nye dbang / klu'i rgyal po mi dang nye/e ḍa bzlo nā ga rā dzā/ bi tsi tro nā ga rā dzā/ rā gha bo nā ga rā dzā/ haste kastso klu'i rgyal po lug mdog /klu'i rgyal po ris bkra/ klu'i rgyal po rtogs pa'i butu)/ klu'i rgyal po nā ga rā dzā/ e la pa tro nā ga rā dzā/ asbra tīsgo 'u//nā ga rā dzā/ a pa la lo 7nā ga rā dzā/glang po che'i mtshan/ klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab/ klu'i rgyal po a mra'i bu/ klu'i rgyal po sog ma med/tsāspe ⑫yo nā ga rā dzā/ a li ko nā ga rā dzā/ pra ⑩mo k+ṣa ko nā ga rā dzā/ sgo ṭa no nā ga rā 1bhe dzā/klu'i rgyal po tsam pa skyes/ klu'i rgyal po khra/ klu'i rgyal po shin tu mthar byed/ klu'i rgyal po rgyas byed/nasdo pa nasdo nā ga rā dzā no⑫/ hu lu ḍo nā ga rā dzā/ u lu ko nā ga rā dzā/ paṇ+ḍa ro klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' gnyis/ klu'i rgyal po hu lu ru/ klu'i rgyal po gsal mthong / klu'i nā ga rā dzā/ tsits+tsha ko nā ga rā dzā/ a ra bā 4ste ḍo nā ga rā dzā/ pa ra bā ḍo nā ga rā dzā/rgyal po skya'o/ /klu'i rgyal po bsags rgyas/ klu'i rgyal po rtsibs ra/ klu'i rgyal po rab bzang /115—113

ma na sī ①nā ga rā dzā/ sho ④ba lo nā ga rā dzā/ ut+pa la ko nā ga rā dzā/ badhe mā na ko nā klu'i rgyal po gzi can/ klu'i rgyal po nya byubs/ klu'i rgyal po uṣ+pe la/ klu'i rgyal po ga rā dzā/ budhi ①ko nā ga rā dzā/ na kha ko nā ga rā dzā/ e ④ḍa me to nā ga rā dzā no⑤/'phel ba po/ klu'i rgyal po blo can/ klu'i rgyal po sen mo can/ klu'i rgyal po lug dang 'du ba gnyis/a sgo to nā ga rā dzā/ kasba khā shwa ta ro rjonā ga rā dzā kaudze+e/ su dar+sha no nā ga rā dzā/klu'i rgyal po ma nyams pa/ klu'i rgyal po kasbra la dang a shwa tar ⑤gnyis/ klu'i rgyal po shin tu mthong /pa ri kyu ṭo nā ga rā dzā/ su mu kho nā ga rā dzā/ ā dar+sha mu kho nā ga rā dzā/ garnya ro nā klu'i rgyal po yongs su brtsegs pa/ klu'i rgyal po bzhin legs/ klu'i rgyal po me long gdong / klu'i rgyal po ga rā dzā/ dra mi ḍo du/nā ga rā dzā/ ba la de bo nā ga rā dz+wa/ kasba lo nā ga rā dzā/spos 'dzin/ klu'i rgyal po 'gro lding / klu'i rgyal po stobs lha/ klu'i rgyal po kasba la/shi ⑩ la ba hurtswa ga rā dzā/ bi bhi ⑪ṣa r+ṇa nā ga rā dzā/ gi gā nā ga rā dzā/ sirnyartswa ga klu'i rgyal po brag lag /klu'i rgyal po rnam par 'jigs ⑫byed/ gang gā'i 0/ klu'i rgyal po/ me+ebyu'i ④klu'i rā dzā/ si tā nā ga rā dzā/ pakyu nā ⑫ga rā dzā/ oṃ ga phyo ⑩nā ga rā dzā//rgyal po/ si ta'i klu'i rgyal po/ bag ⑩shu'i klu'i rgyal po/ klu'i rgyal po bkra shis/klu la la ba'i ming la/in+d+ra se naḥ/ na ḍaḥ/ sun+da raḥ/ haste kaṇ+ḍiḥ/ tīkyāspyoḥ/ dzi ga laḥ⑪/dbang po'i sde/ 'dam bu/ rab mdzes/ glang chen rna ba/ rnon po/ ser skya/bibyu dz+dza ④laḥ⑪/ ma hā bibyun+d+ra bhaḥ/ bha ru kats+tshaḥ/ a mṛ taḥ/ tīrba kaḥ/ be+e ḍūr+ya glog 'bar/ glog gi 'od chen/ dam pa 'gebs( )/ bdud rtsi can/ mu stegs can/ bai byur+ya'i pra bhaḥ/ su baṇ+ḍi ke shaḥ/ srur+ya pra ⑫bhaḥ/ u da ya naḥ④/ ga dza shrīsgo⑫ཿ/ shwe ta ka /'od—/ gseng mdog ska/ nyi ma'i 'od⑪/ 'char ba/ ba lang mgo/ dkar po/115—114

kā la kaḥ/ ya maḥ/ shra ma ṇaḥ①/ mazle lakaḥ/ ma ṇi tsū ḍaḥ/ a mo gha dar+sha naḥ/nag po/ gshin rje/ dge sbyong / sbal pa/ gtsug na nor bu/ don yod mthong /i shā dhā raḥ/ tsi tra ①se naḥ/ ma hā pā shaḥ④/ k+ṣe saṃ ka raḥ/ ma hā pha ṇa ⑤kaḥ/gshol mda' 'dzin/ sna tshogs sde/ zhags pa chen po/ bde byed/ gdengs ka chen po/gasnyi rjor nisgo ṣaḥ/ ma hā ni ⑦na dī/ pi nadi taḥ(pe7/ ma hā bi kra maḥ/ byu rngudze+e ga maḥ/dbyangs zab/ char tho) sgogs/ rnam par dgra 'byin/ rtsal chen/ lag 'gro/ma/ hā ba 'baḥtuspe/ bi(1 (geji taḥ/ bi chag spyoṭa kaḥ(mi/ pra dra/ 1ltaṭa kaḥ/ ces gha chub chub baḥhūṃ7/stobs can/ mthu bsgyings()/ rnam par 'joms/ rab 'joms/ sprin byung /swa snyi kaḥ/ bar+ṣa dhā (5raḥ/ ma ṇi kaṇ+ḍaḥlho6/ su pra tiṣ+ṭṛ taḥ/ shrī bha draḥ/bkra shis ldan/ char pa'i rgyun/ mgul na nor bu/ shin tu brtan pa/ dpal bzang /ma hā ma ṇi ( ste tsū ḍaḥstso / i rā pa ṇaḥ/ ma hā maṇ+ḍa li kaḥ/ ibye ḍa )yu dha shi khā+e/gtsug na nor bu chen po/ ( )sa srung ( stegi bu/ dkyil 'khor chen po can/༷ 1 'ja'i gtsug phud can/a ba bhā sa na shi ste/( 9/ in+d+ra yaṣ+ṭiḥ( 7/ dzam+bu dh+wa dzāḍa 5/ shrī ti dzā( )/ sha shi ta ( ‘snang ldan gtsug phud can/ dbang po'i mchod sdong / dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan/ dpal gyi gzi brjid/ zla ba'i dzāske/ tsū ḍa ⑥ma ṇi ⑪dha raḥ/ in+d+ra dh+wa dzā⑫/ byo tī la 〉ra saḥsnye/ so ma dar+sha rna//gzi brjid/ gtsug na nor bu thogs pa/ dbang po'i rgyal mtshan/ skar ma la dga' ba/ zla mthong /gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i ming la/bai shra ba ṇaḥ/ ma hā gho ṣe shwa raḥ/ dha ra ṇi su ro drwa yu dhaḥ/ ma hā ma tiḥ/rnam thos bu/ sgra chen po'i dbang phyug /sa steng mtshon cha mchog tu mi zad pa/ blo gros chen po/adz+re de tā dhi pa ⑪tiḥ/ badz+ra dṛ bhā ne+e traḥ/ a gra bī ra bā hu pya ཿ/ ma hā se na byu ha pa 'od 'phro mig ⑫bdag /rdo rje ltar sra ba'i mig /mchog tu dpa' ba'i lag pa/ dmag chen po'i 115—115

rā ①kra maḥ④/ me ru ba la pra mdwo/ dhā ④ra bhā su bha kā yaḥ/ ā ⑤ṭa ba ka yak+ṣaḥ/g.yul gnon pa/ lhun po'i stobs 'jomasarjo/ lus sa ltar bzang ba/ gnod sbyin 'brog gnas/rā ba ṇaḥ/ pā— ⑦kaḥ//sgra sgrog gi bu/ lngas rtsen/dri za'i dbang po'i ming la/dh+ri ta rāṣ+ṭaḥ/ dru ma kin+da ra pra bhaḥ/ shu tsi ne+e khyetra ra ti sam+bha baḥ/ pube+e dru ma yul 'khor srung ⑨/ mi 'am ci ljon pa'i 'od/ mig gtsang dga' 'byung / me tog sdong po ku su mi ta ma ku ṭaṃ( )/ ra ti tsa ra ṇa sa man+ta swa raḥ/ pra mu di (speta pra lasbra rgyas pa'i cod pan can/ dga' bas 'gro ba kun du dbyangs/ mig bzang su na ya naḥ⑫/ ⑫/ma no dzha 'u ru ta sau ha dh+wa dzā/ sa man+ta rat+na ki ra ṇa skemuk+ta pra bhaḥ/ring dga'/ yid du 'ong ba'i sgra seng ge'i rgyal mtshan/ rin chen 'od bzhin du kun du gzer gtong /badz+ra dru ma ke sa ra dh+wa dz+wa/ sarba byu ha ra ti swa bhā ba na ya san+dar+sha naḥ//rdo rje ljon pa'i ze ⑩ba'i rgyal mtshan/ bkod pa kun la ⑫dga' ba'i rang bzhin gyi tshul ston pa/lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i ming la/rā hu⑫ཿ/ be+e ma tsi traḥ/ shasba raḥ/ brnyiḥ/ bai ro tsa naḥ/ dṛ bhā badz+raḥ/sgra gcan/ thags bzangs ⑩ ris/ bde ba'i mchog /'ching ba/ rnam par snang byed/ rdo rje sra ba/su tsi t+t+waṃ bu gaḥ/ bṛ hā dā raḥ/ ba la bi pu la te tu ma tiḥdu/ bat+ma shrī sasba 3baḥ/lus shin tu bkra ba/ rtsibs chen/ stobs yangs mergyu'i blo gros/ gzhon nu dpal 'byung /su bra ta swa raḥ//brtul zhugs rab kyi dbyangs/115—116

nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i ming la/ma hā be ga labha s+thā ①mā/ a bhe r+ya rat+na tsū ḍaḥ/ be+e ( 7ma la blube ga shrīḥ④//shugs chen mthu thob/ mi phyed gtsug na rin po che/ dri ma med pa'i shugs kyi dpal/a ni brta bhā ya tsit+ta byu ṣa ṇaḥ/ ma hā sā ga ra pra bhā gartsi sa ra ga ti dha ra6 ཿ/mi bzlog pa'i sems kyi rgyan/ rgya mtsho chen po lta bu'i 'od zab mo rtogs pa/ dang 'dom gar snang / 'chang meb/dharma dṛ ṭ+wā bhe stir+ya su ni lam+bhaḥ/ bi tsit+ta mo li shrī tsū ḍaḥ/ sa man+ta spa ra r+ṇa chos la brtan 'uzhing mi phyed par shin tu ston pa/ cod paṇa sna tshogs dpal gyi gtsug /bzhin kun du nye — mu kha dar+sha naḥ/ sa man+ta byu ⑪ha sā ga ra tsar+yā bya ba lo ka naḥ//khyab par ston pa/ kun du bkod pa rgya mtsho'i spyod pa la rnam par lta rtsertab/mi'am ci'i dbang po'i ming la/dru ma kin+da ⑫ra rā dzā⑫/ de ba ma ti pra bhaḥ/ ku su ma ke tu maṇ+ḍa lī/mi'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po ljon pa/ lha'i blo gros 'odashā1/ me tog rtog ḍa/ )gi dkyil 'khor can/bi tsit+tha bhū ṣa na⑫ཿ/ ma no snyo spyonirtswa nyushād swa raḥ/ dru ma rat+na shā ( byekhā pra bhaḥ/rgyan sna tshogs can/ sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong ༷spe/ rin chen yal ga'i ljon pa'i 'od/su dar+sha na spru ti ka raḥ/ bhū 3 ṣa rten+d+ra pra bhaḥ/ su re rku put+pa dh+wa dzā/ dha ra bhā ta la shrīḥ 3/legs mthong dga' byed/ rgyan gyi dbang po 'od/ rdul mdzes me tog rgyal mtshan/ sa steng dpal/u ra gā dhi pa tiḥ//lto 'phye bdag po/115—117

lto 'bye chen po'i dbang po'i ming la/su ma ti re rkuḥ/ bi ra dzaste dzaḥ/ swa raḥ.a gra ma ti tsi tra tsū ḍaḥ/ su ne+e tā dhi blo gros zhi ba mchog /gzi brjid rdul med dbyangs/ blo mchog sna tshogs gtsug /mig bzang bdag pa tiḥ①/ pra dī pa sha ra ṇa dh+wa dzā/ ā ④lo ka su be ga dh+wa dzā/ dzi ha bat+maḥ①pi po/ skyabs sgon rgyal mtshan/ snang ba shugs mchog rgyal mtshan/ bu seng ge sna tshogs tsiṭ+wā ④lo kā ⑤swa raḥ/ su me ru pat+maḥ/ ru tsi ra pra bhā rjos saṃ bha baḥ//rgyan gyi dbyangs/ bu ri rab/ snang ba mjes 'byung /grul bum gyi dbang po'i ming la/bi rū ⑦bhā kaḥ/ nā gā dhi pa tiḥ/ su ṭīṇ+ḍi dh+wa skedzā/ hi ta tsa ra ṇa saṃ kra maḥ/'phags skyes po/ klu bdag /shin tu spyad pa'i rgyal mtshan/ phan par spyad pa la zhugs pa/ṭī mot+ta ⑨raḥ()/ shā spespel su tsin+t+raḥ()/ me ru su saṃ bha baḥ/ bī ra ba huḥ/'jigs su rung ba'i bla ma/ legs pas shin tu bkra ba/ lhun po shin tu 'byung ⑫ba/ dpa' ba'i lag pa/a narnya shu bha na ya na ke sa rī/ a nan+ta mu kha de bā su ra ne+e tā su raḥ//dge ba mtha' yas pa'i mig gam ⑫ge sar/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa 'dren pa'i lha ma yin/drang srong chen po'i ming la/su shu taḥ/ hā thonyerī taḥ/ ha rish+tsan+d+raḥ/ z-i guḥ/ dhan+dan+ta riḥ/ dzā dṛ kaṇ+ḍiḥtho)/legs thos/ ljang sngo'i bu/ seng ge zla ba/ ngan spong / thang la bar⑩/ rgya skyegs ⑫rna/bhe ḍaḥ/ kā ⑪sh+ya paḥ/ a ga steḥ⑫/ sa na ⑪ta naḥ/ sa natu ku ⑫mā raḥ/ khā ⑫ra nā dī/gzings can/ 'drob (steskyong bu/ ri byi/ g.yung drung / kun 'gyed ()gzhon nu/ sgra drag gi bu/115—118

ā ①tre yaḥ/ pra dzā pa tiḥ④/ pa rā sha raḥ/ ka pi la ma hāk+ṣeḥ①/ ka ṇa da ma rgyun shes kyi bu/ skye dgu bdag / rtsib logs ④skyes/ drang srong chen po ser skya/ drang srong chen po hāk+ṣeḥ⑤ / a k+ṣa pā daḥ/ byā saḥ/ bhā dur dh+wa dzaḥ⑦/ ba siṣ+ṭhaḥ/ nā ra daḥ/ aspru be gzegs ⑧zan/ rkang mig can/ rgyas pa/ bhā ⑨ra rgyal mtshan/ gnas 'jog⑩ /mis byin gyi bu/ me shaḥ—/ a ra ni miḥ⑪//bzhin 'jug /rtsibs kyi mu khyud/sngon gyi mkhan po'i ming la/nā hārdzu ⑫naḥ/ nā gā hwa yaḥ/ ār+ya de baḥ/ ārlu ⑫saṃ gaḥ/ ba su brtseḥ/ ār+ya klu sgrub/ klus bod/ 'phags pa lha/ 'phags pa thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa shu ⑫raḥ/ a shwa gho ṣaḥ/ disgyu ⑫gaḥ/ dharma pā laḥ/ dharma tīt+t+waṃtho)ཿ/ t+tha ra ma ti/dpa' bo/ rta skad/ phyogs glang / chos skyong / chos grags/ blo brtan/saṃ gha bha draḥ/ gu ṇa pra bhaḥ/ ba su mi traḥ/ gu ṇa ma tiḥ/ shākya burnyiḥ/ de ben+d+ra 'dus bzang / yon tan 'od/ dbyig bshes/ yon tan blo gros/ shākya blo/ lha bu dhispyoḥ/ tshwa na gasnyaḥ/ shadha spyorak+shi taḥ/ tsan+d+ra go m+bi/ budha pā li taḥ/ bha byaḥ/dbang blo/ ye shes snying po/ zhi ba 'tsho/ btsun pa zla ba/ sangs rgyas skyong / skal ldan/ba ra ru mkhye⑪/ pā ṇi niḥ/ pā tachu ⑫li/ tsan+d+ra tīt+t+waṃ⑪ཿ/ bi ni ta de baḥ/ nan+daḥ/mchog sred/ pā ṇi ni/ chur lhung / zla grags/ dul ba lha/ dga' bo/dharmot+ta raḥ/ shākya mi traḥ/ dz+nyā na dat+taḥ/ pra bhā ka ra sidhesgo)ཿ/ shī ()la bha draḥ/chos mchog /shākya bshes gnyen/ ye shes byin/ 'od byed grub/ ngang tshul bzang po/rdaṣ+ṭa se naḥ/ dharma tā ④taḥ/ be she ⑪ṣa mi traḥ/ ra bi gup+taḥ/ bā bha ṭaḥ//mche ba'i sde/ chos skyob⑩/ khyad par bshes gnyen/ nyi ma sbas pa/ pha khol/115—119

ya mtshan can gyi ming la/tībye ka raḥ/ t+t+waṃbe+e chokaḥ/ a rā ḍaḥkā la maḥ/ u dra ko khyarā ma pu traḥ/mu stegs byed/ mu stegs can/ sgyu rtsal shes rngukyi bu ring 'phur/ rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod/m+bi mābe+e kaḥ/ be+e shi ṣa pyakaḥ/ saṃ (glukhyaḥ/ lo kā ya taḥ/ kā ṇa dā/ pa ri bra dza kaḥ/spyod pa pa/ bye brag pa/ grangs can pa / 'jig rten rgyang 7pan pa/ gzegs zan pa(pya/ kun du rgyu/be+e r+yaḥ/ pā ṣaṇ+ḍi kā 3/ shi baḥ/ pā (khyashu pa tiḥ/ ka pā lnga/sngo 7/ a tse hūṃskrel kaḥ/sman pa/ ya mtshan can/ zhi ba pa/ phyugs bdag pa/ thod pa can/ gos med/nirgan+d+raḥ / k+ṣa pa ṇaḥ/ ārta taḥlho)/ ma hā bra tīny-i)/ rā ma bra tre+e/gcer bu pa/ zad ⑫byed pa/ mchod spyo'os/ brtul zhugs chen po pa/ rangs byed kyi bu ⑫brtul zhugs can/ mṛ ga shrī ⑩ga bra tī/ kṛṣ+ṭa mu khaḥ/ ma ⑫yu ra bra tī/ pāṇ+ḍa ⑪ ra dzhai k+ṣuḥ pya / tri daṇ+ḍi 0/sha ru'i brtul zhugs can/ ngo gnag /rma bya'i brtul zhugs can/ srong ba dkar po/ dbyig gu gsum pa/e ka daṇ+ḍi/ dī daṇ+ḍi/ go shri 3ga bra 3tī/ ke shophruñtsa phyorgo//dbyig gu gcig pa/ dbyeg gu gnyis pa/ glang ru'i brtul zhugs can/ skra 'bal ba/mu stegs can gyi ston pa drug gi ming la/pū ra ṇaḥkā sh+ya paḥ/ maska rī go shā lbo pu traḥḍa snye/ sañdza yī bai rasbyi ( 9'od srungs rdzogs byed/ kun du rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu/ smra 'dod ()kyi bu mo'i bu ()yang dag pu traḥ/ a dzi taḥke sha kasba laḥ/ a ku daḥ kā t+yā ⑫ya naḥ/ ni grasgo zhu dz+nyā ti pu traḥ//rgyal ba can/ mi 'pham ⑫skra'i la ba can/ ka t+ya'i bu nog can/ gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu/175—120

'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rgyud kyi ming la/ ma hā sasma taḥ/ ro tsaḥ/ ka s+thā ①ṇaḥ/ ba ra ka spyo ṇaḥ/ u po ⑤ṣa dhaḥ/ mūd+dhā ⑤taḥ/mang pos bkur ba/ 'od mdzes/ dge ba/ dge mchog /gso sbyong 'phags/ spyi bo skyes/mār+sā ④taḥ/ tsā ru/ u pa tsā ru/ tsā ru saṃ taḥ⑪/ mu ཿ/ mu tsi lin+daḥ/ sha ku niḥ/nga las nu/ mdzes pa/ nye mdzes/ mdzes ldan/ btang ba/ btang bzung / sha ku ni/ma hā sha ku niḥ/ ku shaḥ/ u pa ku shaḥ/ ma hā ku shaḥ/ su dar+sha naḥ thu7/ ma hā su dar+sha naḥ/sha ku ni chen po/ ku sha /nye ba'i ku sha /ku sha chen po/ legs mthong / legs mthong chen po/bā ma ka⑦ /saṃ gi raḥ/ z-i guḥ⑤/ me ruḥ/ bye kuḥ/ pra dhā ⑨daḥ/ ma hā pra ṇa ⑩daḥ/gnod sel/ shes ldan/ ngan spong / thon po/ nges 'gro/ rab tu sgra bsgrags/ rab tu sgra bsgrags ⑩chen po/shaṃ ka raḥ/ di shasbra tiḥ/ re rkuḥ/ bha ra taḥ/ ma hā de baḥ/ ne+e miḥḍa/5/ rnyi 0/ maḥ/bde byed/ phyogs bdag /rdul bzang / rgyas byed/ lha chen po/ mu khyud/ 'jigs byed/dhī ma ra thaḥ/ sha ta ra thaḥ/ da sha ra thaḥ/ pañtsa la rā dzā/ ka bo ga rā dzā④/'jigs byed shing rta/ shing rta brgya pa/ shing rta bcu pa/ lnga 'dzin gyi rgyal po/ ka ling ka'i rgyal po/asma ka rā dzā(nye/ kau ra ba rā dzā shā )/ ka pā la rā dzā shā )/ ge ya rā dzākṛshe/asma ka'i rgyal po/ sgra mi snyan gyi rgyal po/ thod pa can gyi rgyal po/ klu dbyangs kyi rgyal po/ma ⑪ga dha rā dzārjo/ ta mā ⑪libe+e ka rā dzā 3/ i spyo ku nā ma ༷ )rā dzā 3/ pi rū bhā kaḥ/mā ( nyeg rnya'i rgyal po/ ta ( 9ma li sta'i rgyal po/ rgyal po bu ram shing skyes( bhe/ 'phags skyes po/dzi ha ha nuḥ/ shurnyo 3da naḥ/ shuklo da naḥ/ dro rte da naḥ/ a mṛ ⑩to da naḥ/ sid+dhārjaḥ/seng ge 'gram/ zas gtsang mazhu / zas dkar/ bre'o ⑪zas/ bdud rtsi zas/ don grub⑫/nan+daḥske/ ti6ཿ/ bha dra ⑫kaḥ(ste/ ma hā nā ⑫maḥ/ a ni rudha skyeḥ/ a ⑪nan+daḥ/dga' ba()/ rgyal/ bzang ldan/ ming chen/ ma 'gags pa/ kun dga' bo/115—121

de ba dat+taḥ/ rā hu laḥ//lhas byin/ sgra gcan 'dzin/'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i yon tan dang rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa'i ming la/swa yo yā rgodū/ pra kyu byā rgo1 / ka la ha dzi ta⑦ཿ/ shas+t+ra dzi ta④ཿ/rang 'du ba/ bas su ⑤pa/ 'thab mo bshams nas phebs pa/ mtshon cha brtsams pas rjophebs pa rte /tsa tu rarnyo bi dze tā/ dharmi ko dharma ④rā dzā/ mardi ta kaṇ+ḍa ka⑨ཿ/mtha' bzhir rgyal ba/ chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa/ gnod pa chosas pa'am tsher ⑫ma dkrugs pa/bi dzi ta bi dza yaḥ/ sap+ta rat+na sa ma nā kṛrmeg taḥ/ tsakra rat+t+waṃ/ haste raṭ+wāṃ/rnam par rgyal bar byas pa las rnam par rgyal ba/ rin po che sna bdun dang ldan/ 'khor lo rin po che/glang po rin po che/a shwa rarja/ ma ṇi rat+t+waṃ/ s+t+ri ⑫ rat+t+waṃ/ kṛ ha pa ti rat+t+waṃ/ pa ri ṇa ya ka rat+t+waṃ//rta mchog rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ bud med rin po che/ khyim bdag rin po che/ blon po rin po che/bu stong du tshang bar 'gyur ba'i ming la/shu raḥ/ bī raḥ/ pa dzā ()ga rū r+pā/ pa ra be+e n+ya pra mdwo(ste/ a dzi tai dza dpa' ba/ brtul phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms pa ma phebs pa ya ti/ dzi ta ma dh+yā tsusteb sa tiḥshā 9/ sa i mā me ba sa mu dra par+yadz+nyā ⑫ma hā thra thi 'bebs—/ phebs pa'i sar ⑫gnas 'debs/ de rgya mtsho la thug pa'i sa chen po ma lus par gnod par sdo ⑩ bī a khi dze+e a kaṇ+ḍa ( )tsā a nuṣ+pe t+t+waṃ a daṇ+ḍi nā shaste ṇa dharmi ṇa sa me nā r+bha ba med cing 'tshe ba med pa 'di nyid chad pa med sbung mtshon gyis bda' ⑩ba med la chos dang mthun zhing nirdzi sput+yā dh+yā ba sa ti ⑫//snyoms pas legs par phab ste ④gnas pa'o/ /175—122

dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi'i ming la/tsa tu ram̐ ga ba la kā yaḥ/ haste kā yaḥ/ a shwa kā ①yaḥ/ ra tha kā yaḥ/dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa/ glang po che'i tshogs/ rta'i tshogs/ shing rta'i tshogs/pat+t+waṃ kā yaḥ// dpung bu chung gi tshogs/rgyal po phal pa'i ming la/rā dzā sa ②ha sru nī kaḥ/ rā dzā sha tā nī 1kaḥ/ rā dzā brad+ma dat+taḥ/ rā dzāphonan+ta ne+e rgyal po dmag stong pa/ rgyal po dmag brgya pa/ rgyal po tshangs pas byin/ rgyal po myu khyud mtha' miḥ④—/ rā dzā bisbra ⑤sā raḥ/ rā dzā pra byo ⑥taḥ⑦/ rā dzā pra se na dzit+pa 3/ u da ya na bat+pa rā dzā/yas / rgyal po gzugs can snying po/ rgyal po rab snang / rgyal po gsal rgyal/ rgyal po shar ba'i bu/kṛ tī rā dzā/ gre ṇi ⑨kaḥ/ gre rgyaḥ/ a sho kaḥ/ sārnyi ⑪bā ha naḥ/ ka ni skaḥ//rgyal po kṛ kri/ bzo sbyangs/ bzo sbyangs/ mya ngan med pa/ mthar 'gro zhon/ ka ni ska/skya seng gi bu la sogs pa'i ming go mthun la/paṇ+ḍa thosprebāḥ/ yu byeṣ+ṭṛ thogeraḥ/ dz+nyā ma se naḥ/ na ku lo/ sa ha de baḥ/skya bseng 4stegi bu/ g.yul ngor brtan pa/ 'jigs sde/ rigs med/ lhar kṛstebacas/ardzu naḥ/ ka ra kazloḥ(nye/ haste ni yi saḥ/ pra kṛ tirmā tai ga dā ri kā(9/srid sgrub/ lo tang tho bhenyan/ glang po che 'dul ba/ gdol ba'i bu mo byad bzang mophopya/tri shaṃ kusaḥ/ spru pa tiḥ/ mṛ gā dhā ra mā tā//phur bu gsum pa/ btsun mo'i zhal lta ba'am 0phya mkhan/ ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma/115—123

mi'i rim pa dang lus kyi yan lag dang yul 'khor la sogs pa'i ming las mi'i rim pa'i ming la/rā dzā/ pābe+e baḥ/ rā dzā k+ṣa tri ①yo mūstso ⑤rnyi ṣik+taḥdze+e/ yu ba rā dzārjo/rgyal po/ sa bdag rā dzā dang ma 'dom na rgyal po⑤/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba/ rgyal tshab/māṇ+ḍa ④li ka rā dza⑦/ sā man+taḥ/ rā dza ⑧mā traḥ/ koṭ+wā rā dza⑨ཿ/ madh+ri par+ṣa rgya ⑩k+ṣ-i/rgyal phran/ chab 'og gi rgyal phran nam/ blon po chen po⑪/ khams kyi rgyal po'am rgyal phran/ nang blon spyan⑫/ma hā mā traḥ/ madh+ri/ ā spyomā t+yaḥ/ pu ro hi taḥ/ rā dza ⑫na kaḥ/ daṇ+ḍa mu khyaḥ/sna chen po la gtogs pa/ bka' la gtogs pa/ blon po/ 'dun na 'don/ zhang blon/ dbang blon/daṇ+ḍa nā ya kaskeḥ/ sa ⑩nā ba ⑩tiḥ/ bik+ṣe pā dhi ba tiḥ/⑫ a khye k+ṣaḥ/ ā ṭa bi kaḥ⑪/dbang blon/ dmag dpon/ dmag dpon/ spyan me / nags khrod bdag /an+tarba shi kaḥ/ sārnyi ( spepi gra hi kaḥ/ ga ṇa nā pa ti/ ga ṇa ga ma hā mā traḥ/ ak+ṣa pa nang ba'i bla/ phrin blon/ rtsis kyi bla/ rtsis mkhan chen po/ 'du 'god kyi ṭa ( ) li kaḥ/ pra ti hā raḥ/ dharmā ( stebye ka ra ṇaḥ/ pra deṭ+wā/rtsis pa/ sgo dpon chen po/ chos bzhin gcod ④pa/ pra de— sdedang ma 'dom na zhal che bar gdags zhal ce pa/nā ya kaḥ/ a shwa pa tiḥ ④/ spru lu pa tiḥ/ ga dza pa tiḥ/ khasgyu ⑦ra pa tiḥ/ na ra pa tiḥ/sde sna'am sde dpon/ chibs kyi bla/ dkor gyi bla/ glang po che'i bla/ ma tsangan/ rgyal po'am mi'i bla/koṣ+ṭa pā ⑩laḥ⑪ / an+ta pā laḥstso/ durga pā laḥ⑫/ grekhyu/ bi ṣa ya pa tiḥ/ na ga ra pa tiḥ⑫/rtse rje/ so srung (ste/ rdzong srung / tshong dpon/ yul dpon/(nye gong khyer gyi bla/gā ⑪ma pa tiḥ/ bo ra bya ba tā ⑪ri kaḥ/ nā ya kaḥ⑫/ ni ⑪yuk+ta kaḥ/ bha ṭa ba khā graḥ/grong dpon/ grong gi bla/ sde dpon/ snar bskos pa/ khrom gyi ru/sa mā hadṛḥ/ bra shāsgyu/ sarnyi stsodhā tāstso/ bhaṇ+ḍa ⑩ri kaḥ/ rā dza ⑫dā ri kaḥ/sdud sna/ mthong sbebs kyi dpon/ dkor 'drub ④pa/ mdzod pa/ pho brang 'khor du bka' 'dzin pa/115—124

ga ṇa kaḥ/ bye ti ṣaḥ/ nyi ṣakra①/ bair+yaḥ/ ta la brkaḥ/ bā buri dh+wa dzi kaḥ/rtsis mkhan/ skar mkhan/ sman pa/ sman pa/ sku srung / rgyal mtshan thogs pa/ts+tshat+tha dha raḥ/ tsit+na dha ④raḥ/ tsā ma ri kaḥ thu/ kā ra bā li kaḥ/ khāni ⑥kaḥ/gdugs thogs pa/ rtags thogs pa/ rnga yab thogs pa/ ral gri kyog ⑦po thogs pa/ ral gri pa/pā si kaḥ/ pār+sha dhi kaḥ/ tsā ④kri kaḥ/ phra ⑪ ri kaḥ/ rtsa tra daṇ+ḍi ⑩ kaḥ/ yāṣ+ṭṛ ⑪kaḥ/mdung pa/ dgra sta thogs pa/ 'khor lo thogs pa/ phub thogs pa/ dbyig gu thogs pa/ dbyug pa thogs pa/dā ra pā laḥ/ do bā ri kaḥ/ she ṣa ba tiḥ⑫/ sru tsa kaḥ/ daṇ+ḍa bā si kaḥ/ se ba kaḥ/sgo srung ⑫/ sgo ba/ gnyer pa / log pa'am 'dam po pa/ yul srung spyo/ zham 'bring ba/bhaṣ+ṭaḥ/ i shwasta tsār+yaḥspyo/ nā si raḥ/ ne+e ga maḥ/ dza ⑩na pa daḥ/shor ba'am bkrabs thortepa/ 'phong gi slob dpon/ snga tshoms/ grong mi/ yul gyi mi/de ba ku li kaḥ/ mā yā kā raḥ/ ar+yaste ཿ/ man+t+ra bā ⑩ dī/ kṛ ya bā dī/ kha n+ya bā dī/lha khang srung du ba/sgyu ma mkhan/ jo bo'am rje'ospyo/ gsang sngags smra ba/ bcom 3 ma byed pa/ ter ༄9lta shes pa/dhā tu ④bā dī/ lubha kaḥ ⑤ / māṣ+pe ⑩kaḥ/ shā kurnyi kaḥ ⑦/ o ra z-i ka sdekhartsi kaḥspyo/nor sgyur mkhan/ rngon pa/ nya pa/ bya ba/ shan dzu) pa/sau ka ri kaḥ/ go ghā ⑪ta kaḥ/ bā gā ⑫ri kaḥ/ kauklu ṭi kaḥ/ nā ⑫ga brnya kaḥ/phag 'tshong / ba lang gsod pa/ rgyas 'tshong ba/ bya gag (ste 'tshong ba/ glang po che 'dzin pa/nā ga maṇ+ḍa li kaḥ/ ā ⑫hi tuṇ+ḍi kaḥ/ jo ga ri kaḥ/ sru pa kā raḥ/ ra dza kaḥ/sbrul tshogs can/ sgrul khas bsdigs ⑪pa/ phyag tshang ⑫skyesas mal ba/ phyag tshang tshang mang ba/ btso blag ⑫mkhan/sgra pa tiḥ⑥/ ta k+ṣa kaḥpa la gaṇ+ḍaḥpasnya kaḥ/ sru tra dhā raḥ/ yā stsob si kaḥ/ kaṣ+ṭha hā ra kaḥ/phya mkhan/snye pha gu brtsigs mkhan/ shing mkhan/(tre thig mkhan/ rtswa 'tshong / shing thun/115—125

mā lā kā raḥ/ sauṇ+ḍi kaḥ/ kabe+e bā laḥ/ ā ①yu dha dzī bī/ garnyi kaḥ/ tsit+tha kā ②raḥ/me tog phreng rgyud/ chang 'tshong / chang 'tshong / mtshon chas 'tsho ba/ spos 'tshong / ri mo mkhan/shi lā kuṣ+ṭa1 ཿ/ tan+t+ra bā yaḥ/ su baṇ+ḍi ④kā raḥ/ sau brnyi ⑤kaḥ/ lo buha kā raḥ/lto ⑦mkhan/ tha ga pa/ gser mgar/ gser spyod/ lcags mgar/shaṃ ④sa kā raḥ/ ma ṇi kā raḥ/ sholbi kaḥ/⑨ sru tsi kaḥ/ pan+d+ra ts+tsha da kaḥ/'khar ba mgar/ nor bu mkhan/ zangs mkhan/ tshem bu mkhan()/ glegs 'dra tsuspemakhan/ ne+e mit+t+waṃ ⑫kaḥ/ be+e pakhyu kaḥ/ tsarma kā raḥ/ mo tsi kaḥ/ ra tha kā raḥ/ltas mkhan/ mtshan mkhan/ lham mkhan nam nyu༄ko lpags mkhan(ste/ lham mkhan/ shing rta mkhan nam lham mkhan/be+e rku kā raḥ/ khā ta rū pa kā raḥ/ kum+bha kā raḥ/ bā ṇigra nyu9/ sholki kaḥ/ gosmi kaḥ/sgyug ma mkhan⑩/ rko mkhan nam tshud mo mkhan/ rdza mkhan/ tshong pa/ sho gam pa/ la gcan pa/tā ra pa byi ⑩kaḥ/ te riḥ/ tsa raḥ/ a ba tho)tsa ra kaḥ/ moji ⑪kaḥ/ bi dru ṣaḥ/gru btsas gcod pa/ nyan rna/ nyan rna/ bya ma rta/ zol pa/ bzhad gad pa/mo dri kaḥ bu / kā yasbaḥ/ ā ṭīṇ+ḍi medarnya tā/ dru taḥ/ ka byā ⑫yit+taḥ/ kāṣ+ṭṛ kā bin+ta⑫ཿ/yi ge pa/ yi ge pa/ dbyig pa gcod pa/ pho nya/ rang rta/ rang rta/lo 3hā riḥ sdele kha hā ri ⑩kaḥ/ ku ṭum+bi kaḥ/ ku ṭusbraḥ/ kazhu li/ arnyaḥpu raḥ/ ma habe+eḥ/'phar ma ⑦'am bang chen pa/ khyim khol/ bza'/ nyung rum 3pa/ nyung rum ⑩pa/ nyung rum ⑥pa/karmārnyi ⑥kaḥ/ kād+dhi ⑫kaḥkṛ ṣ+pe ba ⑫laḥ/ ā bhā raḥ/ go pā laḥ/ sha rī ra rak+ṣa kaḥ/zhing pa/ zhing rmod pa/ byugs rdzi/ ba lang rdzi/ lus srung (ste/pa ri bā raḥ/ dā saḥ/ dā sī/ karma ka raḥ/ po ru ṣe yaḥ/ z-i t+yaḥ/ brnya na pā la kaḥ/g.yog /bran nam khol po/ bran mo/ las byed pa/ zho shas 'tsho ba/ gla mi'am g.yog gam bran/ btson rdzi/ba rgya ⑫ghā ta kaḥ/ kā ra ju kā ra kaḥ/ ba dha kaḥ/ ha na rgo/ kalpi kā raḥ⑪ka byā riḥ⑪/gshed ma/ gnod byed/ gsod pa / gsad ⑪pa/ 'bangs sam nang byan nam rtse rgod/115—126

u byā na bā ①laḥ/ ā ⑤rā mi kaḥ/ kṛ tī/ kṛ ha s+thaḥ/ mā ṇa ①ba kaḥ④/skyed mos tshal srung rjob/ kun dga' ra ba pa/ khyim pa/ khyim na gnas pa/ bram ze'i bu/na ga ra ghā ta kaḥ/ gā ma ghā ta kaḥ/ dza na pa da ghā ta kaḥ/ nā bi kaḥ/ ā hā ra kaḥ/grong khyer 'joms rjopa/ grong 'joms pa/ ljongs 'joms pa/ gru pa/ snyod cing stob ⑦pa/nirtswa ⑧ra kaḥ/ kaṇ+ḍi dhā ra kaḥ⑨/ ra ṇa dhā ra ka⑩ཿ/ kau bat+t+waṃspyoḥ//sel pa/ gdos pa 'dzin pa'am rlung g.yor thogs pa/ ru skya 'dzin pa/ rkyal ⑩chen nam nya pa/mi'i rigs sna tshogs la/tsa tā ro btsā⑫ཿ/ zwah+ma ⑫ṇaḥ/ k+ṣat+t+waṃ yaḥ/ bai sh+yaḥ/ shu draḥ/ k+ṣat+t+waṃ ya ma hā sā la rigs bzhi/ bram ze/ rgyal rigs/ rje'u rigs/ dmangs rigs/ rgyal rigs shing sā la ku lo/ drwad+ma ṇa ma hā sā la ku lo/ kṛ ha pa ti ma hā sā la ku lamra(nye/ uts+tsha chen po lta bu/ bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu/ khyim bdag gi rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu/ rigs ku lo/ a rnyi dzā lta/ — tsa (9ku loḥtsu bhe/ tsaṇ+ḍa laḥmā hushe tai gaḥ/mtho ba/ rigs btsun pa/ rigs dma' ba/ ma 'dom ⑪na gnyis ka gdos dupa 'dom na tsaṇ+ḍa la gtum byed du gdags/sha ba raḥpu lin+daḥ/ pu ka saḥ⑫/ ḍo baḥ/ sle ts+tshaḥ/ pra t+yarnya thudza na pa daphra bu//ri khrod pa/ g.yung po/ g.yung po/ gla glo ④/ mtha' khob kyi mi/pha ma la sogs pa gnyen bshes kyi ming la/r+pā tā/ mā tā/ dza na pi ṭī/ pi tā ma haḥ/ pra pi tā ma haḥ( shā/ pi tā ma tī/pha ma ma mes po/ yang mes po/ phyi mo/pra pi tā ma tī/ pu traḥ/ du hi tā/ dz+reṣ+ṭha ⑪bhā tā⑦/ ka nī yo phy-ibhā tā⑥/ sgyu tā/ bha gi yang phyi mo/ bu/ bu mo/ phu bo/ nu bo/ spun/ che zhe'am 115—127

rī| nabhā/ nasnga/ shwa shu ①raḥ/ shwa ④sā/ mā ⑦tu laḥ/ bhārlu pat+t+waṃ ④sring mo'am phu nu mo'am sru/ tsha bo/ tsha mo/ gyos po/ sgyug mo/ zhang po/ chung dā rāḥka la tram̐/ mā dṛ shwa sā⑤/ pi z-i shwa sā/ sa pat+t+waṃ/ an+ta pu re/ ba dhū/ dzadza tī ma'am khyo mo/ sru mo/ ne+e ne+e mo/ chen chun/ btsun mo'i 'khor ram slas/ mna' ma/ khyo dadza tīX/ dā ra gaḥ⑦/ dā ri kā⑧/ ya ma la ⑨kaḥ/ dz+nyā tiḥ⑩/ swa dzā ⑪naḥ/ brtseḥ/shug /khye'u/ bu mo/ mtshe ma/ nye du/ gnyen 'dab/ rtsa lag /sā lo hi taḥ/ mi tram̐/ sa khā/ an+tardza naḥ⑫/ ta na yaḥ/snag gi gnyen mtshams sam pha'am rgan zhugs/ mdza' bshes/ grogs po/ nang mi/ bu/a gra ma hi shī/ na ba ba dhū()/ na raḥ/ nā rī(sre/ mā tro gā maḥ/btsun mo dam pa/ bag gsar ram mna' ma gsar pa/ skyes pa/ bud med/ bud med/pu mānu/ tā tāḥ⑫/ aswā⑩/ dh+wa ṭī/ rgyu gube+e bhā⑩/ ṛ tu ma tī ⑫rgyu//skyes pa'am pho/ yab bam jo jo/ yum mam za za⑪/ ma ma/ bud med sbrum ma/ zla mtshan dang ldan pa'i bud med/lus dang lus kyi yan lag la sogs pa'i ming la/kā yaḥ()sha rī re gā tram̐/ ka ḍi ba re/lus kyi ming 'di rnams 'dom na lus dang gzugs dang khog pa la sogs nye nyer gdags/0 lus/shi raḥ/ masta kaḥ/ masta ka k+shi shaṃ/ sprun+d+ra⑫/ ke shaḥ⑫/ shi ro ru ④haḥ/ mu kha maṇ+ḍa lo/mgo/ klad pa/ klad rgyas/ spyi bo/ skra/ skra/ bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor/ba kre⑫/ la ta/ ⑪ṭaḥ/ byu⑩ཿ/ pasmra⑫/ tā ra kaḥ/ mu khaṃ/ sre kwa rji⑥/zhal lam gdong ngam kha/ dpral ba/ smin ma/ mig gi rdzi ma/ mig gi 'bras bu/ kha/ kha'i grwa/115—128

tsi pu shaṃ/ gī bā/ ka po lo/ gaṇ+ḍaḥ①/ ha nuḥ du/ shaṃ khaḥ①/ dza ཿ④/ dan+taḥ/ tā luḥ/o skorjo/ mgrin pa/ mkhur ba/ mkhur tshosarjo/ 'gram pa/ mur 'gram/ thag 'gram/ so/ rkan/oṣ+ṭhaḥ—/ rda ṭīdze+e/ thra shuḥ/ kaṣ+ṭhaḥske/ kaṣ+ṭha nā li kā⑪/ kaṣ+ṭha ma ṇiḥ/ z-i ⑪ da yo/mchu—/ mche ba/ kha spu/ mgul pa(spre/ mid pa/ ol 'dudakṛtre/ snying /kṛ kā ṭi kā⑫/ hastaḥ/ saṃ shaḥ/ skarnyaḥ/ thrasgo/ dza truḥ/ bā hu shi kha re/ ka k+ṣaḥspyo/ltag pa/ lag pa/ phrag pa/ thal gong / rgyab/ nam 'tshong / dpung mgo/ mchan khung /bā huḥ/ kurba sker rka/ ma ṇi ban+dhaḥ⑫/ hasta thra kṛbye ṣ+ṭhamra/ saṃ gu liḥ/ saṃgudz+remra⑫/dpung pa/ gru mo/ 'khrig ma/ lag pa'i rgyab / sor mo/ mthe bo/tardza —⑪/ ma ṭ+wāṃ ⑥ gu liḥ/ a nā mi kā me/ ka nī ni kā 6/ ka niṣ+ṭha kā bu/ mujiḥ/mdzub mo/ gung mo/ srin lag /mthe'u chung / mthe'u chung / khu tshur/kha ṭa kaḥ④tsa pe ṭā ⑤/ na khaḥ/ hasta ta lo/ sarnyi⑩ཿ/muji dang ma 'dom na khu tshur 'dom na ltag dbyug thal lcag( ) /sen mo/ lag mthil/ tshigs/na ha ru3ཿ/ rtswa yuḥ ⑦/ shi rā⑪/ u raḥ/ pa yo dha raḥ/ sta naḥspyo// z-i da ya pra de shaḥ/chu ba/ rgyus pa/ rtsa/ brang ngam mthong ka / nu ma/ nu ma/ snying ga /u da re/ nā bhiḥ⑫/ nā bhi maṇ+ḍa lo/ bsteḥ/ dza gha rna/ tho ṇi thuḥ/ pe laḥ/ z-i kaḥ/lto ba/ lte ba/ lte ba khung / chu so'am mdoms④/ rked pa/ chu so'am sta stezur/ rlig pa/ mjug do/thraṣ+ṭha baṃ saḥ⑪/ pārnyi kaḥ/ pār+shaḥ⑩/ ka ṭiḥ/ bu liḥspyo/ m+bikra/ pā daḥ/ khru ru⑥ཿ/sgal tshigs/ rtsib ma/ rtsib dzustelogs/ rked pa/ rkub/ rkub tshos/ rkang pa/ brla/dzā nuḥ/ dza byanu maṇ+ḍa lo/ rdza ghāstso/ gube+eḥ/ pābyāḥ(ste/ pā da ta lo/ klo ma kaḥ/pus mo/ pus mo'i lha nga / rje ngar/ long bu/ rting pa/ rkang mthil/ glo ba/115—129

yu bā/ da hraḥ / yu ba ti / ku mā ri//lang tsho la bab pa/ dar la bab pa'am ①skyes phran/ na chung / gzhon nu ma/rgas pa dang na ba'i rnam pa'i ming la/kubyāḥ/ dz+re ṇ+ḍi ②tā/ ba lī pra tsu ra tā/ pā li h+ye/ daṇ+ḍa a baṣ+ṭi rngo )bha na tā 4)/sgur po/ 'khogs pa/ gnyer ma mang ba/ mgo skya/ 'khar ba la brten ⑤pa/khā li tram̐/ kā saḥ bu/ khu ru khu rā ba sak+ta kaṇ+ḍaḥspyo/ pāghā re ṇa kā ye na daṇ+ḍa ma spyi ther/ lud pa lu ba/ mgul sgra ngar ngar pos 'gags pa/ lus sgu bas 'khar ba la baṣ+ṭabhaḥ⑧—/ dha ma nī san+ta ta gā tram̐/ dzīṇ+ḍiḥ⑨/ z-idhaḥ⑩/ ma habe+e kaḥ/brten pa/ lus rtsa phyir 'thon pas khebs pa/ rgas pa'am rnying pa'am rnyis pa4spe/ rgan po/ nas ⑫gzer ba/ga ta yo ba naḥ⑫/ ba rta/ ⑫ni tsi ta kā yaḥ⑫/ bi bhusnaḥ/ ā ⑫tu raḥ⑫//dar yol ba'am phyed/ lus gnyer mas gang ba/ sgur ba/ nad pa'am na ba/yul gyi ming la/de bā ba tā raḥ/ bā rā ⑫ṇa sī/ be+e shā lī⑪/ pa ri nir+pā rde/ rā dza kṛ haṃ0/lha yul nas babs pa/ yul bā rā ṇa sī⑫/ yangs pa can/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa/ rgyal po'i khab/be rku ba dz+wa/ kau shasbyi ⑫/ shā bas+t+ri/ a nā tha paṇ+ḍa ⑪da myu rā maḥste/ dze ⑪ta 'od ma'i tshal/ kau sham+bi⑩/ mnyan yod/ mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba/ rgyal bu rgyal ba rna/ puṇ+ḍa badhe rgo/ bo dhi maṇ+ḍaḥ/ kṛn+d+ra kyu ( nyeṭa parba taḥ⑪/ ga ya shīr+ṣa⑫/byed kyi tshal/ li kha ra shing 'phel/ byang chub snying po/ bya rgod phung po'i ri/ ga ya mgo'i ⑪ri/snyu r+ṇa ()pa snyu r+ṇa gā mo()/ ka pi la bstu na ga re8ste/ ma thu rā/ shrī na lan+d+ra nye/ka ba dang nye ba'i ka ba'i grong / ser skya'i gnas kyi grong / btso blagazhe5 /dpal na len da/115———131

ma ga dhā①/ sha rā ba tīl/ lum+bi ①nī/ in+d+ra shi la gu hā/ ku sha na ga re/ u shī ma ga d+ma/ 'dam bu can/ lum be+e —/ dbang po'i brag phug④ /ku sha'i grong khyer/ u shi ra gi riḥ⑤/ udz+dzaya nī rjon ga rī⑦/ ka liṅgaḥske/ mṛ ga dā paḥ⑨/ ṛ ṣi ba da rgo/ra'i ri/ grong khyer 'phags rgyal/ ka ling ga() /ri dwags kyi gnas/ drang srong smra pa/ṛ ⑪ṣi pa ta dz+wa/ ko sa lā/ sā ke tapo⑫/ a brnyiḥ⑫/ tsaspra/ pa.ā+oṃ laḥ⑫/drang srong lhung ba/ ko sa la⑫/ gnas bcas/ srung ⑫byed/ tsam pa/ lnga len/a ṭa ka ba tī/ ka lan+da ka ni bā ṣa⑩ཿ//lcang lo can/ bya ka ⑫lan da ka gnas pa/ri'i ming la/ni mirnya raḥ/ a shwa kar+ṇaḥ/ su dar+sha naḥ/ kha di ra kaḥ/ i ṣā jo raḥ/mu khyud 'dzin/ rta rna()/ lta na sdug /seng ldeng can/ gshol mda' 'dzin/yu garnya raḥ/ bi na ta kaḥ/ me ruḥ/ su me ru parba ta rā dzā⑫/ tsakra bā ṭa⑥ཿ/gnya' shing 'dzin/ rnam par 'dud/ lhun po/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ khor ⑫yug /ma hā tsakra pā ḍaḥ/ garnya mā da naḥ/ hi ma bānu⑫/ kai khā saḥ/ po ta la kaḥ⑫/khor ⑫yug chen po/ spos kyi ngad ldan/ gangs can/ ti se'i gangs/ gru 'dzin/ma la yaḥ⑪/ bin+dhaphyuḥ/ bi bu ⑫la pār+shaḥ⑥/ be+e de ha ka parba taḥ/ su me ru pā ⑩ri ṣaṇ+ḍaḥ//ma la ya/ 'bigs byed/ ngos yangs/ lus 'phags pa'i ri/ ri rab kyi bang rim/rgya mtsho'i ming gi rnam grangs dang chu dang gling la sogs pa'i ming la/su ⑥mu draḥ/ sā ga raḥ⑫/ dza la dhiḥ/ ma hā ⑫r+ṇa baḥ④/ dza la ni dhiḥ/rgya mtsho/ dug can/ chu 'dzin/ chu chen/ chu gter/115—132

shā li ①ba rgo/ be ta saḥ/ na ḍa ba dz+wa/ sā la thrak+ṣaḥ/ nā ga thrak+ṣaḥ/ thrak+ṣa②ཿ/'bras kyi tshal/ lcang ma/ 'dam bu'i tshal/ shing sā la/ klu shing / ljon pa/tsabyuḥske/ dzā ④tiḥ/ pāṇ+ḍa ④pa khā shaḥ⑤/ shīr+ṇa rjopa khā shaḥ/ kaspyo kaḥ⑦/ tā laḥ/spyi mo/ sri ⑧shing sna ma/ lo ma ser/ 'dab ma lhags/ tsher ma/ shing ta ⑨la/la tā ⑩ba spyo/ ka rī raḥ//'khri shing ngam rdzug ma/ sbyig ma'i ldum bu/sngags kyi rgyud du 'byung ba'i ming la/tatram̐/ ut+ta ra tatram̐/ matram̐/ bibyā/ dhā thosprer tsā/ maṇ+ḍa laphra4)/ shāsnya rka/sngags kyi rgyud/ rgyud bla ma/ gsang sngags/ rig sngags/ gzungs sngags/ dkyil 'khor/ zhi ba/ā kar+ṣa r+ṇa/ poṣ+ṭi kaḥ/ ā bhi tsa ru kaḥ/ ba shī ⑫ka ra ṇaḥ/ ho maḥspyo/dgug pa/ rgyas pa/ drag shul spyod pa/ dbang du bya ba/ sbyin sreg /u pa tsā raḥ⑫/ bi dhiḥ⑩/ bi jo rna⑩/ kalpaḥ⑫/ dzā paḥ/bya ba'i cho ga'am yo byad ces skabs dang sbyar/ cho ga /cho ga zhib mo⑪/ cho ga zhib mo/ bzlas brngod/ho mo pa ka ra r+ṇaḥ/ ā hu ⑫ti dra bye/ ho tā/ ha ba rgo⑪/ dzu ha ⑪yā tu/ a rnyi sbyin sreg gi yo byad/ sreg blugs ⑫kyi rdzas/ sbyin sreg byed pa/ bsreg ⑫pa/ sbyin sreg bya'o/ /dbang ṣe kaḥ⑫/ a rnyi ṣik+taḥ/ a bā ha dz+wa⑪/ ā kar+ṣa ṇi/ bi sardza dz+wa/ brnya dz+wa⑪/bskur ba/ dbang bskur ba/ spyan drangs pa/ dgug pa/ slar gshegs su gsol ba/ bcing ba/utsā ṭa rna/ garbaḥ⑫/ a dhijo rgo/ man+t+ra tsar+yā/ ā lī ḍho/ pra t+yā ⑥lī ḍho/dgar ⑩ba/ bsnyems pa'i tshul/ byin rlabs⑥/ sngags kyi spyod pa/ g.yas brkyang / g.yon brkyang /115—134

pra se rna/ sirnyiḥ/ ma:①/ bi byā dha (kyeraḥ/ sā bye )/ sā dha kaḥ/ ut+ta ra gsal snang / dngos grub/ sngags pa/ rig sngags 'chang / bsgrub bya/ sgrub pa po/ sgrub pa'i sā dha kaḥ④/ e ka dzā ṭī/ mā ma tī/ spru —ṭa ⑤kaḥ/ budha lo tsa nā/ paṇ+ḍa ra bā si nī/grogs mchog /ral gcig ma/ bdag gi ma/ gtsug spyod/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan/ gos dkar can/tā rā/ badz+ra rjoz-i ku ṭi⑦ཿ/ ār+ya z-i ku ṭiḥ⑧/ badzāsru dzā⑨/ badzād+ku shī/sgrol ma/ khro gnyer can/ 'phags ma khro gnyer can/ rdo rje pad+ma/ rdo rje lcags kyu/o dzaḥpra t+yā hā ⑩ri bhā/ hā sa pa ⑪tī/ rah+pholbā/ ā dhā ⑫ra bhā/ sa man+ta bha dā/so sor mdangs 'phrog ma/ bzhad ⑫ldan ma/ rin chen sgron ⑫ma/ kun 'dzin ma/ kun du bzang mo/ra ti rā gā/ badz+ra dhā ⑫tī shwa rī/ sarba tsakrā/ ra1t+ta mā/dga' ba'i 'dod chags ma⑩/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ 'khor lo thams cad ma/ mchog gi rin chen ma/ sā ha sru ba1⑩/ sā byu ma tī/ sirnyot+ta mā⑫/ dhā ⑪ra bhā mu dā/ badz+ra sa twa stong 'khyil ma/ legs pa'i blo gros ma/ grub mchog ma/ gzungs kyi phyag rgya ma/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dz+nyā na mu dru/ ma hā tuṣ+ṭi dz+nyā na mu dru/ ma hā pra bhā ()maṇ+ḍa la byu (7ha ye shes kyi phyag rgya⑫/ dgyes pa chen po'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ 'od chen po'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i ye dz+nyā na mu dru()/ sarba dhan+d+ra (stes ma tā dz+nyā na mu dā/ sarba ta thā ga tā nu rā shes kyi phyag rgya/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes ga ṇa ⑫dz+nyā na mu drwa/ ma hā t+pā ti be+e ga sam+bha ba dz+nyā na mu dru/ sarba ta par byed pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ dga' ba'i shugs chen po 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ de bzhin thā ga tā shā pa ri pū ra ṇa tshwa na mu drwa/ sarba ta thā ga ta gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sa ma yā dhi jo na dz+nyā na mu drwa/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba dzā 'dus pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyi ⑪ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dbang 115———135

bhi ṣe ka dz+nyā na mu dru/ sarba ta thā ga ta pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na mu dru/ sarba bskur ba'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ de ta thā ga ta dharma bāldi n+d+rapañtsa dz+nyā na mu dā/ ma hā tsakra pra bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi tshig spros pa med pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ 'khor lo chen por ①'jug be ②sha dz+nyā na mu dā/ sarba ta thā ga ta bi shwa kabyu ①dz+nyā na mu dā/ du pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las sna tshogs kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ 'thab ra yo ④dha na bīr+ya rjodz+nyā na mu dru/ sarba mā ra maṇ+ḍa la bi dh+wa6 na dka' ba'i brtson 'grus kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i dz+nyā na mu dru/ sarba ta thā ga ta brnya dun dz+nyā na mu dru/ sarba ta thā ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdams pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ de bzhin gshegs pa ga ta su ra ta su khā/ sarba ta thāg tā kar+ṣa dze+etsā/ sarba ta thams cad kyi dgyes pa mchog gi bde ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren masge/ de bzhin thā ga tā nu rā ga tsā/ sarba ta thā ga ta sarnyo ṣa rtswa⑨/ ma hā dhi pa tī⑩/gshegs pa thams cad mnyes byed ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgyes byed ma/ bdag mo chen mo/ma hā byo tā/ ma hā rat+na bar+ṣa/ ma hā t+pā ti har+ṣa/ ma hā dz+nyā na gri tā/gsal ⑪byed chen mo/ rin chen char 'bebs ma⑫/ dga' ba chen pos tshim pa/ ye shes chen po'i glu dbyangs/ma hā snyo ṣā ⑫nu gā/ garnya ba tre+e⑫/ ma hā po rgyaṅga ba tre+e/ tsak+ṣuṣ+ṭha tī⑫/ satwa ba tī/sgra chen po'i rjes su 'jug ma/ spos ⑩ldan ma/ byang chub yan lag che ldan/ mig ldan ma/ snying stobs ldan/sum+bhaḥ—/ ni sum+bhaḥ/ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa le/ dzam+bha laḥ⑩/ udz+ra ṣ+pe⑫/ ār+ya gnod mdzes/ nges par gnod mdzes/ bdud rtsi'i ⑪thab sbyor/ rmug ⑥'dzin/ 'chol pa/ 'phags pa ⑪ya mān+ta kaḥ⑫/ shaṃ ka raḥ⑫/ pi nā tī/ bai ⑫ba shwa tī/ gu h+ya kā rnyi pa tiḥ⑫/gshin rje sel/ bde ()byed/ gzhi thogs/ nyi ma'i bu/ gsang ba'i bdag po/115—136

byo ti ṣe①/ swa s+thā dh+yā ②yaḥ/ sha ku na ru tai/ biṣ+ṭiḥ①/ bya tī pā taḥ/ ut+pā taḥ/skar ma'i yi ge/ mi ltas kyi spyad/ bya skad kyi brda/ 'jug phod/ rnam par nyung byed/ ltas su 'byung ba/ a riṭaṃrjo/ laghā/ yo gaḥ/ daṇ+ḍa bhā saḥ⑤//'chi ltas/ dus 'byor ba/ sbyor ba/ breng nger snang ba/tshad ma dang rtog ge pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i ming la/tat+tha t+ya khyo pa ladhi lak+ṣa rde/ ta dā shri ta pra t+ya k+ko pa labhi dulak+ṣa r+ṇa/de mngon sum du dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la gnas ⑦pa mngon sum du dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/swa khrudzā ṭī ya dṛṣ+ṭarnyo ⑨pa saṃ hā ra lak+ṣa rde/ pa ri niṣ+pen+da lak+ṣa ṇi/ su bi shud+dhā spyorang gi rigs kyi dpe nye bar sbyar ba'i mtshan nyid/ yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid/ lung shin tu rnam par ga mo pa de sha lak+ṣa rde/ ta da n+ya sā rū pyo pa ⑪lasgo lak+ṣa rde/ ta da n+ya dag pas gtan la dbab pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gzhan dang mthun par dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gzhan bai rū pyo ba ladhi ⑫lak+ṣa rde/ sarba sā rū pyo spyopa lasgo lak+ṣa rde⑫/ sarba dang mi mthun par dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ thams cad mthun par dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ thams bai rū pyo pa ladhi lak+ṣa khaṃ/ a n+ya dzā tī ya dṛṭ+wādho thosmepa saṃ hā ra lak+ṣa rde/ a cad mi mthun par dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhan gyi rigs kyi dpe nye bar sbyar ba'i mtshan nyid/ yongs pa ri nibe+en+da ⑩lak+ṣa r+ṇaḥ⑩/ a bi shud+dhā ga mo ⑫pa de sha lak+ṣa rde/ tarkaḥ⑪/ tārki su ma grub pa'i mtshan nyid/ lung rnam par ma dag pa bstan pa'i mtshan nyid/ rtog ge/ rtog ge kaḥske/ pra t+ya k+ṣamra⑪/ a nu mā naphra/ ā ga maḥ/ u pa panyiḥ/ he tuḥ⑥/pa/ mngon sum⑫/ rjes su dpag pa/ lung / 'thad pa'am gtan tshigs/ gtan tshigs/a na yaḥ/ bya ti re kaḥ/ a sidhaḥ/ bi rudhaḥ/ a ne+e kārnyi kaḥ/ dṛṣ+ṭan+taḥ/rjes su 'gro ba/ ldog pa/ ma grub pa/ 'gal ba/ ma nges pa/ dpe/115—138

dṛṣ+ṭiḥ①| dṛṣ+ṭi saṃ ka ṭaḥ②/ dṛji kṛ lta/ dṛji ga tai/ /ngan pa/ lta ba yang ba/ lta bar gyur snepa'am lta bar byas pa/ lta ba'i rnam pa'am lta bar gyur pa/lung du ma bstan pa'i chos bcu bzhi'i ming la/shā shwa to lo kaḥrjo/ a shā shwa to lo kaḥ⑤/ shā shwa tash+tsa shā rjoshwa tash+tsa/ ne+e ba shā shwa 'jig rten rtag /'jig rten mi rtag /⑦rtag kyang rtag la mi rtag kyang mi rtag⑧ /rtag pa yang ma tash+tsa na shā shwa tabyu/ an+ta ṭ+wāṃ lo kaḥ/⑨ sa nan+ta ṭ+wāṃ ()lo kaḥ/ an+ta ṭ+wāṃ yin mi rtag pa yang ma yin/'jig rten mtha' yod pa/ 'jig rten mtha' yod pa ma ⑩yin pa⑫/mtha' yod sh+tsa a nan+ta ṭ+wāṃ sh+tsatu)/ ne+e bān+ta ṭ+wāṃ sh+tsa a nan+ta ṭ+wāṃ sh+tsatuste/ bha ba ti ta thā ga taḥpa kyang yod la mtha' med kyang med/ mtha' yod pa yang ma yin med pa yang ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa rasma ra ḍātuspyo/ na bha ba ti ta thā ga taḥpa rasma ra ḍāt+pa⑩/ bha ba ti tsa na bha ba shi nas yod/ de bzhin gshegs pa shi nas med/ de bzhin gshegs pa shi ti tsa ta thā ga taḥpa rasma ra ṇ+ḍatu⑩/ ne+e ba bha ba ti tsa ⑫na bha ba ti tsa ⑪ta thā ga nas yod kyang yod la med kyang med/ de bzhin gshegs pa shi nas yod pa yang ma yin med pa taḥpa rasma ra ṇatu⑪/ sa dzī ⑫bsta ts+tsha rī re/ a byo dzī bolhan+ya ⑫ts+tsha rī re⑫//yang ma yin/ srog de lus de yin/ srog kyang gzhan la lus kyang gzhan/mu stegs can gyi bdag tu brjod pa'i ming la ān+d+ra④/ sa twaḥ/ dzī baḥ⑫/ dzan+tuḥ/ po ṣaḥ/ pu ru ṣaḥ/ puṅga laḥ/ ma nu dzaḥ/bdag /sems can/ srog /skye ba po/ gso ba/ skyes bu/ gang zag /shed ⑪las skyes/mā ⑫na baḥ/ kā ra kaḥ/ kā ⑫rā pa kaḥ/ be+e da kaḥ/ dzā na ka⑥/ pa sh+ya kaḥ/shed bu/ byed pa po/ byed du 'jug pa po/ tshor ba po/ shes pa po/ mthong ba po/115—144

ut+pā ①pa kaḥ/ sa mubhe ba kaḥ//slong ba po/ kun nas slong ba po/'jig tshogs la lta ba nyi shu'i ming la/bo ②sha ti shi kha ra sa muṅga taḥsaṭ+wā ya dṛṣ+ṭi shi laḥ①/ rū ba dhimā1 swā spyomi bat+pa/'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba/ bdag gzugs yin te bdag po dang 'dra/rū pa bā nān+d+ranya laṅgā dhir btu/ āsbyi ⑦yi rū paṃ z-i t+ya btu/ rū pe ān+d+ra ⑧bdag gzugs dang ldan te rgyan dang 'dra/ gzugs bdag gi yin te bran dang 'dra/ gzugs la bdag ⑨bhā dza na bat+pa/ be da nās+thā/ be+e da nā bā nā1⑩/ ād+dhi yā be da nā/⑪ be gnas te sgod dang 'dra/ bdag tshor ba yin/ bdag tshor ba dang ldan/ tshor ba bdag gi yin/ tshor da nā yā mā1tho)/ saṃ dz+nyā1()/ saṃ dz+nyā bā nā1tsuste/ ādri thonyeyā saṃ dz+nyā/ saṃ ()ba la bdag gnas/ bdag 'du shes yin/ bdag 'du shes dang ldan/ 'du shes bdag gi yin/ 'du dz+nyā yā mān+d+ra/ saṃ sku rā ān+d+ratho)/ ()ādri yāḥsaṃ sku rāḥ()/ saṃ ska re ṭī1/shes la bdag gnas/ 'du byed bdag yin/⑩ 'du byed bdag gi yin/ 'du byed la bdag gnas/bi dz+nyā na mās+thā⑥/ bi dz+nyā na bā māt+tha⑫/ ādri 3yi bi dz+nyā rna/ bi dz+nyā bdag rnam par shes pa yin/ bdag rnam par shes pa dang ldan/ rnam par shes pa bdag gi yin/ rnam par ne+e āt+na④/ /shes pa la bdag ⑫gnas/byu ka ra ṇa'i skad kyi ming la/smu tram̐/ jo tuḥ/ ni pā taḥ/ a nā ⑪khyu rgo/ u pa sargaḥ/ bā kyo ⑪pa myu saḥ/mdor byas pa⑫/ skad kyi dbyingasaspyo/ tshig gi phrad/ rjes su bshad pa/ nye bar bsgyur ba/ tshig gi lhad/115—145

u pa ①saṃ khyu dz+waḥ/ sa mā saḥ①/ sa mastaḥ/ karma/ bhā baḥ①/ saṃ skṛ haṃ/ pā ④kṛ tshig kha skong ba/ tshig sdud pa/⑤ tshig bsdus pa/ las/ dngos/ legs par sbyar ba/ tha mal tai—/ a pa rja shaḥ/ bai rjoshā tsi kaḥ/ kri ④yā pa rda/ a na bas+thā pra saṃ gaḥ/ a ti pra pa / zur chag pa/ sha za'i skad/ byed pa'i tshig /thug pa med par 'gyur⑧/ thal ches par saṅgaḥ—/ pra saṃ gaḥbra sa bye te/ bi gra haḥ/ dwan+d+raḥ/ ju stiguḥ/ takhru ru ṣaḥ/'gyur/ thal bar 'gyur/ tshig rnam par sbyar ba/ zlas dbye ba/ ba gnyis pa/ de'i skyes bu/pa hu bye hiḥ/ a byā yī ⑩bhā baḥ⑪/ karma dhā ra yaḥ/ sa mā nā dhi ka ra ṇaḥ/ kā ra kaḥ/'bru mang po/ zad par mi 'gyur ba/ las 'dzin pa/ gzhi mthun pa/ byed pa/pra tha ma pu ru ṣaḥ⑫/ ma dh+ya ma pu ru ṣaḥ/ ut+ta ma pu ru ṣaḥ⑫//skyes bu dang po/ skyes bu bar ma/ skyes bu mchog /rnam par dbye ba'i tshig bdun gyi ming la/z-i k+ṣaḥ/ thra k+ṣiṃ⑫/ z-i k+ṣuḥspyo/ bṛ k+ṣ-i/ thra k+ṣiṃ/ dṛ k+ṣun/ thra k+ṣe ṇa/ thra k+ṣu ṭ+wāṃ⑫/shing / shing dag /shing rnams/ shing la/ shing dag la/ shing rnams la/ shing gis/ shing dag gis/thra k+ṣeḥ⑩/ thra k+ṣu ⑫ya/ dṛ k+ṣu rgyu/ thra k+ṣe bh+yaḥ⑪/ bṛ k+ṣut+pa⑪/ thra k+ṣu spyo⑪/shing rnams kyis/ shing gi phyir/ shing dag gi phyir/ shing rnams kyi phyir/ shing las/ shing dag las/bṛ k+ṣe bh+yaḥ⑫/ dza k+ṣa gya/ thra k+ṣa yoḥ/ thra k+ṣu rde⑫/ thra k+ṣe/ z-i k+ṣa ④yoḥ/ thra k+ṣe ⑫6//shing rnams las/ shing gi/ shing dag gi/ shing rnams kyi/ shing la/ shing dag la/ shing rnams la/ngan 'gro'i ming la/durga tiḥ⑪/ a pā yaḥ⑩/ bi ni pā taḥ/ na ra kaḥ⑫/ ya ma lo kaḥ⑥/ngan 'gro/ ngan song / log par ltung ba/ dmyal ba/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten/115—146

pi z-i bi ṣa yaḥ①/ tir+ya gyo ②ni ga taḥsne//yi dwags kyi yul/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'am skyes pa④/yi dwags su gtogs pa'i ming la/pre taḥ/ kum+bhaṇ+ḍaḥ⑤/ pi shā tsaḥrjo/ bhū taḥ/ pū ta naḥ⑦/ ka ṭa pū ta naḥ⑧/yi dwags/ grul bum/ sha za/ 'byung po/ srul po/ lus srul po/yi daḥ/ skan+daḥ/ a pas+thā raḥ/ tshwa yā/ rāk+ṣa ⑨saḥ/ re ba tī gra hā/ sha ku ni gra ha⑩/smyo byed/ skem byed/ brjed byed/ grib gnon/ srin po/ nam gru'i gdon/ bya'i gdon/brah+pha rāk+ṣa saḥ⑪//bram ze'i srin po⑫/dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa'i ming la/dzi ha dzā ne+e yaḥ⑫/ i ⑫rā ba ṇa ha steḥ/ hasgyu spyodzā ne+e yaḥ/ kan+d+ra ⑩kaḥ/seng ge cang shes/ glang po che sa srung gi bu/ glang po che cang shes/ bsngags tho)ldan/a shā spyodzā ne+e yaḥ/ ba ⑪khā ha kā shwa rā dzā/ shā ⑫pa daḥ/ dzi ⑩haḥ/ shā rtul⑫/ byā gh+raḥ /rta cang shes/ rta'i rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can/ gcan gzan/ seng ge/ stag/0 stag gzig/④dī spru/ rīk+ṣaḥ/ bhakhru kaḥ⑫/ tar kyuḥ/ z-i ⑪kaḥ/ mṛgā laḥ ⑦/ bhe ru ṇa kaḥ⑫/gung / dom/ dom/ dred/ spyang ki/ ce spyang / ce spyang /lo mā shī/ kroṣ+ṭa kaḥ/ sre gā laḥ/ bi ḍā laḥ/ māsbyo ra⑪ཿ/ na ku laḥ/ mṛ gaḥ/wa / wa/ wa/ bye la / byi la / de'u le'am sre mong / ri dwags/gaṇ+ḍaḥ—/ ba rā haḥ/ ā ⑫ra 5 ba rā haḥ/ ha ri ṇaḥ/ go ra kha raḥ/ gho bse/ phag rgod dam phag /phag rgod/ sha bkra/ rkyang / rta 115—147

ḍa ①ka mṛ gaḥ②/ sha ra bhaḥsne/ sha shaḥ/ pa shuḥ④/ hañtsā/ kuṇ+ḍa raḥ/ ka ri bhā/ ke re khuḥ/rgod/ ldang rjoko ska bse kha skorjo/ ri bong / phyugs/ glang po che/ ba lang/ ba glang mo/ ba lang mo/a shra④ཿ/ tu ram̐ kaḥ⑧/ ha yaḥ/ ba ḍa bā/ uṣ+ṭaḥ/ tsa ma raḥ/ goḥ/rta/ rta/ rta/ rta rgod ma/ rnga mong ⑨/ g.yag /ba lang /ba li ⑩brdaḥ/ ma hi ṣaḥ/ be+e ga sa raḥ/ garda bhaḥ/ a shwatarī/ kar bhaḥ/ ki sho raḥ/glang / ma ho/ dre'u/ bong bu/ bong bu/ che'u/ rte'u/ka la bhaḥ/ ga dza po taḥ/ sru ka raḥ/ e ḍa kaḥ/ u ra bluḥ/ ts+tsha ga laḥ/ a dzaḥ/ba lang gi phrug gu/ ba lang gi phrug gu/ phag /tha/ga /lug /⑪ra/pā ⑫ṇa kaḥ/ bā na raḥ/ marka ṭaḥ/ ka pi raḥ/ rū ṣaḥ⑫/ shi shu mā raḥ④/srog chags/ spre'u/ spre'u/ spre'u/ byi ba / chu srin byis pa gsod/ma skeka raḥ/ gā haḥ/ kutwe raḥ/ na kraḥ/ kyurma⑩ཿ/ u draḥ/ maṣ+ṭhaḥ/ sarba⑩ཿ/chu srin/ chu srin 'dzin khri/ chu srin kusnyi ()ra/ chu srin na kra/ rus sbal/ sram/ nya/ sgrul/byā ḍaḥ/ u ra gaḥ/ pan+d+ra gaḥ/ bṛsh+yi ⑪kaḥ/ kṛ ka lā saḥ/ sa rī mṛ ⑥paḥ/ kṛ miḥ/sbrul| sbrul/ klu'am sbrul/ sdig pa/ rtsangs pa/ sdig sgrul/ srin bu/ma sha kaḥ/ rda shaḥ/ ko sha kā ra kri ṭā0/ kun+taḥ/ pi spru li kā/ blu ma raḥ/sbrang bu mchu rings/ sha sbrang / dar gyi srin bu/ srin bu phre'u/ grog ma'am grog sbur/ bung ba/marja kaḥ/ dza lū kaḥ/ kha byo ta kaḥ/ pa tai kaḥ/ u pā duḥ/ ut+pa ta kaḥ/sbal pa/ srin bu pad sgo)pa/ srin bu me khyer/ bye ma leb/ lji ba/ khyi shig /tre+e khā ṭaḥ/ rgyasru ⑫kaḥ/ dhū ⑫k+ṣaḥ/ ko kaḥ/ yu kaḥ/sbrang bu tre+e la ṭa/ sbrang bu ju ⑫ma bu ka /spyi rdol ⑪can nam khu'am bya rog /srog chags —ko ka'am mtsha' —tsam+bi/ shig /115—148

lik+ṣu①ske/ in+d+ra go baḥ/ ka la dzi kaḥ/ paspyi①/ bi ha ka①ཿ/ tsa ṭa kaḥ/ su paṇiḥ/sro ma/ lham bu chu gsher/ bya ka la thang ka /bya/ bya/ byi'u/ ga ru ḍa dang 'dom na 'dab bzang /badz+nyā se khri/ ma yu ④raḥ/ dzī paṃ jo ⑤ba kaḥ/ gre dh+raḥ/ tsā shaḥ/ shu kaḥ/rma bya/ rma bya/ shang shang te'u/ bya rgod/ bya tsa rjosha /ne+e tso/ku ⑦rngo laḥ/ rā dza ⑧haṃ saḥ/ dh+warta rāt+tha⑨ཿ/ haṃ saḥ/ kroñtsa⑩ཿ/ tsakra bā kaḥ/bya ku na thosprel/ ngang pa'i rgyal po/ ngang skya/ ngang mo/ khrung khrung / ngur pa/sā ra a⑫ཿ/ shā ri kaḥ⑫/ ko ki laḥ④/ ba kaḥ/ ba 'a/ kaḥ/ titi riḥ/ ka piñdza ⑫bzhad/ ri skegs/ khu byug /bya gar⑩/ chu skyar/ sreg pa/ gong ma laḥske/ kra ka raḥ/ kaṅgā ⑩raḥ/ tsa ko raḥ/ u lū kaḥ/ dro ṇa kā kaḥ/ kā kaḥ/sreg /bya bang / bya bang / bya tsa ko ra/ 'ug pa/ bya rog /kha/ba ⑫ya saḥ/ ka po taḥ/ pā rā ba ⑪taḥ/ pa de ⑫kaḥ/ be+e ⑪naḥ/ kuklu ṭaḥ/khā()/ thi ba/ phug ron/ khra/ sde( )/ khyim bya/tsibe+eḥ / tsā ta kaḥ/ pak+ṣa gup+taḥ/ ka rda baḥ/( ste pā ṇa ka dzā taḥ/'ol ba/ khug rta/ bya'i ming ste pakhri dang 'dom na 'dab skyod ces gdags/ thing ril/⑫ srog chags su gyur pa/kuklu ⑪raḥshān/ khañdzaṅka⑫ཿ/ kā raṇ+ḍa baḥ/ ti ṭī laḥ/ tsarma pa ⑫ṭa kaḥ/ ṭī rī/khyi/ ba mo bye'u/ bya ka ran da ba/ pha wang / pha wang / tshad pa'i/si lī/ pra ⑪ṇi byu taḥ/ dī pi kaḥ//byi'u| srog chags su gyur pa'am ⑥srog chags 'byung ba/ sril lam ⑪mug pa/sems can dbyul ba dang bcad cing gtub pa la sogs pa'i ming las tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba'i ming la/saṃ dzī baḥ/ kā la sru tramra/ sar+sā ⑫taḥ/ ro ra ⑫baḥ/ ma hā ro ra baḥ⑫/yang sos/ thig nag /bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/115byed149

tā pa naḥ/ pra tā pa ①naḥ/ a bī tsisaḥ//tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med po/grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba'i ming la/arbu daḥ/ nidra bud①ཿ/ a ṭa ṭaḥ/ ha ha baḥ/ hu hu baḥ/ ut+pa laḥ/chu bur can/ chu bur rdolarjo/ so tham tham pa/ kyi hud zer/ a chu zer/ ut+pal ltar gas pa/pad+maḥ—/ ma hā pad+maḥ⑤/ kuklu rjolapo/ ku ṇa pamra⑦/ kyu ra jo rā⑧/ a si dh+wa rā⑨/pad+ma ltar gas pa/ pad+ma ltar gas pa chen po/ me ma mur/ ro myags⑩/ spu gri'i so/ ral gri'i so/a yaḥ⑪shasma li ba namra⑫/ a si bat+tha ⑫ba namra④/ a yo gu ṭaḥ/ pra t+yā ⑫ka lcags kyi shal ma ri'i nags/ lo ma ral gri lta bu'i nagasatho9/ lcags kyi thu lum/ nyi tshe'i sems na ra kaḥ/ saṃ khyu ⑩r+ya te/ rnyin+darnyi/ bi shīr+ya te/ n+yad+ku ṭa nā ma pā bhā/ a yastuṇ+ḍa can dmyal ba/ gcod/ 'bigs/ zhigs par 'gyur ba'am snyil ba/ 'bu mchu rnon zhes bya ba/ khu lcags nā mā no bā ya saḥtsu)/ masta rka nirmi kharnyi/ asto ()swa ram̐ kran+da kyi mchu zhes bya ba/ klad rgyas 'thog ⑫pa/ nyam thag pa'i nga ro 'byin pa'am 'o dod ⑥'bod pa'am cho ti / d+ma ba ti//nges 'debs pa/ rgyug /rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad kyi ming la/ garnyazaḥ/ bai shi rka⑫/ bāṭ+wā/ māṃ ⑫khyu/ shazaḥ/ tsi kit+t+waṃ ④haṃ/ rī tiḥ/rol mo/ 'khrig thabs/ 'tsho tshis/ grangs can/ sgra/ gso dpyad⑫/ chos lugs/shidze+e / dha nu be phyudaḥ/ he tuḥ/ yo gaḥ/ shā ⑩tiḥ/ smṛ tiḥ/ byo ti ṣe⑫/bzo/ 'phong ⑫dpyad/ gtan tshigs/ rnal 'byor/ thos pa/ dran pa/ skar ma'i dpyad⑩/115—150

ga ṇi lta/ mā yā/ pu rā rde①/ i ti ②hā sa kai④//rtsis/ mig 'phrul/ sngon gyi rabs/ sngon byung ba/bzo'i gnas dang sgyu rtsal la sogs pa'i ming la/ka lā/ li piḥ④/ mu dru/ saṃ khyu/ ga ṇa nā/ muṣ+ṭi ban dhaḥ⑤/ shi khā brnyaḥ/sgyu rtsal/ yi ge/ lag rtsis/ grangs can/ rtsis/ 'dzin stangs/ thor tshugs/pā dud brnyaḥ/ ⑦e ku sha gra haḥ⑧/ sā ⑨ro/ pā sha gra haḥ⑩/ to ma ra gra haḥ⑪/gom stabs/ lcags kyus bsgyur thabs/ ral gri'i thabs/ zhags pa gdab pa/ mda' bo che 'phen thabs/ iṣ+ṭha rtswatsār+yaḥ()/ nir+yā rde/ a pa yā rgo/ ts+tsha bye/ bhe bye/ be ju/ 'phong gi ⑫slob dpon/ mdun du snur ④ba/ phyir snur spyob/ gcad pa/ dral ba/ dbug pa/dru ra be dhaḥ/ shwaja be dhaḥ/ marma be ⑩dhaḥ/ agru ṇa be dhaḥ/rgyang nas phog pa⑩/ sgra grags par 'phog ⑫pa/ gnad du 'phog spyopa/ mi 'chor bar 'phog ⑥pa/dṛ ⑪bhā pra hā ri tā/ pañtsa su s+thā ne+e 6 kṛ tā bi 3saṃ thrat+taḥ/ lo ghi tai/ sā ⑪lo bhaḥ/tshabs che ba/ gnas lnga la byang bar gyur to/ mchongs (stepa/ gyad kyi 'dzin stangs/dza ⑫bi lta⑪/ bla bi tai/ ta ra rja/ haste ⑩shrī bā/ a shwa dṛṣ+ṭha⑫ཿ/ ra thaḥ/bang / rkyal⑥ / rgal ba / glang po che'i gnyar bzhon pa⑫/ rta la bzhon 0pa/ shing rta'i thabs⑫/dha nu ska la ṣa⑫/ // hu byā lha/ maḥ④//mda' gzhu/ 'gyed stobs/rol mo'i cha byad kyi ming la/narta kaḥ/ na ṭaḥ⑫/ bhe rī/ z-i daṅgā/ rdu ⑪du bhiḥ/ mu ra dzā⑥/ pa ṇa baḥ/gar mkhan nam bro mkhan/ gar ram bro/ rnga bo che/ rdza rnga/ rnga/ rdza rnga chen po/ 'khar rnga/115—151

tu na ①baḥ/ dzhadzha rī④/ dzhal+la rīkru / sha myu④/ babe+e rīdhi/pi wang ⑥rgyud gcig pa/ rdza rnga kha gcig /lcags kyi sil khrol/ khar dkrol/ pi wang ⑦rgyud gsum pa/mu kun+daḥpo7/ tur+yamraspu/ saṃ gī tiḥ⑫ / tā ḍā ba tsa raḥ/ bā bye⑪/ bī ṇa/ baṃ saḥ//rnga mu kun dashāshe/ sil snyan/ glu dbyangs/ pheg rdob pa/ rol mo'i sgra/ pi wang lho)/ gling bu/glu dbyangs kyi ming la/ma dh+yā maḥ④/ ṛ ṣa bhaḥ/ gān+t+ra ⑩raḥ/ ṣadz+dzaḥ⑩/ pañtsa maḥ/ bye ⑩ba taḥ/bar ma/ drang srong / sa 'dzin pa⑫/ drug ldan pa/ lnga pa/ blo gsal/ni ṣā daskeḥ//'khor nyan/gar thabs kyi rnam grangs kyi ming la/shri pya gā raḥ/ bī raḥ/ bī bhat+maḥ ⑰/ ro dro/ hā supo me/steg 5 ) pa'am sgeg pa'am 'dzin pa/ dpa' bo/mi sdug pa/ drag shul can/ bzhad ④gad/bha yā na kaḥspyo/ ka ru rja/ abyu tai⑩/ shān+taḥ/ tāṇ+ḍa ⑦baḥ//'jigs su rung ba/ snying rje ba/ brngams pa/ zhi ba/ gar/bram ze'i gtsug lag dang las kyi ming la/ṛ sbedaḥ/ ya dzu rbe daḥd she/ sā ma be+e daḥspyo/ a tharba be+e daḥ/nges brjod kyi rig byed/ mchod sbyin gyi rig byed/ snyan tshig gi rig byed/ srid srung ⑪gi rig byed/115—152

ni ghar+bhaḥ①/ kai ṭa bhaḥ/ ā ②yurbe daḥ/ bāstu bit+yā/ aṅga ma ṇi bit+yā/sgra nges par brjod pa/ shes gsal/ tshe'i rig byed/ khyim sa brtags ①pa'i dpyad/ sha mtshan gyi dpyad/pi spyo sgyu yaḥ/ bā ya sa bibyā④/ sha ku na bibyā⑤/ byo rjotibe+ebyā/ sa mu dra lak+ṣa khaṃ/sme ba'i dpyad/ kha skad shes pa/ la nye'am ltas kyi rig pa/ skar ma'i rig pa/ rgya mtsho'i mtshan gyi spyad⑦/a shwa me ⑧dha ya dz+nyā⑨/ pu ru ṣa me dha ya dz+nyā/ ya dz+nyā iṣ+ṭaḥ//rta gtsang gi mchod sbyin/ mi gtsang gi ⑩mchod sbyin/ mchod sbyin byas/bram ze'i las rnam pa drug gi ming la/ya dza dz+wa/ yā dza rna/ a rgya ya rna/ adh+yā ⑪ya rgo/ dā rgo/ pra ti gra haḥ//mchod sbyin/mchod sbyin byed du 'jug pa/tshig 'don pa/tshig 'don du 'jug pa/ sbyin pa/len pa/skad go mthun gyi ming la/a de shaṃ/ brgaḥ/ ni tsa yaḥ/ be+e bye se nā/ yu ⑫gaḥ/du ma/ sde'am ⑫tshan nam tshogs/ mang po'am phal po che'am phung po/ sde'am dmag /mang po/ga ṇaḥ/ saṃ ghaḥ(ste/ dṛn+daḥ(nye/ bhū yiṣ+ṭhaḥ/ saṃ tshogs/ dge 'dun nam mang po'am tshogs/ tshogs sam khyu'am 'dus pa/ mang du'am phal ⑩cher/ grangs khyu ma piḥ/ ka khā ma pi/ ga ṇa nā ma pi/ u pa mā ⑩ma pi/ u pa ni ṣa da ma pi/ no su yang / char yang / bgrang bar yang / dper yang / rgyur yang / mi ()phod dam bai ti/ nak+ṣa ma te⑪/ laspyoḥ/ se nā ka ()thā/ kaṇ+ḍa rūrnya ⑪mu nye bar mi 'gro ba'am mi chog /mi bzod/ 'ben/ dmag gi gtam/ mda' gnam rgyang du 'phangs pa'am 115—153

khaṃ k+shiste/ swargo pa gaḥ/ gats+tsha ti/ ā gartso ①ti/ ā ga ma nirga mo②/mda' rtse mo gyen du bstan te 'phangs pa/ mtho ris su 'gro ba/ 'gro/ 'ong / 'ong ba dang 'gro ba/pra ti kra ma ti/ a bhi kra ma ti/ a pra kyu dā bsto rī yaḥ/ a pra kra mi ta phyir sdog ①pa/ mngon du 'ong ngam 'ong / phyir bzlog tu mi rung ba/ nur ba'am phyir 'gyed par bya byeske/ san+ni kṛṣ+ṭaḥ/ bi pra kṛṣ+ṭaḥ④/ sañtsa ra ti/ u pa sarba ⑤ti/ a dunu yā ⑦tri kaḥ/ba| nye ba/ rgyang ring ba'am skal ba⑧/ rgyu/ nye bar 'gro/ phyi bzhin 'brang ba/pra kyu dā thrat+taḥ/ pā rā ya r+ṇa⑨/ bh+ra ma yarnya⑩/ a sarnyi ⑪byu taḥ/ a pra ti nir+pā ⑪ti/phyir log /pha rol tu 'gro ba/ 'phyan pa'am 'khyam pa/ nye bar gyur tam bsten/ mi ldog pa/u pa ru ⑫taḥ/ nā ti dru ⑫ram̐/ nā t+yā ⑫sar+ghaṃ/ pa ri blu ma te⑩/ pra t+yā ga ma rna/zhig pa'am med par gyur pa/ ha cang yang mi ring / ha cang yang mi nye/ kun du 'khyam⑩/ phyir 'ong ba/ a nā hi rgyaḥ⑫/ pra yā rde⑪/ a twe tiḥ⑫/ saṃ ko tsaḥ/ saṃ sreṣ+ṭaḥ/bskor nas sam byul nas/ 'go ba'am 'jug pa/ rjes su 'gro/ bskum pa'am zhum pa/ 'dres/mi shrī byu taḥ/ saste daḥ/ a saste daḥ⑪/ urnya na rgo/ sa 'dres par gyur pa/ 'dres pa'am dbye ba/ ma 'dres pa'am dbyer med pa/ rgod byed/ yongs mudha na dz+wa⑫/ bi k+ṣi pa ti/ be+e k+ṣip+ta su rgod byed/ rnam par g.yeng bar byed pa'am rnam par 'thor bar byed pa/ sems g.yeng ba'am tsit+taḥ—/ dusnya ṣa⑫ཿ/ a kamra ⑪pa tsit+taḥ/ aṅga pra t+yaṅgā ni khyun+da sems 'khrugs stepa/ thub par dka'/ sems mi g.yo ba⑩/ yan lag dang nying lag rnams gtubs yaḥ⑫—/ a na ba marda rtswa yaḥ⑫/ dzisgyu kṛ ⑥tai/ a kyang / mi choms pa'am mi brtul ba'am mi rdzi ⑪ba/ zil gyis gnon pa'am ⑪spa bkong ⑫ba/ mi 115—154
