saṃ ①hār+yaḥ/ nakyu khyu tiḥ/ ka ba tsi ta②ཿ/ barmi taḥ①/ a ni bā.oṃ/ tsā po ④'phrog pa/ 'khrugs ⑤par mi 'gyur/ ya lad bgos/ go cha bgos/ mi bzlog pa/ rked pa gzhu'i da ni/ tsā ru dar+sha nādu/ na ba na li na pa tra su bi shu’ na ya nā⑦/chang zungs ltar phra ba/ blta na mdzes pa/ pad+ma gzhon nu'i 'dab ma ltar spyan shin tu rnam par dag pa/pisboṣ+ṭṛ⑧/ mā ya kṛ ta mi ba bisbo/ bhā dza te/ ā mchu be+em pa ltar dmar ba/ gzugs sgyu 'phrul du byas pa bzhin/ mdzes pa'am ta ler gyur pa/ byad kṛ tiḥ⑨/ ā spyole khya tsi1 te ⑪ba dar+sha nī yaḥ⑫/ ban+tu ramra⑫/ pra sā raḥspyo/gzugs sam byad bzhin/ bu don du bris pa bzhin du lta na sdug pa/ legs pa'am mdzes pa/ brkyang ba/usnye paḥ/ pra k+ṣe paḥ⑫/ prasbaḥ⑩/ pra pā taḥ/ gartaḥ/ pa ri khā⑩/ mārga dzi naḥ/ldeg pa/ 'jog pa/ gad ka⑫ /g.yang sa/ ⑪dong / 'obs/ lam rgyal ba/mārga de shi kaḥ/ mārga dz+re biḥ/ mārga ⑫dru ṣ+pe/ rnge ta ā pat+t+waṃ ⑪pra ti pan+da kaḥ/ sho ta lam ston pa/ lam gyis ⑫'tsho ba/ lam sun par byed pa/ rgyun du zhugs pa la 'jug pa/ rgyun du ā pan+daḥ/ sa kṛ dā gā mi ⑫pra ti pan+da kaḥ/ sa kṛ dā gā m+bi/ a nā gā mi ④pra ti pan+da kaḥ/zhugs pa/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba la 'jug pa/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba/ phyir mi 'ong ba la 'jug pa/a nā ⑫gā rī/ arta tra ⑫pra ti pan+d+ra kaḥ/ artan⑦/ ār+ya saṃ ghaḥ⑫/ ār+ya ⑪phyir mi 'ong ba/ dgra bcom pa la 'jug pa/ dgra bcom pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun/ 'phags ga ṇaḥ/ sru ⑪tra dha raḥ/ bi na ya dha raḥ/ mā z-i ka dha raḥ/ mā sgye mi kaḥ⑪/ bi ⑪dz+nyā pa'i tshogs/ mdo 'dzin/ 'dul ba 'dzin/ ma mo 'dzin/ dbu ma pa/ rnam par shes pa tsam na bā dī/ bā h+yarba bā ⑫dī/ sau tārnyi ⑫kaḥ/ bai bhā ṣi kaḥ/ ni kā yārnya rī yāḥ⑫/ bai yā du smra ba/ phyi rol gyi don yod par smra ba/ mdo sde pa/ bye brag tu smra ba/ sde pa gzhan dag /brda ka ra ṇaḥ/ ba laphra/ s+thā maḥ⑫/ a nu bhā baḥ⑫/ pra bhā baḥ/ shastiḥ/sprod pa/ stobs/ ma 'dom na mthu 'dom na stobs/ mthu/ mthu stobs/ nus pa'am mthu/115—155

kṛ pā/ da yā/ pā sā di kaḥ/ a rnyi rū paḥ/ dar+sha smi yaḥ①/ pa ra ma yā snying rje ba'am②/ snying brtse ba/ mdzes pa/ gzugs bzang ba/ lta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po shu na bar+ṇa puṣ+ka la ta yā sa man+d+ra sneg taḥ/ ma hā bha ④gaḥ/ bha rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ dbang thang che ba'am skal ba che ⑤ba'am dpal cha/ skal ba can dang bye—/ yo gyi/ dṛji 0bi ṣaḥ/ ā ⑦shrī bi ṣaḥ/ shā ⑧sa spu la 'bab pa/ spu la 'bab pa dang rung ba/ mig gdug pa/ so gdug pa'am sbrul gdug pa/ dbugs bi ṣaḥ/ uts+tsha ra gha rgo/ ul+la pa rgo/ ka la ha ya ti/ ka li ka la ha bi gra ha bi bā gdug pa/ 'phya ba/ rnying pa/ 'thab pa / 'thab pa dang 'thab mo dang rtsod pa dang 'gyed daḥ—/ do ⑨ṣa mut+pā da ya ti/ tsit+ta mā ghā ta ya ti/ pra ti ni sra k+ṣa ti/pa—/ zhe sdang bskyed dam skyon 'dogs ⑩pa/ sems kyis ⑪kun nas mnar ba/ 'dor bar 'gyur/a sgyu khyu rgo/ ā le khyo ⑩bi le khyo bi pra ti sā raḥ kau kṛ r+ghaṃ⑫/ shi k+ṣu rnyi ni kyu ⑫dzi lta/skur pa 'debs pa/ 'gyod pa dang yid la gcags spyopa'i rnam grangs/ slob ma ldongs shes zer ba/pra ti bā niḥ⑩/ pra ti kyu la tā⑩/ ha n+yatu/ birnyi yatu⑫/ pra bā sa yetra/ sa daṇ+ḍaḥ/ a mi 'phrod pa/ mi mthun pa/ so rtsig⑪ /chings shig /sgyugs ⑫shig /chad pha ⑪ba/ rjes nu sa ra ṇaḥ/ saṃ ba raḥ/ a rnyi ni dzi ⑫taḥ/ dhū mā ⑫ya ti/ ā dīp+taḥ⑫/ pra dīp+taḥ⑫/su 'brang ba⑪/ bde ba'i mchog /mngon par rgyal/ du ba 'thul⑫/ 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ saṃ pra dīp+taḥ⑫/ saṃ pra dz+wa li taḥ/ e ka dzā ⑥lī bhū to dh+yā ⑫ya ti/ ma shi ra ma pi kun du rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu mched cing 'bar/ me byu gcig tu gyur cing bsreg go/ /du ba na pra dz+nyā ya te/ tshwa ⑪yi ka ma pi na pra dz+nyā ya te/ gi ri ཿ/ shi ⑫laḥ/ parba taḥ/ shā ⑫yang med/ thal ba yang med/ ri'am ri bo / brag gam ri/ ri/ bya sgo raḥ/ da rī/ shwa t+t+waṃ④/ ku shwa rja/ ma hā shwa phroṃ/ pra pā taḥ/ de shaḥ/skyibs / ri sul/ ngam grog ⑫gam g.yang sa/ ngam gog ⑪chung ngu / ngam grog ⑩chen po/ g.yang sa/ yul/115—156

bas+thā pa yarnyi/ sā mudh+ri ka ①nā baḥ/ sa mā graḥsne/ bya kyi skabs su bka' khrims bcas④/ rgya mtsho'i gru bo che/ tshogs pa'am mthun pa/ mi mthun pa'am graḥdu—/ balka lam̐/ bi bā haḥ/ ā bā haḥ/ yo rad rod du gyur pa'am phan phun du gyur pa/ shing shun/ bag ma len pa/ bag ma gtong ba/ khud ⑤ta rka du/ a ti thiḥ④/ shi bā ru ṭ+wāṃ/ mā lta giḥ/ sa rtswa/ ⑧ka ku damra/ khu raḥ/pa'am rdzongs/ 'gron/ ce spyang mo'i skra/ gdol pa'am glang mo/ lkog shal/ nog /mig pa/shriṅgaḥ⑨ske/ bi ṣā r+ṇa⑩/ lo gu ⑪laḥ/ pan+d+ra⑫ཿ/ aṣ+ṭha pa dwa ⑫ti/ bat+t+waṃ niḥ④/ a nu gan+ta rwa/ mjug ma/ lam/ lam/ lam/ rjes su 'gro bar bya ba'am rjes su rtogs par byaḥ—/ protu khā (nyelta/ pi ro li taḥspyo/ arnyad+dhā naṅga tamra()/ brta bya ba/ shin tu byung ba'am bton pa/ dkrugs pa'am bsrubs pa/ mi snang bar gyur pa/ 'gyur ba'am 'jug te—/ bi dhū ta pā paḥ/ saṃ kar+yaphra⑫/ ma ra ṇ+ḍaṃ ⑪shi rka/pa'am long pa/ sdig pa rnam par sbyangs pa/ 'dres pa'am 'chol pa/ 'chi ba'i char gtogs pa/u pa pabye ⑥shi rka/ dha nu rā ro pa rna/ i shu k+ṣe paḥ/ ut+pā pa rde⑥/ tso raḥ/skye ba'i char gtogs pa/ gzhu brdung ba/ mda' 'phang ba / slong ba'am ldang ⑫bar byed pa/ chom rkun⑪/pa ri pan+d+rarnyi ṣ+ṭha ti/ ste ya saṃ khyu taḥ⑫/ ha taḥ/ spru lam gcod cing 'dug pa/ rku bar bgrang ba/ brdegs ⑫pa'am bsnun pa'am btab pa/ 'tshir ḍa ya ti/ ku daṇ+ḍaḥsgo9/ u pā las+thā rnyi mā yaḥ()/ a ba tā ra pre ba'am gnod par byed pa/ mi rigs pa'i chad pa'am stong 3/ klan ka tshol ba'i bsam pa/ glags lta k+ṣ-i ṇaḥ⑪/ ni gra tī ta byaḥzhu/ sa ma ⑪bhi dru ba| chad pa bcad pa'am tshar bcad 6 pa skabs dang sbyar/ kun du gnod par gyur pa'am kun du 115—158

taḥ—/ bi he ṭha nā/ sarnyi ts+tsha da kaḥ/ gradz+re mo gtses pa/ 'tshe ba'am mtho 'tshams pa/ khyim 'bugs pa/ mdud pa 'grol ba'am bcings pa tsa kaḥ/ nirlo pa hā ra kaḥ/ pa ri pan+d+ra kaḥ/ 'grol ba'am 'khrol ba/① rim ②gyis phrogs pa'am rku ①ba/ lam 'gog pa'am bar chad byed pa/ha ra ṇi④/ nirlu paṃ ⑤ha ra ti/ dīṣ+ṭaduḥ/ ⑦bi dz+wa ṣaḥ//'phrog pa/ rim gyis sam rmings kyis sam ma lus par 'phrog pa/ sdang ba'am 'gras ⑧pa/ rnam par sdang ba/mtho ris dang 'dod pa la sogs pa'i ming la/ di biḥ⑨/ swargaḥ/ su ga tiḥ⑩/ saṃ ga ti/ de ba lo kaḥ/ bhū bi/ ma nu lha yul/ mtho ris/ bde 'gro/ bzang 'gro/ lha'i 'jig rten/ sa'i steng / mi'i gyi lo kaḥ/ a byu da yaḥ/ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇ+ḍaḥ/ ba dha kāḥkā māḥ⑪/ ā dībhāḥ'ajig rten/ mngon par mtho ba/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ 'dod pa rnams ni gsod pa/ 'dod pa rnams kā mā⑫ཿ/ dhiklu rmā⑫/ kā mā la yaḥ/ kā ma ni yarnyiḥspe9/ durgan+t+raḥkā māḥ/ni kun du 'bar ba/ 'dod pa ngan pa/ 'dod pa la zhen pa/ 'dod pa la 'chums pa/ 'dod pa di dri nga ba/pū ti kāḥkā māḥ⑫/ aghi dzā ⑪lo pa māḥ⑩/ sarba shrīsgo ⑫pa māḥ⑪/ shu lo pa māḥ/'dod pa ni rul ⑫ba lta bu/ me 'bar ba lta bu/ sgrul gyi mgo⑪/ gsal shing lta bu/a si dhā ro pa māḥ/ tas+thā ⑫dza la dzā tāḥ⑫/ gu ḍā guñdzi ka byu tāḥ/ muṭ+wā ba lwa dza ⑫ral gri lta bu/ thags 'khrugs pa lta bu/ dru gu 'dzings ④pa lta bu/ rtsa mun dza dang bal ba dza dzā tāḥ/ ā dzā badzi ba sa mā pan+d+raḥ⑪//lta bur gyur pa/ 'ong ba dang 'gro bar gyur pa⑩/115—159

skabs skabs nas tshig gi phrad du 'byung ba'i ming la/ka ra ṇaḥ①/ e baṃ rū baṃ/ a ta e tasmraṭ+wā ②ra ṇ+ḍatu①/ a tra④/ tat+pa⑤/skabs/ de lta bu/ des na de'i phyir/ 'dir/ de la/i meha/ asmi/ ta thā/ ya thā/ bā/ tsa/ e ba/'di la/ 'dir/ de bzhin/ ji lta ba'am ji ltar ram ji nas sam 'di ltar/ 'am rung /⑦ dang ngam yang / nyid/yasmratu⑧/ kin+ta rnyi⑨/ tatu/ ya ta⑩/ ki/ na nu/gang gi ⑪phyir ram 'di ltar/ de lta mod kyi/ de/ gang yin pa'am gang / ci/ 'am ste 'dri ba'i tshig /kiñtsa/ a n+ya tsa⑫/ a pi tu⑫/ kin+tu/ tar+ya thā/'di ltar yang/ gzhan yang / yang ngam mod kyi/ 'od kyang ngam mod kyi/ 'di lta byaste'am dper na/yad+mā tā a tha/ i me/ a rmā/ e baṃ/ bhū yopho pi⑫/de nas sam ci ste/ 'di dag /'di rnams / 'di skad dam 'di ltar ram de bzhin/ yang ngam ⑩gzhan yang /bhū yaḥ/ ka dā tu ka dā ya dā/ ta dā/ ka baṃ/ e baṃ hi/ ta to pi/yang ngam phyir zhing / nam zhig gam ⑩gang gi tshe/ de'i tshe'am de'i dus/ ji ltar/ de ltar na/ de bas kyang /ta thā hi/ e ba me pa/ sa tsetu ⑫ya di/ pe yā yi/ pūrba 'di ltar/ de bzhin du/ gal te/ de bzhin du sbyar ba'am gong ma bzhin du sbyar ba/ gong ma bzhin nam btu() / u tā ho ⑫a tha pā a ho (spesri ta/ nā ma/ ba snga ma bzhin/ yang na de na ni 'on te'am de ste⑫/ gyur du zin kyang ngam chug kyang / kye ma'am kye hud dam ma taske/ a ho/ hā/ sgru baṃ a ba bye/la'am ji yung rung / e ma'am a la la/ kye hud dam kye ma/ los kyang ngam los te'am nges pa3/nu dz+wa⑫/ a pi sa ha spyos/ sā kamra nges par ram gor ma chag pa'am snyam/ kyang ngam yang ⑪lhan cig gam bcas sam dang / lhan cig gam 115—160

sāsgo①| han+ta/ a n+ya tra/ ta thā phi⑤/ ya di rda/ a tha bā①/thabs cig /'on tang ngam 'o na/ gzhan du 'am ma gtogasadu/ de lta mod kyi/ 'di lta ste'am gang 'di/ yang na/yi tha tha / ki la/ cha/ ⑤pa yi twadu/ hi tā⑦/'on kyang ngam de lta yang de lta la/ lo grag ce'o/ /ma gtogs pa'am bzhag ste/ bor te'am ma gtogs pa/ki.ā+oṃ taḥ/ ye ṣ+pe kṛ ta shaḥ⑧/ tatu ⑨tā btu/de la ⑩cir 'gyur zhe'am ⑪'o na cir 'gyur⑫/ gang dag ⑫gi phyir/ de la re zhig gam de srid/yā ba t+pa / a pi tsa/ kā tsitu / ya thā pi nā maḥ/ ke tsitu /ji srid/ gzhan yang zhe'am ⑫'on kyang / gang yang / dper na zhe'am ⑫ji ltar yang / kha cig /ye ke tsitu/ yaḥka—tu⑩/ kwa ⑩tsa na/ ke tsa na/ a yi/ i rda/ i yi/ ka mya/gang su dag /gang la la/ gang na/ gang dag /pho 'di / ma ning ⑫'di/ mo 'di/ su'i/ke na tsitu/ ke 4)na ye (rten/ ta yā/ a ne ( tren a na yā/ ka ti/ ye ṣ+pe/gang gis kyang / gang gis sam gang gi phyir/ des/ 'dis⑫/ du / gang rnams kyi/te ṣ+pe()/ ya su/ ta su/ a l+ya/ ka su tsitusgosnge/ kwa tsitu()/de rnams kyi/ gang gi'am gang la/ de'i 'am de la/ 'di'i ⑪'am 'di la/ gang la la'i/ la lar/ku tra/ ku taḥ⑦/ ka dze+e tsitu/ ka dā tsit+pa⑫//gang du/ gang las sam gang las shig⑥/ ji ltar yang / nam zhig gi tshe/⑫mkhar dang gnas la sogs pa'i ming la/ko traḥ⑪/ durgaḥ⑫/ pūrba dzi nā byu ṣi lta/ bai ⑫dza yan+taḥpā sā daḥ/mkhar/ rdzong / sngon gyi rgyal ba bzhugs bzhugs pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang pa/115—161

de ba sa bhā/ a su ra sa bhā su dha nā/ li pi shā ①lā/ ku ṭā gā re/ a ba lha'i 'dun sa/ lha ma yin gyi 'dun sa nor bzang / yi ge slob pa'i grwa khang / khang pa brtsegs pa/ 'dug sa thaḥ/ gā maḥ/ gā ④mo pa bi tsā raḥ/ na ga re①/ ni rjog maḥ⑤/ dza na pa rdaX/gnas—/ gong / grong gi nye 'khor/ grong khyer/ grong rdal / ljongs sam yul gyi skye bo'i gnas/rāṭaṃ⑦ske/ rā dzā jo nī/ pu re/ pā sā daḥ⑧/ bethraḥ⑨/yul 'khor/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor/ grong khyer ram pho brang / khang pa'am khang bzangs⑩/ khang pa/kṛ haṃ/ a gā re⑪/ ge haṃ/ bha ba rna/ gha re/ la ya rgo/ harmyakhyim/ khyim/ khyim/ gnas sam khang pa/ khang khyim/ gnas khang / pu shu'am bsil phra—/ ha rmya si kha re/ aṭa/ aṣ+ṭha laḥ(nye/ o bi dh+ya na khā/khang ngam yang thog /pu shu'i steng / yang thog /dgra khang ngam ba gam/ mda' yab pam ba gam/ni1 haḥ/ bā tā ya rna/ ga bāk+ṣe⑫/ to ra rde/ kho ṭa skeb gam mam sgo khang skabs dang sbyar/ skar khung / skar khung dra ba can/ rta babs/ lcog gam shing thags kaḥ—/ pa ri khāspyo/ pat+ta rna⑩/ ha ṭā⑫/ mā s+thā ⑫pa ṇaḥ/ pasgyu ⑪skabs dang sbyar/ 'obs/ tshong rdal lam tshong 'dus/ tshong 'dus/ me tog phreng ba'i tshong khang / zong dgram pa ṇaḥ/ kṛ hā bā saḥ/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ḍaḥ/ ko shaḥ/ kojo gā re/pa'am ( )tshong khang / khyim gyi gnas/ 'khor gyi khyams ⑩/ mdzod dam shugs sam sbubs/ bang ba/bhitiḥ—/ pā 3kā raḥ( she/ pra ti zwa kā geraḥ/ kha ra kṛ haṃ/ pa ṭa ku ṭi/ ya ba ni kaḥ/rtsig pa/ ra ba/ phyi ra/ gur/ sbra/ yol ba/ ṭ+wā ṇa ku ṭi 3/ kā ya mā rde/ raṅga shā khā/ mā ṭā⑪/ bā ḍa daṇ+ḍi kā/spyil pho'am rtsa 8rtekhang / sab mo/ ltad mos/ rnga 6shekhang / sab mos bskor ba'am rib mas bskor ba/115———162

bā tā grat+pa ti kā/ daṇ+ḍa ts+tsha da rgo/ pha la kats+tsha da rgo/ khyu mi gu ①hā/ shi ⑧la gu hā/sgo khang steng gi bsil khang / yol khang / spang leb khang / su phub/ brag phug/gi ri gu hā/ par+ṇa ku ṭi kā①/ kṛ ta rtsa kra ma ḍārjo/ kṛ ta pās+thār⑤ཿ/ ku tū dhiri phug /lo ma'i spyil po/ 'chag sar ⑦byas pa/ bya skyibs su byas pa/ rtog skeha la shā lā/ sa bhā maṇ+ḍa paḥ/ as+thā na maṇ+ḍa paḥ/ maṇ+ḍa paḥ/ saṃ gī ti khang / 'dun khang / gdan la gshegs pa⑨ / mdun khang ngam bkad sa / bgro ba'i khang pa'am ⑩pā sā dā⑪/ ni la yaḥ/ u pasbya ⑫na shā khā/ dā re/ dā ra ka pā ṭaṃ/ ka pā glu dbyangs kyi khang pa/ gnas sam tshang / rim gro'i ()gnas/ sgo/ sgo glegs/ sgo ta pu ṭaṃ/ dā ra sha spyokhā+e/ a ba ṣe gaḥspyo/ n+ya sa⑩ཿ/ sgru shā⑩/ stam+bhaḥske/'phar—/ sgo skyes()/ ya phubs/ them pa/ ka ba'am bzu ( )ba/ ka ba/kum+bha kaḥ/ kṛ ka ṭa rka/ shīr+ṣa rka/ go sā ra kaḥ/ dha ra bhā/ ku ṭa⑪ཿ/ go pā na sī/ka rten/ ka zhu/ bre phul/ gdung / phyam / phyam gyi spyi rten/ phyam sgu bo/arga ḍaḥ/ in+d+ra spru laḥ⑫/ be di kā dzā lo( ste/ stam+bha kaḥ/ saṃ kra ma ṇa ( stekā ni/gtan pa/ 'khor gtan nam sgo'i them pa/ lan kan gyi dra ba/ lan kan gyi ka ba/ bste khang /be di kā sgostesru tsa kaḥ( nye/ shad+ku/ ā sgo)rasbra ṇa shaṃ/ sru tsi rka/lan kan nam kha khyer ram stegs bu'am ⑫gzungs gzer/ gzer bu'am phur bu/ gdang bu/ shar ba/a dhijo rna⑪/ so pā rna/ bi tardiḥ/ ā (nyerā maḥ/ bā ḍi/ shā kha bā ṭi (rmekaḥ/lan kan gyi rten ma/ them skas⑫/ stegs bu/ kun dga' ra ba/ ldum ra/ ra ba/pha ⑫lā rā maḥ/ su sik+to/ su sho dhi tai/ su sho bza' shing ra ba/ chag chag legs par btab pa/ phyag dar legs par byas pa/ legs par ④shin tu 115—163

bhi ti①/ tsa tuṣ+pe ko ṇi 6(mi/ sau hā sa rdosnye)rgo pra tshwabye/ adzha 4yo dza na pā mdzes par byas pa/ grwa bzhir/ seng ge'i khri bshams pa/ kho ra khor yug tu ri sa marnya kaḥ/ yo dza na mu:/ sa ma pā ṇi ta la dzā taḥ⑤/ rat+na ma yaḥ( )saṃ sbi dpag tshad phyed pa/ 'phang du dpag tshad/ lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ gzhi 9)rin po tolha bhū nyeta/ tsa labhe(pe/ lā khā piṇ+ḍaḥ( )/ haste shā lā/ a shwa shā lā/ kha ra cher gyur to/ /bres/ bres kyi rgyu/ gang po che'i bres/ rta'i bres/ bong shā lā/ go shā 'a// a dza shā khā/ u byā tuspedz+wa/ an+ta rā pa rde⑫/ spru bye/bres—/ glang bres/ ra lug gi 3/ bres/ skyes mos tshal/ grong bar / srang ngam khyams spyoskabs dang sbyar/ra byānyenye/ bat+ma shā lā/ pan+d+rake/ / tsa twa raḥ6 / shri gā ṭa ke/ āsba ⑫rda/ ni ke taḥ/lam po che/ be+e'u ra ba/ lam/ bzhi mdo/ sum mdo/ gnas sam rten/ gnas/ni shra yaḥ/ greṣ+pe ⑪kā bā sa ཿ/ bābhā bu kā bā saḥ/ hai spemadhi kā bā saḥ⑪//gnas sam rten/ dpyid sa/ dbyar sa/ dgun sa/shing rta la sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad du ma'i ming la/ra thaḥsha ka ṭaḥ⑪/ ak+ṣaḥ/ tsa kraphra2ste/ nā sgopebhi/ a raḥ/ ne+e miḥ/ i shā/shing rta/ srog shing / phang lo/ lte ba/ rtsibs/ mu khyud / shing rta'i mda'/ra smi ཿ —/ yu ga ཿ / ha la ཿ / ha la da ṇ+ḍa ཿ /srab skyogs sam sna thag /gnya' shing / gshol lam zhing dor ram dmon sko.ipa dor/ gshol mda'/ha la paṃ shaḥ/ swā 'a/9 na/ 'a/ṅga la/ kṛ 8de ṣa ti//gshol 6mda'/ thong lcags/ gshol/ rmo'am ched/1 15zhe 164

bye ①rka /ni man+t+ra ṇa kai/ aut+pā ②ti rka/ uṣ+peṇ+ḍaṃ/ ā lo paḥ④/ bā la 'khor/ mgron du bos pa/ 'phral la bos pa/ spags pa'am nos pa/ kham/ la phug gsar byu lo/ ma hā spru rjolo/ piṇ+ḍa luḥ/ maṇ+ḍaḥ//pa'am gzhon nu/ la phug nar son pa'am chen po/ do ba'i rdog ma(snye/ khur skya/'tsho chas kyi sman gyi ming la/o ṣa dhiḥ/ hai ṣa rdzu/ su dhā/ a mṛ haṃ/ ra sā ya rgo/ susgre khārjo/ sro tāñdza ⑦dz+wa/sman/ rtsi / bdud rtsi/ bdud rtsi/ bcud kyis ⑧len/ sug smel/ lig bu mig/garnya mā sī/ an+d+ra be ta saḥ/ a gaste ha rī ta khri⑨/ go khyu ra kaḥ/ a ya s+thān+taḥ/spang spos/ star bu/ a gas/ gze ma/ khab long /shi lo da rka/ lta ⑩lo/ ka ṭu ka tai ⑪lo/ tā lī saḥ/ sharka rā/ go ro tsa nā/gcong zhi'i chu/ 'bru mar/ yungs mar⑫/ bal bu/ li kha ra/ gi ⑫hang /baṃ sa ro tsa nā/ ta ga re/ nā ga re/ shusnyi/ pisba lī/ ma ri rtsathoste/ ba te ḍi(nye/smig rkang / rgya spos/ li dong ra/ bca' sga/ pi pi ling / na le sham/ ba ru ra/bi dz+rī ta ka /ha ()rī ta tī/ ā tsu)ma la rka /a dza dz+re/ dz+re ra rkatushe/ yasbyi ma byu/ba ru ra/ a ru ra/ skyu ru ra/ go snyod/ tha be/ shing mngar/kubye—/ pe pha ⑪lo/ pū ga pha lo/ twakra/ twatsu rjo / nā ga re gaḥ/ dza / ⑥raḥ/ru ta/ gla gor zho sha /gla gor zho sha /shing tsha/ shing tsha/ skyur rtsi/ skyur rtsi chen po/ba da ra pha lo/ mā tu luṅge/ dzā ti pha lo/ ba tsā/ la baṅge/ dza du bā ra ཿ/rgya shug ga ⑫'bru/ ba lung kha lung / spos kyi rgyal po'am ⑫lig shi ber/ shu dag /li shi/ zur ba/115—167

lo haḥ①/ tāsmre/ tra ⑦puḥ①/ sī saṃ/ ri ju/ rka ④saṃ/ rat+na sasma te//lcags / zangs/ tshon mo stengs⑤/ ro nye/ ra gan/ mkhar ba/ rin po cher slos 0pa/dung la sogs pa'i ming la/ dak+ṣi ṇ+ḍa brta ⑦shaṃ khaḥ/ shaṃ khaḥ/ suk+to kā/ ka pardi sgekā/ boṇ+ḍaḥ/ a bh+ra rka/dung g.yas su 'khyil ba/ dung / nya phyis/ 'gron bu/ srin khog /lhang tsher/tab ṭi na/sti/ dra/ 'eb nga/ ma/ཿ⑩//thod le kor/ thod le kor gyi bye ma/rgyan gyi rnam pa'i ming la/a lo kā ra/ ā bha ra r+ṇa⑪/ byu haḥ/ bi bhū ṣa r+ṇa/ maṇ+ḍa rgo⑫/rgyan/ phyang phrul ⑫lam spud pa'am ma ⑫'dom na rgyan/ bkod pa/ lhab lhub/ rgyan po'i ⑫cho lo/he ma niṣ+kaḥ⑩/ ma ṇiḥ/ ka ṭa shaṃḥ/ ba la yo/ ke yu ⑩raḥ/ saṃ ga daḥ/gser gyi rgyan/ nor bu/ gdu ⑫bu rgyan can/ gdu bu/ dpung rgyan/ dpung rgyan/adhe ⑪hā raḥ⑩/ hā raḥ/ nu pu re/ kuṇ+ḍa lo/ mu ku ṭaṃ/se mo do/ /rgyan phreng ⑥ngam do shal/ rkang gdub/ rna cha gdub skor/ cod pan dang dbu rgyan zla ba can skabs dang sbyar/ki rī ṭiḥ/ mo liḥ/ pa ⑫ṭaḥ/cod pan dang dbu rgyan rtse bran/ cod pan dang dbu rgyan rtse gsum skabs dang sbyar/ dar thod/⑫hasteḥske/ pa ri ha ṭa ke/ ti la ke/ kaṇi rka/ tsan+d+ra rka/ na ku la kaḥ/mgul gdub/ gdu bu/ thig le lta bu rgyan tam mdongs bu/ rna cha/ rgyan zla gam/ rgyan ne+e'u le ⑫can/mu dri ⑫kā/ e gu snyi/ ya ⑫rka/ pā la kaḥ/ pa ri hā ra rka/ tā la rka/ pār+sha sru tra rka/sor gdub rgya/ sor gdub/ sor gdub / gdub bu tham pa/ rgyan ta la 'dab/ se ral phreng /115—171

go mtshon gyi ming la/ka ba tsaḥ①/ barmaḥkhru/ san+d+ra ha/ bā li kā ④san+d+ra ha/ bar+bhe kā san+d+ra ha/ shrīr+ṣa kaḥ/ya lad/ go cha/ go cha/ tshem tshem/ khrab/ rmog gi chem bu/ka tha ④ti/ ka ba tsi ka / pha raḥ⑤/ pā saḥ/ kurnyaḥrjo/ ka ṇa yaḥ/ k+ṣu ra praḥ/ khe ṭa kaḥ/'thab/ 'thab/ phub / mdung ngam thag mdung / mdung / rdo rje rtse gcig /ste'u ka nya/ phub rlum/shu ⑦lo/ tri shā lo/ pa ra shuḥ⑧/ to ma raḥ/ shat+taḥ/ khaṅgaḥ/ snro ri kā⑨/gsal shing / mdung rtse gsum pa/ dgra sta/ mda' bo che/ mdung thung / ral gri/ chu gri/ka ra bā laḥ⑩/ ka ḍidha laḥ⑪/ dha nuḥ/ sha raḥ/ nā rā tsa⑫ཿ/ asnyartswa ⑫rā tsaḥ/ral gri dgu bo/ ral gri dgu bo/ gzhu/ mda'/ lcags mda'/ mda' phyed lcags las byas pa/pat+ma dan+ta kaḥ/ ti la ko tsa ba rka/ bhabe+eḥ④/ muṅga li kā⑫/ ḍā bhā⑩/mde'u be'u so 'dra ba/ mde'u zur bzhi pa/ ste'u ka ma/ mde'u bye'u snying ma/ 'phang mdung /nyiṇ+ḍi pā laḥ/ ā yu t+t+waṃ bra ha ra khaṃ shaste⑩//mtshon rtse gcig /mtshon cha'am lag cha'am mtshon/mchod pa'i yo byad kyi ming la/ts+tsha tram̐/ dh+wa dzaḥ/ pa tā kā/ tsūṇ+ḍaṃ⑫/ puṣ+ka ⑪pu ṭaṃ/ garnyaḥ/ bi le pa rna⑪/gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ bye ma/ me tog gi phur ma/ spos/ byug pa/u pa le pa rna/ mā lhi/ dī paḥ/ bi tā rgo/ bi tā na bi ta tai⑩/ sa musbyi byug pa/ phreng ba/ mar me/ bla re/ bla rer bres pa/ gdugs dang rgyal tats+tsha tradh+wa ⑪dza pa tā kā/ ki ⑫ka tsā dzā lo mu kha rā/ he ma dā rma⑫/mtshan dang ba dan bgreng ba/ dril bu g.yeng ka'i ⑫dra ba 'khrol ba⑪/ gser gyi chun po'am phreng ba/115—173

mukyā dā rmadhi / ma ṇi zhu dā mol/ he ma dzā lo/ paṣ+ṭa dā saṃ④ / pra lam+bi tai/ lasbra te/mu tig gi chun po/ nor bu'i chun po/ gser gyi dra ba/ dar gyi lda ldi/ rab tu dpyangs pa/ 'phyang /pra lasbra te/ a sti pra lalba te/ garnya mā l+ya na ma ṭī ⑤ya te/ a bh+yarnyi haṃ/rab tu 'phyang / mngon par rab tu 'phyang / dri dang phreng bas mchod pa/ mngon par mchod pa'am drin che ba'am btsun pa/dhū ba ni zlu kye pi lta/ saṃ ⑦/pū dzi tai/ pū bye pū dzi tai/ ma hi tai/bdug spos kyi ldubadug pa/ legs par mchod pa/ mchod par 'os pas mchod pa/ mchod par byas⑨/a bhi bra ki rarnyisma/ a bh+ya ba ki rarnyisma/ dz+re 6 bi to pa ka ra rde⑪/ glu na pra t+ya mngon par rab tu gtor/ mngon par gtor/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad/ na ba'i ya bh+yo ⑫ṣa rdzu/ su kho pa dhā rgo//gso sman/ bde ba'i yo byad dam bde ba'i 'tsho chas sam bde bar sbyar ba skabs dang sbyar/me tog sna tshogs gyi ming la/dza la rdza/ sha ta pa ⑫tram̐/ ut+pa lo/ pad+me/ ku mu rda/ puṇ+ḍa rī ka/ sau garnyi shaṃ/chu las skyes pa/ pad+ma/ ut+pa la/ pad+ma/ ku mu da/ pad+ma dkar po/ dri mchog /mṛ du garnyi shaṃ/ sru la dze+e/ tsaspa kaḥ/ ku ra ba kaḥ/ bāk+ṣi ⑪tī/ ma hā bābyu ⑫khri/dri ngad 'jam pa/ skam las skyes pa/ tsam pa ka /ku ra ba ka /bar shi ki/ bar ⑩shi ki chen po/mal+li kā/ na ba mālpi ⑫kā/ dzā ti ku su saṃ/ su ma nā/ yu thi kā/ dhā nu sku rī⑪/ma li kā ⑪/ na ba ma li ka /sna ma'i me tog /sna ma'i me tog /yug ti ka /dha nu kā phyori/kusdo—/ pā ru ṣa shaṃ/ ma hā pā ru ṣa rka/ mañdzu ṣa kai/ ma hā mdzi ṣaka/ a sho kai/kun dam/ pa ru sha ka /pa ru sha ka chen po/ mdzi sha ka /mdzi sha ka chen po/ mya ngan 'tshang /mu tsi lin+de/ ma hā mu tsi lit+t+waṃ/ mu tsu 0kun+daḥ/ ba ku laḥ/ a sa naḥ 3/ thra yi guḥ/ 3/ btang bzung che/ btang bzung ༄pechen po/ mu tsu kun+da/ ba ku la/ a sa na/ thra yabyu ⑦/175—174

pun+d+ra ①gaḥ/ ka dasbraḥ②/ dha nu ke ta kri/ kaṇi kā ①ra puṣ+pe/ e ḍā k+ṣ-i puṣ+pe/pun+d+ra ga /ka dam pa/ dha nu ke ta kidhi/ dong ka'i me tog /me tog lug mig /ta ga raḥ⑤/ ke sha raḥdhi/ ta mā la pa tram̐/ lo ga lī puṣ+pe/ s+t+waṃ pa rka/ ro tsaḥ⑦/ta ga ra/ ke sha ra/ ta ma ⑧la'i lo ma/ lo ga li'i me tog /me tog gi dog pa / me tog mdog mdzes/ma hā ro tsa⑨ཿ/ s+thā lo/ ma hā s+thā lo/ tsakra bi ma loḥ/ tsakra sha ta pa tram̐/ sa ha shwa ⑩pa tram̐/mdog mdzes chen po/ sba la/ sgra la chen po/ 'khor lo dri med/ 'khor lo 'dab brgya/ 'dab stong /sha ta sa ha sra pa tram̐/ sa man+ta pra bhā⑪/ sa man+ta gar+ghaṃ/ sa man+ta sbra khā ⑫ba lo ka na/'dab 'bum/ kun tu 'od/ kun tu bsung / kun tu cher snang /na ya nā ⑫rnyi rā maḥ/ muk+ta ⑫pha la rka/ byo tiḥ⑫pra bhaḥ/ byo tiḥka raḥ⑩/ a ti muk+ta ⑩shaṃ/mig tu sdug /mu tig 'bru/ skar 'od/ 'od byed/ a ti mug ta ka /pā ṭa lo/ ma hā pā ṭa lo/ tsi tra pā ṭa lo/ ma hā tsi tra pā ṭa lo/ man+d+ra ra baḥ⑫/skya snar⑪/ skya snar ⑪chen po/ skya snar ⑪khra bo/ skya snar ⑫bkra chen/ man dā ra ba/ma hā man+d+ra ra baḥ⑫/ karka ra baḥ/ ma hā karka ra baḥ/ de ba su ma nā/ ta ra ṇiḥ/ go ④ta man dā ⑫ra ba chen po/ mdog dkar/ mdog dkar chen po/ lha yid dga'/ ta ra ṇi/ go ta ra ṇiḥ/ ba li/ tin+tu kaḥ/ ki shu kaḥ/ bal+laḥ/ ba ka puṣ+pe/ ka dasbra ka puṣ+pe/ra ṇi/ ba li/ tin du ka /kim ⑪shu ka /ba la/ phra ⑦ba'i me tog /ka dam pa'i ⑫me tog /ku ba la puṣ+pe/ a dza ⑥jo puṣ+pe/ arka puṣ+pe//ma 'dom na me tog ut+pal 'dom na ku ba la/ go snyod kyi me tog /arka'i me tog /me tog gi rtsa ba la sogs pa'i ming la/bi saṃ/ dṛrnyi/ mṛ (kyeṇa lo/ nā lo/ daṇ+ḍaḥ/ pat+t+waṃ/ bi ṭa paḥ/pad+ma'i rtsa ba/ rtsa ba'am thag pa/ pad+ma'i rtsa lag /chu ba/ sdong bu/ 'dab ma/ lo ma/115—175

dzā la ka dzā tai/ k+ṣu ra ka rmyedzā lta/ kā li kā dzā lta/ ṭa la ka dza du lta/ mu chaku la dzā haṃ/sbal mig 'thon pa/ sbal mig bye ba/ me tog kha 'bus pa / kā kā su shaṃ / sa rba pa ri phu dze+e / phru ④ li tai / bi ka si tai /me tog kha bye ba/ me tog 'dab ma thams cad rgyas pa/ rgyas sam 'ukha bye ba/ rgyas sam 1kha bye ba/3/puṣ+pe—/ ke sa ram̐/ ki dzalke/ kaṇ+ḍi 2kā/ karka ṭi kā/ ba ⑨rā gaḥ//me tog /ze ba/ ze 'bru/ snying po/ snying po/ 'thul ba/me tog gi yon tan gyi ming la/sha ka ṭa tsakra pra mā khaṃ(bye / bai ḍūr+ya daṇ+ḍaḥ/ in+d+ra ṭī la karka ṭi kā/ asma gar+bha shing rta'i 'phang hūṃ1lo tsam/ sdong bu ni be+e ḍūr+ya/ snying po ni in+d+ra bhā la/ ze ba ni ke sha ram̐/ shā 8༷/ ko//rdo'i snying po/ ut+pa la'i rtsa ba/spos kyi rnam pa'i ming la/ba ya napo1 / tsan+da napo/ a ga ruḥ/ tu ruskaḥ/ kṛṣ+ṭha hūṃ ga ruḥ/ ta rgya spos/ tsan dan/ a ga ru/ du nyu5ru ka /a ga ru nag po/ ta ma la'i mā la pa tram̐/ u ra ga sā ra tsan+da rna/ kā khā nu sā ri tsan+da rgo/ spyo kaspru raḥ/'dab ma/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po/ dus kyi rngu rjes su 'brang ba'i tsan+dan/(bye ga pur/kumyu rngu mapo/ gug+gu luḥ/ kun+d+ra ruḥ/ sardza ra saḥ pya //gur kum 2/ gu gul/ sog thu/ sra rtsi bog /115—176

ā bha yā/ pa ri sgu ṭopho bhutu①/ a ba bhā si taḥ/ te na rasmyu ba bhā se ④'od kyis/ yongs su khyab pa'am rgyas par gyur pa/ snang bar byas/ 'od zer gyi snang ba na z-iṣ+ṭaḥ/ ya tra srud+ma tsan+d+ra ma mā snepra bhā yā ga tirtswa ste/ ko he tuḥ/ kaḥpra t+ya yaḥ/des reg pa/ gang na nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od mi 'bab pa/ rgyu gang / rkyen gang /pu na ra pyu rjog t+ya/ uṭī ṣa pi ba ⑤re 6pra bi sha ti/ mu kha dā re 'o nu pra bi sha tisma/slar log nas/ gtsug tor gyi gseb tu zhugs/ zhal gyi sgo nas zhugs/na tsa bha ga ba to mu kha dā ra srom+bi dzi tas+thā ni miñdzi tas+thā bupra dz+nyā ya te sma/ a ba bhā saḥ⑦/bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑧zhal gyi sgo phye ⑨ba'am btsum par tho)yang mi mngon no/ /snang ba/sa madhā ba bhā saḥ⑪/ dzi ghaṣ+pe tāḥpūr+ṇa gā tā bha brnyisma/kun tu snang ba/ bgres pa rnams ni ⑫'grangs par gyur ce'am ltogs pa rnams ni lus rgyas par gyur/z-i ṣi 4)tā bi ga ta pi pā sā bha brnyisma/ ro ga spriṣ+ṭha bi ga ta ro gā bha brnyisma/skom thostepa rnams ni ngoms ()par gyur/ nad kyis btab pa rnams ni nad dang bral bar gyur/bi ka ledh+ri yāḥpa ri pūrtebyu tho)yā bha brnyisma/ sa tsedṛṣ+ṭaḥprashā byā ka ra ṇ+ḍa ya/dbang po ma tshang ba rnams ni dbang po ⑩tshang bar gyur/ gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du/a ba kā shaṃ kurlutra spyoka—de ba pra de shaṃ/ a man+t+ra ya tesma/ sā dhu kā ra ma dāt+pa/skabs phye na phyogs 'ga' zhig /bka' stsal pa'am smras pa'am bod pa/ legs so zhes bya ba byen te/sā dhu sā dhu/ te na nyi 1 ⑪rku sā dhu tsa subyu tsa sa ma na si ku ru/ bhā ṣi byepho ⑫harnye/legs so legs so/ /de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig⑥ /ngas khyod la bshad do//bha ga ba taḥpra 3ti shu t+ya/ tsit+ta mā rā dha yi ⑫byu/ tiṣ+ṭha ti/ bye ④ya te/ yā pa ya ti/bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan ⑫nas/ sems rangs ④par bya'o/ /bzhugs/'tsho'o/ /gzhes so//dharmañtsa de sha ya ti/ ya phye ⑪dā sh+lau kā lo ⑫ma n+ya se/ ya du ta/ budha ne+e ṭī/chos kyang ston to/ /⑩de'i dus la bab par shes na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul lam lugs/115—178

ās+thā taḥ①/ go jo/ pa ri tsa yaḥ①/ gran+d+raḥ④/grags pa'am brjod pa/ dge 'dun nam tshogs zhing ④'du ba/ 'dris ⑤pa/ mdud pa'am gos/la lā maḥ/ arnyi ma mā tri gā ma bhā baḥ/ ā ༷ bhā pra t+yā ⑦bhā ni r+ha ra yo ge ⑧na/rgyal mtshan nam grags pa/ bud med kyi lus kyi tha mar gyur pa/ khye'us ⑨khye'u 'byung ba'i tshul du/shu raḥ/ pa bī ra dang ma 'dom ⑩na dpa' ba 'dom na rtul phod pa'am nyams rtsal che ba/⑪ yongs su rgyas par ri sgu ṭaṃ/ ā ⑫bsto napo ba ri brta napo⑫/ bi tsa ra ṇapo/ bhū myu kra ma ṇapo⑫/'gengs pa'am yongs su khyab/ yongs su bskor ba'am bsgyur btusme/ rnam par rgyu ba/ sa gnon pa/byu mispyo myurnya ra saṃ kra (9ma r+ṇa/ bā saṃ kalba ya ti/ a sasnyin+daḥ⑩/ sasnyin+daḥ/sa nas sa ⑫gzhan du 'phar ⑪ba/ gnas 'cha'/ ma 'dres pa'am dbyer med pa/ 'dres pa'am tha dad pa/ta lapo/ sa mā rnyi maṇ+ḍa lamra/ ka ra ta laphra/ dṛ k+ṣa ta ngos sam steng ngam gzhi'am mthil/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor/ lag mthil/ shing drung ngam ljon lamra⑫—/ kra ma ta lamra/ byu mi ta lamra/ ā ⑫kā sha ta laphra/ sa marnya ta lamra⑫//pa'am 'og /zhabs kyi mthil/ sa'i 3steng ngam sa'i gzhi/ nam mkha'i dkyil/ kun gyi dkyil/skad go 'dun la/ut+margaḥ/ a pa bā daḥ(ste/ sa mu dā yārbaḥ/ tsā tusko ()ṭi kaḥ/ praṇ+ḍa niṇ+ḍi spyir btang / dmigs kyis ⑪bsal ba/ spyi'i don/ mu bzhi'am mtha' bzhi/ dris pa gtan la yaḥ6)—/ ni bṛ tā byā kṛ tā( nyeḥ/ a ni thra ()tā byā kṛ tāḥ/ a bhi sa dbab pa/ bsgribs pa'i lung du mi ston pa/⑩ ma bsgribs pa'i lung du mi ston pa/ mngon par rtogs ma yādhi kaḥ⑪/ ki rtenā nā ka ra rde/ a saspra dz+nyā rgo/ ni rā ⑪swā daḥ/ kā mā pa'i mtha' las byung ba / tha dad du bya ba ci yod/ shes bzhin ma yin pa/ ro bro ba med pa/ 'dod pa 115——192

pa tsa raḥ/ rū ①bā ba tsa raḥ/ o mi t+yā rdu)ha/ dī paḥ/na spyod pa/ gzugs na spyod pa/ de bzhin no zhes smras so zhe/zhe'am smras pa ④de bzhin no/ /mar me/us+thā⑤/ us+thā mu khamra ④/ pra dī baḥdze+e/ sa mu di skar ma'am sgon ma'am ta la la/ skar mda'i gdong ngam sna/ sgon ma'am mar me/ shar pa'am 'dus taḥ⑧—/ sh+lau khok+toḥ/ pra thradhe⑨/ a rnyi saṃ ( )sgoṣ+ṭha pa'am ⑪spyi/ tshig zur gnyis su sbyar ba/ 'phel ba'am skyes pa/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang ()rgya te⑫—/ bo (stedhi ma bhi sasrudhaḥ⑫/ a bhi sam+bubye 4lhati/ budha twa bar 'gyur/ byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba/ sangs rgyas ma bā ⑩sdo ti/ bi byo ti taḥ/ pa ri dz+nyā/ sam+bha pa ti/ a sam+bha baḥ/nyid 'thob po/ /⑫rnam par snang bar byas/ yongs su shes pa/ 'byung ngam spyosrid pa/ mi srid ba'am mi 'byung ba/ā kra ma ṇamra⑥ / ā kra ⑪ma ya ti/ a ba kra ⑫ma ti/ ā ya taḥ/ pra bhā gnon pa/ gnon par byed pa/ 'gro ba'am 'jug pa/ yun ring po'am 3rgya che ba'am yangs pa/ brjod ba nā/ bya ba s+thā namra/ bīsgyu(ste/ k+ṣa ṇi kaḥ/ ā lasba pa/ rab tu bye ba'am ⑫rab tu bzhag ba'am rnam par bzhag pa/ zlos pa/ skad cig pa/ grib so teske/ a dh+yā lam+bha ⑩te/ a bhi pra lasba te/ kṛt+t+waṃ mamra ⑦/ sup+taḥ/babs⑫| grib so cher babs/ grib so mngon par rab tu babs pa/ bcos ma/ nyal ba'am gnyid log pa/bra ro ⑥da namra/ a dha raḥ⑪/ sha yā/ ā san+diḥ⑪/ ā bā shra yi⑫/ kha ṭ+wāṅgaḥ/ngu ba/ 'og ma/ mal/ khri'u/ rgyab rten ༄nye/ khri shing /muṅga raḥ(ste/ bra to daḥ/ pra t+ya graḥ/ pū ti bī dzapo/ ā tho ba/ gzugs pa btsugs pa gdab ⑫pa/ sar ⑩pa'am khye'u ⑪tshang / sa bon rul pa/ glo bur gan+tu kaḥ/ luñtsa te/ kṛ shaḥ/ sa ma ba dh+wa napo(nye/du 'ongs sam ()glo skyes sam thor bu/ 'bal lam thog skem pa/ 'gogs pa rgortepa'am phrad pa/115 193

bi shwa kas+thā/ ā ①nā hiṇ+ḍa yi tā/ a karmā ra kṛt+pa④/ pā ṭa las sna tshogs can nam bzo sna tshogs can/ bskor nas/ mkhan bzos ma byas pa/ gzal ba'am snenapo—/ ku ṭā dhiya ti/ bi ta ta ba li kā/ pra ti buñdzi taḥ/ a bhi rū bkas pa/ brdungs ⑤pa'am 'thub pa/ gnyer ma rangs / bskor ba'am ༷gang ba/ 'dzegs sam ⑦ṭaḥ⑧—/ pa ri gyin+daḥ⑨/ pra mā das+thā namra()/ k+ṣip+ta tshistoḥ/ urlu zhon/ brlan pa'am gsher ba/ bag med pa'i gnas/ sems khral khrul du gyur pa/ han tang gis kha dzā taḥ/ sa daḥ/ bi hwa lī ⑪bhū taḥ/ shā ka ⑫raḥ/ dhan+d+ra ⑫btab pa'am blong bar ⑫gyur pa/ myos pa/ rmugs spyoshes song ba'am blong ⑩ba/ 'dres pa/ chos bya sa na sasbrarta nī ya/ bi ṣa mā pa ri hā raḥ/ a ba mā na rgo ⑩bi mā na dz+wa⑫/ dzi kyis 'phongs par 'gyur ba⑩/ ya nga ba mi spongs pa⑫/ brnyas pa'am khyad du gsod pa/ sad pa'am dz+nyā sā/ bi ḍasba nā byu ḍaḥ/ a bi t+yāṇ+ḍa ko ṣa pa ṭa paṃ⑪/bgam pa/ co 'dri ba/ ma rungs pa'am gdug pa'am sbrul/ ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i spubs kyi sgrib ⑫pa/duḥkhaṃ ⑫tī ṭ+wāṃ kha dzā ka ṭu r+yā④/ nā da ti/ m+bi ṭaḥ bi ṭaḥ⑫/ bram+bhar ti/sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub pa tsha ba/ grag pa'am sgra 'byin pa/ mi gtsang ba'am phyi sa/ rab tu zag/ki yan+taḥ⑪/ lū naḥ⑩/ khā ṇaḥ/ dzi ⑫bu sā hwa yaḥ/ ubyā yā ⑥daḥ/ji snyed dam ji tsam/ brngas/ bcad 'phro'am khyi'u kha/ 'dzam bu zhes bya ba/ rabs chad pa/rgyarmā ⑩lo ka mu khaṃ/ brad+ma pa tha ko be ⑥daḥ/ lahūṃ/ lak+ṣa ṇi/ kā ra be+e kārlo ⑫chos snang ba'i sgo/ tshangs pa'i lam la mkhas pa/ mtshan gyi gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ rgyu la 'bras bu pa tsā raḥ/ kābyu kā ra rto pa tsā raḥ/ u pa pati pra ti lasnyi ⑫kaḥ/ dha1 butā pra ti btags ()pa/ 'bras bu la rgyu (9btags pa/ skye bas thob pa/ chos nyid kyis lam+bhaḥ—/ dhan+d+ra ⑪tā pra ti ⑫lā rnyi ke/ bi dhā napo⑥/ sā khi ④sum̐/ pra t+ya yi taḥ/thob pa/ chos nyid kyis rnyed pa/ gcad ⑩pa'am dgag pa/ bshes pa'i tshig /yid ches pa'am yid brtan pa/115—194

a pra byā hā raḥ/ sba lam①/ dha na ni/ ra ṇa shoṇ+ḍaḥ/ di shin tu brjod du med pa/ thang ngam skam/ skam la'am thang la/ g.yul ngor 'dor ba'am brtul ba/ nyi na ka raḥ/ a dh+yā lam+bha naphrasde/ sā ①k+ṣi bya pa diṣ+ṭha/ sā rjok+ṣi thraṣ+ṭa srun/ma'am nyin byed/ lhag par dmigs pa/ dbang por phul ba/ dbang por 'dris pa'am ⑤che bzhi rmas pa/a dzi namradhi/ a nā swa s+t+waṃ sa twa ⑦nā shā sa ye maḥ⑧/ thra thi g.yang gzhi'am pags pa/ sems can dbugs ma byung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ⑨ngo / /sa la mi byā ma pa ta nā ya/ ā gā ṭi ka ri 6 ti/ na ba yā na saspra sbi taḥ⑫/ s+t+ra paḥnyung bar bya ba'i phyir/ dam por byed pa'am sra bar byed pa/ theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa/ mchod tsi ⑪t+yamra/ tsi t+yāṅga ṇaḥ/ ba suḥ⑫/ tsa ra ma bha bi kaḥ/ ni ⑫kā ya ④sa bhā ga s+thā be rten/ mchod rten gyi 'khor saske/ dbyig gam nor/ srid pa tha ma ⑫pa/ ris mthun par 'phen dhaḥ⑩—/ u pa bā saḥ/ ā hā re pra ti ku la saṃ dz+nyā/ sarba lo ke ⑫a na rnyi ra pa/ za gcig gam sgyung ba/ zas la mi 'phrod pa'i 'du shes/ 'jig rten thams cad la mngon par mi dga' ti saṃ dz+nyā/ si k+ṣu ⑪pa damra/ shī lamra/ sasbra raḥ/ byu ⑪ta gu ṇaḥ⑪/ba'i 'du shes/ bslab pa'i gzhi⑪/ tshul khrims sam ngang tshul/ sdom pa/ sbyangs pa'i ⑫yon tan/saṃ le khaḥcha/ saṃ ya maḥ⑫/ a ya spra pā ṭi kaḥ/ shā mi kaḥ⑪/ yuk+toḥpa da byañdza ⑫ne+eḥ/yo byad bsnyungs pa/ yang dag par sdom ⑫pa/ lcags kyi tsha tsha/ g.ya'/ tshig 'bru 'byor ⑥pa/sa hi taiḥ/ ā nu lo ⑫mi kaiḥ/ ā nu ⑪ts+tsha bi kaiḥ/ au pa yi kaiḥ/ pra ti ⑫rū baiḥ⑫/ pra 'brel pa/ rjes su mthun pa/ rjes su 'phrod pa/ thabs dang ldan pa/ 'tsham pa/ mthun dablu ṇiḥ⑪/ ni pa ka ⑪myuṅga sasgyu riḥ/ nā ti dzagret+pa/ nā ti sa retu⑪/ e pa/ 'grus skyong gi yan lag gi tshogs/ ha cang smra ba mang du mi bya/ ha cang 'phro bar mi byed/ de ltar na ba mārlu (rteṇ+ḍaṃ man+t+ra ⑫ṇa/ lasgyu mibyā dṛṣ+ṭiḥ()pra hā 'phags pa rnams kyi smra ba'am bya'agro ba'am brjod pa/ log par lta ba spong bar nus pa'am spang bar rung 115—195

te tuḥ①/ pra dh+wa na te tuḥ④/ sa ha kā ri pra t+ya yaḥ pe/ a pa k+ṣu (4)laḥ/ dodz+ra dz+nyā(khya/rgyu| rgyu'i gtso bo/ grogs byed pa'i rkyen/ skyon/ 'chal ba'i shes rab/doḥ shī dze+edu/ mu suṇ+ḍi kā/ sā rū py-i⑦/ a n+ya tra/ tsā ri tram̐/ ā tsa re/'chal ba'i tshul khrims/ khu tshur/ tshul dang 'dra ba/ gzhan du 'am (shem gtogs pa/ spyod pa/ cho ga /sa pa:⑨/ tsit+ta tsa ri te/ z-ibhaḥ/ tsi ra tre ṣārtaḥ/ pa rā kra 'gran zla/ sems kyi spyod pa/ ngoms/ yun ring po nas skom pas gdungs/ pha rol gnon pa'am maḥ⑫—/ ma n+ya nā/ sha l+yaphra/ ba ṭharnyi/ste/ bi dhu yisteraḥ/ mu brtul ba/ zlom sems/ zug rngu/ 'don pa'am brjod pa/ 'gal ba'am ma tshang ba/ gtso bo'am khyu⑫—/ go ṇaḥ/ skyes pa tsā ri kaḥ/ mas pa tsa yi kaḥ// pa ri bhā dang po/ btags ⑫pa'am phal pa/ nye bar btags pa/ rgyas pa las byung ba/ 'thams pa'am spyo ⑫ṣā⑩ / bra ti kṛ ti/ but+ta liḥ/ bal+lī kaḥ/ sa mā brdza namra/ dhan+d+ra 7shās+t+waṃ/ba/ gzugs brnyan/ gzugs su byas pa/ grog mkhar/ 'dun par bya ba/ chos khrims/a bye ka t+ya/ ā bidhaḥ.ā ⑪k+ṣip+taḥ/ bā la dzā ṭī yaḥ 0/ ma rgyuḥ4te/ garnya yuk+toḥ mi/'on kyang kha cig ni/ 'phangs pa/ byis pa'i rang bzhin can/ khro ba'am brtse ba/ spos sbyar ba/kṛ ṣi kaswān+taḥ⑫/ sru tsi karmā④/ mṛ ta kṛ haṃ/ ka ⑪ṭa sī/ gaṭ+wā⑪/ stso tram̐/ ha ri ta zhing blas/ 'drubs su bya ba'am skud ris/ chad ( bhe pa/ dur khrod/ khung ngam dong / bu ga /ne+e'u shā dwa lo/ pu li naḥ/ uspyoṣ+ṭaḥ/ s+tha ⑫ba raḥ/ dzi ⑥ga maḥ/ ya thā kra mamra/ ma dhū bsing / gling ma/ lhag ma/ gnas pa'am brtan po/ 'gro ba/ go rims bzhin/ sbrang rtsi'i khyuṣ+ṭaḥ—/ sit+tha rtekaphra/ a sgye ⑪sha yaḥ/ ā sha yaḥ1/ ā shā/ ā shā ya taḥ⑫/tshig ma'am pra tshil/ pra ⑫tshil/ lhag pa'i bsam pa/ bsam pa/ re ba/ bsam pa thag pa nas/a bhe bre lta/ ār+ṣa sgoshābhas+thā dz+wa pra ti dzā nī te/ maṅga bsam pa'am 'dod pa/ khyu mchog gi gnas su dam 'cha' 'am zhal gyis 'ches pa/ spa gong ngam yul 115—197

khyu taḥ/ prasta skarnyaḥ/ nin+d+ra ti bhā dz+wa/ a rnyo ①mu khaḥ/ pra m+me na ba raḥ②/yul ④bur gyur pa/ phrag pa bcum/ spobs pa med pa/ mgo smad pa/ sems khong du chud pa/pāṇ+ḍa rjokasba la shi lā ta laphra/ ā ⑤spyo rgo/ pu rā r+ṇa/ i ti hā saḥ/ hā ar mo nig lta rjobu'i rdo leb/ ⑦gtam rgyud/ gna'i rabs/ de lta bu byung bar brngod pa/ bzhad sri| lā sum̐/ bi kan+d+ra rna/ baṇ+ḍi ⑧bā shī/ maṇ+ḍa tai/ la gad| 'jo'am sgeg pakhya/ spyoms pa'am smod pa/ dor ba/ cha pa'am ⑩bzhag pa/ sgeg pa'am ḍi haṃ/ u po ⑪ṣa dhaḥ/ ni kyu dza ya ti/ dh+wa tu pa ti taḥ⑫/ su pa ri rol pa'am tho)mdzes pa/ nye bar gso sbyong byed pa/ skad 'byin/ khams su gtogs pa/ legs par dhardzi tā/ urje spyolta/ pa ri hā ṇiḥ/ saṃ dṛ taphra/ bī rdza ⑫brdos pa/ btus sam phyung ngam bcus pa/ yongs su nyams pa/ bsdams pa'am sngas pa/ sa bon bā pa ya ti/ bi ṣamra/ hā lā ⑩ha lo/ pra t+yā pa rārjaḥ⑩/ ga ḍo nā sa ma ti kran+taḥ⑫/'debs su 'jug /dug /dug ha la ha la/ yid ches par bya ba'i phyir/ bgrang ba las 'das pa'i/sa mu dra tī rī ya kā ⑪māṃ/ u pa laphra/ a k+ṣa mā tā rnyisgro ⑫rā rnyiḥ/ bṛ thas+thā ⑥naḥ/rgya mtsho'i ngogs na gnas pa rnams kyi/ rdo ba/ shing rta'i srog shing tsam gyi rgyun/ so so'i skye bo/ gadhā ba krārnyi⑫/ su kha saṃ ⑫spar+shaḥ/ nā nā byā dhi pa ri ga te④/ na mngal lam lhums ⑫sam rum du 'jug pa/ reg na bde ba/ nad sna tshogs kyis btab pa/ dig laslo bha ba ti/ daṇ+ḍaḥ/ ma hi kā/ rtswa hā ⑪raḥ/ dza lam+bi gā h+ya⑦/pa'am ldib ⑫par mi 'gyur/ dbyug pa'am chad pa⑥/ na bun rmug pa/ khugs rna⑩/ chu 'bogs te/kwa thi tapo/ kwa tha yi tā⑪/ a rnyi bisma yaḥ/ artse tai/ āsh+tsazlo⑫/ bya pa bskol ba'am bsdus pa/ bskol te/ ya mtshan che/ rmad du byung ba/ ngo mtshar/ 'du 'dzi med kṛṣ+ṭaḥ—/ a na pa kṛṣ+ṭaḥ/ kā l+ya me ba⑫/ a ra ṇiḥ(9/pa'am dbe+en pa/ mi dben pa'am 'du 'dzi can/ nang bar kho na'am nang bar sngar/ gtsub shing /115—198

k+ṣe paḥ/ lup+taḥ/ pān+taḥ/ be da nā dh+yā pa ya ti/ san+ni ① pa'am gtams ④pa/ zhig pa'am mi snang ba/ mtha'/ rig byed klog tu 'jug /gnas pa'am shri taḥsne/ bra ṣ+ṭha ④daḥ/ ba lā dhā naphra/ ā ⑤kā k+ṣe mā ṇaḥ/ uts+tsha li taḥ/ bya brten pa/ rab tu sim pa/ stobs skyed dupa/ 'dod na/ bskyod pa'am 'phags pa/ zad pa'am yaḥ—/ bi ni badhaḥ⑦/ bi ṭha pa na pra kyu pas+thā na la k+ṣaṇi⑧/ s+thā naphra/god pa'am 'jig ⑨pa/ 'brel pa/ rnam par bsgrubs pa nye bar gnas pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnyis pa/shīr+ṇaḥ/ a bya ba tī ṇ+ḍaṃ()/ sā ba r+yaphra/ a na ba bye/dengs pa'am rnyis pa'am lhag pa/ ma 'dres pa/ kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa⑩/ kha na ma tho ba med/nirga taḥ/ pra khyuṣ+ṭaḥ/ pra dh+yā yan+taḥ⑫/ dasgo ⑫mā yā kā ro mā yā kā byung / lhung ba'am bo ba/ sems pa'am sems khong du chud pa/ sgyu ma byed pa'am sgyu ma byed pa'i slob rārnye spyobā sī bā/ pra bat+t+waṃ rka/ a nu brta rka/ saṃ ro dhaḥ/ bi katho )/ma mkhas pa/ 'jug par byed pa/ rjes su 'jug pa/ yongs su 'gog pa/ rnam par brjod pa/liṅge/ pra ti k+ṣe pa ṇa sā ba byetsusme/ ni rā ka ra rde/ kā ri tram̐/mtshan nam ⑫rtags/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa/ bzlog pa'am bshig pa/ byed pa/ tseṣ+ṭi tai/ dṛsgo ⑩yi/ bhā ba nā te yo/ a sde/ ā sri⑫/g.yos pa'am spyod pa'i tshul/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba/ gnas/ kha/pa ṭuḥ/ pā p+ta nu ṣaṅgaḥ⑪/ pu sgyu bhi ⑫6n+daḥ/ ā dz+nyā ⑪tsit+ta na⑫/ sarba sgrin po/ 'thob pa dang 'brel pa/ bsod nams rgyun byas⑫/ shes par bya bar sems pa sems tse ta sā mar+sā (stehri t+ya/ pra ti bra tā/ sa ta ta sa mi tai/ kle sha ba kun gyis bsams te⑫/ khyim thab las mi 'phro ba/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad pa/ nyon mongs pa che hu laḥske/ tā ⑪pra rā gaḥ/ tī bra dwo ṣaḥ/ tī ba'am mang ba/ 'dod chags che ba'am bdo ba/ zhe sdang bdo ba'am zhe sdang shas che ba/ gti mug 115—200

bra mo haḥ/ dī naḥ/ tī naḥ/ lī naḥ/ bi bdo ba'am shas che ba'am mi bzad pa'am tsha ba/ zhan pa/'-i) dman pa'am ngan pa/ zhum pa/ yi ṣā daḥ/ a ba sā da mā pa r+ya te/ bi ṣaṇ+ḍa ma na saḥ/ tsit+ta nā ba lbo ya bsad| spa bkong ②bar 'gyur zhe'am yi bsad par 'gyur/ yi bsad pa'am sgyid lug pa/ sems mi te na saṃ lī ya te/ na bi thraṣ+ṭṛ ①bha ba ti a su mā na saṃ/ e ṣa ṇa/ parle ④ṣa rja/ a zhum kun nas mi zhum/ de'i yid phyir phyogs par mi 'gyur/ tshol ba/ yongs su tshol ba/ rjes twe ṣa ṇ+ḍa/ sa ma twe ṣa ṇa/ mṛ ga ya te/ pra t+ya ⑤nu bha ba ti/ be+e da ya ti/ saṃ be+e da su tshol ba/ kun du rjes su tshol ba/ tshol/ so sor myong bar 'gyur/ myong bar 'gyur/ kun du myong ya ti/ pra ti saṃ be+e da ya ti/ ni t+yaḥ/ sgru baḥ/ shā shwa taḥ/ a bi pa ri bar 'gyur/ kun du so sor myong bar 'gyur/ rtag pa/ brtan pa/ ther zug /mi 'gyur ba'i ṇa ma dharmā/ kyuṭa s+thārjo/ a ba kalba nā/ sasgyu ba nā/ tse ta saḥchos can/ ther zug tu gnas pa/ nges par rtog ⑦pa'am legs par rtog ⑧pa/ srid pa/ sems pra sā daḥ/ ats+tshaḥ/ bi pra ⑨san+daḥ/ swats+tshaḥ/ pra san+daḥyi / a nā bi laḥ/ a nā dang ba/ dang ba/ rnam par dang ba/ shin tu dang ba/ dang ba'am gsal ba/ rnyog pa med pa/ mi ra tā⑩/ a bi ra tā⑫/ a pra ti bi ra tā⑫/ a nu ba ra tā/ kurnyi/ pra t+ya yaḥ/ ā spong ba/ ma spangs pa/ phyis kyang mi spong ba/ mi 'dor ba/ dpya⑫/ dpya bla skyesaske/ 'byung ka ⑫raḥ/ ni dh+wa dz+wa/ dha rgo/⑩ dra bye/ dham+bi tī k+ṣ-i ti ma nu pra dā myu maḥ⑫/ ni gha⑩/khungs sam 'byung gnas/ gter/⑫ nor/ rdzas/ chos bzhin du khu'am cha 'bul/ sdig pa/ā ⑥dī na baḥ/ kilbi ṣe⑫/ a pa rā ⑫dhaḥ/ bā los+thā ④pa naphra/ mṛ ṣā mo ⑫ṣa dham+bi ⑩ṇaḥ/nyes dmigs/ sdog pa'am gdug pa/ nyes pa/ byis pa brid pa/ brdzun pa bslu ba'i chos can/bi pa ri ṇa haṃ/ rik+taḥ/ tuts+tshaḥ/ ba shi kaḥ/ a sā raḥ/ ni rī (rtehā/ nibyeṣ+ṭaḥ/rnam par myur/ gsog /gsob/ ya ma rla⑫/ snying po med pa/ g.yo ba med pa/ byed pa med pa/115—201

— ——— ——— — ———byed——— — — —— ———————————— — ——— — ———— —baṃ kaḥ/ bak+kaḥ3 / dzi h+maḥ/ ku ṭi /zhe laḥ/yon po/ ya yo ma 'dom na yon po/ 'gras 'grus sam gya gyu'am ya yo'am g.yon can/ gya gyu can/tsak+ki kaḥ/ —)/ ku sre tiḥ(4// dzi gharmi 5)taḥ/ pi pā si taḥ/thabs su sbyar ba'am g.yor bskyims pepa'am sbyor ka byed pa8/ ngan g.yo/9// bkres pa/ skom pa/ku pā ba ra ṇaḥ/ ku tse laḥ/ kṛ pa ṇaḥ/ ba nīr+ya kaḥ/ artaḥ/ dha ni ka bha bgo ba ngan pa/ gso ngan pa/(/ ) bkren pa/(spe sdug phongs pa/ nyam thag pa/ bu lon pas ya dhī ta yaḥ/ kla ma thaḥ/ kla maḥ/ gabe+e taḥ/ s+t+waṃ 'jigs shing skrag pa/ snyom pa'am 1dub pa/ ngal ba'am ⑫dub pa/ dreg spyopa'am snyems pa/ khengs bhaḥsnyozhe—/ bispa sgro/ bi shrī 6speḍa mā naḥ/ sa lī lo/ dbe+e pa'am rengs pa/ rnam par 'gran pa/ rnam par rtse ba/ 'jo bag can nam 'chos pa/ rgyags pa'am taḥske/ mat+taḥ/ a k+ṣa k+shi 6naḍā/ ri re sā4 chi/ k+shi ḍa ti/ ra ma ti/ ba /beri tsā ra ya ti/dregs pa/ myos pa/ cho los rtse ba/ rtse 'dod/ rtse/ dga'/ dga' mgur spyod/kan+d+raḥskozhe—/ pra te li kaḥ/ ga ha rgo/ gha dz+wa8te/ a nu pa ha tai/ a k+ṣa tai/ a z-i ()ste/pho long / lde'u'am sku ska/ thibs po/ stug po/ ma nyams pa/ ma smas pa/ mi ngoms pa/u rgyu 6geraḥ/ sah+phu ru ṣaḥ/ bu ru ṣa thra ṣa bhaḥ6na/ bu ru ṣa puṅga baḥ/gsal bar byed pa'am brtson pa'am btang ba/ skyes bu dam pa/ skyes bu khyu mchog /skyes bu skyes mchog/ma hā bu ru ṣaḥ/ sārba bā haḥ/ na kuṇ+ḍi bha ba ti/ na lo 5go bha ba ti/ na bak+ṣa ha skyes bu chen po/ ded dpon/ lag rdum du mi 'gyur/ rkang rdum du mi 'gyur/ gzhogs byed skam tsoto bha ba ti/ na bi ka leji yo bha ba ti/ sgo gaḥ/ u pa sgo gaḥ/ pa par mi 'gyur/ dbang po ma tshang bar mi 'gyur/ longs spyod/ nye bar spyod pa/ yongs su spyod pa ri sgo gaḥ/ ābh+yaḥ / ma hā dha naḥ/ bra bhū ta dha naḥ/'di rnams dang ma 'dom na longs spyod/ phyug po/ nor che ba'am nor chen po/ nor mang po/// 5 202

——— — — ——— ———— — — — — —pañtsa rnyiṭ+wā ma gu ṇiḥs 1 mabe+e taḥs man+d+radhī 2bhū taḥ/ sarba su kha sa mabe+etaḥ/ // sa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur pa/ bde ba thams cad dang ldan pa/ 'byor pa'am mabe+etaḥ④—/ yuk+to(5// sa man+d+ra ga taḥ) / u be /5 taḥ/( duḥ/ )kha phul ba'am gtad pa/ 'byor pa'am ldan pa'am rig pakhyeṭ+wāṃ/ ldan pa/ sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa'am sgyun+ta ka raḥ/ par+ya ba ro dhaḥ(she/ yīr+yā ba /shethaḥ/ go tsa raḥ( )/ mā ra tsa spruḥ/sdug bsngal gyi mthar byed pa/ yongs su 'dzin pa'am bkag pa/ spyod lam/ spyod yul/ bdud kyi sde/kriṇ+ḍa tunyebartseḥ/ a nu pa ri pā la ya ti/ sā sra ba dz+nyā rna 39/ a nā sra (zhebadud dam nag po'i rtsa lag /rjes su yongs su skyong / zag pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa/ zag pa med ba dz+nyā rna/ bi parnyiḥ/ bra dā li tā/ bi ki ra ṇi/ bi ga taḥ18/ bi dh+wad+ma pa'i shes pa/ rgyud pa⑪/ rab tu gshegs pa'am btsal ba/ 'thor/ bral ba/ gyes pa'am 'jig na dhan+d+raḥ/ ste da rna/ mā ru taḥ/ ti sha ༄/thiḥ/ hu tā sha naḥhu ta pa'i chos can/ 'jig pa/ rlung dmar ram rlung / tshes grangs/ ma 'dom na me 'dom na gcig bhukra—/ ā kā shaṃ/ ga ga rna khaṃ/ bai shā na raḥ/8spe a na laḥso sreg ⑫za/ ma 'dom na nam mkha' 'dom na go 'byed/ nam mkha'/ me/ sa'i ming ste 'dom bhū ta dhā ṭī( ste/ a ni laḥ/ su dzā ( gyetaḥ/ su pa ri ṇa taḥ/ a nu na 'byung po'i rten/ rlung / legs par skyes pa / legs par smin pa/ rjes su skyes pa'am mthun dzā taḥsha rte/ pra sru taḥ/ a nu shaṅgi kaḥ/ su saṃ sbi taḥ/ te tu kaḥ/par skyes pa/ byung ngam btsas sam skyes pa/ zhar la byung ba/ legs par gnas/ rgyu las byung ba/s+thā yo gi kaḥ/ swa 8sher sa ni ro ( — dha/ na ni bat+t+waṃ ya ti/ nir+ha meraḥ/ a bhi ni sbyor ba las byung ba/ rang gi ngang gis 'gag pa/ mi skye'am mi 'grub/ sgrub pa/ mngon par 'grub rbarta kaḥ/ a ba ro pi ta ku sha la spru laḥ/ pra ti bat+t+waṃ sadzata/ ka ṭa par byed pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa'am bskyed pa82/ sgrub pa phun sum tshogs pa/ dur khrod bskyed 11 5 203

sī badhi shesnatā/ sasbyo na rgoldu / sa mu dā pa—/ kun nas sam legs par ram yongs su bskyed pa/ legs par sbyar ba'am legs par bsgrub ①na nā yalgo / bhā bīlta/ pa ri kalpa sa myustso taḥ/pa'am legs par bsdu ba'i phyir/ 'byung ba'am 'gyur ba/⑪ yongs su rtog ④pa las byung ba/brta (nyate/ ā sā da rgo/ ā sā r+ya/'gyur ro'am 'dug go spyod do/ /thob par byed pa/ brten nas sam phrad nas sam thob nas⑨/pābe+eḥ—/ aze kṛ 7rja/ byarba rja4mi/ pra bhā thob pa/ 'bul ba'am gtod pa/ rnam par 'bul lam rnam par gtod/ rab tu byed do'am rab tu ba yarnyi/ sa mu dā tsā raḥ1rta/ pra ti bā ⑩da ya ti/ pra ti labhaḥ④/'jog go'am rab tu bskyed do/ /kun du 'byung ba/ 'bul lo'am go bar byed do/ /thob pa'am rnyed pa/u pa tshanā ma ya ti/ bṛdhi ⑩bi rū rnyi/ bi pu la tā mā pa r+ya te/ ā tsa yaḥ/ u pa tsa yaḥ/'bul/ 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / yangs par ⑩ 'gyur/ bsags pa/ rgyas pa'am 'phel ba/ā tsi taḥ/ pūr+ṇa hūṃ/ a nu she ra te/ uṅkar+ṣaḥ/ u pa pre tho) bsags pa/ gang ba'am rdzogs pa/ rgyas par 'gyur/ 'phel ba'am skye ba/ 'phel bar byed pa'am ha ya ti/ bi bar+bha rgo/ sañtsi tai/ dṛrnyi pra sarba 7/sher+ṇa/ bi sarba 0 r+ṇa/ u pa rgyas par byed pa/ rnam par 'phel ba/ bsags 2/ skye ba dang 'phel ba/ 'phel/ cher bsags tsi ta ta re/ tsa yaḥ/ a pa tsa yaḥ/ ni rū pa ṇa()/pa'am shin tu bsags pa/ 'phel ba'am sogs pa/ 'grib pa'am 'azi ba/ nges par rtog pa/nibe+e kadze+e a bi kadze+e( spre/ sa bi kawaṃ ri ste/ yo ni shaḥ.u pa pa rī rnam par rtog pa med pa'am rnam par mi rtog pa/ rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa/ tshul bzhin du brtag k+ṣ-i ta byā/ pra rū pa rja/ u pa pa rī k+ṣi rde thu/ a bhi ni rū pa ṇa/ bya ba tsā ra yi ta byu/par bya'o/ /rab tu rtog pa/ nye bar rtog pa/ mngon par rtog pa/ rnam par dpyad par bya/115—204

u pa ni dh+yā ta byaḥ/ ni dh+yāste①/ pra t+ya be k+ṣa yi ④ta bye④/ ni dh+yā duya ti/nges par brtag par bya/ nges par sems pa/ so sor brtag par bya/ nges par sems par byed/a nu gan+ta bye/ ā dz+nyā pa yaturjo/ saṃ dz+nyā pa yet+pa/ ni sgyu pa yetu/rtog par bya/ kun shes par gyis shig /yang dag par shes par gyis shig /nges par soms shig /u ha nārjo/ spru hā yo ⑦ha sa marbaḥ/ u pa lak+ṣa rde/ pre brtag pa⑧/ brtag cing bzhig ⑨nus pa/ nye bar brtags ( )pa'am nye bar mtshon pa/ lta ba'am k+ṣa te/ ni tī ra r+ṇa/ bi tsā ke/k+ṣer rde/ sa mo da ha naḥ/ a no rtog pa/ nges par rtog pa'am phyi ste rtog pa/ dpyod pa/ legs par rab tu rtog pa/ rjes su rab dā ha rna/ pañtsa skarnya ka ⑩pra ka ra rde/ ā ⑫bhe saṃ k+ṣe pi rka/ ā bh+ya ba kā shi rka/ sa ⑫tu rtog pa/ phung po lnga'i rab tu byed pa/ bsdus pa las gyur pa/ mngon par skabs yod pa/ yang mā dā ni rkatsusme/ pa ri kalpi tai/ bai byu (/tshetwe rka/ māṃ bya ba hā ()ri rka/dag par blangs pa las byung ba/ kun brtags pa/ dbang 'byor pa/ kun du tha snyad 'dogs pa/shāñtsā yāḥ/ sān+d+ra tho)sā bye/ a nu bye ti/() a nu bstan bcos las 'byung ⑩ba rnams rlan dang bcas pa/ ljid gnon/ nyams su myong ba/ myong bar bha ba ti/ bi dh+wa rgo/ ā dṛ ya te/ kha raḥ/ hrū skomeraḥ/ pa ru ṣi/byed pa⑫/ sgrub pa'am bzhag pa/ gus par byed pa/ 'khrang ba/ 'thas pa/ rud rud ()po/rū cik+ṣe/ byu dṛ taḥ/ byut+pan+daḥ/ byut+pa hud hud po/ zhugs pa/ byang ba'am rtogs pa'am shed bye ba/ bye brag tu rtogs par byed pa'am bye t+t+waṃ| pra kṛ ⑫tiḥ/ swa bhā baḥ/ swa rū paṃ/ a brag tu sgrub pa/ rang bzhin/ ngo bo nyid dam rang bzhin/ rang gi ngo bo'am rang bzhin/ rjes su nu bi dhā rna⑪/ pu raḥs raḥ/ bi na swa re/ swa tan+t+raḥ/byed pa'am rjes su 'jug pa'am rjes su 'gyur ba/ sngon du 'dren pa/ 'jig pa'i ngang can/ rang dbang /115—205

a nu myu ti/ asmi ①sa tī rda bha ba ti/ asro t+pa ②dā di da mut+pa r+ya te/ dzā ①ya rjes su 'brel ba/ 'di yod pas 'di 'byung / 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye④/ rgyal bar ka raḥ/ ma byu ka raḥ/ sar+pārja sā dha rka⑤/ pa ri ga ṇaḥ/ a dh+yā si taḥ/ ā tsā rjom byed| sbrang rtsir byed/ don kun sgrub ⑦pa/ khang khyim/ ldan pa'am gnas pa⑧/ 'bras maṇ+ḍaḥ⑨ske/ ni sha dā shi khā/ ni sha ⑩dā bu traḥ⑪shi khā pu traḥ⑫/ gha rajiḥ/khu/ mchig gam gtun gyi gzhi/ mchog gu'am gtun bu/ rang thag /ā tā rna/ bi tā dz+wa/ nā li/ be rma/ tu riḥ⑫/ sgyurwadaḥ⑫/ sa rgyu/ spun/ son pa/ thags bzang / tshig pa/ gal gnyis su smra ba/ zhugs mā rū ḍho⑫/ a ku thi haṃ⑩/ ā kasmi pa'am zhon pa'am non pa/ ma rul ba'am ma zhig ⑩pa/ 'phral lam glo bur ram gyi na'am rgyu med par rka—/ ra ṇaḥ/ a kṛ tā sgyu ⑫ga maḥ/ kṛ ta bi kra byung ba⑪/ nyon mongs pa'am 'thab pa'am g.yul⑩/ ma byas pa dang phrad pa/ byas pa ṇ+ḍa ⑪shaḥ/ a nan+ta ra dzad+maḥ⑫/ kṛt+ta shu kle/ gu ru ta ram̐ bha ba ti/chud za ba/ gzhan gyis mchod pa'i tshe la/ dkar nag /nang na lci ba/ba sa naḥ/ ā ⑫be dhaḥ/ pa rā ⑫tshwapra ti māṃ tse ⑫ta bhā ya tā⑪/ pa ra chags zhen/ 'phen pa'am shugs/ gzhan gyis bsgo ba sems pa ⑦las gyur pa/ gzhan gyis gsol ba saṃ ⑫dz+nyābhi s+t+waṃ tse ta nī ya tā/ pha la bi pā ka sasmo haḥ/ ta tāza ⑪sasmo haḥ/btab pa sems pa las gyur pa/ 'bras bu rnam par smin pa la rmongs pa/ de kho na'i don la rmongs pa/byā se kaḥ/ be dhiḥ/ de baṃ⑪/ bi mā la nā/ bya ba ki ra ṇa⑪/ spar+sha rū pa 'phyar ba/ sko sham pa/ gnam gyis bskos ⑫pa/ sbyong ba/ 'dres pa/ reg pas ⑫gzugs su rung ṇ+ḍa / de sha ni rū pa ṇa(sre/ kṛ t+yā ti pastiḥ(sme/ tsagru saṃ spar+sha ba/ yul brtags pas ⑩gzugs su rung ba/ bya ba shor ba/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i 115—206

te① —/ tsi ṭī kā raḥ/ bi dz+nyā na nā lak+ṣa rung ba/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang 'dom na bkra bar 'dzin pa/ rnam par shes par byed pa'i mtshan rde—/ saṃ dz+nyā na nā gelak+ṣa rde/ dhas+thā 1 ya ta ni rka/ baṇ+ḍi ni sgo/nyid/ 'dus te shes par byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos kyi skye mched/ kha dog dang ④'dra ba'am lta bu/bi bhā ṣā⑤/ u pa de shaḥ/ āsnra yaḥ rjo/ sirnyo pa nī taḥ⑦/bye brag tu bshad pa'am smra ba/ lung phog pa/ man ngag /grub pas bstan pa'am brtags pa⑧/pā ⑨ri ṇa mi kaḥ/ saṃ yo gi kaḥ()/ bla tha mashra baṃ/ ཿ/(mebasgyur ba las byung ba/ sbyar ba las byung ba/ lhod pa dang lhod pa ma yin pa/ sbungs skyes pa'am pag rtsa dzā—/ shu maḥ/ bi shra maḥ/ rūtshwa (sngeskyes pa/ ngal ba/ ngal sos ⑫pa/ brgyal ba'am mi dran pa'i ④myog ces byed pa ngom pa'i tshim pa'am z-ibhiḥ⑫ / ba paṃ/ dorba lhi/ ā ba sbi rka⑩/ u tsit+t+waṃ/ a rgyas pa/ nyam yod pa/⑩ nyam chung ba/ gnas skabs las gyur pa/ nar ma'am 'dris pa/ nar nu tsi taispyo/ pra yuk+taḥ⑪/ ā t+yarnyi kaḥ⑥/ma ma yin pa'am ma 'dris pa/ zhugs pa'am brtson pa'am sbyor ba'am sbyar (kyeb/ gtan du ba/e karnyi kaḥ( nye/ a ba s+thā/ bā daḥ/ bā dā dhi ka ra r+ṇa/ bā dā dhijo ⑫rna/gcig tu nges pa/ dus sam gnas sam che'i gnas skabs/ smra ba/ smra ba'i zhal che ba/ smra ba'i gzhi/bā dā lo kā ④raḥ/ bā dā ni gra haḥ/ bā da niḥ⑫sa ra r+ṇa⑫/ bā de ba hu ka rā ⑫dhan+d+raḥ/smra ba'i rgyan/ smra ba chad pas bcad ⑫pa/ smra ba las byung ba/ smra ba gces spras la dgos pa'i chos/pra bā sgo)daḥ/ bi bā daḥ/ a pa (rtebā daḥ/ a nu bā daḥ/ a ba bā daḥ/ bya rmad khyer ba smra ba/ rtsod pa smra ba/ tshig ngan smra ba/ mthun par smra ba/ gdams ⑥pa smra ba/ rnam pa kabhā tai/ ā dz+nyā mā tshu)rā ga ya ti/ sa ma ba sargaḥ/ pā tik+ṣe pi rka par spangs pa/ kun shes pa thob par byed/ rgyun yang dag par bcad pa/ bsal ba ⑫las gyur pa/115—208

bi hā t+yā/ saṃ ka la na pra hā rde/ pā ①mā ṇi kā sa hā ya kā(9/ bā dā bi dhi dz+nyā ①na rnam par nyams par byas pa/ bsdoms dute spong ba/ tshad mar rung ba'i zla grogs/ smra ba'i tshul shes bha bi ⑤ta bye/ āt+ma kā maḥ/ no tu bi gre duh+ya bā daḥ/ rā dzā ku lo/ yuk+ta par bya ba/ bdag legs su 'dod pa/ brtsad cing smra bar mi bya/ rgyal po bzhugs pa/ bskos pa ku lo/ sa bhā/ dṛṣ+ṭarnye na a dṛṣ+ṭa myurnya sa sbo ka ra ṇa sa mā khyu dz+wa⑦/'du ba'i sa/ 'dus pa/ mtha' mthong ba dang mtha' ma mthong ba mtshungs par sbyar zhing bstan pa/e kā ba tsā ⑧ra kaḥ/ pūrba pa da kaḥ/ partswat+pa ⑨da kaḥ/ uṅgā ⑩ri kaḥ/gcig nas rtog pa/ tshig gong ma dang sbyor ba/ tshig 'og ma dang sbyor ba/ de bzhin no zhes bya ba/kā pa de shaḥ/ yā pa de shaḥ/ su ⑩sat+tha kā shā bhādholhathaḥ⑫/ muṣ+ṭi yo gaḥ/ci zhes bstan pa/ gang zhes bstan pa/ bdag nyid yod spyopar smra ba ma nor ba'i don/ mkhyud spyad/dibye / he tuḥ/ kā ra rde/dga' bas/ rgyu'am gtan tshigs/ byed pa'am rgyu he tu nyustedang ni spyomi tā dang 'dom na byed rgyu/ni mit+t+waṃ⑩/ kād+ma pa ⑫dhaḥ/ raṭ+wā spyoha ra rde/mtshan ma'am rgyu ho tu ⑪dang ka ra ṇa dang 'dom na rgyu mtshan/ khar ba bsad pa⑫/ rin po che phrogs pa/si tā ha ra rde/ dza na pa da ka s+thā rde/ rusmi nī ha ra rde⑪/ u pa dha no pa rā gaḥ dhi/rol snyed phrogs pa/ yul gyi bzang mo/ gser ldan ma phrogs pa/ nye bar bzhag pas kha bsgyur ba/a dhi kā raḥ⑫/ pra t+yā sarnyi(shā/ nibyu lam̐/ched du bya ba'am gzhi'am dbang du bya ba/ rab tu nye ba/ shin te ma med pa'am snyigs ma med pa/a pa ga ta phasguḥ(nye/ kiṣ+ṭaḥ()/ ka ṣaskyoḥ()/ pra t+ya snying po ma yin pa med par gyur⑫/ so dog /snyigs ma'am tshigs ma/ nan tan du bya'o zhe'o brtson te—/ byā ti re ba ya taḥ/ k+ṣe paḥ⑥/ byā ha tai/ bya ba par byed do⑩/ /med par gyur/ sdod pa/ rnam par nyams par 'gyur ba'am ⑪'gal ba/ rnam 115—209

sī padhe①/ be bye/ be+e da rka/ biti/ a bhi druste/ a pa khā ②paṃ/par rtogs so/ /rig par bya/ rig par byed④/ rig pa/ rnogs pa'am 'khus pa/ snyon ④pa/a pra ti bā ni/ kañtsa na gaṅgā mṛsbyi kā⑤/ a srad+ma naphrarjo/ ā phyir mi nur ba/ sa khongs na gser yod pa/ rgyun mi gcod pa'am mi gtong ba'am mi lhod pa/ gtod na ya ti/ a rnyi dz+nyā dz+nyā rgo/ pra ti khyu/ gle gha mā ne+e na/pa'am sgrub pa/ mngon par shes pa'i ye shes/ snying ne+eng ⑦ngam gnya'/ 'dod ⑧cing ngam sdod cing sti/ ṭī kho⑩/ dṛrnyo/ ma hābe+e ka /a dh+wa ga lta/ ba yolha nu ⑪pāp+ta/ lo bha rgan po/ ⑫'khogs pa/ gtugs pa/ dus yol ba/ dgog tu phyin pa/ brong ngam brngod skabs yat+pa⑫ / u bha ya to lo nyi ta kṛ to pa dhā ④rna/ ā swā la rna/ saurlo ⑫da yi kā/ pra t+ya dang sbyar⑩/ gnyis su rgyab rten dmar po bzhag ⑩pa/ rdob pa'am spyophul ba/ nyi ma shar ba/ phyir nu yuk+taḥ/ a nu yuk+taḥ⑪/ pra ti ni sargaḥ/ byatre+e bhā baḥ/ byu ba ⑩sha ma⑫ཿ/ bā ṭī kaḥ/brgal/ brgal ba/ nges par spangs pa/ byang bar gyur pa⑫/ rnam par zhi ba/ mi mun po/grangs dang bsre ba dang dus dang phyogs kyi ming las phal chen gyi grangs kyi le'u las 'byung ba'i grangs kyi ming la/sha te/ sa ha sre⑫/ ko ṭiḥ/ a yu taphra/ ni ⑫yu tamra/ bisbra rapo/brgya/ stong /() bye ba/ ther 'bum/ khrag khrig /dkrigs/ka ka raḥ/ a gā rapo/ pra ()ba raḥ ma ba raḥ a ba raḥ/gtams/ yid yal/ mchog yas/ ban bun/ phyar phyur/ta ba raḥ/ sī mā/ ṭu maphra/ ne+e ma ma⑥/ a ba gapo/ rī ba gaphra/phyad phyod/ 'tsham yas/ zam zim/ phyal phyol/ rig sdom/ zar zer/bi rā ⑫gapo/ bi ga bapo⑥/ saṃ kra ⑥maḥ/ bi sa raḥ/ bi dzam+bhaḥ/ bi dza gaḥ/ bi so taḥ/khrib khrib/ bsgyur yas/ spar yas/ 'phro yas/ nab nub/ thab thib/ rgyud yas/115—210

bi bā haḥ/ bi ①bhak+toḥ/ bi khyu taḥ )/ tu la namra/ dha ra ṇapo/ bi pa thaḥ/ bi par+yaḥ/khyad phyinasne/ bkra yas/ grags yas/ gzhal bgrang / gzhal dpag /yal yol/ 'khrul yas/sa mar+yaḥ⑦/ bi turjakhru/ he ba raḥ/ bi tsā nga raḥ/ bi tsastaḥ/ akyuṅga taḥ/ bi shiṣ+ṭaḥ/'phags yas/ rnam phyod/ rgyas ⑦yas/ bgrod yas/ bsngo yas/ zang yag /brtan yas/ne ba laḥ/ ha ri baḥ/ bi khyo bhaḥ/ ha li bhuḥ(mi/ hā rī saḥ(1)/ te lu gaḥ/ dra bu daḥ⑩ /stobs yas/ 'phrog yas/ 'brug yas/ rmo yas/ thing yug /shugs 'phyo/ 'thab yas/ha ru ṇaḥ/ ma lu daḥ/ k+ṣa mu daḥ/ e la daḥ/ ma lu maḥ/ sa da maḥ/ bi mu daḥ/ phyin phyod⑪/ gzungs sbyin/ bzod yas/ thal yas/ tshad yas/ rtogs yas/ dga' yas/bai mā traḥ/ pra mā ⑫traḥ/ a mā traḥspyo/ bh+ra mā traḥske/ ga mā traḥ⑫/ na mā traḥ/ te tshad 'das/ gzhal 'phyos/ gzhal yas/ gzhal thim/ gzhal 'khor/ gzhal med/ gar mā traḥ/ dhe spyomā traḥ/ pa ra mā traḥ/ shi ba mā traḥ/ e laḥ/ be laḥ/ te laḥ/ ge gzhal / gzhal sangs/ gzhal thag / gzhal phul/ yal/ dus 7rlabs/ nyar nyer/ phyag laḥ—/ sī laḥ/ ne+e laḥ/ ke laḥ/ se laḥ/ phe laḥ/ me laḥ sa ra phyig /zal zul/ btang ⑫yas/ sal sal/ yad yod/ phyol yas/ 'phrad /zheyas/ brjod baḥ—/ me lu daḥ/ khe lu daḥ/ ma tu laḥ/ sa mu laḥ/ a ya baḥ/ ka ma lamra/yas/ rdzi phyod/ rdzi phyod phyod/ ma gzhal/ dpag 'byam⑪/ zab bgrang / dga' brkyang /ma ga baḥ/ a ta raḥ/ he lu yaḥ/ be lu baḥ/ ka lā paḥ⑪/ ha ba baḥ/ bi ba raḥ/brtag yas/ bsgral yas/ 'ol phyod ⑫/ gdab yas/ cha tshogs/ bgrang yal/ bsnyad yas/na ba raḥ/ ma la raḥ/ sa ba raḥ/ me ru ṭu/ tsa ma raḥ/ dha ma raḥ/ pra mā daḥ⑫/rab yas/ bsnyal yas/ mchog ldan/ lhun yas/ rgod yas/ 'dzin yas/ dga' 'byam/bi ga maḥ/ u pa bat+t+waṃḥ/ nirde shaḥ/ a k+ṣa 3yaḥ/ sasgru taḥ/ a ma maḥ/ a bān+taḥ/dpag —bral/ mtha' rtul/ nges bstanali/ mi zad pa/ legs 'byung / nga byed/ bsal yas//1 5 211

ut+pa laḥ/ pad+maḥ/ saṃ khyu①/ ga tiḥ/ u pa ga maḥ/ a saṃ khye yi④/ a saṃ ⑦khye brlab yas/ mchog yas/ grangs 'byam/ rtogs 'gro/ rmod yal/ bgrang du med pa/ bgrang du ya pa ri brtaḥ/ a pa ri mā ṇaḥ/ a pa ri mā ṇa pa ri brtaḥ/ a par+yan+ta ཿ/ a pamed pa la rjobagres pa/ dpag yas/ dpag yas la bsgres pa/ mu med/ mu med la r+yarnya pa ri brtaḥ⑤/ a sa man+taḥ/ a sa man+ta pa ri rjobartaḥ/ a ga ṇi ⑦yi/ a ga ṇi bsgres pa/ thug med/ thug med la bsgres pa/ brtsi yas/ brtsi yas la ya ba ri bstoḥ/ a tu lhi/ a tu l+ya pa ri bstoḥ/ a tsirnyi/ a tsin+t+ra ba ⑧ri bsgres pa/ gzhal du med pa/ gzhal du med pa la bgres pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa brtaḥ—/ a me yi/ a me yi ⑨pa ri brtaḥ/ a na rnyi khā bye⑩/ a na bhi lā pya la bsgres pa/ bgrang yol/ bgrang yol la bgres pa/ brjod du med pa/ brjod du med pa la pa ri brtaḥ⑪/ a na bhi lā byā ⑫na rnyi lā ⑫pya pa ri brta nirde shaḥ⑫//bsgres pa/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa la bgres pa bstan pa/sdong po bkod pa las byung ba'i grangs kyi ming la/e rka/ da shaṃ/ sha tai/ sa ha sre/ ko ṭi/ a yu tai/ ni yu tai/gcig /bcu/ brgya/ stong / bye ba/ ther 'bum/ khrag khrig /bisbra raḥ/ rka ka raḥ/ ā gā raḥ/ pra ba re/ ma ba re/ a ba re⑫/ ta ba re/dkrigs/ gtams/ yid yalatho)/ mchog yas/ ban bun/ phyar phyur/ phyad phyod/sī oṃ/ po mi⑩/ ne ⑫oṃ/ a ga baṃ/ mri ga baṃ⑪/ bi rā gi/ bi ga baphra/mtshams ⑩yas/ zam zim/ phyal phyol⑪/ rig sdom/ zar zer/ khrab khrib/ bsgyur yas/saṃ kra rma/ bi sa re/ bi bha rdza/ bi dzā ()r+ghaṃ/ bi so rda/ bi bā haṃ()/ bi bhak+to/ bi spar yas/ 'phro yas/ nab nub/ thab thib/ brgyud yas/ khyad phyin/ bkra yas/ grags 115—212

kha tai/ tu la rgo/ ba ra ṇaphra/ bi ba ram̐'-i / a ba rna/ tha ba rgo/ bi paṅgi/yas| gzhal bgrang / gzhal dpag yal yol/ gsa' yas/ rgod yas/ khrul yas/sa mazlo④/ bi tūṇ+ḍaṃ/ he ba re/ bi tsā re/ bya t+yas+t+waṃ/ akyuṅga tai/ bi shiṭaṃ/'phags yas/ rnam phyod/ rgyas yas/ bgrod yas/ bsko yas/ zang yag /bstan yas/ni ba lo①/ ha ri sgo/ bi k+ko sgo/ ha li dzha/ ha riḥ/ ā lo kaḥ/ dṛṣ+ṭharnyaḥ④/stobs yas/ 'phrog yas/ 'brug g.yos⑤/ rmo yas/ thing yug /shugs 'phyo/ yid 'phyo/ha tu rgorjo/ e lo/ du be+e lam̐/ k+ṣe buḥ/ e la rda/ mā lu rda/ sa ma tā(pe/ bi phyin spyod/ thal thal/ yal yal/ bzod yas/ thal yas/ thal yas/ rtogs yas/ dga' ma rda/ pra mā tram̐/ a mj-i/ bh+ra rma tram̐/ ga oṃ tram̐/ na saṃ tram̐/ na hi rma tram̐/yas—/ gzhal 'phyos/ gzhal yas/ gzhal thim/ gzhal 'khor/ gzhal med/ gar gzhal/bi oṃ tram̐/ pa ra me ⑧tram̐/ shi marja/ e luḥ6)/ be luḥ/ ge luḥ/ shwe luḥ/gzhal sangs/ gzhal thag /gzhal phul/ yal/ dus / shā ) rlabs/ phyag phyig /zal zul/de ⑪luḥ/ bhe luḥ/ ke luḥ/ se luḥ/ pe luḥ/ me luḥ/ sa ra rde⑫/ me ru duḥ/gtang yas/ nyar nyer/ sal sal/ yad yod/ phyol yas/ 'phrad yas/ brjod yas/ rdzi phyod/khe lu duḥ/ mā lu duḥ/ sasba lo/ a ya baḥ(ge/ ka ma lo/ ma ga baṃ/rdzi phyod phyodathoste/ ma gzhal/ dpag 'byam/ zab bgrang / dga' brkyang / brtag tusteyas/a ta ruḥ/ he lu buḥ/ ka ṣa rtsa/ ha ba baḥ/ ha ba lo/ bi ba rebe/ / bim+bi/bsgral yas/ 'ol phyod/ cha tshogs/ bgrang yas/ ljab ljib/ bsnyad yas/ gzugs yas/mi ra baḥ/ tsa ra r+ṇa/ tsa ra oṃ/ dha ba re/ dha ma rgo/ pra mā daḥ/ ni ga saṃ/lhun yas/ gdab yas/ mtha' 'byam/ lang ling / 'dzin yas/ dga' 'byam/ dpag bral/u pa bat+t+waṃ/ nirde (zheshaḥ/ ak+ṣa yi/ sasnyu lta/ a ma saṃ/ a ba rda/ ut+pa lo/mtha' brtul/ nges bstan/ mi zad pa/ legs byung /1 / nga byed/ gsal yas/ rlab 3geyas/115 213

pad+me①—/ saṃ khye/ u pa ga oṃ②/ ga tiḥ/ u pa bye①/ a saṃ khye yo/mchog yas/ grangs 'byam/ smos yal/ rtogs 'go/ dpe yas/ bgrang du med pa/a saṃ khye ya pa ri ④brtaḥ/ a pra mā r+ṇa⑤/ a pra mā duṇa pa ri brtaḥ⑦/ a pa bgrang du med pa las bsgres ⑧pa/ tshad med pa/ tshad med pa las bsgres ⑨pa/ dpag ri mā r+ṇa/ a pa ri mā ṇa ba (kyeri bat+t+waṃḥ/ a par+yan+taḥ/ a par+yan+ta pa ri yas/ dpag yas las bsgres pa/ mu med/ mu med las brtaḥske/ a sa man+taḥ/ a sa man+ta ⑪pa ri brtaḥ/ a ga be+e yi/ a ga be+e bsgres pa/ thug med/ thug med las bsgres pa/ brtsis ()yas brtsis ⑫ya pa ri brtaḥ4snge/ a tu sum̐/ a tu l+ya spesmepa ri brtaḥ⑫/ a tsirnyi/yas las bsgos pa/ gzhal du med pa/ gzhal du med pa las bsgres pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/a tsirnyu ()pa ri brtaḥ()/ a mā (trebye/ a mā pya ⑫pa ri bstoḥ/bsam gyis mi khyab pa las bgres pa/ gzhal gyis mi lang ba/ gzhal gyis mi lang ba las bsgres pa/a na rnyi lā bye/ a na bhi khā pya pa ri ba7ཿ⑥/ a na bhi lā ⑫pyu na rnyi khā bye/ a brjod du med pa/ brjod du med pa las bsgres pa/ brjod du med pa'i yang brngod du med pa/ brjod du na rnyi khā pyu na rnyi lā pya ⑫pa ri brtaḥ//med pa'i yang brjod du med pa las bgres pa/rgya cher rol pa las byung ba'i grangs dang rtsis kyi ming la/sha haṃ ko ṭī nā ma yu lta nā mo ⑫tsu te/ sha ta ma yu tā nān+da ⑫yu te nā ⑪mo bye ba phrag brgya na ther 'bum zhes bya'o/ /ther 'bum phrag brgya na khrag khrig ces tsu te/ sha tai na yu tā māṃ ⑫rka ka ram̐ ṇa mo tsu te/ sha tai ka ka rā ṇ+ḍaṃ bisbra bya'o/ /khrag khrig phrag brgya na gtams pa ()zhes bya'o/ /gtams pa phrag brgya na 115byed214
