bslab pa bca' ba'i phan yon bcu dang cing byed sde lnga la sogs pa'i ming las phan yon bcu'i ming la/saṃ gha saṃ gra hā ya/ saṃ gha subyu tā yi/ saṃ gha su spar+sha bi hā dge 'dun bsdu ba'i phyir/ dge 'dun legs par bya ba'i phyir/ dge 'dun bde bar gnas par bya rā ya/ drurmabyu māṃ puṅga ①lā māṃ ni gra hā ya/ lalja dzā spar+sha bi ba'i phyir/ gnong mi bkur ④ba'i gang zag rnams tshar bcad ①pa'i phyir/ ngo tsha shes pa rnams bde bar hā rā rjoya/ a na bhi pra san+d+ra māṃ ⑤a bhi pra sā dā ya/ a r+bha gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ mngon par ma dad pa rnams mngon par dad par bya ba'i phyir/ mngon par pra san+d+ra ṭ+wāṃ byu yo bhā bā ya/ dṛṣ+ṭa dharmi kā shā mā sra bā shā sasba rā ④ya/ sasba dad pa rnams phyir zhing 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ mthong ba'i chos kyi zag pa rnams ⑦bsdam pa'i phyir/ tshe rā yi kā hūṃ skese tu sa mutra ghā tā ya/ bra d+ma tsar+yañtsa ⑨me cingasbi ti rka bha ⑩bi 6 ti//rabs phyi ma'i rnams chu lon gyis bzlog pa'i phyir/ nga'i tshangs par spyod pa yun ring du ⑪gnas par 'gyur/thong byed sde lnga dang ma nges pa'i ming la/tsa tā raḥpā ⑫rā dzi kā dharmā⑫/ tra yo da sha saṃ ghā pa she ṣā/ pā pati spyokā/phas pham par gyur pa'i chos bzhi/ dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum/ rtsang byed/tsa tā ⑫raḥpra ti de sha nī yāḥ⑫/ sasba hu lāḥ⑩shi gyi dhas+thāḥ⑫//so sor bshags pa bya ba bzhi/ bslab pa'i chos mang po/phas pham pa bzhi'i ming la/a bra h+ma ⑪tsazlo/ a dat+ta dā ṭ+wāṃ/ pa ⑫dhaḥ/ ut+ta ra ma nu 6 dharma pra khā paḥspyo/mi tshangs par duspyod pa/ ma byin par len pa/ gsod pa/ mi'i chos bla ma smra ba/115—223

dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum dang ma nges pa gnyis la/shu kra bi mṛṣ+ṭiḥ/ kā ya saṃ sargaḥ/ me thu nā bhā ṣa rde/ pa ri tsarlu saṃ bar+ṇa hūṃrgo/khu ba 'byin pa/ lus kyi reg pa ༄ bye/ 'khrig pa dang ldan pa smra ba/ bsnyen bkur bsngags pa/sañtsa ri tram̐/ ku ṭi kā/ ma hābe+e kaḥ — / a rū la shaṃḥ/ zlasashi shaṃ④/ saṃ gha bhe daḥ/smyun byed pa/ khang pa/ khang chen pa/ rtsa ba med pa/ bag tsam pa/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa/ta da nu bat+t+waṃ kaḥ/ ku la dru ṣa kaḥ/ dorba tsa sum̐/ dā ba ni ya to//de'i rjes su/ phyogs pa/ khyim sun 'byin pa/ bka' blo mi bde ba/ ma nges pa gnyis/spang ba'i ltang byed sum cu'i ming la/nai mgi ka pā pat+t+waṃ kā/ dra snyetha saṃ da sha kai/ dhā ra khaṃ/ bi pra bā saḥ/ ni k+ṣe paḥ/spang ba'i 1nga byed/ bcu pa dang po la/ 'chang ba/ 'dral tre pa/ 'jog pa/dhā ba rgo/ pra ti gra haḥ/ yātsā/ sān+ta rot+ta ram̐/ tse ta na kā ni/'khrur 'jug pa/ len pa/ slong ba/ smad g.yogs dang stod g.yogs su bcas 7pa/ rin thang pra h+ye rka/ pre ṣa ṇi/so so/ ba/ bsku ra ba/dī ṭī yo da sha kai/ kau she yo/ shudha zhe ka /kā la kā ṭ+wāṃshe / dī bhā bcu pa gnyis pa la/ mon dar/ bal/ nag po nyu — 'ba' zhig /cha gnyis gaḥ / ṣadzar+ṣa 1 ṇi/ bi tasteḥ/ a dz+nyārje ṭiḥ12/ ur+ṇa pa ri karma rte1 /bsre ba/ lo 1〉drug tu 'chang ba/ mtho gang / lam na bal thogs pa/ bal rmel du 'jug pa'i spang ba/dzā ta rū pa ra dza ta spar+sha rgo/ rū pi ka bya ba hā raḥ/ kra ya bi kra yikyi/gser dngu'/ la reg pa/ mngon tshan can gyi spyod pa/ nyo 'tshong byed pa/115byed224

tre ①tī yi da sha shaṃ/ pā tra jo ra rte glu/ pā tra pa rīṣ+ṭiḥ/ dhā ya naḥ/bcu pa gsum pa la/ lhung bzed 'chang ba/ lhung bzed tshol ba/ 'thag tu 'jug pa/u ya mā na brja 1rgo/ da tā dā rgo/ kāt+t+waṃ kā t+ya yi shaṃ / sabe+e rā tra bi pra bā saḥ/'thag pa bskyed rdo⑤pa/ byin 'phrog /ston zla tha chungs 6la tha' ba/ zhag bdun na bral ba/bar+ṣa shā ṭ+wā ⑦kā lā pa rīji dhā ra r+ṇa/ ba ri shā 8—mamra/ san+ni dhī kā 7 raḥ/dbyar gyi ras chen dus ma yin par tshol pa dang 'chang ba/ bsngos pa las bsgyur ba —/ gsog 'jog/ltung byed dgu bcu'i ming la/shudha pā ya—1t+ta ⑪kaḥ/ mṛ ṣārmo5/ ༷/ 1/na bā daḥ/ bhe k+ṣu bai rngushubye/ltung byed 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur ba rnams la/ brdzun/ skyon nas smra ba/ dge slong la phra ma byed pa/kho ṭā rgo/ dubyu khā ro tsa ā+oṃ⑩/ ut+ta ra ma nu 6 dhadz+re 36ro tsa rgo/ ṣat+pāñtsi kā yā bā ro skyo rngogs byed pa/ gnas ngan len brjod pa/ mi'i chos bla ma brjod pa/ tshig drug gam lnga las lhag dharmā ⑩de sha nā yā⑫/ sa ma pa dodu ⑪de sha dā rgo/ saṃ stu tiḥṭi/ bi taṇ+ḍa rgobhe bhe/par chos bshad na/ tshig mthun pa dang tshig lhag par slob pa/ bshes ngor byed pa/ khyad du gsod pa/dī tī yo da sha ka/ bī dza gā ma byu ta gā ma bi nā sha rgo/ a ba dh+yā dze+e/ ā dz+nyā bi bcu pa gnyis pa la/ sa bon gyi tshogs dang 'byung po'i tshogs 'jig pa/ 'phya ba/ bsgo ba te ṭha rna/ mabye( meḥ/ saṃ sta raḥ/ niṣ+kar+ṣa rde/ a nu praṣ+kad+dhāpā taḥ/ ā hār+ya bā 7 shābacag pa/ khri/ gding ba/ sgod pa/ phyis gnan pa/ rtsa ba 'byung ba da kā ro tīḥ/ sa pā ṇi ko pa sgo gaḥ/ do bā tra yo bāts+tsha da na pa mar+yā dā ta byāḥ/la 'dug pa/ srog chags dang bcas pa la spyod pa/ rim pa gnyis sam gsum brtsig 1pa/tre tī yo da sha shaṃ/ a sasma tā ba bā daḥ/ asta mi tā ba bā daḥ/bcu pa ( stegasum pa la/ ma bskos par ston pa/ nyi ma nub kyi bar du ston pa/115—225

ā mi ṣa ki— kā ①ba bā daḥ/ ṭī ba ra dā rgo/ ṭī ②ba ra ka ra rde/ rnyigru bhā sāze ①na zas cung zad tsam gyi phyir ston pa/ gos sbyin pa/ gos 'tshem pa/ dge slong ma'i mgron po mang po sa ha ga ma dz+wa/ sa bhi kyu bhā kā dza lā yā no ṭiḥ④/ ra ha si ni ṣa t+yā⑤/ ra ha si dang lhan cig 'gro ba/ dge slong ma dang lhan cig grur 'jug pa/ dben pa na 'dug pa/ dben pa s+thā rgo/ bhikyu rji pa ri pā rjotsi ta piṇ+ḍa pa tro pa sgo gaḥ/na 'greng ba/ dge slong mas sbyor du bcug pa'i zas za ba/tsa tudze+e da sha rka⑦/ pa radza ra sgo dzā ⑧rgo/ e kā ba sa thā bā saḥ/ dī tri pā tra bcu pa ⑨bzhi pa la/ yang yang za ba/ gnas gcig na ⑩gnas pa/ lhung bzed do pū rā ti rik+ta gra ha rde/ a kṛ ta ni rik+ta khā da rna⑪/ a kṛ ta ni ṛk+ta ⑫pra bā ra rde/gsum las lhag par len pa/ lhag mar ma byas pa'i bza' ba/ lhag mar ma byas pa stob pa/gaṇa sgo dzā ()rgo/ a kā la bho dzā thostedz+wa/ san+ni ti ta brdza rgo/ a pra ti gā nyi 'dus shing za ba/ dus ma yin par za ba dang / gsog 'jog spang ba/ sbyin tho)len ma byas ka byuk+toḥ⑫/ pabhā ta bi dz+nyā pa naphra/par za ba/ zas gsod pa slong ba/sa pā hā dza tu)lo pa bho gamra/ sa bho dzā na ku la ni ṣa byā⑫/ sa bho srog chags dang bcas pa'i chu la spyod pa/ nyal po byed po bshoms ⑪pa'i khyim na gnas pa/ nyal po dza na ku las+thā rgo/ a tsi la dā rgo/ se nā dar+sha dz+wa/ se nā byed par ⑥shom pa'i khyim na 'greng ba/ gcer bu pa ⑪la sbyin pa/ dmag la blta ⑫ba/ dmag gi nang ba saḥ/ u byu ⑫thi kā ga ma rna(ste/ pra da ⑫ra dā rgo/ uṅga ra rde/ dubyu lā na gnas pa/ g.yul bshams sgo9pa 'khrug tu 'gro ba/ brdeg pa/ gzas pa/ gnas ngan pra titshwa ④da rna/len 'chab pa/115—226

bhak+tats+tsha ①da kā ra rde/ asdi thrat+tamra/ ts+tshan+da pra byud+dhā ②raḥ/ a nu pa sadzan+da sa zas gcod du 'jug pa/ me 'bud pa/ dad pa phyir bsgyur ba/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa ha swasnaḥ/ dṛji ga tā nu ta ①rgaḥ/ utrībhā nu z-itiḥ⑦/ nā shita dang lhan cig nyal ba/ lta bar gyur pa mi 'dor ba/ spangs pa'i rjes su phyogs pa/ bsnyil ba saṃ gra haḥ/ a rak+ta bstopa sgo gaḥ/ rat+na saṃ spar+shaḥ/ rtswa tra pā ya—ti rka/sdud ⑤pa/ kha ma bsgyur ba'i gos sgon pa/ rin po che la reg pa/ khrus byed pa'i nyung byed/tir+yasba rjodhaḥ/ kau kṛ rkyo pa saṃ hā raḥ/ i ⑦gu li pra bho dā dz+wa/ u da ka har+ṣa r+ṇa/dud 'gro gsod pa/ 'gyod pa bskyed pa/ mdzub mos ga ga tshil byed pa/ chu la rtse ba/mā z-i gā me na sa ha swadze+e/ dhī ⑧ṣa r+ṇa/ go pa napo/ a pra kyud+dhār+ya pa ri sgo gaḥ⑨/bud med dang lhan cig nyal ba/ sngangs par byed pa/ sbed pa/ phyir ma blangs par spyod pa/a spru la kā sgyu khyu dz+wa⑩/ a pu ru ṣa yāṣ+ṭṛ ⑩yā mārga ga ma rde⑩/gzhi med par skur ba 'debs pa/ skyes pa med par bud med dang lam du 'gro ba/ste ya sārja ga ma rna/ u na bo sha bsgo ()pa saṃ pā da rgo/ khan dz+wa/rkun ma dang lhan cig 'gro ba/ nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa/ sa brko ba/pra bā ri tāṭ+wā ti se bā/ u pa shra ba ga na taphra/ si k+ṣiṃ pa saṃ hā raḥpra ti k+ṣe paḥ/mgron gnyer ba las ring du 'dug pa/ nyan rna las gyur pa/ bslab pa la nye bar 'jog pa spong ba/ tuṣ+ṭi bi thosrekra ma rde/ a nā da ra dṛt+taphra/ su (sterā mi re yā ma r+ya pā rna/mi smra bar 'gro ba/ ma gus pa'i tshul/ 'bru'i chang dang sbyar ba'i chang sgos par gyur pa 'thung ba/a kā la tsarlu⑩/dus ma yin par 'gro ba/ku la tsarlu⑩/ rā dza ku la rā tri tsarlu()/ shik+ṣa pa da dra bya tā rmya ⑪ba tsā raḥ/grong rgyu ba/ rgyal po'i pho brang du nub mo 'gro ba/ bslab pa'i tshig gi dngos po la khyad du gsod pa/115—227

sru tsi kṛ ha ka suspra ①da rgo/ pā da kā saṃ pā da dz+wa④/ a ba nā haḥ/ ni ṣa ①da na ga tai/khab ral 'chos pa/ khri'i rkang pa 'chos pa/ shing bal gyis gos rjopar bya ba/ gding ba las gyur pa/bar+ṣa shā ṭī ga tapo/ kaṇ+ḍa pra tisgro ⑤da na ga tamra/ su ga ta ṭī ba ra dbyar gyi ④ras chen las gyur pa/ g.yan pa dgab pa las gyur pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i chos gos kyi ga tapo//tshad las gyur pa/so sor bshags pa'i chos bzhi'i ming la/pra ti de sha rtswa yā ni⑦/ rnyikyu bhā piṇ+ḍa ka gra ha rde paṃ k+to ri ⑧ṣa mya bā dā ni so sor bshags pa/ dge slong ma las zas lag tu len pa gral rims su ma bab par 'grim ⑨du bā ri ta twe ⑩bhustiḥ/ ku la shik+ṣu ⑪bhaṅga pra thratiḥ/ ba na bi tsa ya ga te/'jug pa la ma bzlog par za ba/ khrims dral te grong du 'gro ba/ nags tshal brtag ⑫pa las gyur pa/bslab pa'i chos mang po'i ming la/ni bā sa ne+e na sop+taḥ⑫/ pa ri maṇ+ḍa la ni bā sa rgo/ nā kyuskṛṣ+ṭaḥspyo/sham thabs la rnam ⑫pa bdun/ sham thabs skum por ⑩bgo ba/ ha cang rtsengs pa ma yin pa/nā kyu pa kṛṭaṃ/ na ha ste shuṇ+ḍa ()pa lam+bi tai/ tā la dṛn+da rka/ha cang 'jol ba ma yin pa/ glang po che'i sna ltar nar thonyeb ma yin pa/ ta la'i lo ma ltar ltab pa/na kusmra sa piṇ+ḍa rka/ na nā ga shīr+ṣa rka ni bā sa rgo ni bā sa yi byā m+bi ti sdek+ṣu kā ra ṇi yā/'bru'i phur ma spyoltar ma yin pa pya / sbrul mgo'i gdengs spyoka ltar smad g.yogs mi bgo bar bslab par bya/ nā kyu1ṭaṃ ṭī ba re⑫/ nā kyu pa kṛṣ+ṭi ṭī ⑫ba re/ pa ri maṇ+ḍa lo ṭī ba re/chos gos ha cang rtsengs pa ma yin/ chos gos ha cang 'jol ba ma yin/ chos gos skum por bgo ba/115—228

su saṃ thra tā/ su pra tits+tshan+d+ra①/ awa shabhā④/ a nuspyip+ta ①tsak+ṣu ṣaḥ/ yu ga shin tu bsdams pa/ legs par bgos pa/ sgra bskyung ④ba/ mig g.yeng bar mi bya ba/ gnya' shing mā tra dadhi na/ noṅgaṇ+ḍi ⑤ka yā/ no1khyu ka yā/ not+mak+to dhika /yā no spya ste ka yā/gang tsam du blta ba/ mgo mi g.yog /mi dze+e⑦/ mi gzar/ gnya' gong du mi bsnol/na par+ya ste ka yā⑧/ noṭ+wāṃ ki ka yā/ nolja ki ka ⑨yā/ no4 ⑩ghi ka yā/ nod+ku ṭu ki phrag pa gnyis ka la mi gzar/ brang bas ma yin/ 'jal thabs su ma yin/ mi 'chong / tsog pus ka yā/ na skasgyu kṛ tā⑪/ na kā ya pra tsā la ke/ na ba hu pra tsā ⑫la rka/ na shīr+ṣa ⑫pra ma yin/ dkur mi bstan/ lus mi bsgyur/ lag pa mi bskyod4sre/ mgo mi tsā la rka/ ṭ+wāṃ so rto ki ka ⑫yā/ na ha sta saṃ la ghi ga ⑩yā/ nā na nā ⑩dz+nyā tā/ na pra bsgyur/ phrag pa mi sprad/ lag pa mi stel()/ ma bsgo 4)bar/ stan la t+ya bekhyopho ()sa rna/ na sarba kā yo sa ma bajoya(spe/ na pā de pā da mā dh+wa ya/ma brtags par/ lus thams cad kyis ljid kyis mi dbab/ rkang pa mi bsgol/na sathi ni sasmyu ⑫dhā ya/ na gusbre 3gube+e mā dhā ya④/ na saṃ k+ṣi pya pā do/ na bispyi byapya brla mi bsnol/ long bu'i steng du long bu mi bzhag /rkang pa mi dgug /rkang pa mi pā do/ na bi ḍi gi ka yā/ sat+t+waṃ phyut+ya piṇ+ḍa pā tram̐ pra ⑫ti gra hi ṭī ⑫maḥ/ na sa ma titi gdang / mdoms mi snang / legs par zas blang ba/ mu dang kha da chad ( )ke⑫—/ na sa ma sru pi rka⑪/ sā ba dā rgo/ pā tra saṃ rnyi ⑫naḥ/ nā nā ⑫ga te du ma yin/ tshod ma dang mnyam par ma yin/ mthar chags/ lhung bzed la blta ba/ bza' ba dang khā da nī ye sgo dzā nī ye bā tra mu pa nā ma yi byā maḥ④/ no da ne+e na sru pi rka pra titshwa da bca' ba ma 'ongs par lhung bzed mi bzed/ 'bras chan gyis (k+ṣetshod ma'am yi t+yā maḥsru pi ke na pā o da rgo/ sa1 t+ya piṇ+ḍa pā tram̐ pa ri sgo rgyu ⑪maḥ/ nā ti khun+ta tshod mas ⑩'bras chan ⑫mi dgab/ legs par zas bza'/ kham ha cang 115—229

n+da kai rā ①lo baiḥdze+e/ nā ti ma hārnyi/ pa ri maṇ+ḍa la mā lo pāḥske/ nā nā ga te ④ā chung ba yang ma yin/ ha cang chen po ma yin/ kham ran po⑤/ kham ma lo rjope mu kha dā re bi ba ri t+yā maḥ/ na ⑦sā lo pe na mu khe na bā ram̐ pra byu ha ri — maḥ/gzas skepar kha mi gdang / kha kham gyis bkang ste mi smra/na tsurtso kā ra rka⑨/ na shuzla kā ra kespyo/ na thut+tha kā ⑪ra ka⑩/ na pudru kā ⑫ra rka/tsug tsug mi bya/ cag cag mi bya/ hu hu mi bya/ phu phu mi bya/na dzi hā nirtswa ra ka piṇ+ḍa pā tram̐ bhos+thā ④maḥ/ na set+tha dṛ thakrā ra rka/ nā par+ṇa kā ra rka⑫/lce phyung ste zas mi za/ 'bru nas tha dad du spyomi bya/ phyas spyomi gdags/na ga1 pa hā ra rka/ na ka ba ḍa ts+tsha da rka/ na dzi hā sgo ⑫ṭa rka/ na hastu ⑪ba le ha rka/mkhur ba mi spo/ kham 'phro mi bcad/ rkan mi tog /lag pa mi bltab/na pā tā ba le ha shaṃ/ na hasta saṃ byu ⑫na rka⑪/ na ⑫pā tra saṃ dhū ⑫na rka/ na stu ④pā kṛ lhung bzed mi byog /lag pa mi sprug /lhung bzed mi skyom/ mchod rten ti mi ⑫ba mṛ r+ya biṇ+ḍa pā tram̐ pa ri sto byu maḥ⑪/ na sā mi ṣe ṇa pā ṇi nā u da kas+thā la 'dra bar byas te zas mi bza'/ lag pa zas dang 'bags pas rka gra hi ṭī maḥ/ na sā mi ṣe r+ṇa da ke nān+ta ri rka rnyi kyu gye ta ghā ()maḥ/chu snod la ⑫mi gzung / drung na 'dug pa'am ⑪dge slong la zas dang 'bags pa'i chus ⑫mi gtor/nā ba byā na pre k+ṣi ṣ+yon+ta ri ka su bhi spyoḥ⑪pā tra ma ba lo ka yi byā maḥ⑫/ na sā mi ṣa drung na 'dug pa'i dge slong gi lhung bzed la 'phyas gdags pa'i phyir mi blta/ khyim du u da rka an+taspyo te ⑫stso ra yi sgyu ④masmarnye kṛ hi ṇa ma na ba lo ⑫kyā/ na bā tre ṇa ⑪'dug pa la ma dris par zas dang 'bags pa'i chu khyim pa'i khyim du mi dbo/ lhung bzed kyi bi gha saṃ ⑥stso ra yi byā maḥ/ nā nā ñtsāṇ+ḍi ⑫thra thi bī ⑥bra de she pā tram̐ s+thā pa ye byat+yā maḥ/nang du zas kyi lhag ma blugs te ⑪mi 'dor/ 'og gzhi med pa'i sa phyogs su lhung bzed mi bzhag /115—230

shi ra se ①dharman+de sha yi ṭī maḥ/ na ha sgyu ②rū bhā ②ya dharman+de sha yi t+yā maḥ/ nā shwa rū bhā pa la chos mi bshad/ glang po che la zhon pa la chos mi bshad/ rta la zhon ya dharman+de sha yi t+yā maḥ/ na shi bi kā rū ghā ya dharman+de sha yi byā maḥ/ na yā nā rū ṭ+wā pa la chos mi bshad/ khyogs na 'dug pa la chos mi bshad/ bzhon pa'i steng ya dharman+de sha yi t+yā maḥ/ na pā da kā rū ṭ+wā ④ya dharman+de sha yi byā maḥ/ na daṇ+ḍa pā ṇa na 'dug pa la chos mi bshad/ lham mthon po gyon pa la chos mi bshad/ lag na 'khar ba ye dharman+de sha yi t+yā maḥ/ nats+tsha tra pā ṇa ye dharman+de sha yi sgyu maḥ/ na sha s+t+ra ⑤pā ṇa ye thogs pa la chos mi bshad/ lag na gdugs thogs pa la chos mi bshad/ lag na mtshon thogs pa dharman+de sha yi byā maḥ/ na khaspyo pā ṇa ye dharman+de sha yi byā maḥ/ nā rjoyu dha pā ṇa ye la chos mi bshad/ lag na ral gri thogs pa la chos mi bshad/ lag na dgra cha ⑦dharman+de sha yi : maḥ/ na san+dad+dhā ⑧ya dharman+de sha yi byā maḥ/ nā ⑨glu na udz+re ta utsā ⑩thogs pa la chos mi bshad/ go cha gyon pa la chos mi bshad/ mi na bar 'greng ste ra pra sru baṃ ka ri byā maḥ/ nā glu na u da ka udz+nyā ⑪ra pra sru baṃ ⑫khe ṭaṃ ṅga ghā ṇa gshang gci tho)mi bya/ mi na bar chu'i (stenang du gshang ()gci dang mchil ma dang snabs dang rka bārnyi bi rik+to tso spyor yi byā maḥ/ nā glu nā sa ha ri ta thra thi bī ⑩pra de she utsā ra bra sgyugs pa dang kha nas byung ba mi dor/ mi na bar rtswa sngon po yod pa'i phyogs su gshang ()gci sru baṃ khe ṭaṃ /dze+e/sau ghā ṇa shaṃ bārnye bi rik+to ⑩stso ⑪ra yi byā maḥ/ na sā dhi ka po ru ṣ+yo ⑫dang mchil ma dang snabs dang skyugs pa dang kha nas byung ba mi dor/ gnod pa byung ba ma gtogs dza k+ṣa ma bi ro lha ma a n+ya tā pā da i ti shi k+ṣu ka ra bhā yā⑫//par shing la mi gang tsam las mthor mi 'dzeg pa la bslab —par bya/115—232

rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'i chos bdun la/saṃ mu kha bi na yaḥ/ smṛ ti bi na yaḥ/ a mū ①bhā bi na yaḥ/mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa/ dran pas 'dul bar 'os pa/ ma myos par 'dul bar 'os pa/yasgru yaḥyī shrī tī yaḥ/ ta tra swa bhā bai laṣ+pe yaḥ/ z-i ṇa ①gang tshul shing mang po sbyin par 'os pa/ de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa/ rtswa bkram prastu ra kaḥ/ pra ti dz+nyā kā rjor kaḥ//pa lta bur 'os pa/ khas blang bar 'os pa/chad pas bcad cing gso ba la sogs pa'i ming la/bi na yā ti sā ri hā yaḥ⑤/ de sha nā ka ra bhā yaḥ/ sasba ra ka ra bhā yaḥ/'dul ba dang 'gal ba/ bshags par bya ba/ bsdam mepar bya ba/tardza nī yi/ ni garnya ⑦bhā yi/ pra bā sa smi ⑧yo/ pra ti saṃ ha ra bhā yi/bsdigs ⑨pa/ smad pa/ bskrad pa/ phyir gyed pa thortespang ba/ u t+pa k+ṣe ⑪pa nī yi/ nā sha rtswa ⑫yo/ ut+pati byubhe dz+wa(she/ pa ri bā saḥ/ spru la gnas nas dbyung ba/ bsnyil ba/ lhung ba las bslang ba/ spo ba/ gzhi nas pa ri bā saḥ/ spru mā ⑩pa kar+ṣa pa ri bā ⑫saḥ/ mā nā bye/ rū la ⑩mā nā bye/ spru lā spong batho)/ yang gzhi nas bslang ste spo ba/ mgu bar bya ba/ gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba/ yang gzhi pa kar+ṣa mā nā bye/ tsir+ṇa mā nā bye/ ā spyobarta rde/ ts+tshan+da pa ri shudhitukyeḥ//nas bslang ste mgu bar bya ba/ mgu ba byas/ dbyung ba/ dad pa dang yongs su dag pa/115—233

bslab pa'i gzhi brgyad la sogs pa'i ming la/ pā ḍā ①ti s+thā ta bi ra tiḥ/ a dartswa dā na bi ra ⑦tiḥ/ a bra za tsar+ya ①srog gcod ④spong ba/ ma byin par len pa spong ba/ mi tshangs par spyod pa bi ra tiḥ/ mṛ ṣā bā da bi ra tiḥ/ ma r+ya pā na bi ra tiḥ/ garnya mā l+ya bi le pa na spong ba/ brdzun du smra ba spong pa/ myos par gyur pa'i ⑤btung ba sgong ba/ spos dang kha dog dang bar+ṇa ka dhā rjor ṇa bi ra tiḥ/ uts+tsha sha ya na ma hā sha ya na bi ra tiḥ/ bi kā ⑦la sgo dzā ⑧byug pa dang phreng ba thogs pa spong ba/ khri stan mthon po dang khri stan chen po spong ba/ dus ma yin pa'i zas na bi ra tiḥ⑨/ sa man+d+ra ha ra ā tsār+ya/ sh-i ()kho tu bha dadhā saṃ ghaḥ/spong ba/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/yā balja ⑪baphra/ ugluspa tu māphra⑫/ a nu shi k+ṣe/ a nu bi dhī ⑫ye/ji srid 'tsho'i ⑫bar du/ bdag drang du gsol/ rjes su slob po/ /rjes su sgrub po/ /a nu ka ro mi⑫//rjes su bgyid do/ /dge spyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi'i ming la/tsa twa raḥshra ba ṇa kā ra kā dharmāḥ/ ā krusne ()na na pra t+yā groṣ+ṭa tho)bye/ ro ṣi dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi/ gshe yang slar mi gshe/ khros kyang te na na pra ti ro ṣi ta bye/ bhaṇ+ḍi te na na tho)pra ti bhaṇ+ḍi ta bye/slar mi khro bar bya/ mtshang brus kyang slar mtshang tu)mi 'bru bar bya/tā ḍi ta ⑩na na ⑪pra tī ⑫ḍi ta bye//brdeg kyang slar mi bane+eg par bya/115—235

rab tu byung ba la sogs pa'i ming la/pra bra dzi taḥ/ u pa sasbran+daḥ①/ shra ma ṇaḥ/ rnyi kyuḥ/ dhi ②kyu ṇi/ shra ma ṇi raḥ/rab tu byung ba/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ dge sbyong / dge slong / dge slong ma/ dge tshul/shra ma ṇi ri kā/ shik+ṣa mā ḍā①/ ma hāl+la kaḥ/ shi k+ṣu ④dat+ta kaḥ/ u pā sa kaḥ/ u pā dge tshul ma/ dge slob ma/ rgan zhugs/ bslab pa byin pa/ dge bsnyen/ dge si kā⑤/ po ṣa dhi kaḥ/ u pā sgyu yaḥ/ ā tsār+yaḥrjo/ karma kā ra kaḥ/ ra hopho nu ⑦bsnyen ma/ gso sbyong ba⑧/ mkhan po/ slob dpon/ las byed pa/ gsang ste shā sa kaḥ/ ni shra ya dā pa kaḥ/ pā ṣā tsār+ya⑨ཿ/ sgra bi raḥ/ da hraḥ/ na ba karmi kaḥ/ston pa/ gnas sbyin ⑩pa/ klog pa'i slob dpon/ gnas brtan/ gzhon rabs/ lag gi bla/ bai yā dṛ ⑪t+ya ka raḥ/ shi 6ཿ/ pra shi gyiḥ/ an+ta bā sbo/ pasbyosbra ma ṇaḥ/ ma rgyaḥ⑫/zhal ta ba/ slob ma/ yang slob/ nye gnas/ phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge spyong / bar ma/na ba kaḥ/ dṛd+dhān+ta⑫ཿ/ na bārnyaḥ/ ne+e ⑫bā si kaḥ/ ā gan+tu kaḥ/gsar bu/ rgan rimasatsunye/ gzhon rims(9/ gzhi ba/ glo bur du 'ongs pa/ga mi kaḥ/ ā ga ⑩mi kaḥ/ kā la pa1 kaḥ/ saṃ dz+nyā bi ⑫gruḥ/ pra ti dz+nyā bhi kyuḥ⑪/'gro bar chas pa/ 'ongs pa/ lhung bzed nag po can/ ming gi dge slong / khas 'che ba'i dge slong /bhi k+ṣa ta i ti bhā ⑥kyuḥ/ bhin+da kle sha tāt+pa ⑪bhi kyuḥ/ dz+nyābhi slong ba'i phyir ⑫dge slong / nyon mongs pa bcom pa'i phyir ⑫dge slong / gsol tsa turba karma ḍo pa saṃ parjo ④bhi kyuḥ//ba ⑫bzhi'i las kyis ⑪bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i phyir dge slong /115—236

ta ke shaḥ①/ nā ga ke shaḥ/ ha ri ke shaḥ/ ka pi la ke shaḥ/ a ke sha kaḥ/ba/ skra ba lang gi spu 'dra ba/ skra ser skya/ skra seracho skra med/ghā ṭā shi raḥ/ bstu shi rā④/ a ti sgyu ④laḥ/ a ti hra swaḥ/mgo 'bar 'bur can/ glang po che/ ha cang sbom pa/ ha cang thung ba/a ti dīr+ghaḥ/ kṛ shā la kaḥ/ bi ka ṭa kaḥ/ nī lats+tsha bi baṇ+ḍiḥ/ spru tats+tsha bi ha cang ring ba/ skem po/ lus nyams pa/ sha mdog sngo ches pa/ sha mdog ser baṇ+ḍiḥ—/ lo hi tats+tsha bi baṇ+ḍiḥ/ a ba dā tats+tsha bi baṇ+ḍiḥ/ be+e pā ṭa ka④ཿ/ kha ches pa/ sha mdog dmar shas che ⑤ba/ sha mdog dkar ches pa/ lus slebs rjopa 'dra ba/ mgo ra shīr+ṣaḥ/ sru ka ra shīr+ṣaḥ/ dī shīr+ṣaḥ/ shwa shīr+ṣaḥ/ a shīr+ṣa kaḥ⑦/ haste bong bu'i lta bu/ mgo phag gi lta bu/ mgo gnyis/ mgo khyi'i lta bu/ mgo'u chung / rna ba glang po che kar+ṇaḥske/ a shwa kaṇ+ḍi⑧ཿ/ go ṇa kaṇ+ḍi⑨ཿ/ marka ⑩ṭa kaṇ+ḍi⑪ཿ/ kha ra kaṇ+ḍiḥ/ sru lta bu/ rna ba rta'i lta bu/ rna ba glang ⑫gi lta bu/ rna ba spre'u'i lta bu/ rna ba bong bu'i lta bu/ rna ba ka ra kaṇ+ḍiḥ/ e ka kaṇ+ḍiḥ/ a kaṇ+ḍiḥ/ lo ti tā k+ṣaḥ/ a ti ban+d+ra k+ṣaḥ/ tsusmra ⑫k+ṣaḥ/phag pa'i lta bu/ rna gcig pa/ rna med pa/ mig dmar ba/ mig ha cang che ba/ mig chung ⑫/a ti piṅga lā k+ṣaḥ/ kā tsā k+ṣaḥ/ skan+t+ra k+ṣaḥ/ bubyu dā k+ṣaḥ/ e kā k+ṣaḥ/ a na k+ṣa ka⑫ཿ/mig ha cang ser ⑩ba/ shel mig phrag ⑩mig /mig chu bur lta bu/ mig gcig pa/ mig med pa/a shwa nā saḥ/ haste nā saḥ/ go ṇa nā saḥ/ marka ṭa nā sa4)ཿ/ kha ra nā saḥ/sna rta'i lta bu/ sna glang po che'i lta bu/ sna ba glang ⑪gi lta bu/ sna spre'u'i lta bu/ sna bong bu'i lta bu/sru ka ra nā saḥ/ e ka nā saḥ/ a nā saḥ/ haste dzo ḍaḥ/ a shwa dzo ḍaḥ/sna phag gi lta bu/ sna spubs gcig pa/ sna med⑪/ kosko ⑥glang po che'i lta bu/ kosko ⑫rta'i lta bu/go ṇa dzo ḍaḥ/ marka ṭa dzo ḍaḥ/ kha ra dzo ḍaḥ/ sru ka ra dzo ḍaḥ/kosko ()ba lang gi lta bu/ kosko ⑫spre'u'i lta bu/ kosko ⑫bong bu'i lta bu/ kosko ⑪phag gi lta bu/115—238

ak+ṣ-i shan+d+raḥ/ ak+ṣi bi tsartsi kaḥ/ ak+ṣi dadraḥ/ nā ḍi kaṇ+ḍiḥ/ aṇ+ḍa māṃ gyu la mig mdzer ①can/ mig 'brum can/ mig shu can/ rna mchog gru 'chas/ rmig pa'i nang du pra tits+tsha naḥ/ spru bhāḥ/ e ka pā daḥ/ e ka hastaḥ/ a hastaḥ/ a pā daḥ/mtshan ma nub pa/ glen pa/ rkang gcig pa/ lag pa gcig /lag med/ rkang med/kabyu li tā k+ṣaḥ/ sartsin+da byañdza nā/ sa dā ②pra sra ba bhā①/ a lo hi nī/ ne+e mit+t+waṃ tī④/mig sle'o/ /sle 'dams pa/ rtag tu zla mtshan zag pa/ zla mtshan med pa/ mtshan tsam yod pa/byaṭ+wā ⑤na pa ri brta terjo//mtshan 'gyur⑦/yo byad bcu gsum gyi ming la/saṃ ghā ṭī/ ut+ta rā ⑧saṃ gaḥ/ an+tathā saḥ/ saṃ kak+ṣ-i kā⑨/ pra ti si ⑩ka k+ṣi kā⑪/snam sbyar/ bla gos/ mthang gos/ rngul gzan/ rngul gzan gyi gzan/ni bā sa rna/ pra ti ni bā sa rna/ ke sha pra ti gra ha rde/ rtswa tra shā ṭa rkatho)/sham thabs/ sham thabs kyi gzan/ skra bzed/ khrus ras/ni ṣa da dz+wa⑫/ pra t+yāstu raḥ/ kaṇ+ḍa pra titsā da ⑩rna/ baṣ+ṭha shā ṭī ṭī ⑫ba re/gding ba/ g.yan pa dgab pa/ dbyar gyi gos ras chen/pa ri sku ra tsā ba reḥ⑩//yo byad kyi gos/dge slong gi yo byad kyi ming la/pā tram̐/ ku pā (rtetram̐/ shi kyi/ pā tra po ṇi kaḥ/ pā tra sgra bi kaḥ()/lhung bzed/ lhung bzed chung ngu / dra ba/ lhung bzed kyi snod/ lhung bzed kyi snod/115—240

gang zag bcu gnyis kyi ming la/bi hā rodre ①sha kaḥ/ bha k+kodhe sha kā/ ya bā ④gyu tsā ra ka①ཿ/ khā r+ya ka tsā ra kaḥ/gnas khang bsko ba/ zas la bsko ba/ thug pa 'grim pa/ bag chos 'grim pa/pha la tsā ra kaḥ/ yat+t+waṃ—dz+nyā ra kaḥ/ bhāṇ+ḍa go ba kaḥ/ bhāṇ+ḍa bhā dzā ④kaḥ/shing thog ⑤'grim pa/ phran tshegs 'grim pa/ snod spyad 'drub rjopa/ sgod spyad 'ged pa/bar+ṣa shā ⑦ṭī go pa kaḥ/ ṭī dze+eb ra go pa kaḥ/ ṭī ⑨ba ra bhā dzā tho)kaḥ/dbyar gyi ras chen sbed pa/ gos sbed pa/ gos 'ged thotrepa/u ba dhi bā ri ka⑫ཿ/ pre ṣa kaḥ/ bhā dzā ⑫na bā ri kaḥ/ pā nī spyoya bā ri kaḥ/dge skos/ mngag gzhug thosngepa/ sder spyad kyi zhal ta pa/ chu'i zhal ta pa/pā ⑩sā di bā ri ⑩kaḥ/ ba ri ṣaṇ+ḍa bā ri kaḥ/ sha ya nā sa na bā ri kaḥ/ muṇ+ḍa ⑫sha ya mdzes 'chosathospre/ bang rim gyi zhal ta pa/ mal stan gyi zhal ta pa/ mal stan gyi phyogs nā sa na bā ri kaḥ⑩/ ts+tshaṇ+ḍi kā bā ri kaḥ//kyi zhal ta pa/ sge'u chung bsrung ba/sde bzhi rnam pa bco brgyad du gyes pa'i ming la/ār+ya sar+pā ste bā dāḥ(spre/ spru la sar+pā sti bā dāḥ/ kā ()byu 'phags pa thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde⑫/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde/ 'od srung spru yāḥ/ ma tī sā sa kāḥ/ dhan+d+ra gubhāḥ/ ba hu shu tī yā④ཿ/ tāmra shā ṭī yāḥ/ bi bha ⑫bye ba'i ()sde/ sa ston sde/ chos srung sde/ mang du thos pa'i sde/ gos dmar sde/ rnam par bye bā di naḥ/ ār+ya sasma tī yāḥ/ kau ru kul+la kā()ཿ/ ā ban+ta kāḥdzu)/ste smra ba'i sde/ 'phags pa kun gyis bkur ba'i sde⑪/ sar sgogs rigs kyi sde/ srung ba pa'i sde/115—243

bāsgri pu ①ṭī yāḥ/ ma hā s+t+waṃ bhi kā②ཿ/ pūrba shi lāḥ/ a pa ra shi lāḥ/gnas ma bu pa'i sde/ dge 'dun phal chen pa'i sde①/ shar gyi ri bo'i sde/ nub kyi ri bo'i sde/hai ④ma ba tāḥ/ lo kot+ta ra bā ti ⑤naḥ/ pra dz+nyābhi bā nyi dunaḥ/ ār+ya s+thā bi rāḥ/gangs ri pa'i sde/ 'jig rten 'das smra'i sde/ btags par smra ba'i sde/ 'phags pa gnas brtan pa'i sde⑦/ma hā bi hā ra ⑧bā si naḥ/ dze ta ba nī yāḥ/ a bha ya gi ri bā se naḥ//gtsug lag khang chen gnas sde/ rgyal byed tshal gnas pa'i sde/ 'jigs med ri gnas sde/gzhi bcu bdun la/pra bra dz+nyā bstuḥ⑨/ po ṣa dha bstuḥ/ bar+ṣa bstuḥ⑩/ pra bā ra ṇa bstuḥ/ ka ṣ+ṭha na rab tu byung ba'i gzhi/ gso sbyong gi gzhi/ dbyar gyi gzhi/ dgag dbye'i gzhi/ sra brkyang gi bstuḥ⑪—/ ṭī ba ra bstuḥ/ tsarma bstuḥ/ dzhai ṣabye bstuḥ⑫/ karma bstuḥ⑫/ pra ti gzhi/ gos kyi gzhi/ ko wags kyi gzhi/ rtsi'i gzhi/ las kyi gzhi/ phyir bcos kri yā bstuḥ⑫/ kā lā kā la saspra ta bstuḥ⑫/ bhū myan+ta rasba tsa ra ṇa bstuḥ⑩/pa'i gzhi/ dus dang dus ma yin pa dang sbyar ba'i gzhi/ sa gzhan du spo ba'i spyod ⑩pa'i gzhi/pa ⑫ri karma ṇa bstuḥ⑪/ karma bhe da bstuḥstso/ tsakra bhe da bstuḥ⑪/ a dhi ka ra ṇa yongs su sbyangs pa'i ⑫gzhi/ las mi mthun ba'i gzhi/ 'khor lo mi mthun pa'i gzhi/ rtsod pa'i bstuḥ⑫—/ sha ya nā sa na bstuḥ⑥//gzhi / mal cha'i gzhi⑫/chu rung ba rnam pa lnga'i ming la/saṃ gha kalpaḥ/ puṅga la kalpaḥ/ pa ri sru ba ṇa ()kalpaḥ/dge 'dun gyis rung ⑪ba/ gang zag gis rung ⑫ba/ chu tshags kyis rung ⑥ba/115—244

a ho rā tra kalpaḥ/ u da pā na ①kalpaḥ//nyin zhag gis rung ②ba/ khron pas rung ④ba/dge sbyong gi skyon du brtsi ba'i ming la/a bhi kyuḥ/ a shra ma ṇaḥ/dge slong du mi rung ba'am dge slong ma yin pa/ dge sbyong du mi rung ba'am dge sbyong ma yin pa/a shā kya pu ṭī ya ཿ / dh+wa l+ya te rnyi gru bhā bā t+pa rjo /shākya'i bur mi rung ba'am shākya'i bu ma yin pa/ dge slong gi dngos po las nyams par 'gyur⑤/ha ta ma su bha ba ti shā ma byerjo/ dh+wa staḥ/ ma thi te④/de 'i dge sbyong gi tshul zhig pa ra 'gyur/ nya ma sa pa / ba com pa /pa ti tai/ pa rā dzi lta/ a pra kyud+dhār+ya ⑧ma su bha ba ti ⑨shā ma bye⑩/ tar+ya thā tā lhung ba/ pham par gyur pa/ de'i dge slong ⑪gi tshul phyir bslang du med par 'gyur/ dper na shing ta le ⑫masta kāsbyin+da ⑫a bha byo ha ri ta tā ⑫ya/ duḥshī laḥ/ pā la'i mgo bcad spyopa bzhin sngon por 'gyur du mi rung ba'am mi btub/ tshul khrims 'chal pa/ sdig pa dhan+d+raḥ⑩/ an+taḥ()pū tiḥ⑫a pa shu taḥ/ ka shasbra ka dzā (/)taḥ/ shaṅka swā stsor sa pa'i rdos can/ khong myags shing phyir 'dzag pa/ shing rul pa lta bur gyur pa/ lus bong ltar mā tsā ⑪raḥ/ a shra ⑫ma ṇaḥshra ma ṇa pra ti dz+nyā⑫/ a bra d+ma tsā ri bra t+tha tsā ⑫ri pra spyod pa/ dge sbyong ma yin par dge sbyong du khas 'che ⑫ba/ tshangs par spyod pa ma yin par tshangs par spyod ti dz+nyāḥ/ shi la bi pan+daḥ/ dṛṣ+ṭi bi pan+daḥ/ ā tsā ra bi pan+daḥ/ ā dz+re ba bi pan+daḥ/par khas 'che ba/ tshul khrims nyams pa/ lta ba nyams pa/ cho ga nyams pa/ 'tsho ba nyams pa/shik+ṣu ⑪bh+raṣ+ṭaḥ//bslab pa zhig pa/115—245

gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i ming la/garnya ku ṭī/ bi hā ram̐①/ la ya namra/ bar+ṣa skekaḥ/ gaṇ+ḍi/ ga5ko ṭa na rka/dri gtsang khang / gtsug lag khang / gnas khang / dbyar khang / gaṇ+ḍi/ gaṇ+ḍi'i the'u/be+e snelā tsakre//nyi tshod kyi 'khor lo/gos kyi gzhi'i ming la/ ——r+ṇa shaṃ rjo// saḥ/ ste/ na rka⑤/ k+ṣiṃ ma rka/ do (1 la ke/ koṣ+ṭadza rka/mal rjogos/ sha na'i ras/ zar ma'i ras/ do gu ⑦la'i ras/ ko tam pa'i ras/kar+pā ⑧sa rka/ kau re/ pa rka⑨/ saṃ sdo/ rka/ paṣ+ṭa rka⑩/ pa ṭaḥ⑪/ pa ṭa rka/ che/ ṭa rka/ras gos/ mon dar/ dar la/ dar/ snam bu/ ras yug chen/ ras yug phran/ pā // raḥ⑫/ sto/ mi laḥ/ kṛ mi li kā/ kṛ mi ba1/ sau ⑫mi li kā④/ kā shi ka be'u ras/ be'u ras yug chen/ be+e'u ras dmar po/ la dmar/ be'u phrug /yul ka shi ka'i ras srukhye—/ sa ma bar+ṇa(ste/ durbar+ṇa/ ā pa ran+ta rka/ e ra kamra/ me ra kaphra/phran/ kha dog ran pa/ kha dog ngan pa/ nyi 'og gi gos/ bal stan/ shing shun gyi gdan/sun+d+ra ra kapo/ man+d+rar ⑩kapo/ mṛ ta pa rishī raḥ⑩/ sha ma sā man+ta rka⑫/ yu gā/ dī ⑪srin bal gyi gdan⑥/ ras bal gyi stan/ shi ba'i nor rdzas/ gru ⑥gang 'khor yug /zung / snam pu ṭa saṃ ghā ṭiḥ/ z-i pu ṭa saṃ ghā ṭiḥ/ dha ni kaḥ/ ṭī ba ra tho tsā/ ā nan+d+ra paṭi kaḥ/sbyar nang shun can/ snam sbyar sum rim pa/ chag stab ⑫pa/ chos gos kyi tshal bu/ mtha' bskor/pha la kaḥ()/ garja shi kaḥ6ste/ u pa ni shra yaḥ/ ā sgonyeshra ya bhā yi/ kadze+e rka/sgo gu'i rten ma/ lhan pa glon (nyepa/ re zhig gnas bca' ba/ gnas ()bca' ba/ rung ba/115—246

——tabyudhe na(nye / ma nu gyi ga teḥ/ ma nu gyi — )bi gra haḥ/ bi ni dh+wa ya saṃ dz+nyā —// tat+t+waṃ dzha yā④/de ltar bsam khrupas/ mir gyur pa/ mir )chags pa/ 'du shes bsgyur ba/ de ltar 'du shes pas/ut+ta ra ma nu byu dharma yuk+ta tokyā ( /bāt+ma naḥ/ ba rā ba ga me/ a nā pasbyiḥ/ ā di bdag mi'i chos bla ma dang (nyaldan par smras pa/ pha rol gyis go ba/ lhung ba med pa/ las dang kārmi ⑨kaḥ/ ut+man+ta kaḥ/ bi k+ṣip+ta tsit+taḥ/ be da nā rnyi tun+daḥ/ bra ()yo gi tī/po pa/ myos pa6spe/ sems 'khrugs pa/ sdug bsngal ⑩gyi tshor bas gzir ba/ sbyor ba las byung ba/gurtswa—/ lasī/ sā ba she ṣā/ ni ra ba she ṣā/ ā sap+ta oṃ yu ga mu pā dā ya(nye/phyi ba/ yang ba/ lhag ma yod pa/ lhag ma med pa/ pha ma'i rigs bdun rgyud tustetshun chad/pā tra ni kudze+e spre)dz+wa/ sā shaṅge(—/ sa pra ti bha ya bye ra ba saṃ ma te/lhung bzed khas dbub pa/ dogs ⑩pa dang bcas pa/ bag tsha ba dang 'jigs pa dang bcas par grags pa/ṣabyegi kāḥ/ bi tsa ṭa rgo/ ā ko ṭa namra/ dh+wa ba yetu/ rañdza yetu/ ā ko ṭa yet+pa/drug sde/ rmal pa⑫/ bcag pa/ 'khrur 'jug /'tshed du 'jug /'chag tu 'jug⑪ /kṛ ha byā ku li kā/ pu ()rā ṇarnyi (spetī yā/ ghartswa ( )ba sgo ṣa rde/ kār+ṣa pa r+ṇa()/khyim so6sre/ sngon gyi chung ma/ dril sgra las bsgrags pa/ kar+ṣa (nyepa ṇa/mā ṣa ()rka/ saspra dzā na mṛ ṣā bā daḥ/ a gā (zhem kaḥ/ a dz+nyā pa rka63/ma sha ka /shes bzhin gyi rdzun smra ba/ go bar byed pa ma yin pa'am mi go ba/ shes par byed pa ma yin pa/sa ma graḥ/ bya graḥ/ pūrba tsa ra maḥ⑪/ mṛ (kyeta bai bha baṅga kaḥ/ sāsgo bi hā rī(spe/mthun ⑫pa/ mi mthun pa/ dang po dang tha ma la sbyin pa/ shi ba'i nor bgo ba/ lhan cig gnas pa/pra ti brnyaḥ/ ut+pa ṭu kasbaḥ1/ astoḥsī mā/ kṛ te dam+bi tso 'gog pa'am bgegs shesam bar du gcod pa/ cog pur 'dug pa/ mtshams kyi nang / cha byad 'di ṣa ma(zhe/ pañtsa maṇ+ḍa la ke na ban+da rna kṛ ta6zhe/ pra dza ti tā ñdza li/ saṃ snra dhī naḥ/bzhin bya ba(nye/ yan lag lngas phyag byas/ thal mo sbyar/ dge 'dun la rag lus pa/115 —248

a rnyi bā sa namra/ mañtsaḥ/ spru ṭhaḥ①/ gha ṭaḥ/ gha ṭi kā/ ka ra ki hā kuṇ+ḍi ②kā/gnang ngam ⑦rung bar bya ba/ khri/ khri'u/ rdza ma/ phru rtog /ril pa spyi blugs/katse kaḥ/ pa rish+tsa dza namra/ ghaṣ+ṭa naphra/ bhār+yādu/ pra ṇa yaḥ/ pra ka ṭaḥ/ pa ri pā ṭiḥ⑤/rung ba/ khyud pa/ bslas pa/ chung ma/ sdug pa/ gsal ba'am mngon pa/ rims kyis/ha ra ti pra t+yā ha ra ti/ ā kar+ṣa ṇaphra/ pā ṭā pā ṭi kā/ byā maḥrjo/ hastaḥ/phrin phar bskyal ba dang phyir bskyal pa/ drang ba/ lan gcig gnyis sprad pa/ 'dom/ khru/bi ta steḥ/ aṅga liḥ/ a nu that+ma naphra/ a n+ya thā bhā gī yaḥ/ ts+tshan+da po ṣa dha mā ro ⑦mtho/ sor/ bskur/ gzhan gyi cha/ dad pa'i gso sbyong bgyi bar tsa ya ⑧ti ā ro tsi lta tsa pra be ⑨da ya te/ pra ti bstutho)/ u j-i ta ka ṣ+ṭha rna/gsol ba 'debs so gsol ba yang mkhyen par gsol lo/ /nor dang 'dra ba/ sra brkyang phyung ⑪ba/ka ṣ+ṭha na stu raḥ/ saṃ kalpi ta mārga khaṃ/ ts+tshan+da dā ya kaḥ/ a dhi ka ra ṇaphra/ san+ni sra brkyang gding ba/ shom pa la sbyor ka byed pa/ dad pa 'bul pa/ rtsod pa/ bzhag pa'am gaster du hi lta/ a pra ⑫ro ha ṇa dharma kaḥ/ ku la pra ti saṃ be da kaḥ/ o shī ri kaḥ/ go ⑫laḥ/bcug pa/ mi skye ba'i chos can/ khyim so sor bsgo ba/ zha lu'am myu gu/ bum pa/ṭi bya kaḥ/ pra ṇi ta rka bsnarnyiḥ/ a hu saḥ/ saṃ ya ma ni kaḥ/chu la mdzub mos se gol rdob pa/ skur ④'dzugs pa'am yal zug khra ba/ mi chung ba/ yang dag par sdom pa/kri ⑫yā kā raḥ/ pa ri mārdza ⑩rna/ pra spo ṭa ni⑩/ kau ṭa kaḥ/ arnyar+pār+ṣa/khrims su byas pa/ byi bdar bya ba/ sprugs pa'am phyi ba/ be+egs kyi btsa'⑫/ dbyar tshun chad/spyon+da bāk+ṣi kaḥ⑪/ a bāk+ṣi kaḥsgo)/ khaṇ+ḍa dbyar gnas pa las nyams pa/ dbyar gnas su ma bzhugs stsopa'am lor ma lon pa/ khang pa ral zhing pul+laḥ—/ lī khā yi ta te/ san+d+ra ⑫na ba hu sum̐/ dharma pa ṇa rgo/'grums ()pa/ lus bsgyur ba/ rgyud (stemang ba chos 'tshong ba()/115—251

bi ①pra bā da rna/ bi saswā da rna/ pu ṭa shaṃ/ u pa ni man+d+ra r+ṇa②/ pū ti muk+to/ kā li kaḥ/slu ba / phur ma/ mgron du gnyer ba/ bkus ta bor ba/ dus su rung ba/yā mi kaḥ/ sabhā ④hi kai/ yā basmyu ④pi rka/ khe ṭa ka ṭā ⑤ha kamra/thun tshod du rung ba/ zhag bdun pa/ 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba/ mchil ma'i snod/ku— kā/ shupo kaḥ/ kuṇ+ḍa la kamra/ pa rat+t+waṃ/ be+e lo rjoti kaphra/gtan pa dbye ba'i lcags spu dgu bo⑦/ zhib ma'am slo ma/ bkru bshal gyi snod/ 'brad pa/ rdol pa/phudru ⑧saḥ/ ba le na a nu pra ske r+yaḥ⑨/ u da ka dat+taḥ/ dha na 1 te⑩/ dh+wa dzā snod rnying khyer ba/ ljid kyis phab ste 'gro ba/ chu tshogs kyis byin pa/ rin chas nyos pa/ btsan 'phrogs ⑪hri tāthome/ khyun+da bā si smi/ ba ṭa bā si nī/ sa ma jo bi kā/ pi dṛ ()ra k+ṣi tā/su thob pa/ dang sang du 'dus ⑫pa/ gos zas kyis 'tshos pa/ kha dum pa/ phas bsrungs pa⑫/mā ⑩tre ra k+ṣ-i tā/ khyu dṛ ra k+ṣi tā/ bha ⑩gi ni ra k+ṣi tā/ shwa shu spyor ra k+ṣi tā/ shwa ⑪shu mas bsrungs pa⑫/ ming pos bsrungs pa/ phu nu mos bsrungs pa/ gros pos bsrungs pa/ sgyug mos ra k+ṣi tā/ dz+nyā ti ra k+ṣi tā/ go tra (sprer k+ṣi tā/ mā lā gu ṇa pa ri k+ṣip+taḥ/ tatu bsrungs pa⑫/ gnyen pas bsrungs pa⑫/ rus chags kyis bsrungs pa⑫/ skyes kyi dus btab pa/ thang k+ṣa ⑫ṇi kaḥ/ ā bā haḥ/ bi bā ha⑪ཿ/ kā ya saṃ sargaḥ/ pa riṣ+ṭha dza mā tram̐⑫/'ga' 'phrad pa/ bag mar blangs pa/ bag mar btang ba/ mthang sprad pa/ mthang sprad pa tsam/dwa ya dwa ya sa mā bat+t+waṃḥ//gnyis kyis gnyis sprad pa/drug sde'i ming la/nan+daḥ⑫/ u pa nan+da/ pu narba su/ ts+tshan+daḥ/ a shwa ⑪kaḥ⑩/ u da yī//dga' bo/ nye dga' bo/ nab ⑪so/ 'dun pa/ 'gro mkhyogs/ 'char ka /115—252

ma ma bzhi'i ming la/e ga dhā ṭī/ k+ṣi lhar dhā ṭī/ ma la dhā ṭī/ t+pā ḍa ni kā dhā ṭī//spang dun 'tsho ba'i ma ma/ nu ma bsnun pa'i ma ma/ dri ma 'phyi ba'i ma ma/ rtsen 5grogs kyi ma ma/nad kyi ming la/byā bye/ ro gaḥ/ ba ri dā haḥ/ bra rde④/ gaṇ+ḍa/ shā bi kā/ kusgo/ bi sgo ṭaḥ/nad/ yongs su gdung ba'am tsha ba/ rma/ 'bras / mdze/ 'brum bu/ki ṭi chobhaḥ/ dazluḥ/ ki khā saṃ/ bi tsartsi kaḥ/ gaḍūḥ67/ pā mā/ kadz+raḥ/'brum bu phra mo/ shu ba/ ngal skyen klupa'am sha khra zu/ rkang shu/ g.ya' ba/ g.yan pa/ khyi rngo⑨/bi sru 0 tsi kā/ e bā naḥ/ hikrā/ rā dza bakhye11/ k+ṣa ya byā dhiḥ/ bh+ra /stemaḥ/ kā saḥ/gsud pa/ sgos pa/ skyigs bu/ gcong chen po/ nang khong skem 11pa/ mgo 'khor/ lud pa/shā saḥ/ sho ṣaḥ/ lo la/7liṅge/ a pa smra raḥ/ bai sarbaḥ/ aṅga bhe daḥ/dbugs mi bde ba/ skem pa/ ldog ⑫pa/ brjed byed/ me dbal/ yan lag tu zugs (7pa/gube+eḥ / paṇ+ḍa ro gaḥ/ k+ṣa taḥ/ sasnyin+da byañdza sum̐/ a ṭak+ka raḥ/ bha gan+da raḥ/ bhas+t+waṃ nya 7ka/skran—/ skya sbab/ glo 'groms kṛ)pa/ gle 'dams pa/ bkres ngab/ mtshan bar rdol ba/a shāṅgiḥtho)/ ts+tshadiḥ/ mū tra ro dhaḥ/ shrī pā daḥ/ kla maḥ/ aṅga dā ha( byeḥ/gzhang 'brum(spe/ skyug bro ba/ chu 'gags pa/ rkang 'bam/ ngal pa/ lus tsha ba/pār+sha dā haḥ/ asbi bhe daḥ/ sañtsa ra byā dhiḥ7 rta/ dz+wa raḥ/ pit+t+waṃ/ ru bye ram̐/rtsib logs tsha ba/ rus pa la thug pa/ nad 'go ba/ rims 5/ mkhris nad/ khrag nad/pra dz+wa raḥ/ e ka di ④kaḥ/ dwo tī ya kaḥ/ tre+e tī ya kaḥ/ tsā turja kaḥ/ ni t+ya dz+wa raḥ/rims drag po/ nyin gcig pa/ nyin gnyis pa/ nyin gsum pa/ nyin bzhi pa/ rtag pa'i rims/115—253

du〈〈pe〉〉giḥ/ rjo〈〈snar 〉mo / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dharma ñtsa/ ⑧〈po ra 〉rnam/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉tha ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉spyong byung / ⑫〈〈snar 〉sngag/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stabaḥro/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rdo bkugs/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sta / ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rnam1/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉ra / ske〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉sna / ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7ཿ/ ⑥〈'a ra 〉snga ṣ+ṭha ka spyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mthugs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mirnya/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rgyu / ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thargyud brgyad/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉motshogs/252 ①〈〈pe 〉ra ba/ 〈〈snar 〉ra bi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉ṇa/ ①〈〈pe 〉phrop+ta/ 〈snar 〉mip+ta/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mi—/⑤〈〈pe 〉skru/ rjo〈〈snar 〉〉dze+e dze+e〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉d+ku'o/ sge〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7 phu/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/⑩〈〈pe 〉snga ta/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉〉phrogs/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉snaṭha ṣe ṭa/ 〈po ra 〉〉dh+wa dza z-i tā/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉stan ṭi/〈snar 〉ma tre/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thadu dus/ ske〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasrung ba/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉pa/ ⑩〈snar 〉wā/⑫〈〈snar 〉〉tha/ spyo〈〈pe 〉ra / ⑥(〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra srung ba/ rjo〈〈pe 〉mnya/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ra srung ba rgyug mos bsrung ba/ ④〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7srung ba/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dkyi bsrung ba/ spyo〈〈pe 〉〉tak+ṣa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ta6/⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉wā/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉tra/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ཿ/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉sha ⑫〈〈pe 〉7ཿ smyo〈〈pe〉〉〈'ar 〉rabs/253 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉 / ②〈〈pe 〉snga' ra 〉7nga / ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra da/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉ṇi/ 0〈snar 〉lī/rjo〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ra kāḥkarnga/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ngan rkyen/ ske〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉snga/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉sngo / ⑩〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉mas/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 kya/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉mo1/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉ga mas/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉 rta/〈〈snar 〉7ha/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉lkeg ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉jug ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉masasna/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'grams / ⑪〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉pho/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skaragrum/ ⑫〈po ra 〉〉giḥ/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉〉rim—/ ④〈〈snar 〉8/115—310

dag /sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa bzhugs/①༄7/ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ bam po dang po/ rta'i lo la btsad ④po khri lde srong btsan pho brang gi'i ①'on cang rdo na dubazhugs/ stod smad kyi dmag rnying rjed dang rkun chen btul⑤/ gar log gi pho nyas phyag btsal/ blon chen po zhang khri zur ram shag rjodang / mang rje lha 'od ⑦la sogs pas rgya las gnang ⑧mang po bcad de/ rnga rta dang ba mar ⑨phal mo che phyag tu phul/ zhang blon man chad so sor bya dga' stsal ba'i lan la/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dzi na mi tra dang /su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dā na shī la dang / bo dhi mi tra dang /bod kyi mkhan po rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang / dhan+d+ra tā shī la dang / lo tsā ba mkhas par chud pa dz+nyā na se na dang / dza ya rak+ṣ-i ta dang / mdzi shrī wan+d+ra dang / rasnen+d+ra ⑩shrī la la sogs pas theg pa che chung las 'byung ba'i rgya gar gyi skad las bod kyi skad du bsgyur zhing ⑪ming du btags pa rnams dkar chag tu bris te/ nam du 115—312

yang gzhung lugs de las mi bsgyur zhing kun gyis bslab du ①rung bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal nas/ sngon lha sras yab kyi ring la/ ā tsār+ya bo bye satwa dang /ye shes dbang po dang / zhang rgyal nyen nya bzang dang / blon khri gzher ②sang shi dang / lo tsā ①ba dz+nyā na de ba ko ṣa dang / lce khyi 'brug dang / bram ze ā nan+da la sogs pas chos kyi skad bod la ma grags pa las ming du btags pa mang ④dag cig mchis pa'i nang nas kha cig chos kyi gzhung dang / byā ⑤ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi mthun te/ mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams kyang bcos/ skad kyi ming gces rjoso 'tshal gyis kyang bsnan nas theg pa che chung gi gzhung las ji ltar 'byung ba dang / gna'i mkhan po chen po nā gā pyardzu na dang / ba su ban+tu la sogs pas ji ltar bshad pa dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i sgra'i lugs las ji skad du 'dren pa dang yang bstun te/ mjal spridaka' ba rnams kyang tshig so sor phral nas gtan tshigs kyis bshad de gzhung du bris/ skad rkyang ⑨pa bshad mi 'tshal ba sgra bzhin du bsgyur bar rigs pa rnams kyang sgra btsan par bgyis te ming du btagasarka/ skad kha cig don bzhin du gdags ⑩par rigs pa rnams kyi ⑪don btsan par bgyis te ming du btags nas/ btsad ⑩po'i spyan sngar ban+de chen po dpal gyi yon tan dang / ban+de chen po ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yang 'tshogs ⑫te / rje blon gdan 'dzom pa la zhus nas dha1 bsgyur ba'i thabs dang / rgya gar gyi skad la bod kyi skad du ming btags pa rnams gtan la phab ste/ bkas bcad pa/ dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i lugs ni don dang yang mi 'gal la bod skad ⑫la yang gar bde bar gyis shig /dhan+d+ra bsgyur ba la rgya gar gyi skad kyi go rims las mi bsnor ba ⑫bod kyi skad du bsgyur na don dang tshig tu 'brel zhing 115—313

bde na ma bsnor ①bar sgyur ④cig /bsnor na bde zhing go ba bskyed pa cig ④yod na/ tshigs bcad ④la ni rtsa ba bzhi pa'am/ drug pa'ang rung ste/tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi nang na gang bde ba bsnor zhing sgyur ⑤cig /rkyang pa la ni don gang snyegs pa yan chad kyi tshig dang don gnyis ka la gar bde bar bsnor zhing sgyur rjocig /skad gcig ⑦la ming du mar 'dren pa ni ltag ⑧'og dang bstun la gar snyegs pa bzhin du ming thogs shig /go ta mya ⑨lta bu go'i sgra las tshig dang / phyogs dang / sa dang / 'od dang / rdo rje dang / ba lang dang / mtho ris la sogs pa rnam pa du mar snyegs pa dang / kau shi ka lta bu'i ⑩rtswa ku sha thogs pa dang / mkhas pa dang / pad+ma la dga' ba dang /'ug pa dang / mdzod ldan la sogs pa'i sgra'i lugs las ⑩drangs shing bsgyur na sna grangs mang po ⑫zhig tu snyegs la/ bsgyur ba rnams gcig gi nang du ni sna grangs de kun 'dur yang mi btub ste/ gcig tu chad par byar yang gtan tshigs chen po med pa rnams ni mi bsgyur bar rgya gar skad so na zhog cig /gar yang drang du rung ba'i tshig ⑫byung na/ phyogs gcig tu chad par mi bsgyur bar spyir snyegs su rung bar gyis shig /yul dang / sems can dang / me tog dang / rtsi shing la sogs pa'i ming bsgyur na yid gol zhing tshig mi bde ba dang / 'ol phyir ④bsgyur du rung ba ⑫don du de ltar yin nam ma yin gtol med pa rnams la/ mgo la yul zhe'am/ me tog ces pa la sogs pa gang la bya ⑩ba'i ming gcig bla thabs su snon ⑩la rgya gar skad so na zhog cig /grangs la rgya gar skad bzhin du bsgyur na dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum zhes 'byung ba la sogs pa ni stong nyis brgya lnga bcu zhes tha mal par bod kyi skad ⑫bzhin 115—314

bsgyur na don dang yang mi 'gal ba ①bod kyi skad la yang bde bas grangs bsdom du rung ba rnams bod skad kyi lugs bzhin du thogs shig /pa ri dang / sam dang / u pa lta bu la sogs te/ tshig gi phrad dang rgyan lta bur 'byung ba rnams bsgyur na don dang mthun ②zhing 'byor pa'i thabs ni/ yongs su zhe'am/yang dag pa zhe'am/ nye ba zhes sgra bzhin du sgyur ④cig /don lhag par snyegs pa med pa rnams ni tshig gi lhad kyis bsnan mi dgos kyis dudon bzhin du thogs shig /rnam grangs su gtogs pa'i tshig rnams ni ma 'doms ⑤na ming gang bod skad du spyir grags rjoshing tshig tu gar bde bar gdags so/ /'doms ⑦na so sor btags pa bzhin du thogs shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos la sogs pa zhes dang sko ⑧long gi tshig gi rim pa ni sangs rgyas la zhe sa'i ⑨tshig tu bsgyur/ gzhan la tshig 'bring po man tshad ⑩tsam du byas te/ sngon lha sras yab kyi spyan sngar mkhan po dang lo tsā ⑪ba mkhas pa 'tshogs ⑫pas/ dhan+d+ra dkon mchog sprin dang / laṅkar gshegs pa bsgyur te/gtan la phab pa'i lugs bzhin du sgyur ⑫cig /skad kyi lugs 'di ltar bkas bcad pa las so so nas su yang 'chos shing 'og tu ming gsar du 'dogs su mi gnang gis/ bsgyur ba dang 'chad pa'i grwa (steso so nas skad gsar du ming gdags dgos pa zhig yod na yang / so so'i grwa grwar ming chad ⑫par ma gdags par chos kyi gzhung dang sgra'i lugs las ji skad du 'byung ba'i gtan tshigs dang / chos la ji skad du gdags pa dpyad de/ pho brang du bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs kyi 'dun ⑩sa dang / dhan+d+ra zhu chen 'tshal ba'i grwar ⑩phul la/ snyan du zhus te bkas bcad nas skad kyi dkar chag gi dkyus su 115—315

bsnan no/ /gsang sngags kyi rgyud rnams gzhung gis ①gsang bar bya ba yin te/snod du ma gyur pa rnams la bshad cing bstan du yang mi rung la/ bar du bsgyur zhing ④spyod du gnang gis kyang / sdem po dag tu bshad pa ma khrol nas sgra ji bzhin du 'dzin cing log par spyod pa dag kyang byung sde/ sngags kyi rgyud kyi nang nas thu zhing bod skad du bsgyur ba dag kyang byung zhes gdags kyi/ phyin chad gzungs sngags dang rgyud bla rjonas bka' stsal te/ sgyur ⑤du bcug pa ma gtogs pa / sngags kyi rgyud dang / sngags kyi tshig thu zhing bsgyur du mi gnang ngo / /skad kyi ming sngon gtan la ma phab pa dang ming du ma thogs pa las theg pa che chung gi gzhung dang sgra'i gzhung las 'byung ba dang sbyar te bshad pa'i dang po'o// //sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang yon tan gyi ming la sogs pa skad dka' ba rnams thog thog bshad pa sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs la/ budhaḥzhes bya ba'i rjosgra las drangs na gcig tu na/ mo ha ni dru ⑦pra mat+ta pra budha bu ru ṣa bta ces bya ste/ gti mug gi gnyid ⑧sangs pas na mi gnyid sangs pa bzhin te/sangs pa la snyegs⑨/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ butre+e ti ⑩kā sha nā da ⑪budha bi budha pad+ma bta/ blo bye zhing rgyas pas na pad+ma kha bye zhing rgyas pa dang 'dra bar yang bshad de sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /tshig gi don spyir na chos thams cad thugs su chud cing ma lus par byang chub pa la bya/ bha ga bān zhes bya ba gcig tu na/ bha ga na mā ra ⑩tsa tuṣ+ṭa pa twa dwa ⑫bha ga bān/ zhes bya ste bdud bzhi bcom pas na bcom pa la bya/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na bha ga ni legs pa rnam pa drug gi ming ste/ gzugs dang / grags pa dang / dbang phyug dang /dpal dang / shes rab dang / brtson pa ste 'di drug gi spyi la bya/ bān 115—316

zhes 'byung ba ni bha ga myu snri ti bha ga bān zhes ldan par bshad de/ de rnam grangs 'di skad du bya ba las sngar bsgyur ba'i tshig grags pa btsan par bya ste/bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni mdo sde dag las sangs rgyas kyi yon tan la mtshan 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /zhes kyang 'byung bas na/ 'jig rten pa'i bha ga bān las khyad par du 'das zhes bla thabs su ①bsnan te/ bcom ldan 'das zhes btags/ 'jig rten pa'i bha ga bān zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten pa'i gzhung nyid las kyang bcom par mi 'chad de/ legs pa dang ldan pa zhes 'chad pas 'jig rten pa'i bha ga bān ni legs ldan zhes gdags/ ta thā ga ta zhes bya ba ta thā ni de bzhin ga ta ni gshegs pa'am ②byon pa'am mkhyen pa'am gsungs pa ④la bya ste/ tshig gi don spyir na sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams ji ltar gshegs shing phyin pa dang / chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid ji lta ba rjomakhyen zhing gsungs pa ⑤la bya mod kyi/ sngar grags pa bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa zhes gdags| artan zhes bya ba gcig tu na/ pū dza ma ra ha tī duti artan ⑦zhes bya ste/ lha dang mi la sogs pa kun gyis mchod par 'os pas na mchod 'os zhes kyang bya/ yang gcig tu na/ kle sha a ri ha da bān artan ⑧zhes bya ste/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra bcom ⑨pa ⑩zhes kyang bya ste/ rnam pa 'di ⑩/las 'dir ni don btsan par bya ste dgra bcom pa zhes btags/ samyak+shi burnya zhes pa ⑫samyaka ni yang dag pa/ sam ni sa man+ta'am/ sam pūṇ+ḍi ste ma lus pa'am rdzogs pa/burnya ni sangs rgyas pa ⑫la bya ste/ spyir na chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid ma nor bar thugs su chud cing mngon par byang chub pa'i mtshan te/ yang dag par —rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya/ bibyā tsa ra ṇa saṃ pan+da zhes pa ⑫bibyā ni rig pa/115—317

tsa ra ṇa ni rkang pa/ saṃ pan+da ni ldan pa'am phun sum tshogs pa la bya ste/bslab pa gsum dang sbyar na lhag pa'i shes rab ni rig pa lhag pa'i sems dang lhag pa'i ①khrims ni rkang pa/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang sbyar na /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni rig pa/ lhag ma bdun ni rkang pa ste/ rig pa mig dang 'dra bas mtshon nas rkang pas phyin cing thob par 'gyur bas na rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa zhes bya/ su ga ta ces ⑦bya ba gcig tu na/ sho bha na ga ta su ga ta su rū pa bta ①ces bya ste/ legs par gshegs pas na legs par gshegs pa ste/ gzugs legs pa bzhin/ a pu nar prat+yā rjog ta su naṣ+ṭa dz+war bta ⑤ces bya ste/ phyir mi ldog pa rjogashegs pas na legs par gshegs pa sterka/ rims nad legs par byang ba dze+ebazhin/ yā baṅga ta bya ⑧ga ma nā ta ⑨su ga ta/ su pūr+ṇa gha ṭa bta ⑩ces bya ste/ ji tsam du 'gro bar bya ba ma lus par phyin pas na legs par gshegs pa ste/ bum pa legs par gang bzhin pa ⑪zhes 'byung / yang na gcig tu na/ dhan+d+ra skarnya ⑫las 'byung ba su ga ta i ti su khi to bha ga bān⑫/ swarga ta ⑫a bya thi ta/ dhabyu sa ma nā ga ta/ ta du tsu te su ga ta ces ⑫'byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das bde bar gyur cing mtho ris kyi bde ba dang ldan la/ gnod pa mi mnga' zhing gnod pa med pa'i chos dang ldan pas na bde bar gshegs pa'am bde ba brnyes pa la yang bya ste/ 'dir sngar grags pa dang / dhan+d+ra skarnya ⑩las 'byung ba dang sbyar te bde bar gshegs pa zhes btags/ lo ka bid ces bya ba lo ka ni 'jig rten/ bid ni bid dz+nyā na ste de bzhin gshegs pas ⑩nyin lan gsum mtshan lan ⑫gsum du gdul ⑪ba'i sems can gyi khams la gzigs shing / skal ba yod pa dang med pa rtogs par 115—318

mkhyen pas na 'jig rten mkhyen pa zhes bya/ a nu t+ta ra pu ru ṣa da mya sā ra thi zhes bya ba/ a nut+ta ra ni bla na med pa①/ pu ru ṣa da mya sā ra thi ni skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ②ba ste/ sor mo'i phreng ba la sogs pa dze+ezhe sdang che ba dang /dga' bo la sogs pa 'dod chags che ba dang / lteng rgyas 'od srungs la sogs pa gti mug che ba'i 'dul ba'i sems can rta rgod dang 'dra ba 'dul dka' ba rnams 'jam pos 'dul ba yang 'jam pos btul/ drag pos 'dul ba yang drag pos btul/ gnyi gas 'dul ba yang gnyi gas btul te/ thabs bzang zhing sla ④bas thabs thabs khrubazhin du btul nas don sgrub pa'i mchog mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas par kha lo sgyur rjozhing 'jog pas na/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ⑦ba bla na med pa zhes bya/ shāsta zhes bya ba shā su a nu ṣi sgo zhes bya ste/ phyir tshig gi ⑧don du na ston zhing slob pa la bya/ ta ni tshig gi don ⑨du bya bar zad de/ spyir na lha dang mi la sogs pa thams cad kyi ston par gyur pas na ⑩ston pa zhes bya/ dzi na zhes bya ba dzi ta pā pa ka a ku sha la dhasmra zhes bya ste/ sdig pa dang mi dge ba'i chos las rgyal bas na rgyal ba zhes bya/tā yi zhes bya ba tā yi ni san+ta na pa ⑪la na yoḥ⑩zhes bya ste/ 'phags pa'i lam thugs su chud pa bstan zhing ⑫bshad de/ rgyun mi gcod pa dang / skyob sbung skyong ba la bya ste/ pā la skyong ba zhes btags pa zhig kyang gud ④na yod pa dang ma 'dom par bya ste skyob par btags/ ma hā ṛ ṣi zhes bya ba ma hā ⑫chen po/ṛ ṣi ni ṛ ṣi ga to ⑫zhes bya ste/ shes pa dang ldan pa la'ang bya/ yang gcig tu ⑩na/ ṛ bye ti pra ṇi ⑫dhā nan zhes bya ba ste/ smon pa rnams 'byor zhing 'grub pa la'ang bya/ yang gcig tu na/ kā ya bāgla no bhi ṛ ⑪dzu she te i ti ṛ ⑥115—319

ṣi zhes bya ste/ lus dang ngag dang yid drang por gnas shing srong bas na drang srong chen po zhes btags/ e gi ra sa zhes bya ba thog ma sdedrang srong nyid kyi lus las byung bas na bdag lus skyes zhes ②bshad pa dang / e gi ra sa ni nyi ma ste/ nyi ma'i rigs yin pas na nyi ④rgyud ces kyang bshad du rung bar 'dul ba'i dngos po dang / bshad pa las 'byung la/ mdo sde dag las sku'i kha dog nyi ma bzhin du lham me lhang nger bzhugs pa'i yon tan lta bur yang bshad pas nyi ma'i rgyud ces btags/ de bzhin gshegs pa so so'i mtshan la/ bi shwa bhu ga zhes bya badhi/ bi shwa ni thams cad/ bhu dza bā la na a bh+ya ba ha ra yo zhes 'byung sterka/ longs par kun la spyod pa'am sems can thams cad skyob pa la bya ste/skabs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi mtshan yin pas na thams cad skyob ces btags/ kra kusgon+da ces ⑤bya ba/ kra ni kra ma ste 'khor ba/ kutsun+da ni/ lta kung sa ya ti zhes bya ste/ 'khor ba rjo'ajoms pa'am/ sel ba la bya ste/ 'khor ba 'jig ces bya/ yang yi ge kha cig gi nang nas kra kuts+tshan+da ces ⑦kyang 'byung ste/ kuṣ+pe ⑧ta tshasdo/ a ti krasdo ⑨smra di ti zhes bya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan cing bshad pas mi dge ba dang log pa la ⑫dad pa bsal zhing ⑪med par byas pa'i mtshan te/ log ⑫dad sel zhes bya/ kā sh+ya pa ⑫zhes bya ba/ ka sh+ya ga te zhes bya ste/ chad pas bcad pa'am gnod par bya ba'i rigs ④pa yin/ pa ⑫ni pā la ni skyob pa'am skyong ba'i drang srong gi rigs su skyes pa la bya ste/ chad pas bcad ⑩cing gnod par bya ba las skyob pas na gnod skyob ces kyang bya/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ kā byu dri pa to zhes kyang bya ste/ skal ba yod pa'i sems can chos bshad pa'i 'od kyis ⑩snang bar bya ba'i rigs pa rnams gcig tu na kā 115—320

byu dī pa to zhes kyang bya ste/ skal ba yod pa'i sems can chos bshad pa'i 'od kyis snang bar bya ba'i rigs pa rnams ①srung zhing skyob pas na 'od srungs zhes kyang byar ②rung ste/ sngan chad ming du btags te grags pa bzhin du 'od srungs zhes btags/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi ming la mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i phung po dang / ye shes dang sku gsum la/ a sa ma sa ma pañtsa skarnya zhes bya ba a sa ma ni mi mnyam pa ste/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams la bya/ sa ma ni mnyam pa ste sngon gyi sangs rgyas de dag nyid dang mtshungs par gyur pa la bya/pañtsa skarnya ni phung po lnga ste zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po ste/ sangs rgyas rnams la mnga' ba'i phung po 'di dag phal pa la med pas na mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i phung po lnga zhes bya/ dhabyu dh+wa tu bi shudha zhes bya ba chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa yin te/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa 'phags pa'i chos rnams skye zhing 'byung ba snedang dbyings su gyur pas na chos kyi dbyings de bzhin nyid la glo bur gyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa sprin dang 'dra ba dwangs shing bubyang ste/ nam mkha'i dbyengs dag pa dang 'dra bas na chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa zhes bya/ā ⑤dar+sha dz+nyā na zhes bya ba me long lta bu'i ye shes yin te chos kyi dbyengs rnam par dag pa la dmigs pas gzung ba rjodang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa thams cad dang bral te kun gzhi rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pas/ me long phyis pa'i nang du ci yang snang ba bzhin du chos thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba la bya ste/ me long lta bu'i ye shes zhes bya/ sa ma tā dz+nyā na zhes bya ba thog ma sa dang po la de kho na nyid 115—321

mngon par rtogs pa'i tshe/ bdag dang gzhan du mi 'byed cing mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas gong nas gong du sbyangs pa'i ①sangs rgyas kyi sa la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa'i tshe/ nyon mongs pa can gyi ④yid gnas 'phos te/ye shes su gnas ④gyur pa la mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes zhes bya/ pra t+ya be k+ṣa ṇa ④dz+nyā na zhes bya ba so sor rtog ⑤pa'i ye shes yin te/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pas gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin dang bsam gtan dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes 'jug pas chos kyi char chen po 'be+ebs shing the tshom sna tshogs gcod pa dang / sku be+e ḍūr+ya la sogs pa rin po che'i mdog tu ston pa'i rgyur gyur pa yin te/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes zhes bya/ kṛ t+yā nuṣ+ṭha ༷na dz+nyā na zhes bya ba bya ba sgrub ⑦pa'i ye shes yin te/ mig la sogs pa dbang po lnga'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du thabs sna tshogs dpag tu med pas sems can mang po'i don mdzad pa'i gzhir gyur pa yin te/ bya ba sgrub ⑧pa'i ye shes zhes bya/ dhan+d+ra kā ya zhes bya ba chos kyi sku yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi sa dang sbyar na chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes ni de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin te chos kyi sku zhes bya/ sasto ga kā ya zhes bya ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes gnyis kyis chos kyi longs spyod dang skyid pa chen po ma lus pa myong bar mdzad pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku la bya ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes bya/ nis+thā ṇa kā ya zhes bya ba sprul pa'i sku yin te/ bya ba sgrub ⑨pa'i ye shes kyis sems can so so cis 'dul ba bzhin du thabs thabs su sku dang gsung 115—322

dang thugs sprul te/ sna tshogs su ston pa la bya bas na/ sprul pa'i sku zhes bya/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la/ da sha ta thā ga ta ba lo zhes pa ①de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes sgrib pa med pas shes bya'i dngos po gang la yang thogs pa med de mkhyen pa 'di bcu'i mthu nyan thos la sogs pa gzhan las 'phags pas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu zhes bya/ s+thā nā s+thā na dz+nyā na ba lan ②zhes bya ba gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ gnas ni legs par spyad pas 'bras bu yid du 'ong ba 'grub pa dang / nyes par spyad pas 'bras bu yid du mi 'ong ba smin par 'gyur ba la sogs pa la bya/ gnas ma yin pa ni legs par spyad pa'i 'bras bu yid du mi 'ong bar gyur pa ①dang / nyes par spyad pa'i 'bras bu yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ba ④la bya ste/ srid pa dang mi srid pa ma nor bar mkhyen pa'i stobs dang ldan pa'i phyir gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes bya/ kan+d+ra bi pā ka dz+nyā na ba lan rjozhes bya ba las kyi rnam par smin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes kyis rjo'adas pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da lta dze+ebyung ba'i las yang dag par blangs pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa las kyi rgyu gang gis/ gnas gang du 'bras bu smin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes bya| nā nā dhi mut+ta dz+nyā na ba lan ⑧zhes bya ba mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang khams gsum la dga' zhing mos pa rnam pa sna tshogs mkhyen pas na mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes bya/ nā nā dhā tu dz+nyā na ba lan ⑨zhes bya ba khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ khams zhes bya ba ni sngon gyi bag chags kyis grub pa'i 115—323

bsam pa'i khams dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa'i khams dang / rnam par byang ba'i khams la sogs pa la bya ste/ khams tha dad pa mang po'i rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ma nor bar thugs su chud pas na khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes bya/ idh+ri ya pa rā pa ra ①dz+nyā na ba lan sdezhes bya ba dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ dad pa la sogs pa'i dbang po rab dang / 'bring dang /① tha ma'i rim pa dang rnam grangs ma lus par mkhyen pa'i ④dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen ⑤pa'i stobs zhes bya/ sarba tra gā mi rtswa pra ti pan+d+ra ba lan ༷zhes bya ba thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ 'gro ba lngar ⑦skye ba'i lam dang / mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba'i lam la sogs pa lam mo cog chub par mkhyen pas thams cad du 'go ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes bya/ sarba dh+yā na bi mok+ṣa sa mā dhi sa mā sgepati saṃ kle sha bya ba dā na dz+nyā na ba lan ⑨zhes bya ba bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa dang /rnam par byang ba dang ldang ba ⑩thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ bsam gtan dang po la sogs pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / stong pa nyid la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin mang po dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la sogs pa la bya⑪/ kun nas nyon mongs pa ni lta ba dang dmigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis nyon mongs par gyur pa la bya/ rnam par byang ba ni 'khor ba la chags pa med pa dang mi dmigs pa dang ldan pas rnam par dag pa la bya/ ldan pa ni lugs dang mthun ⑫pa'am mi mthun pa dang thod rgal la sogs pa'i tshul gyis ldan pa ⑫mkhyen pa la bya/ pūrba ni bā sā nu smṛ ⑫ti 115—324

dz+nyā na ba lan ①zhes bya ba sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sngon gyi tshe rabs grangs med pa tshun chad gnas gar skyes pa dang / byad gzugs kyi rnam pa ci 'dra ba dang / mtshan ma dang rtags ⑤ci yod pa dang las kyi rgyu cis skyes pa mkhyen pas na sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes bya/ sgo kyu pa pati dz+nyā na ba lan ①zhes bya ba shi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ lha'i spyan gyis sems can rnams gang nas shi 'phos nas gang du skyes pa ma lus par gzigs pas na shi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes bya/ ā rjoshra bak+ṣa ya dz+nyā na ba lan ⑤zhes bya ba zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad bag chags yan chad zad cing byang bar gzigs pas na zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes byabu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mi 'jigs pa bzhi la tsa twa ri ta thā ga ta bai shā ra bye ⑦zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i mi 'jigs pa bzhi yin te/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa phal pa mang po'i nang du byon nas khyu mchog gi gnas rlabs po che zhal kyis 'che ste/ tshangs pa'i 'khor lo bskor ⑤zhing yang dag par seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pas na mi 'jigs pa zhes bya/ de la mngon par byang chub pa la mi 'jigs pa dang zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa la mi 'jigs pa gnyis ni sangs rgyas nyid kyi khyargyud la mnga' ba'i yon tan yin pas na rang gi don phun sum tshogs pa yin la/bar du gcod pa'i chos nges par bstan pa dang / nges par 'byung ba'i lam bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa gnyis ni gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir bshad pa yin pas na gzhan gyi don te/ bdag dang gzhan ⑩gyi don phun sum tshogs par 115—325

bstan pa'ang yin no/ /sarba dhas+thā ①r+bha saṃ bo dhi bai shā ra r+yan ③zhes bya ba chos thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa la mi 'jigs pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad phyag mthil du skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu bzhag pa dang 'dra bar thugs su chud de/ mngon par byang chub pa la shes rab brnyes ③pas dge sbyong ngam bram ze'ang rung / lha'i mig dang pha rol gyi sems shes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa lha'am bdud kyang rung rdzu 'phrul dang ldan zhing mthu che ba'i tshangs pas kyang chos dang mthun pas ④mngon par sangs rgyas pa ma yin par brgal ba'i gzhi dang gtan tshigs med de brgal gyis dogs pa med pas na chos thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa la mi 'jigs pa zhes bya ste/ mi 'jigs pa 'og ma gsum gyi mjug kyang 'di dang 'dra bar bshad/sar+pā shra pak+ṣa ya dz+nyā na bai shā ra r+yan ⑤zhes bya ba zag pa thams cad zad pa rjomakhyen pa la mi 'jigs pa yin te/ zag pa zhes bya ba di nyon mongs pa'i ming ste/'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang ma bral na srid pa'i rtse mo man chad kyang slar 'dzag cing rtsang bas na zag pa zhes bya/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te zad par mdon pa la zag pa ma zad par sun dbyung zhing don ⑦rtags kyis brgal du med de/ mi dogs pas na zag pa thams ⑧zad par mkhyen pa la mi 'jigs pa zhes bya/ an+ta ra ⑨yi ka dhas+thā na n+ya tha ⑩tā ni bye ta byā ⑪ka ra ṇa bai shā ra r+yan ⑫zhes bya ba bar du gcod pa'i chos rnams gzhan du mi 'gyur bar nges pa'i lung bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa yin te/ bar du gcod pa'i chos zhes bya ba bag ⑫med pa dang ngo tsha mi shes pa dang khrel med pa la sogs pa 'phags pa'i lam dang / dge ba'i phyogs kyi bar du gcod pa rnams bar chad kyi chos yin no zhes 115—326

lung bstan cing bshad pa la thog tu ma bab pa med pas na bar du gcod pa'i chos rnams gzhan du mi 'gyur bar nges pa'i lung bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa zhes bya / sarba ṅga pa dā dhi ①ga mā yi ne+et+yā ṇi ka ④pra ti pat+ta ④thā twa bai shā ra r+yan ④zhes bya ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob par 'gyur ba nges par 'byung ba'i lam de bzhin du 'gyur ba la mi 'jigs pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pas ⑤nyan thos rnams la nges par 'byung ba'i lam mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur zhing sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa bshad pa la nges par 'byung ba'i lam ma yin no zhes dge sbyong ngam bram ze sus kyang brgal zhing gzhan du bsgyur rjodu med pas na phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob par 'gyur ba nges par 'byung ba'i lam de bzhin du 'gyur ba la mi 'jigs pa zhes bya/sangs rgyas kyi chos ⑦ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la/ aṣ+ṭa ⑧da sha be+e ⑨ṇi ka budha dhas+thā zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad yin te/ chos 'di rnams nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang mi mnga' ste/ phal dang thun mong du gyur pa ma yin la/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig la yon tan 'di rnams mnga' bas na sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa zhes bya| nā ste ta thā ga ta su slu li ta tho)na zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa la 47'khrul pa mi mnga' ba yin te/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi phrin las la nor zhing thog tu ma bab pa med pas na de bzhin gshegs pa la 'khrul pa med pa zhes bya / nā ste ra bi tan zhes bya ba ca co med pa yin te/ dgra bcom pa kha cig lam nor nas ku co 'don pa dang / sngon gyi bag chags ma byang bas ca co che zhing tshig la 'khral 'khrul yod pa lta bu ma yin pas ca co med pa zhes bya/ nāste 115—327

mu ṣi ta smṛ ti tā ①zhes bya ba bsnyel ba med pa yin te/ dgra bcom pa la ma dgongs pa'i ye shes mi mnga' ste/ bsnyel nas sems can gyi don bya ba la sogs pa shor ba dang / dus las yol ba lta bu ma yin pas na bsnyel ba med pa zhes bya/ nā ste sa mā ②hi ta tsit+t+waṃ zhes bya ba sems mnyam par ma bzhag ①pa med pa yin te/ dgra bcom pa dag nam ting nge 'dzin gang la zhugs pa de'i tshe/ting nge 'dzin de la mnyam par gzhag ④pa lta bu ma yin gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pas ting nge 'dzin mchog brnyes pas na ting nge 'dzin la zhugs kyang rung ma zhugs kyang rung ste/ mnyam par ma bzhag ⑤pa med pas na sems mnyam par ma bzhag rjopa med pa zhes ⑦bya/ nāste nā nā tā saṃ dz+nyā zhes bya ba/ tha dad pa'i 'du shes med pa yin ⑧te/ dgra bcom pa dag 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis la bye brag tu 'dzin cing nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i chos la sogs pa la tha dad du 'byed pa lta bu mi mnga' ste/ sems mnyam pa nyid dang chos mnyam pa nyid du gzigs pas na tha dad pa'i 'du shes med pa zhes bya—/ nāsngu pra ti saṃ khyu yo pek+ṣa zhes bya ba so sor ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms med pa yin te/ dgra bcom pa dag sems can gyi don la ma brtags ⑨par yal bar 'dor ba lta bu ma yin gyi/ skal ba yod med dang dus la bab ma bab gzigs nas dus dang sbyor ba ma gtogs par yal bar 'dor ba med pas na so sor ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms med pa zhes bya/ nāste ts+tshan+da mya hā ni zhes bya ba 'dun pa nyams pa med pa yin te/ dgra bcom pa dag spyod yul dman pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa la mos shing 'dun pa med de nyan thos kyi bya ba la mos pa lta bu ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang / dkon 115—328

mchog gsum gyi gdung mi 'chad par bya ba la sogs pa la rtag tu 'dun par 'jug pas na 'dun pa nyams pa med pa zhes bya/ nāste bī r+ya su hā ni zhes bya ba brtson 'grus nyams pa med pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa sems can gcig gi phyir bskal par chos bshad kyang sku dang gsung dang thugs bsnyel bar mi 'gyur ba dang / sems can gcig gi phyir yang 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa 'das te gshegs pas na brtson 'grus nyams pa med pa zhes bya/ nāste smṛ ti hā ①ni zhes bya ba dran pa nyams pa med pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / spyod pa dang / bsam pa dang / mos pa la sogs pa sems can 'dul ba'i thabs dang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad dang / chos thams cad ji ltar gzigs shing dgongs pa la phyis ye shes kyis brtag ②mi dgos te/ —nyams pa med pas na dran pa nyams pa med pa zhes byaske/ nāste sa mā dherta gni zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin nyams pa med pa yin te/chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid mnyam pa nyid la snyoms par 'jug cing de las mi g.yo bar 'dzin pas na ting nge 'dzin nyams pa med pa zhes bya/ nāste pra dz+nyā yā rta ni zhes bya ba shes rab nyams pa med pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa mkhyen pa mi zad pa dang / sems can yongs su smin pa mkhyen pa mi zad pa dang / so sor yang dag par rig pa 'ami zad pa mnga' bas na shes rab nyams pa med pa zhes bya/ nāste bi muste rta ni zhes bya ba 6rnam par gol ba nyams pa med pa yin te/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad las grol bas na rnam par grol ba nyams pa med pa zhes bya/ sarba kā ya karma dz+nyā na pu ⑦baṃ ga rma dz+nyā nā pyanu pa ri bat+t+waṃ zhes bya ba lus kyi las thams 115—329

cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin te/ dgra bcom pa kha cig lus kyi las bsam ①bzhin ma yin par byed de/ 'jig rten gyi yid dang 'gal ba lta bu ma yin gyi/ spyod lam bzhi po kun gyis kyang sems can 'dul te/ ye shes sngar 'byung ba'i rgyu las byung bas na ye shes sngon du 'gro ba yinarka/ ye shes dang lhan cig 'byung zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'jug pas na ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin te/ bsdus na lus kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'go zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya/ ngag dang yid kyi skabs su yang ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba 'di bzhin du bshad/sarba wā k+kan+d+ra dz+nyā na byubaṃ ②ga me dz+nyā nā nu ④pa ri bat+t+waṃ zhes bya ba ngag gi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad cing chos bstan pa la don med cing chud za bar mi 'gyur la/ gsung gi yan lag drug cu dang ldan pas na ngag gi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya/ sarba ma naḥ④kan+d+ra dz+nyā na pūbaṃ ga rma dz+nyā nā nu pa ri bat+t+waṃ zhes bya ba yid kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin te/ nyon mongs pa dang spros pa'i bag chags thams cad dang ⑤bral te/ yang dag pa'i mtha' don dam pa'i mtshan nyid dang ma bral bas na yid kyi las thams cad ye shes rjokyi rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya/ a tī te dh+wa n+ya ⑦saṃ ga mā sgepra ti ha ta stidz+nyā na dar+sha rgo pa ri bat+t+waṃ te zhes bya ba 'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa yin te/ dgra bcom pa ltar 'das pa'i dus kyi ⑩dngos po ci ⑪la brtags pa sna gcig mkhyen gyi gzhan la thogs shing mi mkhyen pa lta bu ma ⑫yin 115—330

gyis / 'das pa'i dus kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang / sa chu me rlung gi rdul phra mo'i grangs dang / sems can gyi bsam pa dang spyod pa la sogs pa ma lus pa ①mnyam par gzhag ③pa dang / ma bzhag ①pa'i dus dang sbyar ba med cing ci la yang thags thogs med pa ④thugs su chud pas na/ 'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa zhes bya/ ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gyi dus kyi skabs su yang 'di bzhin du sbyar zhing bshad/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ⑤la/ tsa tuṣ+ṭha pra ti saṃ dhibid ces bya ba so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yin te/ chos dang don dang nges pa'i tshig dang sgobs pa bzhi la mkhas pas so so yang dag par rig pa ⑦zhes bya/ cho 'phrul gsum la tho ṇi mā ti ④hāt+yā ni zhes bya ba cho 'phrul gsum yin te/ ā de sha na mā ti hār+ya zhes bya ba ⑨pha rol gyi snying la ci sems pa mkhyen pas ji sems pa kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul dang / ṛ ⑩rnyi mā ti hār+ya ⑪nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang / sku lus mang por sprul pa la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / a nu shā sa bhā ⑫mā ti hār+ya bden pa gnyis kyi sgo nas chos thams cad gtan la phab par bkrol te phan zhing rjes su mthun ⑫par bshad pas na rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul rnam pa 'di gsum ngo mtshar che ba'i ④rmad du byung bas ⑫sems can mang po dad cing 'dun par mdzad pas na cho 'phrul gsum zhes bya/ byang chub sems dpa'i sgra bshad pa la bo dhi satwa zhes bya ba ⑫satwa na ye ṣ+pe ste bo dhi satwa zhes pa bo dhi ni byang chub/satwa ni sems dpa' 'am sems stobs che ba la bya/ bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la gcig tu brtul ⑩zhing mi nur bas na byang chub sems dpa'/ ma hā satwa zhes bya ba ma hā di chen po/ satwa ni sems dpa' ste nyan thos dang rang 115—331

sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa lta bu ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la zhugs pas ①na sems dpa' chen po zhes bya/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos kyi sa'i rim pa'i ming la da sha byu mi zhes bya ba sa bcu yin te/ sa gong ma'i yon tan thob par bya ba'i rten du 'gyur zhing / sa de nyid yon tan gyi gzhi yin pas na sa zhes bya/ sa dang po pra mu di ta ces ②bya ba ni don chen po sngon 'dris pa ma yin pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems thob pa dang / byang chub dang nye zhing sems can mang po'i don sgrub pa gzigs nas dga' ba rlabs po che skye bas rab tu dga' ba zhes bya/ sa gnyis pa ni snebi ma la zhes bya ba ni/ tshul khrims 'chal pa'i rtsang ba phra mo yan chad kyang byang bas na dri ma med pa zhes bya/sa gsum pa pra bhā ka ri zhes bya ba ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po yongs su dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba chen po'i gnas su gyur pa thob pas na 'od byed pa zhes bya/ sa bzhi pa artsiṣ+ṭha ④ti zhes bya ba ni/ nyon mongs pa sreg pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi me'i 'od 'phro ba can zhes bya/ sa lnga pa su du rdza ya zhes bya ba ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas las 'das pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la sgom zhing 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis ka la mi gnas pa'i shes rab yongs su dag par ⑤sbyang zhing sgom pa shin tu dka' bas na sa de non par dka' ba'am rjobasgrub par dka' ba la bya ste—/ shin tu sbyang dka' ba ⑦zhes bya/ sa drug pa a rnyi mu khi ⑧zhes bya ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis ka la mi gnas shing mtshan ma med pa la gnas shing mtshan ma med pa la ⑨115—332

rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa'i ye shes la mang du gnas shing mngon du gzigs pas na mngon du gyur pa zhes bya/ sa bdun pa dru re ①ga ma zhes bya ba mtshan ma med pa la bgod pa gcig tu gyur pa'i ④lam dang nye zhing ring du phyin pas na ring du song ba zhes bya/ sa brgyad pa a tsa la zhes bya ba ni mtshan ma'i 'du shes dang mtshan ma med par rtsol ba'i 'du shes gnyi gas bskyod par mi nus pas mi g.yo ba zhes bya/ sa dgu pa sā byu ma ti zhes bya ba ni/ sa dgu pa la so so yang dag par rig pa brnyes pas na blo gros gzhan las 'phags pa yin te legs pa'i blo gros zhes bya/ sa bcu pa dhan+d+ra me gha zhes bya ba ni gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin kun la yang sprin dang 'dra bar ①khyab cing thos pa'i chos nam mkha' dang 'dra ba la sprin bzhin du khyab pas na chos kyi sprin zhes bya/ sangs rgyas kyi sa sa man+ta pra bhā budha bhū mi zhes bya ba ni 'od zer mang po bkye bas 'dul ba'i sems can smin par mdzad cing chos kyi snang ba 'od dang 'dra bas thams cad la gsal bar byas pas na sangs rgyas kyi sa kun du 'od ces bya/ shukla bi dar+sha na byu miḥrjozhes bya ba ni mos pas spyod pa'i ⑤drod la dang po rnam par byang ba dkar po mthong bas 0dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa zhes bya/ go ⑦tra bhū miḥ④zhes bya ba ni dad pa shin tu che ba'i sa 'jig rten gyi chos kyi mchog la chos dang gang zag la bdag med par bzod pas na byang chub ⑨thob pa'i rigs dang ldan pas na rigs kyi sa zhes bya/ aṣ+ṭa mi ⑩ka bhū mi zhes bya ba ni brgyad pa la bya ste/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob pa'i gral dang po nas yas bgrangs na/ rgyun du zhugs pa la 'jug pa grangs brgyad pa la bab pas na brgyad pa'i sa zhes bya/ dar+sha na bhū mi zhes bya ba ni dṛ shāta ⑪prek+ṣa ṇa zhes bya ste/ dṛ sha ni mthong ba/ bhū mi ni sa ste/115—333

rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la gnas pas de kho na nyid rtag ①par mthong bas na mthong ba'i sa zhes bya/ ta byu ⑧byu mi zhes bya ba ni lan cig phyir 'ong bas 'dod pa'i khams kyi 'dod chags srab mor byas pas na bsrabs ④pa'i sa zhes bya/bī ta ④rā ga byu mi zhes bya ba ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i sa la ⑤bya ste/ sa 'di la gnas pas 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / gnod sems spangs pas na 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba yin te/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa zhes bya/kṛ dhitā bhi byu mi zhes bya ba ni dgra bcom pa'i sa la bya ste/ kṛ ta ⑦ni byas pa/a bhi ni a bhi dum shī la zhes bya ste/ bsrung ba'i rang bzhin can yin pas na/sngar byas te grub pa'i don mi nyams par bsrung ba'i phyir byas pa srung ba'i sa zhes bya ste/ dngos su na dgra bcom pa'i sa la bya/ mos pas spyod pa ⑧dang nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun ⑨pa'i rim pa'i ming la a dhi mut+ta ⑩tsar+ya byu mi zhes bya ba/ bskal pa grangs med pa gcig gi bar du byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings la mos pa bsgoms te/ da dung de bzhin nyid ma mthong bas na mos pas spyod pa'i sa zhes bya/ ā lo ka lasta zhes bya ba chos kyi dbyings la mos pas bsgoms pa'i bye brag gis rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid du brtags pa'i chos thams cad dngos po med de brjod pa tsam du rig la/ chos la nges par rtog pa'i bzod pa'i snang ba dang po thob pas na snang ba thob pa zhes bya/ ā lo ka bṛrnyi ⑪zhes bya ba chos kyi snang ba de nyid rgyas par bya ba'i brtson pa brtan par rtsom pas na snang ba mched pa zhes bya/ ta tā dze+eka ⑫de shā nu pra be sha zhes bya ba chos kyi snang ba mched pas phyi rol gyi yul med cing sems tsam du rtogs te/ gzung ba'i g.yeng ba dang bral bas na de kho na'i don kyi ⑫phyogs gcig la ④zhugs pa 115—334

zhes bya/ a narnyar+ya sa mā rnyi zhes bya ba dad pa rab kyis ①sa 'di la 'dzin pa'i g.yeng ba spangs nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog ②pa de ma thag tu thob par 'gyur bas na bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya—/ nisgo snedha bha gī ④ya zhes bya ba ni nish+yi tu bhi ⑤dha ni bhe dha bhā gī rjoya zhes bya ste/nir ⑦ni nges pa'am gdon mi za ba/ be+e dha ni rtogs ⑧pa'am 'byed pa/ bha ⑨ga ni cha'am skal ba/ yī ⑩ya ni phan pa'am mthun ⑩pa lta bu la bya ste/ dngos su na 'phags pa'i sa ni ma job la/ so so'i skye bo'i sa las ni 'das pa yin te/'phags pa'i lam mthong ba dang sgom pa rnam pa gnyis yod pa'i nang nas mthong ba'i lam gyi cha gcig po dang nye bas na nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun ⑫pa zhes bya/ uṣ+ṭha ga ta zhes bya ba ni nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun ⑫pa'i tshe 'phags pa'i lam nyon mongs pa'i shing thams cad sreg ⑫pa'i me dang 'dra ba'i drod sngar byung bas na dro bar gyur pa zhes bya/ sprudha ⑫zhes bya ba ni dge ba'i rtsa ba snga ma mi brtan pa g.yo ba'i rtse mor phyin pas na rtse mo zhes bya/ spyo ti zhes bya ba ni bden pa la bzod pa rab 'bring du mar phye ba'i nang nas bzod pa ⑩rab dang ldan pa ste/ de las nyams par mi 'gyur zhing / ngan song du mi ltung bas na bzod pa zhes bya/ lo ki kā gra dhan+d+ra zhes bya ba sa 'di 'jig rten pa'i chos kyang yin la/ sngan chad ma mthong bas 'phags pa'i lam lta bu 'jig rten pa'i chos dang mi mthun pa yang 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi mchog 'dis cha mnyam pa'i rgyu med par 'thob ⑩par nu sa te/ 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi phul du byung bas na 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi mchog ces bya/ rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyi gang zag gi rim pa'i ming la/ pra bye ka budhe zhes bya ba e ka brga nā ⑫ma pra 115—335

ti burnya bo dhi pra byu ka burnya zhes bya ste/ sems can mang pos ①don mi mdzad kyi/bdag gcig pu byang chub pa dang mya ngan las 'das par sgrub pas na rang sangs rgyas zhes bya/ khaspyo bi ṣā sdeṇa kalpa zhes bya ba snekhaṅga bi ṣā ṇa tu l+ya tā taX/khaṅga bi ṣā ⑤ṇa kalpa zhes bya ste/ rang sangs rgyas bskal pa brgya'i bar du tshogs bsags pas dbang po rnon po phal dang mi 'dre bar bse ru dang 'dra ba ④gcig tu bzhugs pas na rang sangs rgyas bse ru lta bu zhes bya/ brga tsā ④ri zhes bya ba brga ni sde'am tshogs sam mang po gcig tu 'dus pa la bya/ tsā ri tsā ra ga t+yaze zhes bya ste/ 'gro ba yin pas rang sangs rgyas phal dang thabs cig tu gshegs shing bzhugs pa dang spyod pa la bya ste/ tshogs dang spyod pa zhes bya ste/shā ⑧ba ka zhes pa ⑨gcig tu na 1 nā ⑩na tī ti shā ba ka zhes bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa las chos kyi lung ma mnos par bdag nyid kyis rtogs par mi nus te nyan pa la yang bya/ yang gcig tu na samyaka dz+nyā na pha lan shā ba saṭī ti shā ⑩ba ka zhes bya ste/ yang dag pa'i shes pas rgyun du zhugs pa la sogs pa'i 'bras bu thob pa gzhan la sgogs shing ⑫thos par byed pas na nyan thos zhes bya/ sro tā pan+da zhes bya ba sro ta ni chu'i rgyun lta bu la bya/ ā ⑫pan+da ni nang du zhugs pa la bya ste/ spyir na mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtshor 'bab ⑫pa'i 'phags pa'i lam gyi chu bo'i rgyun du zhugs pa la bya ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa zhes bya/ sap+ta kṛt+ta ⑫ba par ma zhes bya ba rgyun du zhugs pa bsgoms ⑩pas spangs pa'i nyon mongs pa ma zad la/ 'bras bu thob pas mi'i nang du yang ⑩lan bdun skye/ lha'i nang du yang lan bdun skye ba la bya ste/ mir skye ba'i srid pa bar ma bdun dang /lhar skye ba'i srid pa bar ma bdun gyis bsnan na skye ba bdun bzhi nyi shu rtsa brgyad 115—336

kyi bar du 'khor ba'i nang na bzhugs ①pas na re ④ltar thogs na srid pa lan bdun pa zhes bya/ ku li ①ku la zhes bya ba rgyun du zhugs pa 'dod pa'i khams kyi nyon mongs pa gsum dang bzhi ༷man chad las grol ba/ skye ba gnyis sam ⑤gsum gyi bar du 'khor ba na gnas shing lha dang mi'i rigs bzang por skye bas na rjorigs su skye ba zhes bya/ sa kṛ dā ⑦ga mi zhes bya bas kṛ ⑤ta ni lan cig ā ga mi ni 'ong ba ste/ tshe de ⑨nyid la mya ngan las mi 'da' ste/ lan cig slar 'jig rten 'dir skye bas na lan cig phyir 'ong ba zhes bya/ e ka bi ⑩tsi ka zhes bya ba lan cig phyir ⑪'ong ba 'dod pa'i khams kyi nyon mongs pa bdun pa dang brgyad pa spangs pa/ skye ba gcig gis mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu'am/phyir mi 'ong ba'i sa thob pa'i bar du ⑫chod pas na bar chad gcig pa zhes bya/a nā ⑫gā mi zhes bya ba tha ma'i skal ba can gyi chos rnam pa lnga spangs pas spyoslar 'dod pa'i khams su mi skye bas phyir mi 'ong ba spyozhes bya/ an+ta ra ba ri dis+thā ṇi ⑩zhes bya ba phyir mi 'ong ba srid pa gcig nas 'phos pa pha rol tu yang ma skyes par srid pa bar ma do'i tshe dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas nas mya ngan las 'da' bas na bar ma dor yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba zhes bya/ u pa par+ya pa ri s+thā ṇi ⑩zhes bya ba phyir mi 'ong ba lam la zhugs shing brtson pa tshe 'phos nas pha rol tu skyes ma thag tu nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ lhag ma dang bcas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa mngon du byed pas na skyes nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba zhes bya/ a rnyi saṃ sku ra pa ri niṣ+ṭha ṇi ()zhes bya ba phyir mi 'ong ba 'khor bas rgyun ma ⑪bcad pa pha rol tu skyes nas brtson ni brtson la lam ma byang ba ⑫rtsol ba dang bcas pas mya ngan las 'da' bar byed pas na mngon 115—337
