rje 'bangs la bajongs pa bzhugs/①༄༅/ /gces pa bsdus pa'i 'phrin yig btsun pa chen po dpal dbyangs kyis bod rje 'bangs la brdzangs ②pa/ bdag rtog skyon gyi phung po bshig/legs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin pa/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig ded dpon gtso/ /ma lus mkhyen la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal po rnams dang dge slong dang / /blon po las kyi sna la gtogs/ /so so'i ded dpon dbang byed dang / /zhing pa tshong pa zho shas 'tsho/ /mi yi skye ba blangs pa yi/ /dal 'byor rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bud med rol mo mkhan rnams dang / /dbung mtha'i bod ni rje 'bangs la/ /'di dang phyi mar phan pa'i phyir/ /dge ba bcu dang bcu drug dang / /bsam pa bcu dang chos spyod bcu/ /pha rol phyin drug spyad pa yis/ /tshe rabs mang po bgrangs par yang / /legs pa'i gzhung gzugs bde 'gro dang / /mthar ni sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i phyir/ /zhal nas gsungs pa'i mdo sde 115—611

dang / /dge bshes pa rnams mnyes ①par mdzad/ /klu sgrub snying po blo gros dang / /ma la byams pas mdzad pa yi(mi/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / /bshes shing mdza' ba'i 'phrin ④yig dang / /rin chen phreng ba la sogs pa'i/ /nang nas phan pa'i gdams ngag dang / /mang zhing zab mo'i don rnams ni/ /rgyas par bshad na mi rtogs pas/ /de las bsgrub ⑦sla gzung bde rnams/ /nyung zad tsam zhig bdag gis bsdebs/ /dul ba'i dpal ni bskyed nas kyang / /bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin du nyon/ /dge bcu rmad du bya ba yi/ /mdo sde las ni 'di skad 'byung / /lus kyi spyod pa rab bsdams nas/ /srog gcod rku dang g.yem mi bya/ /phra ma brdzun (gedang tshig rtsub dang / /kyal dhipa smra bar mi bya'o—/ /'dod pa rnams la mi chags shing / /zhe sdang sems kyang med par bya/ /log par lta ba kun spangs na⑦/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin/ /zhes 'byung / mi dge ba bcu spyad pa'i rnam par smin pa cir 'gyur zhe na/ rin po che'i ⑧phreng ba las/ gsod pa yis ni tshe thung zhing / /dmyal ba'i gnas su yun ring 'gyur/ /rnam par 'tshe bas gnod pa mang / /tshe rabs kun du sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /rku ba yis ni longs spyod nyams/ /tshe rabs kun du yi dwags skye/ /byi po byed pas dgra dang bcas/ /chung ma snying ni ring bar 'gyur// brdzun du smra bas skur ⑨pa mang / /tshig ni nam du'ang mi btsun 'gyur/ /phra ma yis ni bshes dang 'bral/ /bdag la slu ba byed pa mang / /tshig rtsub kyis ni mi snyan thos/ /mang po'ang ngan pa smra bar 'gyur/ /'khyal pa yis ni don mi rnyed/ /bdag la'ang rkyal ⑫pa byed par 'gyur/ /brnab sems yid kyi re ba 'joms/ /gnod sems 'jigs pa sbyin par byed/ /log par lta bas lta 115—612

ngan nyid/ /chang gis ①'jig rten myos 'gyur te/ /nor shor don rnams yal ba dang / /bya ba ma yin thams cad byed/ /des na chang ni tshod zin bya/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /mi chos bcu drug ni/ dkon mchog gsum la gcig tu dad/ /dge sbyong 'dzin cing bram zer 'dzin/ / drang zhing drang ②ba'i rang bzhin can/ /byas gzo byas la phan 'dogs dang / /pha dang mar ne+e 'dzin pa dang / /rigs kyi rgan rims gus ⑦par byed/ /tshes grangs rgyud la mkhas pa dang / /dus tshigs rjogaso sbyong byed pa dang / /bre srang 'jal ⑤lugs g.yo sgyu med/ /phan tshun 'gran sems gnod mi byed/ /'di ched phyi ma bsnyoms rjonas spyod/ /dge bcu'i steng du 'di bsnan te/ /tshul bzhin bsrungs na lha mi yi/ /lus thob don yod chud mi za/ /de phyir thub pa chen po yis/ /'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta/ /chen po su la yod gyur pa/ /de ni tshe rabs stong dag tu/ /ngan 'gror thong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'byung / rtag tu bsam ⑦pa bcu ni/nges par 'chi bsam las kyi bsags pa bgrang / /dkon mchog gsum bsten ngo bo gnyis med mos⑧/ /byang chub sems brtan ⑨theg chen zhugs la byams/ /rtags ⑩bsam don chen dpal gyi phreng bas bsngags/ /zhes ⑪mdo sde dpal phreng las 'byung ste/ rtag tu ⑫bsam ⑫pa bcu po 'di dag dang ldan na yon tan ci 'thob ce na/ yang mdo dag las/ dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis 'di dgongs ⑫pas/ /dug gsum skye ba'i ljon pa rtsa nas bcad/ /nyon mongs bud shing skam po tshang tshing la/ /ye shes me stag rang rig gsal 'bar ba /blo las byung ⑫nas thal ba bzhin du bsregs/ /bdud bzhi'i dmag dpung g.yul bzlog bkan phub nas/ /bdud kyi gnas mukhang kun gzhi gtan nas 115—613

blangasarka/ /de dag phyin chad nga ni rgyal ba mngon phyung ste/ /lha mi kun gyi bde ston ①dpal gyi sdong po nga ②/ /rtag tu bsam par bya ba bsams pas na/ /de phyir sangs rgyas zhes ni mtshan gsol to/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /chos spyod rnam pa bcu ni/ mgon po byams pas dbus mtha' las/ /yi ge 'dri sdemachod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang 'dzin dang klog pa dang / /'chad dang kha don byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang dusgom pa'o/ /'di bcu chos kyi ⑤sgo mo ste/ /'dren pa rnams kyi gshegs shul yin/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga kun mkhyen pas/ /thams cad mkhyen par mtshan gsol to/ /de phyir rigs ldan skyes bus kyang / /gnyid dang snyom dulas le lo dang / /'du 'dzi chags phyir khyim la dga'/ /bye mo'i ⑦gtam dang bsrung sdebs dang / /rgyan po 'gyed dang 'dus la lta⑧/ /sdig pa'i grogs dang 'gogs pa dang / /chang dang mtshan mo 'gro ba dang / / long yod ⑫snyam pa'i 'du shes spang / /deng bya sang bya ma sems par bang bya brtod de ma 'bad na/ /'chi bdag bdud ni drung na ⑫bya ra byed/ /ces ⑪'byung ngo / /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ni/ sbyin pa dang ni tshul khrims dang / /bzod ⑫dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan dang / /shes rab thabs la sogs pa rnams—/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho sgol ba'i gru/ /zhes 'byung / pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag ma spyad spyon sgo gzhan nas thabs med dam zhe na/ mdo las/yun rings 'gron ⑫po'i rgyags su sbyin pa ste/ /lus sems rgyan dang chas su tshul khrims brjod/ /nyon mongs dgra tshogs 'joms par bzod pa dpa'/ /'phags lam bde bgrod bzhon par brtson 'grus bzang / /yang dag don chen rtogs par bsam gtan myur/ /ma rig mun pa bsal bar ⑫shes rab gsal/ /115—614

zhes pa dang / rin po che'i phreng ba las kyang / sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde/ /bzod pas mdangs ldan dge bas brjid①/ /bsam gtan gyis ni blo gros 'phel/ /snying brtse ②bas ni don kun 'grub/ /bdun po 'di dag ma lus par/ /cig car pha rol phyin spyad pas/ /sa thob ma gyur par du yang / /'khor ba'i bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /ngan song ming yang mi grag cing / /mi khom brgyad po gtan du spangs/ /de nas rim par sa thob nas/ /'jig rten mgon po nyid thob 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /da zhuni de ltar dge ba bcu dang mi chos bcu drug dang / rtag tu bsam pa bcu dang / chos spyod rnam pa bcu dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa nyams su blangs nas spyad dgos pa mdo tsam bstan nas da ni chos 'di dag (petshig tsam du bzlas pas mi phan par bstan te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i nang nas/sman pa'i ngag ma mnyan na sman dag gis/ /bcos dgos nad pa sos par ga la 'gyur—/ /sman dpyad bklags ⑤pa tsam gyis ni/ /nad pa la ni de phan nam/ /zhes 'byung ste/ rgyal po chen po la rjogadams ngag gsol pa peyang rgyal po ka ni sa ④ka la gsol ba'i 'phrin ⑨yig las/ gdams bgyi mang por mchis mod kyang / /thams cad gdams par sus rngo thogs⑩/ /mdo tsam du ni gdams bgyi na/ /de ltar snyan gtod nyid kyi ched47/ /bdag gis gsol ba 'di gson te/ /bsgrub ⑫dang gtang ba'i phyogs gnyis las/ /gang rigs de ni nyams su bzhes/ /gtang bar bkyi ba gtan ma mdzad/ /sa bdag tsher ma'i shing las sbrang rtsi ltar/ /dgra bo las kyang legs par smras pa gzung / /gser gyi ri la dug rgyun ji bzhin du/ /yid 'ong skye bo'i tshig ngan spang 'tshal te//115—615

mdo tsam gsol ba 'di dag nyams su bzhes/ /rgyal srid 'jig rten pha rol ①nasaske/ /bsnams te ma byon bsnams mi 'gyur/ /bsod nams rgyun las bsgrubs pa ste/ /de yang yud tsam cig ④tu bas/ /g.yung drung btsugs par ma dgongs shig /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten bgyi zhing ①/ /gus dang zhe sar bcas pa yis/ /dam pa'i chos ni gsan par mdzod/ /gsan pa'i chos rnams rnam dpyad de/ /dpyad rjopa la ni mkhas par mdzod/ /mya ngan gyis ni 6ma gdungs shigarjo /na gzhon nad med longs pa yi/ /dngos po da ltar byung ba yi/ /blo gos la ni mi nus med/ /longs spyod srid la ma yengs par/ /mkhas pa rnams las dus su gson/ /'on tang rim gyis mkhyen par 'gyur/ /nyung ngu'ang bstsags ⑦na nges par ni/ /ring por mi thogs mang por 'gyur④/ /rtag tu chu thigs re re'i rgyun/ /bar chad med par bab pa yis/ /gang zhig gang bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /snod de ji lta bu zhig mchis/ /ji ltar dpe gsal de lta bu/ /rgyal pos tshad mar mdzad nas ni/ /dam pa'i chos di gsan pa la//rtag par dgyes pa nyid du mdzad/ /zham rang ⑨blon po'i pu tshugs ni/ /yon tan nor gyi ()gnyer la gnyen/ /mkhas shing snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ / byas gzo ⑩phongs chos mi bgyid pa/ /bzang po khyod kyi slad du zhog /mi gang dka' ba spyod byed dang / /dor bar ⑫bya dka' 'dor ba dang / /bzod par dka' ba bzod byed dang / /bkur dka' ⑫nyams su len pa dang / /ring por blta zhing nges pa dang / /'phral blo myur zhing sdug pa dang / /khong ④sran che zhing dpa' ba dang / /bslu bar mi tshugs gsang thub dang / /chos kyis ⑫rgyal srid skyong dga' dang / /dam chos mdzad la mi 'khor ba/ /rin gyis 115—616

'jal yang mi pham gyis/ /thugs brtan mdzod la spyan sngar ①zhog /khyod kyis blun ⑤dang phongs chos can/ /gzhung ngan gdong gang byed pa dang / /brkam zhing byas pa mi gzo dang / /kha gcam gtum po mi bzang ba/ /yul na'ang gnas su ma stsal ④cig /gal te gzhung lugs bzang dgyes bun/ /gong nas gong du 'bar bar 'gyur/ /gal te ngan pa spyod mdzad na/ /'og nas 'og tu rtsang bar 'gyur/ /khyu mchog dang ni khyus 'gro bzhin/ /khyod ni gya gyu la zhugs na/ /gya gyu kho na'i rjes 'brangs ⑤te/ /skye dgu khyod kyi rjes rjo'abrangs pas—/ /rgyal khams ngan par 'ong ⑦'gyur ro/ /zla ba mar gyi ngo bzhin du/ /nyes pa'i tshogs rnams 'grib par mdzod/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du/ /rgyal khams legs par rgyas par mdzod/ /dam chos bskyang ba'i khrims rnams mdzod//dam chos 'jig pa'i skye bo dang / /bka' khrims 'dral ba'i ngan pa rnams/ /lo thog rtsi thog ⑧rgyas pa la/ /thog dang ser ba bzhin du phob/ /'on dang ngan mig 'gag par 'gyur/ /le lo nyam bu shed ma mdzad/ /'chi bdag su dang mi bshes pa/ /glo ⑨bur dag tu 'bab 'gyur bas/ /sang dag bya zhes ma gzhes par/ /dam pa'i chos la smyur ( 7te mdzod/ /'chi bdag gis ni drangs pa na/ /dge dang sdig pa ma gtogs ⑩pa/ /'gro ba thams cad phyir log nas/ /'ga' yang khyod rjes ⑫mi 'brang bas/ /mkhyen par mdzod la legs par spyod/ /slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis/ /rgyal po bde spyod bzang po la/ /brdzangs pa'i 'phrin yig dag ⑫las kyang / /longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas/ /dge slong bram ze bkren dang bshes rnams la/ /sbyin pa tshul bzhin stsal ()bgyi pha rol tu/ /sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma 115—617

mchis so/ /khyod kyis dge slong bram ze lha dang ni/ /mgron ①dang yab yum sras dang btsun mo dang / /'khor gyi slad du sdig pa mi bgyi ste/ /dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis/ /sdig pa'i las rnams spyad pa 'ga' yang ni—/ /mtshon bzhin 'phral du lus la mi gcod ②kyang / /gang du phyin pa'i sa phyogs de na sdod/ /thar pa dag la rag lus 'di la ni/ /gzhan gyis grogs ①bgyir cir yang ma mchis kyis/ /de ༷ltar nyid kyi rtsal gyis 'bad par mdzod/ /tshe ni ⑤gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yirjo/ /chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag ste/ /dbugs rngub dbugs phyung gnyid kyis log pa las/ /sad khom gang lags de dag ngo mtshar che/ /lus mtha' thal ⑦ba mthar skam mthar 'drul zhing / /tha mar mi gtsang snying po ma mchis pa/ /rnam par 'jig ⑧dengs myags par 'gyur ba de/ /so sor gyes chos can du rig par mdzod/ /rgya mtsho gcig gnas gnya' shing bu ga dang / /rus sbal phrad pa bas kyang dud 'go las/ /mi nyid ches 'thob dka' bas mi dbang gis/ /dam chos spyad pas de 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /gang zhig gser snod rin chen spras pa yi⑨/ /snod du ngan skyugs phyag dar bgyid ⑩pa bas/ /gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa dag /bgyid ⑪pa de ni ches rab blun pa lags/ /sras dang btsun mo yab yum 'khor rnams kyang / /nges pa ma mchis las kyi rlung dmar gyis/ /bdas ⑫pa tsam ste bdag tu bzung ba bas/ /pha ni bu nyid ma ni chung ma nyid/ /skye bo dgrar gyur pa yang bshes nyid dang / /bzlog pa nyid du mchis pas de slad du/ /'khor ba dag na nges pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /thugs brtan ma mdzad 'di kun bslu ba'i bdud—/ /bsnyengs dang bral ba mang du gsol ci 'tshal/ /phan pa'i gdams 115—618

ngag dam pa 'di lags te/ /khyod kyis ①thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis//sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ /rin po che'i phreng ba las kyang /dam pa'i chos dang chos smra la/ /nyid kyis bkur ste mchog dang ni/ /gus par mdzod de gdan las bzhengs/ /me tog gtor nas chos mnyan cing / /chos kyi sbyin pa dag kyang mdzod/ /'jig rten gtam la dga' ma mdzad/ /'jig rten 'das la dgyes par mdzod/ /'khor rnams zil gyis mnan pa'i phyir—/ /lhun stug ②brtan dang nges par mdzad/ /bka' lung mi 'gyur nges par gsungs/ /snyan khung mi yangs stug ①pa dang / /bud med chags phyir 'phyar rjogayeng dang / /srab chos bus pa ltar ma mdzad/ /cung zad tsam gyis khro ma mdzad⑤/ /ji ltar rgyal srid bskyang ba dang / /'bangs kun bde la 'god rjopa dang / /bsdo ba'i dgra rnams gdul ba dang / /rgyal khams chos kyis bskyang bgyi ba/ /zhib tu dgongs nas grub par mdzod/ /'grub bam mi 'grub ma nges par/ /dgongs ma thag tu ma gsungs shig /yun ji srid cig ⑦chos sgrub cing / /ser sna 'jur 'gegs ma mdzad par/ /bdog pa thams cad gtugs te mdzod/ /khyod ni bdog pa kun bor nas/ /gcig pu ga shed gshegs 'tshal ba/ /chos kyi slad du spyad pa kun/ /khyod kyi mdun du 'ong ba nyid—/ /'bangs la re ba ma 'jog par/ /zhal bzhugs tshe na myur bar mdzod—/ /gtsug lag khang dag brtsig pa dang / /mchod rten brtsig dang na bza' gsol/ /zhig ral bcos dang mchod pa gzugs/ /lha khang la sogs gzhan bgyi ba/ /snga lugs bzhin du rgyas par mdzod/ /dam chos tshul bzhin spyod pa yi⑧/ /dge slong dge bsnyen la sogs pa/ /gzhan gyis gtse ⑨ba med 115—619

pa yi/ /dpung ①gnyen skyabs dang kha 'dzin mdzod/ /'di kun yun du bde ba yi—/ /mya ⑧ngan 'da' ba'i dge tshogs lags/ /bgres khar dgon par gshegs nas ni/ /mi ru 'khrungs pa'i don yod mdzod/ /blon po rnams dang las kyi sna/ /mnga' ris dbus mtha'i 'bangs rnams ni/ /dran pa can gyis bsgrubs ①byas pa/ /rnam pa mang po yod na yang / /sngon gyi khyodrang srong mkhas rnams kyis/ /gdams ngag mdo tsam 'dir bstan gyis/ /bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin du slobasadhi/ /gting nas khros shing 'khrugs gyur kyang / /mdog mdangs ldan zhing 'dzum par smra/ /'khon gcugs che zhing sha chags kyang / /phran tshigs ④khro gtum gnod mi byed/ /dgra bo 'thab zlar gyur kyang 'phral tshul ci dgar 'drid/ /pha rol tshig ngan rdzogs kyang ngan du lan mi smra/ /bdag gi rgyab tu lta zhing lam sel thub thabs srang srub ⑦tshol/ /gnyen sbyar ran par tshol zhing so nam zhib mor sgrub/ /phaṭa ral rtsing dang gtum chos nga rgyal chung / /rnam smin med pa'i so nam yal bar bor nas ni/ /gzhan gyi nor la rtsis ⑧gdab chom rkun gzan btsal yang / /pha ma'i nor dang drin chen dga' mdza' ⑨nor/ /dkon mchog dkor dang lha klus dbang byas nor/ /nam du'ang mi spyod ⑩phongs chos khrel dor spang / /bya'o ⑪cog la yid ring sran dang ldan/ /rna khung ran par che zhing phra ma'i kha na phyi/ /drin can pha khu ma dang gnyen bshes la/ /gsong des ⑫bkur ste rim gro bran ltar byed/ /byed dgu ran la tshod ⑫zin brtan par gzhung la mkhas/ /dogs ④pa'i don la ma lus ⑫le lo med/ /gya tshom mi smra shes kyang ma bcol rang zhugs yong mi byed/ /zin khar mi 'dor 'og nas sngar mi smra/ /lhag par khe mthong btsal glags yod 115—620

kyang mi rigs 'dod chen yong mi byed/ /dbang dang tshan gyis thub kyang 'phyas gnon ①gzan mi tshol/ /nye zhes nye mgon mi byed ring zhes snyom ②las yong mi spyod①—/ /dbang sar phyin cing kun gyis bkur yang mtha' dag sems bsrung ④bya—/ /legs nyes bsam zhing srod dang tho rangs dge ba spyad/ /nga rgyal khengs sems mur cor ⑤smra dang rgyags chos med/ /tshan kar mi 'dor gzhan gyis brtsi sar yun rings sdodarjo/ /phyi tshul mi 'chos nang gi g.yo sgyu med/ /gsong des mnyen dang gsal stug ⑦'jam la ring / /ngan la khyad du mi gsod zhe sa phangs med mnyam⑧/ /phrag dog 'gran sems nor ngan gzhan la 'phya ⑨mi byed—/ /bdag la rang bstod ⑩mi byed gzhan la mtshang mi 'bru/ /dpa' la sran che byed dgu mdzangs las ⑪slob/ /chang dang bud med dad dang khe brkam ⑫gcam bu'i las/ /nam du'ang mi byed chung ma ngan pa'i khar mi gtang ⑫/ /yong ni 'phya la mi mkhas shing / /byed du bcug na nor par rtsom/ /zhib tu dpyad de las rnams brtsam/ /mang po rnams ni kha bsdus la/ /ngan pa'ang khyad du mi gsod par/ /gros su byas dang 'gyod pa med/ /mdzangs ⑫pa rnams ni las su brko⑫/ /yul du gsar khung byung ba yin/ /dpa' bo rnams kyis 'thab sna drang / /drang rgan rnams kyis mdun sa spyogazung / /drang po rnams kyis zhal lce ⑩gcad/ /g.yog rnams 'khor gyis mel tse bsgrim/ /nyes na chad pa ran par gcad/ /ches na bus kyang mi bzod 'gyur/ /thog tu bab pa'i las rnams bya/ /'on tang kun gyis bsngags par 'gyur/ /legs pa'i ngo 'phral sbyin pa yang / /thog tu bab dang phrag dog med/ /nyes pa'i skyon yang mi 'phel lo/ /nyes pa ma legs byung na yang / /mi ni gting nas yi 115—621

mi ①gcad/ /phyi nas chu gang dran par 'gyur/ /phyugs ②ni dus gcig sdesun mi dbyung / /'on dang lcags skyed che bar 'gyur/ /bran ni 'os shing rjorigs bkol dang / /yun du snying ni nye bar 'gyur/ /bu tsha mkhas par bslab pa ni//gtan gyi srid du phyi phyir che/ /skyes pa mdzangs ⑤par gyur pa ni/ /nor du mkhas dang gtam snyan sgrub/ /bud med mdzangs rjopar gyur pa ni/ /khyo la sri zhu rim gro ⑦dang / /rigs las skebasgrubs pa'i bdog don dang / /mi smra rna khung ⑨che ba dang / /dgos pa'i mgron spyol yangs pa dang / /skyes bu gzhan du mi tshol dang / /bya ba rnams la ma rmongs na⑪/ /lkugs pa bzhin du 'dug kyang bla/ /zhes pa la sogs pa sngon gyi drang srong gis gdams ngag mdo tsam bstan pa yang tshe 'di'i ched dang / tshe phyi ma'i ched kyang gong du bstan pa bzhin byas la ngang drang na yun gyi srid chen po yang zhar la yod de/ rgyal pos drang ⑫por byas dang rgyal srid mi nyams che/ /blon pos drang por byas dang che btsan yun du rtag4ste /de yi gzhi las thar pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung /gzhan dag las kyang / rtsod pa med par chos smra ba ni mkhas pa'i rab ji ltar ngan par glengs par ④gyur yang ma 'khrugs pa ni bdud kyi yul las 'das⑫/rgyal po'i phrin las bya ba ni/ /gtso cher 'bangs kyi spu 'dam mo⑩/ /blon po'i las su bya ba ni/ /drang snyoms ⑩mi ni thabs kyis bcos/ /phyugs ⑫ni mig gis btsa' ⑪ba dang / /nor ni dgos pa'i don dang ⑫sbyar/ /mo ni sman dang yul mi 'chor/ /sprid pa'i mtha' ni ring por 'gyur/ /dal gyis 'bab pa'i chu bo ni/ /yun du gzhung ni btsan par 'gyur/ /sprin ni hal hol can dag gis/ /zhing pa dga' ba'i char mi phebs/ /mi ni khra khro can dag gis/ /115—622

dgos pa'i don ni shor bar 'gyur/ /dal bus song bas gang du'ang phyin/ /'jam par smras pas su yang go/ /bsrings nas bsgrubs pa 6)ci yang 'grub/ /blon po rnams kyis bya ba'i mdo/ /khrims su bcas pa brtan por bzung ②/ /bka' lung btsan zhing snyan par bsgrub/ /sgo phyed ①yal bar bor nas ni/ /gtso cher spyi ched srog dang bsdo0/ /mna' ni gzan du mi bor zhing / /'thams ⑤pa thams cad btsan dupar bya/ /dam chos bsrung la brtson pa dang / /gtso cher yun gyi srid du ni/ /dam chos spyod pa mchog yin no/ /zhes 'byung /blon po gcig ⑦pur ma zad kyi/ /mi yi ⑧ris su skyes pa yi/ /glen lkugs 'on pa ⑨ma gtogs par⑩/ /thams cad kun gyis de bzhin spyad/ /'on tang 'di dang phyi mar yang / /bde ba phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /de dag gdams ngag dam pa yin/ /da ni rab tu byung ba'i dge slong dang / dge tshul dang /dge slong ma la gdams ⑪ngag bya ba/ dang por rab tu ji ltar byung / /sems thag bcad nas skra bregs ⑫shing / /ston pa'i na bza' ngur smrig bgos/ /pha dang ma dang gnyen bshes la'ang / /chags pa med pa'i tshul byas pas/ /kun gyi mchod gnas yin pas na/ /'jig rten pa yis ma 'phyas pas⑫/ /bslab pa 'di ltar rim bzhin bya/ /ston pa rkang gnyis gtso bo dang / /'dod chags bral ba chos kyi gtso/ /'dus pa'i gtso ste dge 'dun la/ /gus par skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /slob dpon mkhan po khrims dbang dang / /phrin spyo las mdzad pa'i dge 'dun la/ /gus par zhus te dge bsnyen dang / dge tshul dge slong bar slob dang / /dge slong ma yi sdom pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du mnos nas kyang / nyes 115—623

byas med par bsrung bar bya'o/ /maṇ+ḍal chag chag phyag dar dang / /zhu gnas bca' ①dang lhung bzed bkru/ /bla ma dge 'dun bgres pa yi/ /dgos pa'i yan lag thams cad bya/ /srod dang tho rangs thun gnyis la/ /mi nyal kha thon ④dge ba bya/ /'dri ④klog nyan 'dzin bsam pa dang / /sgom dang bden pa bzhi la bsam/ /de nas rim gyis brtson ldan par/ /bla ma mgu bar byas nas ni/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i lugs/ /'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa rjornams/ /theg pa kun las 'jam ⑤par bslab/ /kun gyi phul du phyin bya'i phyir/ /rig rjopa'i gnas lnga dag dang ni—/ /rig ⑦pa'i gnas ni bco brgyad la/ /thogs pa med par bslab par bya'o—/ /bkur ste'i gnas su gyur nas kyang / /nga rgyal khengs sems phrag dog spang / /rang mthong sger bu'i las mi bya/ /kha nas smra ba'i tshig rnams dang / /don du skemathun par chos bzhin spyod/ /nga mkhas gzhan ni mi shes zhesarka/ /kun la 'phya ba'i las mi brtsam/ /slob par 'dod pa'i gang zag rnamasaske/ /ci la dga' bar bshad par bya'o/ /sngon gyi slob dpon drin can ⑨la| /bkur ste rim gro bran bzhin bya'o/ /gtsor na snying rje brtser ldan zhing / /tshad med bzhi yi go cha bgos/ /dus ngan tha mar skyes pa yi⑩/ /da lta'i dge slong rang mthong can/ /cung zad yon tan rnyed pa dang / /khengs shing rang mthong gyong bu byed/ /mar gyis ko khengs bskus mnyes na/ /mi dul ba ni gcig ⑪kyang med/ /de bzhin chos kyi mar gyis kyang / /mi shes ⑫ko khengs 'dra ba 'dul/ /grod ⑫skogs mar dang lhan cig kyang / /mnye btul ma byas gyong bur 'dug /de bzhin chos kyi mar gyis bskus/ /shes bzhin dran pas 115—624

ma mnyes na/ /chos mar bskus kyang gong bur 'dug /mnyes pa bzhin du dul bar gyis/ /bslab pas mi ngoms mnyan ①par byos/ /mkhas pa rnams la dri ba byos/ /che 'chos sa ni shor dogs par/ /thos pa mang po ma yin yang //'ga' tsam goms la'ang mnyen par byos/ /grogs po rnams la 'gran sems bor—/ /rgan pa rnams ni rim par khur/ /gzhan la 'phya ba mi dgos kyis/ /rang nyid de ltar ma byed cig /chos kyi spun dang bral nas ni/ /mi chos gnyen ②la mnyes ma byed/ /sems can ngan mig ma skyed (micig /khyod kyis bya ba'i las min pa/ /chung ma blang dang bu tshang klag /'khrug pa bya dang khe tshong bya / /bre zol bya dang srang zol bya/ /sgyu ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /'phyar dang rta gad rtsab hral dang / /chos gos med par grong rgyu dang / /gzhan gyi chung ma bsten pa dang / /srog chags gsad dhidang brdzun ⑤smra dang / /chom rkun bya ba'i rjopho nya dang / /phra ma mi dbyes ⑦la sogs pa/ /'chi bar bsams nas mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan shākyas bka' stsal pa/ /nga yi bstan pa'i dam chos ni/ /mu stegs can gyis mi bshigs ④te/ /seng ge'i khog pa ji bzhin du/ /nga yi slob mas gzhig ⑨par 'gyur/ /nga yi bstan pa dam chos ni/ /nan tan snying por byed pa yi/ /gang zag dge slong lag na gnas/ /bka' bzhin byed pa'i dge slong ni/ /'jigs pa med par ngas bshad de/ /dam pa'i chos 'jig ngan sna 'dren/ /ngan song gsum gyi 'jigs chen las/ /nams kyang thar par ⑩ngas ma gsungs/ /bdud kyi slu bas zin pa la/ /thar pa'i glags ni med 'gyur gyis/ /dang po'i dam bcas ji bzhin du/ /chos kyi klung du 'gro bar byos/ /bu smad 'dod pa'i sred pa dang / /nams kyang gnas par ma 115—625

byed cig /gal te bu ①smad 'dod ces te/ /khyim pa'i dngos po byed ce na/ /dang po khyod ni su yis bslus/ /dkon mchog gsum bslu ci yi phyir/ /slob dpon mkhan po ci la dgos/ /skye bo'i mchod gnas ci phyir bya/ /'dreg pa'i bye brag gsum yod de/ /sog ②po rnams ni bcos ④kyis 'dreg /dud 'gro phal ni las kyis 'dreg /dge 'dun rnams ni yon tan gyis/ /'dreg pa yin na gang phyir bregs④/ /ston pa'i na bza' chud re zos/ /na bza' chos gos 'o re brgyal⑤/ /dang po 'dod chags bral zhe na/ /ci'i phyir da ni bu smad la/ /mi shes skye bo 'ju ba bzhin/ /khong nas gdung sems yod re che/ /'dod pa rnams la de bzhin 'dun/ /dang po'i dam bca' gang tsug song / /de yis mya ngan 'da' 'gyur ram/ /sdug bsngal grong khyer 'jig 'gyur ram/ /ji ltar bshang gci gsher ba la/ /ngan skyugs khyi phag chags pa ltar/ /de bzhin bshang 0gci gsher ba la/ /'dod ldan ban de phag ltar chags/ /bdag lus bud med mi gtsang bar/ /da dung bar du ma rtogs par/ /mi rtag sgyu ma'i bu smad la/ /yang dang yang du chags pa di/ /mi gtsang don du khyi ⑦rnams bzhin/ /e ma'o gzu lums e ma'o blun/ /e ma'o skye bos khrel du rung / /slob dpon mkhan po khrims dpang rnams/ /khyud skor los kyang mthong mi byed/ /chung ma'i gnyen la dge bshes bzhin/ /skyo ba tsam du 'khor bar byed/ /des byu 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /myur du rgal bar 'gyur zhe 'am//ga sha khu ljo ma byas tsam/ /glegs ⑧bam thag pas khu ljo yi/ /dkri ba'i thag pa ma byas tsam/ /sku gzugs dar ma lha cha rnams/ /byi brun thigs ⑨pa du bas non—/ /g.yang sa gtsang mar bskyal na rung / /gal te legs don ma yin 115—626

yang / /'bum la khyim par gyur yang ni/ /bde gshegs bslab pa dran byas nas//gnas khang so sor 'dug byas la/ /nyes pa bshags shing dge ba spyad/ /bslab la ①'grus par brtson par bskyed/ /btsun pa rnams la bkur ste bya/ /rang skyon sba phyir mtshang mi 'bru②/ /'on tang sdig zhad 'bri la phan/ /sems la lta snezhing don la sgom/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /dge slong ma yang ci yi phyir/ /dang po khas blangs dam bcas nas/ /sngar tshul bstan pa'i dge slong bzhin/ /legs par rab tu byung byas nas/ /rang ④bslus sdig pa'i khur bu drags/ /ston pa'i bka' ni khyad du gsad⑤/ /khyim pa skye bo'i 'og rjon nyal/ /dang po skra ni 'drag ④pa'i tshe/ /khyim bdag snying du mi sdug gamaske/ /pha ma sdang ngam mgo rgyan med/ /khyim thab ⑧mchis sam nyes skyon byung / /ci yi phyir na tshul khrims dral/ /snying nas dam chos spyod ce na/ /las 'phro ngan cing blo zhan pas/ /mkhas pa'i phul du mi 'grub kyis/ /sems thag chod la btsun par sgrubs⑨/ /klog dang don ⑩la brtson 'grus bskyed/ /skyes pa rnams la mi lta zhing / /rang gi gnas khang dag tu 'dug /thos pa bsags ⑪na nam zha yi/ /chos kyi gter ni gzung bar 'gyur/ /bya byed dag la yong ma 'jug /de dag tsam ni theg tshad yin/ /da 'di man chad ⑫ni/spyir dge ba spyad cing sdig pa spang bar gdams ngag byed/ de yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i nang nas mdo tsam bstan pa/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par ⑫shin tu dka'/ /skyes bus ⑫don grub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs ⑫na/ /phyis 'di yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur—/ /bdag gi 'byor pa drug gzhan gyi 'byor pa bdun te bcu gsum mo/ /115—627

de la bdag gi 'byor pa drug la/ yul gyi dbus su skyes pa dang / dbang po tshang ba dang / gnas la dad par gyur pa dang / smon lam dag pas sdig pa'i gogs ①po dang ma phrad pa dang / las kyi mtha' ma log pa dang / lta ba ngan pas mi 'phrogs pa'o/ /gzhan gyi 'byor pa la/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten ②byung ba dang / dam pa'i chos bstan pa dang / bstan pa gnas pa dang / chos kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i grogs po zang zing la mi lta ba dang phrad pa dang / theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes ④gnyen gzhan gyi don du snying rje chen po ④dang phrad pa dang / chos byed pa la byams pa'i grong khyer du ⑤nye bar skyes pa dang /rgyal po chos bzhin byed pa'i yul du skyes pa'o/ /ji ltar mtshan mo'i mun nag sprin rum nas/ /glog 'gyus skad cig bar snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthus kyang brgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' du'abyung / /de ltar dge ba nyam ⑦chung nyid la rtag /sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min pa/ /dge gzhan gang gis zil kyis gnon par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod sems yod kyang / /sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug /bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ /rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ /yid brtan mi rung 'chi bdag 'di/ /byas dang ma byas mi sdod ⑧pas/ /na dang mi na kun kyis kyang / /glo bur tshe la yid mi brtan/ /thams cad bor te chas dgos ⑨par/ /bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' don gyi phyir/ /sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas/ /mi mdza' rnams kyang med 'gyur zhing / /mdza' ba rnams kyang med par 'gyur/ /bdag kyang med par 'gyur ba nyid/ /de bzhin 115—628

thams cad med par 'gyur/ /rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin/ /re zhig gson tshe 'di nyid la/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' du ma 'das/ /de dag don du byas pa'i sdig /mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas/ /de ltar bdag ni glo bur zhes—/ /bdag gis rtogs par ma gyur pas/ /gti mug ①chags dang zhe sdang gis| /sdig pa rnam pa du ma byas/ /nyin mtshan sdod ②pa yong med par/ /tshe 'di rtag tu 'god 'gyur zhing / /snon pa gud nas 'ong med na/ /bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur/ /bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du/ /gnyen bshes mang pos mtha' bskor ①yang / /srog gcod pa yi tshor ba dag /bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur/ /gshin rjorje'i pho nyas zin pa la/ /gnyen pas ci phan bshes ci phan/ /de tshe bsod nams gcig skyabs na/ /de yang bdag gis ma bsten to/ /'jigs ⑤pa 'di 'dra ma 'tshal nas/ /mi rtag tshe 'di'i ched dag tu/ /sdig pa mang po nye bar bsgrubasarjo/ /de ltar 'jigs chen yod pas na/ /dge bshes bsten la bsod nams byos/ /gnyen dang bshes rnams rnam spangs nas/ /gcig pu ga shed 'gro dgos na/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' kun cir rung / /mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung / /de las ji ltar nges thar zhes/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bdag gis ni/ /de nyid rtag tu bsam par rigs/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /mi ru skyes pa'i don yod bya/ /long bas phyag dar phung po las/ /ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar—/ /de bzhin ji zhig ltar stes nas/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la skyes//blo 'dir rab tu shugs ⑦dbyung ngo / /ding nas brtson pa ma byas na/ /'og nas 'og tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sems can rnams ⑧la phan mdzad pa'i/ /115—629

sangs rgyas grangs med 'das gyur kyang / /bdag ni rang gis nyes pa de'i/ /gso ba'i spyod yul ma gyur to/ /da dung de bzhin bdag byed na/ /ngan 'gro ngan dang 'chi ba dang / /sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byung ba dang / /dad dang mi lus thob pa dang / /dge goms rung ba de lta bur/ /dkon pa nam zhig thob par 'gyur/ /nad med nyi ma 'di lta buraske/ /zas bcas 'tshe ba med kyang ni/ /tshe ni skad cig slu ①ba ste/ /lus ni thang cig brnyan ②po bzhin/ /bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni/ /mi lus phyis ni thob mi 'gyur/ /mi lus thob par ma gyur na/ /sdig pa 'ba' zhig dge ba med/ /gang tshe dge spyad skal ldan yang / /dge ba bdag gis ma byas na—/ /ngan song sdug bsngal kun rmongs pa/ /de tshe bdag gis ci byar yod/ /dge ba dag kyang ma byas la/ /sdig pa dag ni cher bsags na/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /don med dgra yis rma srol btod ①pa yang / /lus la rgyan dang 'dra bar srel byed na/ /don chen sgrub phyir yang dag brtson gyur larjo/ /bdag la sdug bsngal ci'i ⑤phyir gnod byed yin/ /nya pa zhing pa gdol ba la sogs pa/ /rang gi 'tsho ba tsam zhig sems pa duyang / /grang ⑦dang tsha la sogs pa gnod bzod na/ /yun ⑧gyi bde phyir bdag lta ci zhig smos/ /de phyir sdig ni sems las byung bas na/ /bslab pa bsrung bar sti'adod pa yis/ /rab tu bsgrims ⑩te sems gdul te/ /sems 'di gdul ba ma byas na/ /bslab pa bsrung bar yong mi ⑪nus/ /sems kyi glang po yan btang bas/ /mnar med gnod pa byed pa ltar/ /glang chen ma dul myos pa yis/ /'di na de 'dra'i gnod mi byed/ /kun nas dran 115—630

pa'i thag pa yis/ /sems kyi glang po dam btags na/ /'jigs pa thams cad med par 'gyur/ /dge ba thams cad lag tu 'ong / /sems 'di kho na thul ba yis/ /gnod byed thams cad 'dul bar 'gyur①/ /sems can mi srun ②nam mkha' bzhin/ /de dag gzhom gyis ga la lang / /khro ba'i sems na ( kegacig bcom narjo/ /dgra de thams cad choms dang 'dra/ /sa stengs ⑤'di kun kos g.yog tu/ /de snyed ko ba ga la yod/ /rkang mthil gang gi duko bas ni / /sa stengs ⑦thams cad g.yogs dang 'dra/ /de phyir phyi rol dngos po yang / /bdag gis phyir bzlog mi lang gis/ /bdag gi (shesems 'di phyir bzlog bya'i/ /gzhan rnams bzlog go ci zhig dgos/ /gang gis chos kyi don po mchog /sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na/ /bde 'dod sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang / /de dag don med gyi na 'khyam/ /de ltar bdag gi sems 'di ni—/ /legs gzung ⑨legs par rtogs par bya/ /sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa/ /brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya/ /ma grangs grol ba'i khrod gnas na⑩/ /bsgrims te rma yi bag byed bzhin/ /skye bo ngan khrod gnas pas kyang / /sems kyi rma ni rtag tu bsrung /me/ /sems rma rtag tu bsrung ba yang / /bla ma dang ni 'grogs pa las/ /mkhas pas rjes su bstan ⑫pa dang / /'jigs pas skal ldan gus byed la/ /dran pa shin tu skye bar 'gyur—/ /de phyir dge bshes mkhas pa bsten/ /don med g.yeng bar lta ba ni / /ban des nam yang mi bya ste/ /skye bo mdzangs pa'ang myade bzhin spyod/ /gang zhig mig lam 'ongs ⑫na yang / /bltas nas legs par mgu bar bya/ /dgos na thag ring dag tu'ang lta/ /gang zhig bsams nas byar brtsams ⑫pa /115—631

de las gzhan du mi bsam ste/ /der gtad pa yi bsam pa yis/ /de nyid kho na bsgrub ①par bya/ /de ltar ②na ni kun 'grub 'gyur/ /gzhan du gnyis kar mi 'grub po/ /khyi ni cung peng snyeg pa dang / /lha khang bar gyi khyi bzhin du//dran drod thams cad mi bya'o/ /ring zhig lon nas dal ③ba'i mchog /rnyed pa yang dang yang bsams nas/ /dge slong yin na 'khor g.yog dang / /drung du 'ongs pa'i lha mi rnams/ /thams cad dge la gzud par ④bya/ /khyim pa yin na'ang bu dag dang / /chung ma pha ma gnyen 'dun rnams/ /gros btab thams cad dge la gzung / /'on tang byang chub spyod pa rdzogs/ /bran g.yog bkol du mi btub ⑤pa/ /zas la sogs pa mi sbyin ltar/ /dge ba mi byed lus 'di la/ /bsnyod kyang de'u re rjogazhan 'gro la/ /sdig lus bsnyod cing gos bskon ⑦yang / /phan med sdig byed ji ste gso/ /khyod ma 'grangs spripas phung 'og bcug⑨ /khyod 'grangs ⑩pas na phung mgo btsugs/ /dkon mchog pha ma dga' mdza' dang / /drin yod drin med rnams kyi nor/ /sgyus brkus ⑪mthus phrogs thabs kyis bslus/ /ma 'grangs ma g.yogs ⑫sdig lus khyod—/ /mjug tu 'bu sbrang nyod par sod/ /khyod ma sos pas dmyal bar btang / /bsad pa'i sdig pa khyod las byung / /khyod ma mgu bas 'phrog zlom byas—/ /yi dwags gnas su khyod kyis btang / /khyod ma sos pas long chung ste/ /dge bshes ma bsten chos ma nyan/ /des na dud 'gro blun por gyur⑫/ /gtan du 'khyams pa khyod kyis nyes/ /khrod ni dge ba spyod gyur na/ /rin chen phung po phangs pa'i gtso/ /khyod la brten ⑫nas sangs rgyas chos/ /'bras bu bla med byang chub dang / /bar du'ang bde 'go skyid pa ni⑫/ /long 115—632

btags don yod byed pas na/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'i rten tsam du/ /lus la gru yi blo zhog ste/ /'di la gla rngan byin nas ni/ /da ni rang gi don byed chug /zongs pa'i sems khyod ci zhig zer/ /gzugs su 'dzin pa khyod rang yin/ /lus su lta ba khyod rang yin/ /don med shes pa gzhan nas 'ongs/ /'byung bas bsgrubs pa'i khu khrag la/ /khyod kyis ngar 'dzin byas nas ni/ /bu dang bu mor khyod kyis bzung / /gzhan gyis 'byung ba'i khu khrag la/ /gzhan zhes dgra ru lta bar byed/ /sdig pas bsgrubs pa'i zang zing la/ /gzhan gyis khyer snyam phrag dog langs①/ /don med byes pa'i spyod pa 'dra/ /khyed ④kyis shes na de min pa'i/ /bzang po'i dpal ta re yod na/ /de las ma shes ci byar yod—/ /nga yi ①nyes pa ci yang med/ /nyes pa thams cad khyod las byung / /khyod kyis rjortsa ya kun bcom na/ /gang du 'gro ba kho bos lta/ /khyod kyis ⑤ngar 'dzin ma byas na/ /nga ni 'byung ba'i bag la zha/ /nga ma gso bar khyed rjobader sgrubs/ /skyon can khyod kyi nyes pa kun/ /dran drod ma smra so sor 'dug/khyod la gsol bag dze+eci ma lus/ /gzhan yang tshigs su bcad pa la/ /deng bya sang bya le lo phyi shol gyis/ /sngon 'das dus nas da srid 'gyangs pas chog /'chi bdag dgra dang bang bya brtod ⑧nas ni/ /bka' bsdos myur te ⑨bya ba'i mi rigs sam/ /skra dkar skyes shing gnyer ma'i tshogs bgrangs ⑩kyang / /byis pa shed ma bye dang 'dra ba ni⑪/ /don la mkhas pas brtags na snying re rje/ /gzhan yang / bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs/ /legs spyad gang yin thams cad kyang / /khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed/ /zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa lta bu'i 115—633

dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod la ①nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul bzhin bsgom ④par bya/ /zhe sdang zug rngu'i sems 'chang na/ /yid ni bde ba'i nyams mi myong / /sgyu mar bsams nas bzod pa bsgoms①/ /gal te bcos su yod na ni/ /de la mi dga' byar yang med/ /'on te bcos ④su med na yang / /de la mi dga' byas ci phan/ /la la bdag gi khrag mthong na/ /phyir zhing khong dgrar 'gyur ba'ang yod/ /la la gzhan kyi rjokhrag mthong na/ /'bog cing brgyal bar 'gyur ba'ang yod/ /de ni sems kyi ngang brtan dang / /sdar ma'i tshul las gyur pa yin/ /de bzhin dge ba bsgrub ༷pa yang sems thag gcad ⑦dam mi gcad zan/ /khyim dang ⑧'bral bar mi ⑨nus dang / /so nam yal bar dogs pa dang / /dam chos bsgrub ⑩par bsam pa dang / /yun gyi bde ba bsgrub ⑪pa ni/ /gnyis ka yong ye ⑫'grub mi 'gyur/ /sbyin pa gtang ⑫bar bya ba dang / /zad par dogs pa gnyis mi 'phrugs/ /dpa' bo bya bar bsam ④pa dang / /shi bar dogs pa gnyis mi 'phrugs⑫/ /mang po dga' bar bya ba dang / /khro gtum bya ba gnyis mi 'phrugs/ /bslab ⑩la 'grus par bya ba dang / /zang zing btsal ba gnyis mi 'phrugs/ /btsun pa'i phul du byung ⑩ba dang / /yul la chags pa gnyis mi 'phrugs/ /kun gyis bkur bar 'dod pa dang / /spyod lam ngan pa gnyis mi 'phrugs/ /rgyal po mnyes par bya ba dang / /khyim na nyal ba gnyis mi 'phrugs/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub ⑫par bya ba dang / /sdig pa spyad pa gnyis mi 'phrugs/ /de bzhin gang zhig sgrub na yang ⑪/ /⑩sems thag gcod ⑥par byed par bya/ /'on tang dgos pa thams cad 'grub/ /'jig rten mgon pos de skad gsungs/ /115—634

mdo sde rnams las bslab pa snang / /rtag tu mdo sde blta bar bya'o/ /de dag gang zhig sgrub na bde①/ /rlung med g.yo ba'ang med pa bzhin/ /bsod nams brtson 'grus med mi 'gyur/ /sgyid lug snyom pa'i stobs bcom ste/ /nyin mtshan phyad par bsgrub ②par bya'o/ /des na 'bras bu med mi srid/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho rgal ④ba dang / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dgos pa ma lus bos pa bzhin/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /rgyal bas kyang ni mi mgu na/ /bdag 'dra ngan pas ci zhig smos/ /de bas 'jig rten bsam pa btang ④/ /sems can rnyed pa med la smod/ /rnyed pa can la mi snyan brjod/ /rang bzhin 'grogs dka' de dag gis/ /dga' ba ji ltar skye bar 'gyur/ /des na dben par gnas par bya'o/ /bdag gis mkhas pa'i rjes bsnyags la/ /bag ⑤yod gdams ngag dran byas te/ /gnyid dang rmugs pa bzlog par bya/ /rgyal sras thugs rje chen po ltar/ /rigs pa'i sran du gzugs bya ste/ /byis pa'i spyod pa btang byas nas/ /mdor na bdag dang gzhan rnams la/ /phan pa du'aba' zhig lhur bya'o/ /de ltar gdams ngag byas nas kyang / /bdag gis spyad par ma grub cing / /nyams kyis lcogs par ma gyur na/ /tshe rabs kun du phan pa yang pya / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas gsungs/ /sdig pa thams cad zad byed cing / /dge ba ma lus rdzogs byed pa/ /'di dag brjod pa'i bsod nams gang / /gal te de la gzugs yod gyur/ /gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi ni/ /'jig rten khams su shong mi 'gyur/ /tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu 'di/ /gtsug shelag khang ngam mchod khang ngam/ /mchod rten sku gzugs spyan snga 6'am/ /gzhan du'ang rung ste 115—635

'di skad brjod/ /nyin mtshan lan ni gsum gsum brjod/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang / /sgo gsum btud de skyabs su mchi'o①/ /mchod 'os rnams la phyag 'tshal lo /sdig pa'i las las bzlog bgyid cing / /bsod nams thams cad yongs su gzung / /lus can rnams kyi bsod nams dag /kun la rjes su yi rang ngo /bdag ni spyis btud thal sbyar te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor slad dang / /'gro gnas rab tu bzhugs slad du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol/ /de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams dang / /bdag gis bgyis dang ma bgyis gang //des ni sems can thams cad kyang / /bla med byang chub sems ldan shog /sems can thams cad dri med dbang / /yongs rdzogs mi khom kun 'das shing //spyod pa rang dbang yod pa dang / /'tsho ba bzang dang ldan par shog /lus can dag ni thams cad kyang / /lag na rin chen nyid ldan zhing / /yo byad thams cad mtha' yas pa④/ /'khor ba ji srid mi zad shog /bud med thams cad rnam kun du/ /phan tshun phrag dog 'gran sems dang / /rang bzhin bzang por skyes gyur nas/ /skyes mchog nyid du 'gyur bar ①shog /lus can thams cad rig pa dang / /rkang par ldan pa nyid du shog /lus can kha dog ldan pa dang / /gzugs bzang gzi brjid che ba dang / /blta na sdug cing nad med dang / /stobs can tshe dang ldan par shog /thams cad thabs la mkhas gyur te/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum la gzhol ba dang / /dmu rgod mi nag med par shog /gtsug lag khang dang dben gnas kyi/ /gnas dang nye bar gnas ④par shog /sangs rgyas 115—636

chos nor ldan pa dang / /tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa dang / /pha rol phyin drug ldan par shog /tshogs rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs te/ /mtshan dang dpe byad gsal ba dang / /bsam gyis mi khyab sa ①bcu dag /rgyun mi 'chad par bgrod par shog /bdag kyang yon tan de dag dang / /gzhan kun gyis kyang rgyan ②ldan te/ /nyes pa'i skyon las grol ①ba dang / /sems can kun mchog byams pa dang / /sems can thams cad yid re ④ba'i/ /bde ba thams cad rdzogs byed cing / /rtag tu lus can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal sel bar byed par shog /'jig rten kun na skye bo gang / /su dag 'jigs pas nyen pa rnams/ /bdag gi ⑤ming tsam thos pas kyang / /shin tu 'jigs pa med par shog /bdag ni mthong dang dran pa dang / /ming tsam thos pas skye bo rnams / /rab tu 'khrug med rnal ma dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub mkhas pa rnams| /tshe rabs kun du rjes bu'abrangs pa'i/ /mngon shes lnga po thob par shog /sems can kun la rnam ⑦kun du/ /rtag tu phan bde byed par shog /'jig rten kun na skye bo gang / /sdig pa byed par 'dod gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad gnod med par/ /rtag tu cig car zlog gyur cig /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /sman dang dgon pa'i shing bzhin du/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyis④/ /rang dgar dgag med spyod par shog /sems can la bdag srog bzhin phangs⑨/ /de dag bdag la ches phangs 7shog /bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ji srid sems can 'ga' zhig kyang / /gang na ma grol de srid du/ /de phyir bla na med pa yi—/ /byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig /bdag ni dge slong dpal 115—637

dbyangs kyis/ /gces ①pa'i phreng ba las bsdus pa'i/ /gdams ngag brtsam par ④byas pa yis/ /gdams ngag 'di ni sus thos pa/ /gdams pa'i rjes su spyod gyur nas/ /byang chub myur du thob par shog /bod la dge slong ming yang med pa las/ rje byang chub sems dpa' khri srong lde btsan gyis dam pa'i chos brnyes nas dpal lha btsan po dad pa bskyed de/ rab tu byung ba'i ming dpal dbyangs zhes bgyi/ btsun pa'i phul du phyin/ mdzangs pa'i zhi ①rab tu phyin/ bod kyi mdun sar bsres na dpe zla med pa des mdzad de/ btsan po la bka' gros dag gsol ba las/ la la ni gnang / la la ni ma gnang bas 'khon nas gyed ④de lhor bzhud/ gdams ngag 'di slar rje blon dang /ser chags yongs dang / bod rje 'bangs la brdzangs pa lags so/ /mjug ⑤'khon pas legs te/ btsun pas ni bzang po'i spyod pa rjo'agrub/ bod rje 'bangs ni grogs kyis dma' zhes gda'o/ /gdams dze+engag gces pa bsdus pa'i 'phrin zhuyig btsun pa dpal dbyangs kyis sngon nas las kyis ⑨'brel cing bshes par gyur pa bod rje 'bangs la brdzangs pa rdzogs so// //115—638

3601—༄ga /lta ba'i rim pa bshad pa bzhugs/①༄4/ /pad+ma'i spyan la phyag 'tshal nas/ /lta ba'i rim pa bshad par bya/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'das/ /gser gyi rdzas ltar gcig las snang / /rnam grangs snang ba lnga gsum gnyis/ /shes nas gzhag dang blang bar bya /thams cad byang chub snying po'i ②klong / /pad+ma 'khyil ba'i rang bzhin la/ /rang gi rtog rnyog ri bos mnan/ /rang rgyud rkyen gyis log snang ba 7/ /skye bo pa dang mu stegs pa/ /drug dhidang rtag chad snang bar byung / /dmus ⑤long tshul gyur skye bo yang 0/ /mtho yor mi ltar brtags snang ba/ /dmyal ba'i rang sems mi sogs snang / /yi dwags sdig sems mi gtsang yul/ /byol song gyen thur ngam grog snang / /mi la mjong yul 'di nyid snang / /de bzhin lha min go mtshon snang / /lha yi dge sems rin chen snang / /ci yang snang phyir mthong mi bden—/ /skye bo rtog pas phrogs pa yi④/ /rnam 'phrul phyi nang lta bur snang / /115—643

brtags pa brda yi tha snyad shar/ /rkyen gyis log ①tshul mu stegs pa/ /khrid byed drug gi bstan pas bslus/ /mdo bsdus mu stegs chad pa la/ /glo bur tsam snang mtha' med lta/ /rtag pa byas snang dngos por 'dod/ /de yang rgyu min rgyur smra ba/ /rang bzhin rgyur 'dod dbang phyug rgyu/ /ngo bo nyid la rgyur smra dang / /rdul phran rgyu ru 'dod pa dang / /byed po rgyu ru 'dod pa log /gzhan yang mu stegs zhar byung la ④/ /phyi rol pa dang yang dag pa/ /gsang sngags pa dang gsang chen pa/ /gnyis gsum lnga rnams rgyu yi tshul/ /gsum gnyis 'bras bu'i tshul snang ba/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa bzhi la ①lta/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lta ba yang / /cig shos lta ba las 'phags pa/ /nyan thos rang rgyal mdo sde dang / /kṛ ya u pa yang dag dang / /de bzhin yo ga'i theg pa dang / /ma hā yo ga'i theg pa dang / /a nu yo ga'i theg pa dang / /a ti yo ga'i theg pa dang / /chos tsam lta ba'i nyan thos pas/ /mdo sde pa dang bye brag gnyis/ /phyi rol yul la rtsod byed cing / /shes pa skad cig snang bar mthunaske/ /de bzhin rang rgyal theg pa pa/ /phyi rol bcu gnyis sgyu ma tsam/ /rdul yang phyogs chas ma grub 'phags/ /shes pa skad cig snang dang mthun/ /mtshan nyid zeg pa'ang rnam pa gsum/ /rnam rig pa dang rnal 'byor pa/ /de bzhin mdo sde dbu ma pa'o/ /rnam rig phyi rol mtho yor mi/ /srab mo rta ltar med bzhin du/ /rang gi rnam shes 'khrul snang 'dod/ /don dam ye shes skad cig 'dod/ /rnal 'byor dbu ma kun rdzob mthun/ /don dam stong pa ma skyes 'dod—/ /mdo sde kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam/ /yul rnams log ④nas snang bar lta/ /dam par mtha' gnyis bral ba yis⑤/ /dbu ma chen por 'dod pa'o/ /kṛ 115—644

yas don dam chos nyid lta①/ /kun rdzob rang rig yon tan lta④/ /rigs gsum dkyil 'khor snang ba la/ /skye bos ①'khrul pa med par 'dod/ /gnyis ka rgyud kyi spyod pa ni/ /lta spyod gong 'og rjes su mthunadu/ /yo ga'i ⑤don dam rnam dag pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su/ /rtogs rjopa'i byen rlabs lhar snang la/ /skye bos 'di dag lhar mthong 'khrul/ /ma hā yo ga'i dze+edon dam du/ /rang gnyis med de de bzhin nyid/ /rtogs pa'i cho 'phrul drug sogs pa'i/ /ltar skesnang ngang la 'khor ba med/ /a nu yo gas don dam du/ /bde chen rtogs pas rig ⑨pa'i rtsal/ /kun rdzob lha yi dkyil 'khor snang / /de phyir skye bos brtags pa 'khrul/ /a ti yo ga'i ⑫bden gnyis bral/ /thams cad rang byung rang snang ba'i/ /ye shes mtha' dbus bral ba la /brtags pa gnyis po gdod nas med/ /de phyir gser la gser mthong ltar/ /ji bzhin ma nor bden mthong yin/ /mnyam nyid rang bzhin ma nges pas /ji ltar bltas pa der snang phyir/ /dngos po rtag pa yod min te/ /yod na kun la mthun snang phyir/ /de phyir rang sems ngo bor snang / /brtags pa gcig yul gcig min ⑪pas/ /'khrul pa snang bar the tshom med/ /des na spyod yul gdod nas med/ /rtog sems 'gro ba so so'i sems/ /gcig na dge sdig rnam smin yang / /ma spyad kun gyis myong bar rigs/ /de min yang dag don mi rung / /rnam smin thun mong ma gyur phyir/ /gcig min de nyid ma skyes pas/ /tha dad don du'ang mi rung ste/ /gcig dang tha dad las grol ba'o//dngos po sna tshogs brtags pa yi/ /ming la grub pa'i gtan tshigs med/ /de phyir mtshan nyid ci yang min/ /ma grub pa la yod rtogs pa/ /sgyu ma'i skyes 115—645

bus shes 'gyur gyi/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis mi mkhyen no/ /snang bas spyod yul ma grub phyir/ /dmigs pa'i shes pa yod mi rung / /spyod yul ma skyes ye shes phyir| /bsgom bya'i chos nyid logs na med/ /sems kyi ye shes mtha' 'bral phyir/ /sgom pa po yang ga la yod/ /de ltar sgom mkhan dngos med na/ /mi gnas mi rtog ①'jog pa dang / /nam mkha' lta bu rang gsal ba'i/ /rang sems yong gis de lta'o/ /ci yang yid la mi byed na/ /yang dag don la phebs pa'i rigs/ /lus ngag ma skyes gzhi med phyir/ /skyil krung smra bcad kha na med/ /de bzhin sems kyang dngos bral bas/ /rtog spang sgom pa'i khar mi 'ong / /de ltar rtog skepa sgom pa'o/ /yal bar 'dug pa nam yang med/ /ci phyir bdag nyid de phyir bas/ /rang gi dbyings las g.yos pa med/ /rtog pa'i mtshan ma bzang dang ngan/ /ci skyes dgag par mi bya zhing / /de don dran pas 'bral ba'ang med/ /rang byung rang zhir nga smra'o/ /dper na rkun po tshor ma thag /ma bskrad ①'bros bzhin gdeng gis zhi/ /lta ba'i shugs las byung ba'i phyir/ /ched du tshor ba bstan mi dgos/ /de min blo yi ④skad cig tu/ /rnam rtog rang gi de nyid blta'o/ /bying ba shes pa ldang mi nus/ /rmugs pa don nyid mi gsal ba'o/ /byeng rmugs rab tu bying rmugs dang / /shin tu byeng rmugs phyir mi gtang ⑤/ /de bzhin rgod pa rnam rjopa gsum/ /le lo snyom ( las dman la sbyor/ /dogs pa gol dang lhung ba gnyis/ /re ba rtags dang 'bras bu'o/ /'khrug dang 'jug tu mi btub dang / /lus kyi bya byed spyod pa dga'—/ /ngag gi ca co smra dga' ba/ /yang dag don las ring ba'i phyir/ /bya byed grong yul gtam mi gleng dze+e/ /sbyin dang cho ga'i las mi bya/ /dge ba'i 115—646

las kyang g.yeng 'gyur na/ /sdog las mi bya smos ci dgos/ /nyams dang g.yo dang goms pa dang / /brtag pa'i nyams dang sbyar bar bya/ /don du 'di snyam bstan du med/ /de rtogs yang dag nyams dang ldan/ /de tshe phyi nang gsang ba'i drod/ /phyi nang rtags kyang rim pas 'byung / /skyes kyang dga' drod ①sems ma byed/ /med kyang de la mi dga' med/ /de dag g.yo dang thob brtan na/ /rim 'byung gsang sden dngos grub 'byung / /klu gsum ldan pa'i skyes mchog la/ /seng ge lta bur 'jig tshogs bral/ /zas dang nor gnyen ma chags shing / /snying rje chen po mi 'bral na/ /chos nyid don dang phrad pa'i rtags—/ /ci spyod don las ma nyams na/ /goms nas las su rung ba'i rtagasaske/ /'di ldan dbang phye btsums med na/ /snang ba gang yang mi bskyon ①zhing / /yid la bya ba med phyir ro/ /lus kyis rim par bzod thob dang / /chos brgyad spong len med pa dang / /gang la'ang nyon mongs mi skye na/ /'di yang sa la 'gro ba'i rtags/ /yid la byed med 'gags snang med/ /'du shes ma bzung rjorang gsal la/ /gang yang nyams su mi len cing / /sems kyis mngon par ma phyogs shing / /dmigs med tshul du rang snang ba/ /tha snyad tsam du bsgom zhes brjod/ /yang dag don gyi gdeng 7med par/ /tshig tsam lta la khungs chung zhing / /bya med chos la blo gtad nas/ /rtsing chos phaṭa ral spyod byed pa/ /rgyal ba'i bkas kyang mi skyobs te/ /ya nga'i 'bras bu the tshom med—/ /rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid brgyad ldan na/ /skyes bu de ni rgyal ba'i sras//gdeng bumed lta ba mtho 'dod pas/ /rang gi nga rgyal snyems byed pa/ /ri bos srog chags mnan pa ltar/ /nam yang thar ba'i khar mi 'byung / /gsang 115—647

602༄ga /gsung rab rin po che'i gtam rgyud dang shākya'i rabs rgyud bzhugs/①༄4/ /dkon mchog gi za ma tog las/ sems can 'khor ba las 'byung bar rtsol ba la bdud bar chad byed kyi mi rtsol ba la ni mi byed do zhes 'byung / sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo las/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis ②chos zab mo bshad pa dang / rab 'byor gyis khyod las dang po rjes su mi bsrung ba'i chos ston to zhes bya ba dang / 'jam dpal gyis nad gso ba'i phyir/ sman pas sman rtsa ba byin pa 'phral du bde bar bya ba'i phyir ma yin no zhes bya ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ma 'ongs pa na chos zab mo 'di la su dad pa nyan thos kyi theg pa can zhig na ni byams pa'i 'dus pa gsum gyi khongs su gtogs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa can zhig na ni bzod pa gang yang rung ba thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs/dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa'i mdo las/ ye shes mtha' yas pa ni phyogs bcu'i 115byed650

'jig rten rab 'byams ①thams cad du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las dang bzo gnas la ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims mi zad pa ni rgyun mi zad pa'i phyir blta bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ so so'i skye bo rnams kyi tshul khrims ni skye ba'i gnas rnams kyi zad par 'gyur ro/ /phyi rol gyi brda mngon par shes pa rnams kyis mngon par 'gyur ro/ /mi rnams kyi ni dge ba bcu'i las kyi ②lam zad pas so/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi lha'i bu rnams kyi ni bsod nams zad pas so/ /gzugs kyi khams kyi ni ①tshad med pa dang bsam gtan zad pas so/ /gzugs med pa'i lha rnams kyi tshul khrims ni ji lta bur snyoms par zhugs pa skyes pa zad nas zad par 'gyur ro/ /slob pa dang mi slob pa dang nyan thos thams cad kyi ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar ro rang sangs rgyas kyi ni snying rje chen po dang bral bas so/ /gzhan yang theg pa gnyis te/ lha'i theg pa dang mi'i theg pa'o/ /de la sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i byams pa ni/ sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi'o/ /chos la dmigs pa ni/ spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi'o//dmigs pa med pa'i byams pa ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa job pa ④rnams kyi'o//'khor los sgyur ⑤ba'i rgyal po rjorin po che sna bdun gyi sngon du 'gro ba ltar dbugs dbyung ba dang / rngub pa ni skyes bu'i srog gi dbang po'i sngon du 'gro ba'o / /byang chub sems dpa'i lha'i mig rnam par dag pa ni phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa na/ sems can gzugs med pa ma gtogs pa thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba dang las dang 'bras bu dang po'i rim pa shes pa'o/ /sbyin pa ni 115—651

chos dang zang zing ngo / /snyan par smra ba ni tshig 'jam pa'o/ /don spyod pa ni gzhan dag gi bsam pa bzhin rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /don mthun pa ni bdag yon tan du 'du shes pa'i theg pa de nyid la gzhan dgod pa'o/ /mdor na chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa ni tshig 'bru zhes bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi skad dang yi ge dang tshig 'brus brjod du med pa'i don ni ston to/ /skye ba dang 'gog pa la gnas pa ni rnam par shes pa'o/ /mi skye ba dang mi 'gog pa la gnas pa ni ye shes so/ /nges pa dang drang ba ①ni don dam pa dang kun rdzob bstan pa'o/ /gang zag ni skye bo'i ②gang zag gi sangs rgyas kyi bar brdas bstan te/ ①de dag la mngon par zhen pa ni ston pa ma yin no/ /chos nyid ni mnyam mo/ /'dod chags la ④spyod pa nyi khri chig stong de bzhin du zhe sdang dang gti mug dang cha mnyam la spyod pa ste/ spyir brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo / /sbyin pa bzhi ni ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur te/ chos smra ba rnams la sgyu ⑤gu dang /go ga la sogs pa sbyin pa dang / stan sbyin pa dang / rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / snyan pa sbyin pa rjodang / legs par gsungs so zhes bya ba sbyin pa'o//yang bzod pa bzhi ni ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur te/ chos tshol ba la ⑦brtson pas ngan du smra ba bzod pa dang / skemakhan po dang slob dpon dang mthun par 'jug pa'i bzod pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum la bzod pa'o/ /mi rtag pa'i don gang zhe na/ med pa'i don dang / mi chags pa'i don to/ /⑨dkon mchog 'byung gnas las/ bram ze'i rig byed las mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa ni 'gro ba gnyis te/ 'khor los sgyur ba dang / sangs rgyas so/ /sman ser 'di yis mig bskus na/ gzugs ci mjong ba thams cad 115—652

gser gyi kha dog tu mthong bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dpag tu med pa gang dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yang dhi 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'dis byang chub tu btsud do/ /za ma tog bkod pa las—/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis lha ma yin gyi dbang po gtor ma lung bstan / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spobs pa lta bu de bzhin gshegs pa la yang mi mnga' zhes 'byung / ri'i rgyal po de dag la rang sangs rgyas de dag gnas te/ mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa la sogs pa rnam pa du ma dag phan tshun smra'o/ /dge 'dun gyi las spyod pa'i mi 'os pa las spyod pa las sdig che ba 'byung / 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa las/ gang du sems dang yid dang rnam par rig pa 'jug na/ tha na mya ngan las 'das par sems pa yang rung ste/de thams cad nyon mongs pa'o/ /kha dog dang gzugs kyi ①rtags dang spyod lam gyi dbyebs ni byang chub sems dpa'i rab tu 'byung ba ma yin gyis sems can gzhan dang gang zag gzhan dag la byams pa dang / snying rje'i sems bskyed pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i rab tu 'byung ba yin no/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa las/ chos nyid la ①brten na mdo sde thams cad nges pa'i don yin no/ /'jig rten la brten na thams cad drang ba'i don yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i las ni gnyis so/ /sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su bzung ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa la gnas shing sa dgu par 'phar ba ④la byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ma 'dres pa bco brgyad yod/ chos de dag kyang ⑤mdo 'di nyid las 'byung / ma 'dres pa'i nang nas byang chub sems 115—653

dpa' la sems can gdug pa rnams kyis gnod pa byas kyang mi brdzi ①la/ gnod pa byas pa'i gzhi des sems can de yang ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims dag pa'i smon lam gyi dbang gi phyir ro/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi ④sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa las①/ rab tu byung ba'i yon tan bcu yod de/ 'dod pa la mi chags pa dang / dgon pa la dga' ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul 'thob pa dang / chung ma la sogs pa la sred par mi 'gyur ba dang / ngan 'gror 'go ba'i chos spong ba dang /bde 'go'i chos la brten rjopa dang / sngon gyi ⑤dge ba'i rtsa ba las yongs su mi nyams pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba phun sum tshogs pa 'thob pa dang / lha rnams dga' ba dang / mi ma yin pa rnams bsrung bar 'gyur ba'oX/ /sangs rgyas bdun gyi smon lam las/ sems can gyi rnam par shes pa gshin rje'i mis drangs te/ gshin rje'i mdun du khrid cing mi de dang lhan cig skyes pa'i lha phyi bzhin 'brang bas ⑦sems can des legs nyes ci byas pa thams cad legs par yi ger bris te/ gshin rje la phul ba dang / gshin rjes dris shing brtags nas/ de la ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du bsgo'o/ /mi shi ma thag tu sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od mchod na/ des zhag bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ sum cu rtsa lnga'am/ bzhi bcu rtsa dgu na dran te/ de phyin chad sdig pa mi byed do/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi ④sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi ⑨'khor dang bcas pa la/bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis ⑩bste 115—654

stang byas pa bas①/ byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba rab tu ④dben pa 'dod cing dgon pa'i logs su phyogs te①/ gom pa bdun bor na ches bsod nams che zhing / sangs rgyas su yang nye bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi phyogs ni bag yod pa la gnas so/ /byang chub ni nan tan la gnas so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing smon lam gyis grub po/ /gang gis sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyi mtshan brjod pa bas ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brjod pa bsod nams ches che na/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun du gzigs pa'i mtshan brjod pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la byang chub sems dpa' zhig gis khyod nam 'tshang rgya ④zhes dris pa dang / nam yang 'tshang mi rgya ba'i dper/ zla ba ni nyin mor 'gyur ba dang / nyin mo ⑤ni mtshan mor 'gyur ba dang / dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba na bdag 'tshang rgya'o zhes bshad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i bkod pa las/ bar gyi bskal pa nyi shu la bskal pa gcig go/ /de'i dubaskal pa bcu la bskal pa chen po gcig go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i gang zag khyim nas byung ba zhig gis mdo sde 'di gzung ba dang / bklag ⑦pa la sogs par mi rnyed la de la gal te la la zhig gis khyod khyim gyi gnas btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du 'dug phod na mdo sde 'di sbyin no zhes zer ladu/ gal te mdo sde rnyed pa lta ⑨na khyim gyi gnas btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na gnas kyang ldung ba med do/ /mi 'khrugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na tshe gcig gis dgra bcom par 'gyur te/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba zhes bya ba'i 'bras bu ming tsam ste/ sems can gyi ⑩ris der skye ba med do/ /de bzhin 115—655

gshegs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa las/ 'di lta ste/ las bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / klu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bsam gtan pa kyibasam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /rang gi lus kyang ras bcos bus dkris nas/ 'bru mar gyis bskus nas mar me 'bud do| /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'di de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin mig bzangs zhes bya bar gyur to/ /chos bzhi dang ldan na rgyal po la chos kyi rgyal po zhes bya ste/ byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba dang / gzhan dag kyang byang chub la bkod pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub tu bsngo ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi che ba mthong ngam thos na de la mos pa ma gtogs pa lha la sogs pa dang / nyan thos la sogs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa gang la yang ma mos pa'o/ /byams pa seng ge tog me tog pad+ma me tog skar ma rgyal spyad ②legs lag bzangs 'od skar ma la dga' ba/ mngon 'phags shes pa yon tan gyi mchog mnga' ba nor dpal ye shes 'byung gnas/ rin po che 'byung gnas kun du snang ba/yon tan mtha' yas grags pa mos pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa mos pa'i sku tshe dang nyan thos ni bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu kun bsdoms pa dang mnyam mo/ /de snyed kyi mdzad pa kun sangs rgyas ④mos pa gcig pus ④mdzad do/ /tshangs pa gtsug phud byang chub kyi rim gro ba'i lta gzi brjid kyi ⑤stobs zhes bya ba rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i zham ring na rjo'abrang ste/de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal zas snod du zed⑦/ gzugs med pa'i lha'i tshe bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong / sems can gang dag dgon pa'i gnas la chags pa de dag la byang chub sems dpa'i sems dbe+en par bya ba'i gtam bya'o/ /115—656

lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin gshegs pas yi ge gcig kyang ma brjod do zhes kho bos sngar ma bshad dam/ de lta mod kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ sems can rnams kyis dmigs so//chos kyi mdo bzhi rnam par gzhag ①ste/ dge sbyong dang / bram ze rtag par smra ba rnams dang / lha tshe ring po rtag par 'du shes pa rnams kyis gzhom pa'i phyir/'du byed thams cad mi rtag go zhes bya ba dang / lha dang mi bde bar 'du shes pa rnams kyi ④gzhom pa'i phyir 'du byed thams cad sdug bsngal lo zhes bya ba dang /mu stegs can bdag tu smra ba rnams kyi ①gzhom pa'i phyir chos thams cad bdag med pa zhes bya ba dang / rnam par rtog pa la spyod pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams kyi ④gzhom pa'i phyir/ mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba zhes bya'o⑤/ /rmi lam bstan pa las/ sa dgu pa dang bcu pa las rmi lam log par mthong ba med do| /phung po gsum pa rjolas kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir bklag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang gi rmi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos gos gsum char rnyed na de ni sa brgyad par blta'o/ /me tog gi ⑦tshogs las/ byang phyogs na yul gan dha ra zhes bya ba na lo 'bum du mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba 'dzin par 'gyur ba yod do/ /kha che'i yul nas khri phrag lnga/ byang phyogs nas bye ba phrag brgyad dang lnga 'bum/ shar phyogs nas brgya stong phrag mang po/ /lho phyogs su nyis 'bum/ nub phyogs nas 'bum/ rigs kyi bu gang de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi mtshan thos pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de la ma dad cing /yid ma ches nas/ de lta bur ga la 'gyur zhes tshig tu smras na/ lo stong phrag drug cur sems can dmyal ba chen po ⑧'o dod 'bod pa zhes bya bar 'tsho bar 115—657

'gyur ro/ /phyogs gang na bstan pa rab tu 'bar bar gyur pa de na/ dam pa'i chos spang ①ba'i skyes bu blun po shin tu mang bar gyur ⑦to/ /mi lus thob par dka' ste/ rus sbal dang gnya' shing gi dpes bstan pa 'byung / 'phags pa byams pa seng ge'i sgra chen po las/ 'bras bu ma thob par tha na dad pas byin pa chu snod gang tsam yang blang bar mi bya'o/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rab tu byung ba sdig pa can gyi 'dod pa bzhi ste/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas mthong bar 'dod pa/ 'khor los sgyur ⑪ba'i rgyal srid 'dod pa/ rgyal rigs 'dod pa/ bram ze'i rigs 'dod pa'o/ /gling bzhi pa'i sems can thams cad la bskal pa bas ④lhag par yo byad kun byin pa bas/ yang dag par zhugs pa tshul khrims yongs su dag pa 'tsho ba dag pa zhig gis ⑤sbyin pa po gang gis dad pas byin pa tha na chu snod gang tsam blangs na de bsod nams che'o/ /rab tu byung ba nyon mongs pa cha phra ba 'di dag dang ldan na/ mda' 'phangs pa bzhin dmyal bar 'go ste/ gzhan gyi rnyed pa la phrag dog dang / sdom pa dang ldan pa'i mdo sde thos na tshul khrims la smod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkas bslabs 0pa las 'gal na nga rgyal gyis mi 'chags ⑦pa dang / shes bzhin du yon bdag dad pas byin pa la spyod pa'o/ /rab tu byung ba rgyags pa 'di bzhi dang ldan na dmyal bar 'gro ste/ bzhi ni mang du thos pas rgyags nas bag med pa dang / rnyed pa dang / bkur stes ⑧rgyags pa dang / mdza' bshes ⑨dang / slong mo ster ba'i khyim gyis rgyags pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis rgyags nas bdag bstod/ gzhan la smod pa'o/ /chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpar khas 'ches te/ rnyed pa 'dod pa dang / bkur 115—658

ste ①'dod pa dang / g.yo byed pa dang / ya nga ba'i 'tsho bas 'tsho bar byed pa'o| /dus lnga brgya tha ma la byang chub sems dpar khas 'ches pa'i ②khyi'i chos kun tu spyod pa dag 'byung / dge slong khyim pa rnams su 'gro bar 'dod pas ni chos kyi skyes ma gtogs par skyes gzhan bskur ④bar mi bya/ khyim du song nas chos ma gtogs 'du 'dzi'i gtam mi bya/ ngas ni sngon byas pa'i las zad par bya ba'i phyir/ phung po gsum pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs gsungs/ byang chub sems dpa' ltar bcos pa kha cig sdig pa byas pa bshags pas 'byung ba'i sems kyis ④phyin chad sdom par mi byed/ nyin gcig la lan brgya bar du 'byung ba'i phyir spong ba ni bla'i/ tshul khrims ma dag pas dad pas byen pa la yongs su spyod pa ni de lta ma yin no/ /gal te khyed nyan thos gcig gi ⑤sems dag rnam par ⑦grol bar ma gyur du zin na ni ⑦'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed byed du bcug nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ⑧mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang 'gyur ro/ /khyim pas kyang phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ tshong dpon bzang skyong gis zhus pa las/ tshong dpon zla ba 'byor pa de la ni lha'i dbang po brgya byen gyi bde ba'i yo byad kyis kyang ci tsam du yang mi phod do/ /dper na dgra bcom pa 'gog pa'i stoms par zhugs pa'i rnam par shes pa'i khams de 'gog pa las 'das nas yongs su phyin pa de bzhin du/ rnam par shes pa'i khams 'di yang skye ba po shi ba'i lus yongs su btang zhing khams rnams bor nas/ nang gi gzugs dang ⑨phyi rol gyi gzugs yod de⑩/ nang gi ⑪gzugs ni zin pa'i mig gang yin pa ni phyi rol gyi gzugs so/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa gang yin 115—659

pa ni gzugs so/ /nang gi mig shes pa dang ldan pas rmi lam na gzugs mthong gi sha'i mig gis ni ma yin no/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo las 'di gnyis lo khrir dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bsgrubs pa bas/ gang zhig der snga dro gcig gi de ni de bas ches ①bsod nams mang du yang dag par smra ba'o/ /dkon mchog sprin las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni don dang bral ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos nyid thob pa'i phyir te/ rigs kyi bu chos nyid ma thob pa rnams kyi ni don dang 'bral ④bar 'gyur gyi/ chos nyid thob pa rnams kyis ni ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni tshig 'bru dang bral ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bstan bcos thams cad la 'jigs pa med pa'i phyir te/ rigs kyi bu bstan bcos kyi phyogs 'ga' shes pa rnams kyis ④ni tshig 'bru dang bral bar 'gyur gyi bstan bcos thams cad med par 'gyur ba buni ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni gang na gnas pas sangs rgyas skyes bu du ma 'bras bu med par 'gyur ba dang / sems can gyi don 'grib par 'gyur ba/ lha tshe ring po'i nang du mi skye'o—/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'dod pa'i khams nyid du gang sems can gdul bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas skyes pa mnyes par byar yod par skye'o//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni thabs mkhas pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi'o/ /'dul ba'o/ /tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa las/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na 'ga' zhig bskal pa brgya stong du tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa bas/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na gang snga dro'i dus gcig zhe sdang med par gnas pa bsod nams shin tu ⑤115byed660

che'o / /chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan la gnas nas/'dod pa'i khams su skye ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sems las su rung ba dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba stobs skyed ①pa dang / sems can yongs su mi gtong ba dang /thabs dang shes rab bsgom ⑧pa'o/ /gang rnams dngos po 'jig pa ①las 'gags pa ④de 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /smra bar gyur pa de dag ni lam log par zhugs pa ste/ nga ⑤yang de dag gi ston pa ma yin/ de dag ⑦yang nga'i nyan thos ma yin no/ /gal te sems can thams cad kyang / /theg pa dam pa 'dod 'gyur na/ /thams cad kyi yang go skabs yod/ /theg pa'i khyad par dag la ltos/ /dngos po ni mig ⑦gi rang bzhin gyis dben te/ gang chos thams cad mi sgom pa 'di ni lam sgom skepa'o/ /bskal pas bsreg pa ⑨na chu bran dang / rdzing bu dang mtsho la sogs pa sngar skam la phyis rgya mtsho chen po skam pa ltar dam pa'i chos nub pa'i tshe/ nyi tshe ba'i spyod pa la zhugs pa'i sems can rnams kyi chos sngar nub par 'gyur la/ phyis skyes bu dam pa blo gros rgya mtsho lta bu sangs rgyas kyi theg pa yang dag par 'dzin pa de dag gi lag nas dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho las byung ba/ /rin po ches ni spyorin chen sdud/ /ces bya bar bsngags pa/ bsreg ⑪pa'i bskal pa byung yang mi 'tshig ⑫ste/ /de yang 'jig rten 'jig tshe gzhan du 'gro/ /de bzhin dri ma med pa'i chos 'jig tshe/ /brtson 'grus mchog ldan de dag 'bad cing 'dzin/ /snod min 'jig rten chos min 'dod rig nas/ /khams pa rgyal ba gzhan gyi drung du 'gro/ /chos rnams ⑫'byung ba med pa bstan pa las/ /lan cig kho nas rgyal ⑫bar 'gyur ba min/ /rigs pa'i rim dang bya ba'i rim gyis 'thob/ /115—661

bskal pa khrag khrig bye ba grangs med du/ /go cha bgos pas 'thob kyi gzhan du min—/ /rigs kyi bu bdag bsrung bar 'dod pa des gzhan su'i spyod pa la yang brtag par mi bya ste/ 'di ni 'di 'dra'o/ /'di ni 'di 'dra'o zhes dbe+e bar mi bya'o/ /chos 'di thos shing mir 'gyur ba'i①/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga chags khyim pa'ang bla'i/ /bstan pa 'di la rab tu byung gyur zhing ②/ /dmigs lta sbyangs pa'i yon tan rlom pa min/ /'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi gzhus pa las/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ni sems dang po bskyed pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kun gyi rtsa ba'o/ /bsod nams ni sems bskyed ma thag tu sems can dang theg pa dman pa'i bsod nams zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /ye shes ni dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag bla na med par bsngo ba'o/ /shes rab kyi ye shes kyis ni sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su 'dor/ thabs kyi ye shes kyis ni sems can thams cad mi gtong ④ba ste/ tshig nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i phyir gshe yang slar mi gshe/ lus nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i phyir brdeg kyang slar mi brdeg /sems nam mkha' dang mtshungs pas spyo yang be+er mi spyo/ bsam pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pas khros kyang slar mi khro/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen rab tu rnyed pa'o/ /bsod nams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs su mi gtong ba'o/ /ye shes ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la kun dri bya'o/ /thos pa ni shes rab chen po'i rgyu ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal bas/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bsod nams kyis brgyan pa de la btsun mo yang brgyad khri bzhi stong bu yang brgyad khri bzhi stong yod do/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba ni sdig pa so sor 'chags pa'o/ /bsod nams ni dge ba'i rtsa 115—662

ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ /ye shes ni sangs rgyas thams cad la gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /shes rab gang ngoms de dag shin tu ngoms/byang chub kyi sems ni chos gnyis kyis bsdus na phyir mi ldog par gnas so/ /gnyis gang zhe na/ bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa'o/ /de la bsam pa ni g.yo med pa dang sgyu med pas bsdus so/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa ni de la chags pa dang khyad par du 'gro bas ①bsdus so/ /sems kyi dmigs pa ni bdud kyi yul te—/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ chos bzhi dang ldan na mi khom pa spong bar 'gyur te/ dkon mchog gi bsngags pa brjod pa dang / chos 'dod pa rnams g.yengs par mi byed pa dang / bdag gi 'gyod pa mi skye ba dang /gzhan gyi 'gyod pa sel ba'o/ /chos gnyis dang ldan pas mi dge ba'i chos rnams bsal nas mi dge ba'i chos 'gog par 'gyur te/ gnyis ni phung po gsum gyi bsngo ba dang ldan pa dang / bag yod par gnas pa'o/ /yang ba/nyis te—/ dge ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa dang / rnam par smin pa la mi re ba'o /chos brgyad dang ldan na rab tu byung ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i rigs kyis chog par 'dzin pa dang / sbyangs pa'i zhuyon tan dang yo byad bsdus ①pa mang du thos pa/ sems nges par sems la dga' ba/ byang chub pa'i bsam pa la ma rmongs pa dran pa mnyam par gzhag pas gnas pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab bsgom ④pa la brtson pa/ brtsams pa thams cad bsrung ba snying por byed pa/ 'khor gyi nang du 'ong ba (nyal zab mo'i chos kyi gtam gyi bar bgyid de gtam sna tshogs gleng ba gang yin pa de ni dam pa'i chos mi nub par bya ba'i tshuphyir brtson pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe 115—663

na—/ 'dzam bu'i ①gling 'dir ji srid zab mo'i chos grags ④pa de srid du chos nub par mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di'i gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya pa dang ji tsam ①gyi gling bzhi par gyur pa la de lta bu'i bye ba phrag brgya/ de na ④mi rnams bar ma dor 'chi ba med/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas tshul khrims yongs su rdzogs par ma byas te/ cho ga nyams pa ⑤dang / 'tsho ba nyams pa dang / tshul khrims nyams pa ni yongs su rdzogs par byas la/ de dag gi lta ba drang por 'gyur te/des na sems can dmyal ba rnams su mi skye'i/ klu'i skye dhiganas su skye bar 'gyur—/ byad bzhin bzang po la phrag dog mi byed pa de ni lus chen por 'gyur/bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' lding bzhis/ khye'u bzhi pa'i ting nge ⑦'dzin las/dbu ni shar phyogs/ zhal ni byang phyogs/ rgyab ni lho phyogs su bstan la glo g.yas pas phab/ drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa las/ nor gang gi ⑧yin pa de ni sbyin bdag yin no⑨/ /byed du bcug pas byin pa ni/ sbyin pa po yin gyi sbyin bdag ma yin no/ /gang rang gi dngos po bdag nyid kyis sbyin pa de ni sbyin pa po yang yin la/ sbyin bdag kyang yin no/ /dug dang mtshon cha dang srog chags bsad de sha dang / bag med pa rnams la chang sbyin pa dang / 'di dag ni bdag gi rim gro dang mchod par 'gyur ro snyam nas sems can bsdu ba dang / 'thob pa'i phyir bsdu bar sbyin pa ni ⑩spyin pa yongs su ma dag pa'o/ /rtsed mo la sogs pa bya ba'i phyir rol mo mkhan la sbyin pa byin pa ⑪ni yongs su ma dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun dang chos smra ba dang nad pa dang pha ma la sbyin pa byin pa ni sbyin pa bla na med pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs ⑫115—664

pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la mchod pa byed pa ni rnam par smin pa mtshungs so/ /dge ba byas pa ma'i mngal du skyes pa na zhag bdun gyi bar du/bdag de nas shi 'phos te 'dir skyes te las 'di lta bu zhig gis gyur to zhes bya bar dran no/ /mi dge ba byed pa yang de dang 'dra'o/ /lha phreng ba thogs pa dag gnyis kyis gnyis sprod kyi khu ba ni mi 'byung / bu mngal na zhag bdun gnas nas dku g.yas nas 'byung ngo / /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha 4bar dor 'chi ba'i dus mi byed/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha ag tshom 9dang spu thung ba(7/cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa las/ mngon par rtogs pa gcig tu 'dus pa la/bden pa bzhir yongs su brjod/ byang chub kyi gnas kyi rjes su 'jug pas/byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /rtsom 4 pa chen po nyams 5'og tu chud par byed pa dang / ye shes chen po yongs su rdzogs par byed pas/ sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyis geyongs su gzung )ba'i tshig gis sems can thams cad kyi nyes par smra ba zil gyis non par byed pa de lta bu ni chos smra ba yin no/ /sems can thams cad la 'dun cing mi dge ba mi byed pa ni nga rgyal med pa'o/ /bdag tshul khrims la gnas la/ sems can thams cad kyi 'gyod pa dang / kun nas sdang ba bsal ba'i phyir chos ston pa ni 'dul ba smra ba'o—/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ bdag dang sems can dang gang zag la sogs pa ni yang dag pa ma yin pa'o/ /byis pa thos pa dang mi ldan pas—/ bdag la sogs pa yongs su rtogs pa ni yang dag pa ma yin pa kun rtog pa'o/ /nga ni tshul khrims ldan zhes bdag ma bsnyems/ /'di ni tshul khrims ngan shezhes gzhan ma brnyas/ /tshul khrims tsam gyis gzhan la gang 115—665

brnyas pa/ /bsnyems phyir de ni tshul khrims 'chal zhes ①bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chags pa med pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi shing la sogs pa thams cad gcig tu srungs te/ bsregs la rgya mtsho chen por sbyangs nas②/ de las rdul blangs na 'di di 'di'o zhes bya bar yang mkhyen la chags pa yang mi mnga'o/ /rgyun du zhugs pa srid pa brgyad pa mngon par sgrub pa ni gnas ma yin no/ /tshe de nyid kyis g.yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa ni gnas yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la chos gos sor bzhi tsam gyis mi reg mod kyi/ rnam par 'thor rlung gis kyang bskyod par mi nus so//byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa rnams kyi byams pa ni sems can la dmigs pa'o/ /spyod pa la zhugs pa rnams kyi ni chos la dmigs pa'o/ /bzod pa thob pa rnams kyi ni dmigs pa med pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa ni sbyin pa nyung ngu yang mang por byed do/ /ye shes kyi stobs kyis ④lhag par byed do/ /shes rab kyis rgyas par byed do/ /bsngo bas dpag tu med par byed do⑤/ /gang zag sbyor rjob dman pa ⑦la mos pa rgya che ba yang yod/mos pa dman pa ⑧la sbyor ba rgya che ba yang yod/ bud med ni nyes pa mang ba sgyu ‘mkhas pa sems yang ba/ sems 'gyur ba sems mi brtan ⑩pa/ sems rab tu g.yo zhing mi brtan pa spre'u'i sems spre'u dang mtshungs pa ⑪sgyu ma ston pa la mkhas pa ste/ de'i phyir bud med ces bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa ni ldog pa bzhi bskyed de/ 'dod pa dang / srid pa dang / byas pa mi gzo ⑫ba dang / 'du byed du gtogs pa'i sdug bsngal las bzlog ⑫pa'o/ /theg pa chen po la zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bus/ bud med kha dog rgyas pa mthong na 115—666

'du shes bzhi bskyed ①par bya ste/ nyams par 'du shes pa dang / g.yang sar 'du shes pa dang / phyi sa khung du 'du shes pa dang / rnag tu 'du shes bskyed do/ /gal te de ltar brtags kyang 'dod chags skye ba lta na/ 'du shes gsum bskyed par bya ste/ ma 'dra ba la ma'i 'du shes dang / sring mo 'dra ba la sring mo'i 'du shes dang / bu mo 'dra ba la bu mo'i 'du shes bskyed do/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i bar du gcod pa dang / 'jig par byed pa ni dge slong sdig can las gzhan gang yang med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' ②khyim pa chos lnga dang ldan na sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes par mi byed/dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mi brten/ dal ba 'byor pa mi rnyed/ dge ba'i chos bsgrubs pa chud ①gzon/ sdom pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su mi slob 'tshang mi rgya'o④/ /lnga ni rgyal pos bkrab ⑤par 'gyur/ skye bo mang pos skrag par 'gyur 0la/ skye bo mang pos bdag cag gi 'di bgyir gsol zhes don bcol ba las bya bar khas 'ches 4 nas mi byed pa dang / dge slong dang dge slong ma dang dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma grong ngam/ ljongs sam yul lam pho brang 'khor du gnas par gyur pa la/ de dag gis tshul khrims nyams par byed pa dang / pha ma dang bu pho dang bu mo dang sring mo dang mdza' bo dang / nye du dang sems can gzhan yang rung ste/ chos byed pa'i bar chad byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa zab mo thos na ma dad cing kye/kha zer la gzhan yang de las 'dun ⑨pa bzlog pa dang / blon po'am 'khor gzhan stobs chen po la brten thokyecing / dbang phyug bstems pas skye bo mang po la gshe brgyad⑪/ 'phyas 'dogs 'be+eng ⑫slad byed do/ /rab tu 115—667

byung ba yang chos lnga dang ldan na de ltar 'gyur te/ lnga ni 'chal pa'i tshul khrims spyod pa dang / dam pa'i chos la smod pa dang / rnyed pa dang bkur ste dang /tshigs su bcad pa la chags pa dang / bdag tu lta ba'i zibs po dang / gzhan gyi khyim la phrag dog dang ser sna byed pa'o/ /ye shes kyi tshogs ni sbyin pa bzhi ste—/ chos smra ba la rim go dang / smyu gu dang / snag tsha dang / glegs bam sbyin pa dang / stan sna tshogs sbyin pa dang / bkur ste dang tshigs su bcad pa ①thams cad sbyin pa dang / g.yo med par legs so zhes bya ba sbyin pa'o—/ /de ②ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum ①du bzhugs pa ting nge 'dzin las/bu dang bu mo la dgrar 'du shes pa/ chung ma la sring mor 'du shes pa dang ④/'di ltar ma gus pas na dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig ting nge 'dzin 'di ni gzung ⑤'dod pas/ ngo mi rtag pa thams cad spang rjobar bya/nga ⑦yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi stong du ting nge 'dzin 'dzam bu'i khrugling na spyod par 'gyur te/ lo brgya pa tha ma phyi ma'i tshe/ phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya pa tha mar gyur pa/ dngos po'i 'du shes can gyis ⑨sangs rgyas mthong bar mi 'gyur—/ chos kyi 'du shes can gyis mthong bar mi 'gyur/ rnam par byun pa'i re bas gtong ba phun sum tshogs par mi 'gyur/ bsgom pa la mngon par dga' bas tshul khrims rnam par dag par mi 'gyur/ chos la ser sna byed pas mang du thos par mi 'gyur/ gang zag la brten pas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar ⑩mi 'gyur/ bre mo'i gtam la dga' bas bden pa mthong bar mi 'gyur—/ gnas la dga' bas 'bras bu thob par mi 'gyur/ rjes su chags pas skyon mthong bar mi 'gyur/ gnod sems la dga' bas nges par mi 'gyur/115—668
